In our work, we propose Play2Evolve, a recursive game development framework with three stages: Initialization, Refinement, and Evolution. Using playfulness as feedback, agents playtest the game and diagnose issues in its functionality, visual presentation, and gameplay. Their feedback guides bug fixes and asset improvements. It also helps agents propose new gameplay and aesthetic goals for continued game evolution. To enrich game materials, we combine a video generation model with code to create appealing static and dynamic assets and integrate them into interactive gameplay. Finally, Play2Evolve achieves state-of-the-art performance among the evaluated methods, scoring 60.05 on GameCraft-Bench compared with 50.81 after Game Initialization and 52.46 for Play2Code. Human overall-quality ratings reach 3.67, compared with 2.38 and 2.43, respectively. Our code will be released at this https URL.

translation.title: 以趣味性作为反馈的智能体游戏开发
translation.abstract: 编程智能体可以根据自然语言描述生成可运行的游戏。然而，可运行的游戏并不能保证为玩家提供出色的游戏体验。我们认为，一个有趣的游戏应提供：1）可靠的核心功能，2）吸引人的视觉设计与素材，3）支持探索与进程推进的丰富玩法。智能体如何改善这些趣味性方面仍待探索。在本工作中，我们提出 Play2Evolve，一个包含初始化、精化和演化三个阶段的递归游戏开发框架。以趣味性作为反馈，智能体对游戏进行试玩，诊断其功能、视觉呈现和玩法中的问题。它们的反馈指导缺陷修复和素材改进，还帮助智能体提出新的玩法和美学目标以推动游戏持续演化。为丰富游戏素材，我们将视频生成模型与代码相结合，创建吸引人的静态和动态素材，并将其集成到交互式玩法中。最终，Play2Evolve 在所评估的方法中取得最先进性能，在 GameCraft-Bench 上得分60.05，而游戏初始化后为50.81，Play2Code 为52.46。人类整体质量评分达到3.67，而两者分别为2.38和2.43。我们的代码将在此 https URL 发布。
translation.brief: 针对编程智能体生成的游戏缺乏趣味性的问题，提出以趣味性为反馈的递归框架Play2Evolve，通过智能体试玩诊断并结合视频生成模型迭代改进游戏功能、素材与玩法。

papers.title: AI-human hybrid conversations: Can AI Agents Improve Discourse Quality?
papers.abstract: Conversations are central to how people exchange information, share experiences, and develop collective understanding. Yet, across conversational settings, discussions often suffer from uneven participation, unanswered contributions, and a narrow range of perspectives. As generative AI agents increasingly participate alongside humans, hybrid human-AI conversations present a new opportunity to address these challenges. We investigate whether AI agents can serve as catalysts for human interaction, improving conversational engagement and broadening collective discourse. We develop a framework for introducing generic and persona-conditioned AI agents into evolving discussions and evaluate it through two complementary studies. First, using agent-based simulations grounded in Reddit discussions across four domains, we find that AI-generated conversations are more positive and less toxic than human conversations, but substantially less semantically diverse. Persona conditioning produces more human-like contributions and narrows this diversity gap, while increasing the representation of underrepresented personas can shift which perspectives emerge without necessarily increasing overall diversity. Second, we conduct a pre-registered experiment with 221 participants across nine discussion threads, comparing human-only conversations with those involving generic or persona-conditioned AI agents. We find that AI participation increases responsiveness, reduces unanswered contributions, and broadens the range of ideas expressed by human participants, even though the AI agents themselves do not fully reproduce human conversational diversity. These findings suggest that the value of hybrid human-AI conversations lies not simply in the content AI agents generate, but also in their potential to stimulate more responsive and diverse interactions among humans.

translation.title: AI-人类混合对话：AI智能体能提升话语质量吗？
translation.abstract: 对话是人们交换信息、分享经验和形成集体理解的核心方式。然而，在各种对话场景中，讨论常常存在参与不均、发言无人回应以及视角范围狭窄的问题。随着生成式AI智能体日益与人类共同参与，人机混合对话为应对这些挑战提供了新机遇。我们研究AI智能体能否作为人类互动的催化剂，提升对话参与度并拓宽集体话语范围。我们开发了一个将通用型和角色设定型AI智能体引入动态演化讨论的框架，并通过两项互补研究进行评估。首先，基于Reddit四个领域讨论的智能体仿真表明，AI生成的对话比人类对话更积极、毒性更低，但语义多样性显著更低。角色设定能产生更接近人类的发言并缩小这一多样性差距，而增加代表性不足角色的呈现可以改变涌现的视角，但不一定提升整体多样性。其次，我们开展了一项预先注册的实验，221名参与者分布在九个讨论主题中，比较纯人类对话与包含通用型或角色设定型AI智能体的对话。我们发现，AI参与提高了回应性，减少了无人回应的发言，并拓宽了人类参与者表达的想法范围，即使AI智能体本身并未完全复现人类对话的多样性。这些发现表明，人机混合对话的价值不仅在于AI智能体生成的内容，还在于其激发人类之间更具回应性和多样性的互动的潜力。
translation.brief: 针对人类讨论中参与不均、发言无人回应和视角狭窄的问题，通过仿真与预注册实验研究引入通用型和角色设定型AI智能体能否提升混合对话的参与度与话语多样性。

papers.title: Dynamic Reasoning in Next-Gen Detection and Response: An Empirical Study of LLM Triage, Reinforcement Tuning, and Adversarial Evasion
papers.abstract: We present an end-to-end empirical study of dynamic reasoning in next-generation detection and response pipelines, evaluating how static classifiers, graph-based signal fusion, and large language model (LLM) triage agents perform under strict human-analyst attention budgets (Recall at B alerts/day). Across 56 reproducible experiments spanning a multi-layer enterprise-and-cloud simulator and four public datasets (SOREL-20M, BODMAS, LANL, and DARPA Transparent Computing), we test twelve architectural claims governing modern fleet-scale defense. First, we show that fleet growth halves recall at a fixed analyst budget even at negligible compute cost (<$0.0003 per million events), and that rarity-weighted graph risk propagation outperforms GraphSAGE without neural training. Second, evaluating frontier reasoning models (Gemini) and fine-tuned open-weight models (Qwen3-4B) for alert triage reveals that unconstrained LLM auto-closure eliminates 90% of false positives while silently discarding 31-44% of true attack cases. Third, post-training with Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO) causes severe reward hacking on unseen attack classes, suppressing up to 86% of novel attacks compared to two-epoch supervised fine-tuning. Finally, against an adaptive adversary generating plausible cover stories in benign telemetry fields, LLM triage evasion rises sharply unless gated by a deterministic policy harness prior to model invocation.

translation.title: 下一代检测与响应中的动态推理：LLM 分诊、强化调优与对抗规避的实证研究
translation.abstract: 我们对下一代检测与响应流水线中的动态推理进行了端到端实证研究，评估静态分类器、基于图的信号融合以及大语言模型（LLM）分诊代理在严格的人类分析师注意力预算（Recall at B alerts/day）下的表现。在涵盖多层企业与云模拟器以及四个公开数据集（SOREL-20M、BODMAS、LANL 和 DARPA Transparent Computing）的 56 个可复现实验中，我们检验了支配现代大规模防御的十二项架构主张。首先，我们表明即使计算成本可忽略不计（每百万事件不到 $0.0003），在固定分析师预算下，机群规模增长会使召回率减半，且稀有度加权的图风险传播无需神经训练即可优于 GraphSAGE。其次，对前沿推理模型（Gemini）和微调开源权重模型（Qwen3-4B）进行告警分诊评估后发现，无约束的 LLM 自动关闭可消除 90% 的误报，但会悄悄丢弃 31-44% 的真实攻击案例。第三，使用 Group Relative Policy Optimization（GRPO）进行后训练会在未见过的攻击类别上引发严重的奖励作弊，与两轮监督微调相比，最多抑制 86% 的新型攻击。最后，面对在良性遥测字段中生成貌似合理掩护说辞的自适应攻击者，除非在模型调用前由确定性策略框架进行门控，否则 LLM 分诊的规避率会急剧上升。
translation.brief: 研究 LLM 在安全告警分诊中的动态推理问题，通过 56 个可复现实验评估静态分类器、图信号融合、GRPO 后训练及对抗规避的表现。

papers.title: DevEx is for Humans, AX is for Agents: Measuring Context Health in Agentic Software Work
papers.abstract: Coding agents succeed or fail in the context humans give them, yet most evaluations measure only output. Drawing on developer experience research, we introduce Agent Experience (AX), an instrument that scores session transcripts on four dimensions of the CAFE(S) framework: Clarity, Actionability, Fidelity, and Efficiency; Security, a gate rather than a friction dimension, is out of scope. A rubric-guided language model rates each dimension from 1 to 5 and explains what the human could have provided. We report on three studies that tested this model. In the Stack Overflow Developer Survey, respondents reporting context problems were less likely to rate AI as very useful in all seven activities examined (12-28%). Across 882 rated agentic sessions from a pilot sample of 1,000, Actionability received the lowest ratings (59.6% of ratings at or below 3, versus 26.6% for Fidelity), and ratings were lower in longer sessions. One researcher's unblinded review of 15 randomly sampled sessions found all scores reasonable and explanations supported. In a controlled scenario, we injected context defects into one data-analysis task and ran it twelve times. Every defect condition used more tokens than the clean baseline (mean +91%), and five evaluator models flagged 50-85% of targeted dimensions and 14-36% of non-targeted dimensions. Fidelity defects were detected most consistently and Actionability defects least. Because interventions were imperfectly isolated, these results are exploratory. AX gives teams structured, actionable evidence about context-related friction that complements output and outcome measures.

translation.title: DevEx 面向人类，AX 面向代理：度量智能体软件工作中的上下文健康度
translation.abstract: 编码智能体的成败取决于人类提供的上下文，但大多数评估只衡量输出。借鉴开发者体验研究，我们提出 Agent Experience（AX），一种基于 CAFE(S) 框架的四个维度——Clarity、Actionability、Fidelity 和 Efficiency——对会话记录进行评分的工具；Security 作为门槛而非摩擦维度，不在范围内。一个由评分细则引导的语言模型对每个维度打 1 到 5 分，并解释人类本可以提供什么。我们报告了检验该模型的三项研究。在 Stack Overflow 开发者调查中，报告上下文问题的受访者在所有七项活动中都更不可能认为 AI 非常有用（12-28%）。在来自 1,000 个试点样本的 882 个评分智能体会话中，Actionability 得分最低（59.6% 的评分不超过 3，而 Fidelity 为 26.6%），且会话越长评分越低。一位研究者对随机抽取的 15 个会话进行非盲审查，发现所有评分合理且解释有据。在一个受控场景中，我们向一个数据分析任务注入上下文缺陷并运行十二次。每个缺陷条件都比干净基线消耗更多 token（平均 +91%），五个评估模型标记了 50-85% 的目标维度和 14-36% 的非目标维度。Fidelity 缺陷被检测得最一致，Actionability 缺陷最少。由于干预未能完全隔离，这些结果属于探索性。AX 为团队提供关于上下文相关摩擦的结构化、可操作的证据，补充输出和结果度量。
translation.brief: 针对编码智能体评估只看输出而忽视上下文质量的问题，提出基于 CAFE(S) 框架四维度的 Agent Experience（AX）评分工具来度量会话上下文健康度。

papers.title: Benchmarking Open-Ended Vulnerability Discovery in Windows Kernel Binaries
papers.abstract: Frontier models are increasingly used to discover real-world security vulnerabilities, making it critical to systematically evaluate their cybersecurity capabilities. However, existing security benchmarks primarily focus on known vulnerabilities in open-source projects, largely overlooking closed-source binaries, which underpin much of the software industry. In this paper, we ask: how effective are frontier models at uncovering deep vulnerabilities in production binaries? To answer this question, we present DeepBinary, the first comprehensive benchmark for open-ended vulnerability discovery in Windows kernel binaries. Given a target binary, an agent analyzes it using a disassembler and kernel debugger in network-isolated VMs and reports each vulnerability with a crashing proof of concept (PoC). Unlike existing benchmarks, DeepBinary replays every report on fresh VMs and employs an LLM-based judge to assess its validity, uniqueness, and impact (estimated by bug bounty values). Beyond known vulnerabilities, DeepBinary also enables the discovery and validation of previously unknown (0-day) vulnerabilities. We conduct a comprehensive evaluation of representative open- and closed-weight models (including GPT-6 Sol, Claude Opus 5, and DeepSeek V4.1 Flash) across diverse coding agents (including Codex and Claude Code) on 12 target binaries. In total, they discover over 200 vulnerabilities with an estimated aggregate bounty of $661,000, including 146 distinct previously unknown vulnerabilities across all experiments. Our results further reveal substantial differences in models' ability to analyze binaries, conduct experiments, and sustain vulnerability discovery over long horizons. Overall, DeepBinary makes long-horizon, open-ended vulnerability discovery in complex binaries measurable, revealing fundamental differences in how frontier models analyze and explore such systems.

translation.title: Windows 内核二进制文件中开放式漏洞发现的基准测试
translation.abstract: 前沿模型越来越多地被用于发现真实世界的安全漏洞，因此系统性地评估其网络安全能力至关重要。然而，现有的安全基准主要关注开源项目中的已知漏洞，很大程度上忽视了支撑软件行业大部分的闭源二进制文件。在本文中，我们提出问题：前沿模型在生产二进制文件中发现深层漏洞的效果如何？为回答这一问题，我们提出 DeepBinary，首个针对 Windows 内核二进制文件开放式漏洞发现的综合基准。给定一个目标二进制文件，智能体在网络隔离的虚拟机中使用反汇编器和内核调试器进行分析，并为每个漏洞提交可导致崩溃的概念验证（PoC）。与现有基准不同，DeepBinary 在全新虚拟机上重放每份报告，并使用基于 LLM 的评判器评估其有效性、独特性和影响（以漏洞赏金价值估算）。除已知漏洞外，DeepBinary 还支持发现和验证此前未知的（0-day）漏洞。我们在 12 个目标二进制文件上，对代表性开源与闭源权重模型（包括 GPT-6 Sol、Claude Opus 5 和 DeepSeek V4.1 Flash）在多种编码智能体（包括 Codex 和 Claude Code）下进行了全面评估。它们总共发现了 200 多个漏洞，估计累计赏金为 661,000 美元，其中所有实验共包含 146 个不同的此前未知漏洞。我们的结果还揭示了模型在分析二进制文件、进行实验以及长时间持续漏洞发现能力上的显著差异。总体而言，DeepBinary 使复杂二进制文件中的长时程、开放式漏洞发现变得可度量，揭示了前沿模型分析和探索此类系统的根本差异。
translation.brief: 针对安全基准忽视闭源二进制文件的问题，提出 DeepBinary 基准，让智能体在隔离虚拟机中用反汇编器和内核调试器对 Windows 内核二进制进行开放式漏洞发现并用 LLM 评判器验证报告。

papers.title: Evaluating Large Language Models on conversational African American English: Feature classification and next-turn generation
papers.abstract: Large Language Models (LLMs) are known to misinterpret and misrepresent regional and social varieties of English other than Mainstream American English (MAE), such as African American English (AAE), yet most evaluations of these biases have relied on synthetic, stylized or decontextualized data. This paper instead evaluates LLMs on authentic, conversational AAE to more closely reflect how such models may encounter AAE when deployed as chatbots. Concretely, we perform two complementary evaluation tasks on 100 six-turn segments randomly sampled from the Corpus of Regional African American Language (CORAAL; Kendall and Farrington, 2024), comparing three closed-weight LLM configurations: Gemini 2.5 Flash with and without reasoning, and GPT-4.1 mini. The first task compares the models against gold-standard manual annotations for five AAE morphosyntactic features, while the second assesses their ability to generate contextually appropriate next turns, evaluating outputs for AAE feature frequency, diversity (Self-BLEU), and pragmatic quality. Reasoning-enabled Gemini is the strongest feature detector by a clear margin (macro F1 of 0.91), outperforming both other LLMs as well as a finetuned BERT-based baseline (Masis et al., 2022). In generation, however, all LLMs underproduce AAE relative to the human speakers and produce relatively uniform continuations, with reasoning-enabled Gemini producing the least AAE and the least diverse output. We conclude that a model's ability to detect AAE does not straightforwardly translate into its spontaneous use of AAE in generation, and argue that addressing this gap requires changes upstream, in how pretraining and alignment data represent dialectal variation.

translation.title: 评估大语言模型对会话式非裔美国人英语的处理：特征分类与下一轮生成
translation.abstract: 众所周知，大语言模型（LLM）会误解和误表述主流美国英语（MAE）之外的区域和社会英语变体，如非裔美国人英语（AAE），但大多数此类偏见评估依赖合成、风格化或脱离语境的数据。本文转而在真实的会话式 AAE 上评估 LLM，以更贴近此类模型作为聊天机器人部署时可能遇到 AAE 的方式。具体而言，我们从区域非裔美国人语言语料库（CORAAL；Kendall and Farrington, 2024）中随机抽取 100 个六轮对话片段，执行两个互补的评估任务，比较三种闭源权重 LLM 配置：带推理和不带推理的 Gemini 2.5 Flash，以及 GPT-4.1 mini。第一个任务将模型与五项 AAE 形态句法特征的黄金标准人工标注进行比较，第二个任务评估其生成语境恰当的下一轮对话的能力，从 AAE 特征频率、多样性（Self-BLEU）和语用质量方面评估输出。启用推理的 Gemini 以明显优势成为最强的特征检测器（macro F1 为 0.91），优于其他两个 LLM 以及基于 BERT 的微调基线（Masis et al., 2022）。然而在生成方面，所有 LLM 相对于人类说话者都产出更少的 AAE，且生成内容相对单一，其中启用推理的 Gemini 产出的 AAE 最少、多样性最低。我们得出结论：模型检测 AAE 的能力并不能直接转化为其在生成中自发使用 AAE 的能力，并认为弥合这一差距需要在上游进行改变，即在预训练和对齐数据中如何表征方言变异。
translation.brief: 针对 LLM 偏见评估依赖合成数据的问题，在真实会话式 AAE 语料上通过特征分类和下一轮生成两项任务评估三个 LLM，发现检测能力不等于生成能力。

papers.title: LogToPersona: New Benchmark and Efficient Persona Prediction through Semantic Log Filtering
papers.abstract: Detailed knowledge of a user's persona is valuable for personalizing generative AI models and agents, yet such details are difficult to obtain and change over time. We address the task of inferring persona attributes from a single day of mobile activity logs. No suitable publicly available benchmark exists for this task, so we introduce a synthetic benchmark of 1,600 persona-log pairs. We target on-device inference so that raw logs never leave the phone, which makes memory rather than speed the limiting constraint: a day of activity yields roughly 30K tokens, whose key-value cache alone exceeds the INT4 weights of a 4B-parameter model. We therefore propose a log filtering method that retains only behaviorally distinct entries. Filtering reduces the memory footprint by up to 39% across nine models from four families and more than halves prefill time, while maintaining or improving prediction quality. For Qwen3-4B it removes 2.5GB, bringing the model from well beyond a realistic per-process budget to a manageable one. Within our benchmark, these results indicate that preserving diverse behavioral events matters more for persona prediction than retaining every semantically similar log entry.

translation.title: LogToPersona：通过语义日志过滤实现新基准与高效人格属性预测
translation.abstract: 详细了解用户的人格属性（persona）对于个性化生成式 AI 模型和智能体很有价值，但这些细节难以获取且随时间变化。我们研究从单日移动活动日志推断人格属性的任务。该任务没有合适的公开基准，因此我们引入了一个包含 1,600 对人格-日志的合成基准。我们面向端侧推理，使原始日志永不离开手机，这使得内存而非速度成为限制性约束：一天的活动产生约 30K token，仅其键值缓存就超过一个 4B 参数模型的 INT4 权重。因此我们提出一种日志过滤方法，仅保留行为上有区分度的条目。过滤使来自四个系列的九个模型的内存占用最多降低 39%，prefill 时间减半以上，同时保持或提升预测质量。对于 Qwen3-4B，它减少了 2.5GB，使模型从远超现实的单进程预算降至可管理的水平。在我们的基准内，这些结果表明，对人格预测而言，保留多样化的行为事件比保留每条语义相似的日志条目更重要。
translation.brief: 针对从单日移动日志推断用户人格属性缺乏基准且端侧内存受限的问题，构建 1,600 对合成基准并提出仅保留行为上有区分度条目的语义日志过滤方法以降低内存占用。

papers.title: Learning to Reason in Real-Time
papers.abstract: AI agents that operate in the real world must reason correctly and on-time, yet they currently do not account for how time should alter their reasoning. Modern agents learn to do tasks in environments that are entirely synchronous: where the world waits for the agent to act before changing. A real-time environment, by contrast, changes independent of the agent. Existing approaches try to bridge this gap by imposing a ratio of thinking to acting. However, for an agent to succeed in real-time it must learn to act quickly when delay is costly and to reason longer when the benefit outweighs the missed opportunities. To this end, we introduce real-time reasoning training (RRT) as the class of training techniques for real-time reasoning agents. We develop three standard RRT techniques: (1) using real-time data, (2) decoupling acting and observing, and (3) curriculum learning in time. Together, these simple techniques substantially outperform strong baselines. Across time pressures, we outperform the strongest non-RRT baseline by an average of 33% reward on in-distribution and 55% reward on out-of-distribution tasks in two real-time environments: Frogger and Snake. These results demonstrate that we can teach agents to balance reasoning and responsiveness under real-time constraints, and that RRT opens a broad, new set of capabilities for real-time agents.

translation.title: 学习实时推理
translation.abstract: 在真实世界中运作的 AI 智能体必须正确且按时地进行推理，但目前的智能体并未考虑时间应如何改变其推理方式。现代智能体在完全同步的环境中学习执行任务：即世界会等待智能体行动之后才发生变化。相比之下，实时环境独立于智能体而变化。现有方法试图通过强加思考与行动的比例来弥合这一差距。然而，智能体要在实时环境中取得成功，必须学会在延迟代价高昂时迅速行动，而在收益超过错失机会的代价时进行更长时间的推理。为此，我们提出实时推理训练（RRT），作为面向实时推理智能体的一类训练技术。我们开发了三种标准 RRT 技术：（1）使用实时数据，（2）解耦行动与观察，（3）在时间维度上进行课程学习。这些简单的技术组合在一起大幅超越了强基线。在两种实时环境 Frogger 和 Snake 中，跨越不同时间压力，我们在分布内任务上比最强的非 RRT 基线平均多获得 33% 的奖励，在分布外任务上多获得 55% 的奖励。这些结果表明，我们可以教会智能体在实时约束下平衡推理与响应能力，并且 RRT 为实时智能体开辟了广泛的新能力。
translation.brief: 解决智能体在实时环境中无法根据时间压力调整推理时长的问题，提出实时推理训练（RRT），通过实时数据、行动与观察解耦及时间课程学习三种技术训练智能体。

papers.title: Evaluation and Restoration of Safety in Reasoning-Tuned LLMs
papers.abstract: Open-source LLMs that are optimized for reasoning, such as VibeThinker, aim to democratize AI by bringing high-capability models to users with limited resources. They are broadly available but lack regulation and external guardrails; therefore, in order to integrate them safely into human society, it is critical that they perform in a safe manner. There are popular and intuitive arguments for why improved reasoning should improve safety, but recent evidence suggests that, in fact, the opposite may be true. This paper aims to characterize and mitigate this issue. First, it develops a metric for evaluating LLMs optimized for reasoning, and shows that increasing reasoning across multiple model families increases the unsafe rate in all cases. Second, it proposes a method for restoring safety by combining evolution strategies with a post-training guardrail (ESPG). Compared to alternative methods for safety post-training such as GRPO, ESPG is simple to implement, requires no GPU memory beyond that of inference, and works with remarkably few training samples (e.g.\ 30), yet makes the model significantly safer. The study thus establishes a path towards safe post-training of open-source AI models.

translation.title: 推理优化 LLM 的安全性评估与修复
translation.abstract: 为推理而优化的开源 LLM（如 VibeThinker）旨在通过将高能力模型带给资源有限的用户来实现 AI 的民主化。它们广泛可得，但缺乏监管和外部防护；因此，为了将其安全地融入人类社会，它们必须以安全的方式运行。关于改进推理能力应能提升安全性的流行且直观的论点很多，但最近的证据表明，事实可能恰恰相反。本文旨在刻画并缓解这一问题。首先，本文开发了一个用于评估推理优化 LLM 的指标，并表明在多个模型家族中增强推理能力都会提高不安全率。其次，本文提出了一种将进化策略与训练后防护相结合的安全修复方法（ESPG）。与 GRPO 等其他安全后训练方法相比，ESPG 实现简单，除推理外不需要额外的 GPU 显存，且只需极少的训练样本（例如 30 个）即可显著提升模型安全性。因此，本研究为开源 AI 模型的安全后训练开辟了一条路径。
translation.brief: 解决推理优化使 LLM 安全性下降的问题，提出将进化策略与训练后防护相结合的 ESPG 方法，用极少样本恢复模型安全性。

papers.title: PRECEPT: Security Self-Improvement of Coding Agents via Evolving Principles
papers.abstract: AI coding agents increasingly write and submit code with limited human review, and much of it passes functional tests while remaining insecure. We show that these failures persist. Across 14 task sequences, Codex, Claude Code, and Qwen Code fixed a vulnerability 85.7% of the time when shown the failing security test, then reintroduced the same vulnerability class in a new session 26.7% of the time, about as often as agents that had never seen it (27.5%). The capability is present; the retention is not. Neither recording the repair in the agent's persistent context nor supplying published secure coding principles closed the gap: the recorded fix stayed tied to the family of the task it came from, and the principles, written for human developers, remained too general to apply to the code at hand. The knowledge exists; it is not activated. We call the missing ability security self-improvement: an agent learns from its own security failures so that each lesson persists across sessions, applies to new code, and does not break what works. We present PRECEPT, which equips coding agents with this ability through an evolving library that starts from authoritative secure coding principles and revises them against the agent's own failures, so that each principle comes to fire on the code where that agent actually goes wrong. A revision is kept only if fresh executions show it makes code more secure while keeping functional success within a small tolerance of the agent without the library. Improvement continues across evolution steps rather than saturating after the first. On task families never seen during evolution, PRECEPT's weakest agent reaches 97.1% secure working code, above the strongest unaided agent at 81.9% and the strongest baseline at 87.7%.

translation.title: PRECEPT：通过演化原则实现编码智能体的安全自我改进
translation.abstract: AI 编码智能体越来越多地在有限人工审查下编写并提交代码，其中许多代码通过了功能测试却仍不安全。我们证明这些失败会持续存在。在 14 个任务序列中，Codex、Claude Code 和 Qwen Code 在看到失败的安全测试时修复漏洞的比例为 85.7%，但在新会话中重新引入同类漏洞的比例为 26.7%，与从未见过该漏洞的智能体（27.5%）几乎相同。能力是存在的，但记忆保持不存在。无论是将修复记录在智能体的持久上下文中，还是提供已发布的安全编码原则，都无法弥合这一差距：记录的修复始终局限于其来源任务的家族，而那些为人类开发者编写的原则过于笼统，无法应用于眼前的代码。知识是存在的，只是未被激活。我们将这种缺失的能力称为安全自我改进：智能体从自身的安全失败中学习，使每一条经验都能跨会话保持、适用于新代码，且不破坏已有的有效功能。我们提出 PRECEPT，通过一个不断演化的库为编码智能体赋予这种能力：该库从权威的安全编码原则出发，并根据智能体自身的失败对其进行修订，使每条原则都能在该智能体实际出错的代码上触发。只有当新的执行结果表明修订使代码更安全、同时功能成功率保持在无库智能体的较小容差范围内时，修订才会被保留。改进在演化步骤中持续进行，而非在首次之后饱和。在演化期间从未见过的任务家族上，PRECEPT 最弱的智能体达到 97.1% 的安全可用代码率，高于最强的无辅助智能体（81.9%）和最强基线（87.7%）。
translation.brief: 解决编码智能体无法从自身安全失败中持久学习的问题，提出 PRECEPT，通过根据智能体实际失败不断演化的安全编码原则库实现安全自我改进。

papers.title: Deletion You Can Check: Auditing LLM Unlearning
papers.abstract: A common indication that a fine-tuned model has forgotten a deleted record is a membership-inference score near chance (ROC-AUC $\approx 0.5$). This reading is sound only if the comparison population represents how the record should behave after a valid deletion---a counterfactual that is rarely validated. We test this premise in a controlled $2\times2$ study pairing two membership-inference benchmarks, ArxivMIA and BookMIA, with two language models, Llama-3.2-1B and Qwen2.5-1.5B. Exact retraining validates the membership reference: it lies within the prespecified chance band on ArxivMIA but reaches $0.122$ on BookMIA, causing the same metric to reject an empirical deletion reference. A post-hoc BookMIA/Qwen diagnostic replaces benchmark label-0 records with same-pool, never-fine-tuned records and moves the reference from $0.257$ to $0.523$, supporting population mismatch in that cell. Each approximate-unlearning checkpoint is judged jointly on membership removal, deletion-targeted shift beyond non-deletion variation, and utility. On the admitted ArxivMIA/Llama axis, no tested configuration of gradient ascent with retain descent (GA+GD), negative-preference optimization with retain training (NPO-RT), or teacher--student unlearning (SCRUB) passes. A score near chance is not evidence of forgetting until a reference establishes what chance means.

translation.title: 可检验的删除：审计 LLM 遗忘
translation.abstract: 微调模型已遗忘某条被删除记录的常见标志是成员推断得分接近随机水平（ROC-AUC ≈ 0.5）。这一解读只有在比较群体能够代表该记录在有效删除后应有的行为时才成立——而这一反事实很少得到验证。我们在一项受控的 2×2 研究中检验这一前提，将两个成员推断基准 ArxivMIA 和 BookMIA 与两个语言模型 Llama-3.2-1B 和 Qwen2.5-1.5B 配对。精确重训练验证了成员推断参照：它在 ArxivMIA 上处于预设的随机区间内，但在 BookMIA 上达到 0.122，导致同一指标拒绝了经验性删除参照。一个针对 BookMIA/Qwen 的事后诊断将基准中标签为 0 的记录替换为同池中从未微调过的记录，使参照从 0.257 移动到 0.523，支持了该组合中存在群体不匹配。每个近似遗忘检查点都从成员移除、超出非删除波动的删除目标偏移以及效用三个方面进行联合评判。在被认可的 ArxivMIA/Llama 轴上，带保留下降的梯度上升（GA+GD）、带保留训练的负偏好优化（NPO-RT）以及师生遗忘（SCRUB）的所有测试配置均未通过。在参照确立随机水平的含义之前，接近随机的分数并不能作为遗忘的证据。
translation.brief: 解决 LLM 遗忘评估中成员推断参照群体未经反事实验证的问题，通过受控 2×2 研究和精确重训练检验参照有效性，并据此联合审计多种近似遗忘方法。

papers.title: RankCast: Phase-Aware Rank Balancing in MoE Serving
papers.abstract: Modern large language model (LLM) inference increasingly adopts disaggregated architectures that separate Prefill (P) and Decode (D) phases. Meanwhile, Expert Parallelism (EP) has been widely adopted in large Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) model serving. However, load imbalance still slows down MoE inference because each layer must wait for the busiest EP rank. The main source of latency differs between prefill and decode. Prefill is compute-bound, and its MoE layers' latency is determined by the maximum token count of the busiest rank. At the same time, under moderate batch sizes, Decode is memory-bound, so the latency is dominated by the maximum active-expert count across ranks. To solve both problems under a unified framework, we present RankCast, a system that reduces rank-level maximum token counts during prefill and active-expert counts during decode. For every token, RankCast preserves the predicted Top-p experts and chooses the remaining k-p from its Top-L candidates (L > k). In prefill, RankCast yields a price per rank that steers flexible assignments to less loaded ranks. In decode, RankCast closes experts on the busiest ranks while preserving the constraints for each token. Both paths are implemented and tested in the state-of-the-art inference frameworks SGLang and DeepEP. We overlap RankCast's kernels with model execution and reuse the existing DeepEP communication channel for metadata transmission. On Qwen3-235B-A22B with EP=8 and Qwen3.5-397B-A17B with EP=16, RankCast removes over 75% of the busiest rank's excess prefill load, improves prefill input throughput by up to 19%, and reduces decode time per output token by up to 10%. The quality cost is below one percentage point.

translation.title: RankCast：MoE 服务中的阶段感知秩均衡
translation.abstract: 现代大语言模型（LLM）推理日益采用分离 Prefill（P）与 Decode（D）阶段的解耦架构。与此同时，专家并行（EP）已在大型混合专家（MoE）模型服务中被广泛采用。然而，负载不均衡仍会拖慢 MoE 推理，因为每一层都必须等待最繁忙的 EP 秩。Prefill 与 Decode 的主要延迟来源不同。Prefill 是计算受限的，其 MoE 层的延迟由最繁忙秩的最大 token 数决定。而在中等批大小下，Decode 是内存受限的，因此延迟由各秩间最大活跃专家数主导。为了在统一框架下解决这两个问题，我们提出 RankCast，一个在 prefill 阶段降低秩级最大 token 数、在 decode 阶段降低活跃专家数的系统。对每个 token，RankCast 保留其预测的 Top-p 专家，并从其 Top-L 候选（L > k）中选择其余 k-p 个专家。在 prefill 中，RankCast 为每个秩计算一个价格，引导灵活分配流向负载较低的秩。在 decode 中，RankCast 关闭最繁忙秩上的专家，同时保持每个 token 的约束。两条路径均在最先进的推理框架 SGLang 和 DeepEP 中实现并测试。我们将 RankCast 的内核与模型执行重叠，并复用现有的 DeepEP 通信通道传输元数据。在 EP=8 的 Qwen3-235B-A22B 和 EP=16 的 Qwen3.5-397B-A17B 上，RankCast 消除了最繁忙秩超过 75% 的超额 prefill 负载，将 prefill 输入吞吐量提升最高 19%，并将每个输出 token 的 decode 时间降低最高 10%。质量损失低于一个百分点。
translation.brief: 解决 MoE 推理中 EP 秩间负载不均衡导致的延迟问题，提出 RankCast，在 prefill 阶段通过价格机制均衡 token 分配、在 decode 阶段关闭繁忙秩上的专家。

papers.title: Non-manipulability and Approachability Beyond Two-Player Games
papers.abstract: We study the problem of guaranteeing non-manipulability and low regret for $n-1$ independent learners in an $n$-player repeated general game with one optimizer. Non-manipulability is a property which guarantees that learning agents can prevent a strategic opponent from exploiting their learning dynamics for its own benefit, while no-regret provides guarantees to a learner with respect to a fixed static benchmark. This problem is well understood in games with a single learner and a single optimizer, where the intersection of non-manipulable and no-regret algorithms is exactly the class of all no-swap regret algorithms. But having multiple independent learners introduces a fundamental constraint: without shared randomness, the learners' joint mixed actions must remain product distributions and individual no-swap regret guarantees need not provide a guarantee of non-manipulability. Our core contributions are as follows. We introduce a set of $n-1$ algorithms that $n-1$ learners can play which individually guarantee sublinear swap regret and, when played in conjunction with each other, jointly guarantee non-manipulability against an optimizer. These algorithms require the computation of a Nash equilibrium at every timestep, and we show that this computational cost is inherent in general games. We construct a reduction from computing Nash in $(n-1)$-player games to finding $n-1$ jointly non-manipulable no-external regret algorithms. Therefore, polynomial time algorithms which guarantee multi-learner non-manipulability in conjunction with no-external regret do not exist unless PPAD $\subseteq$ FBPP. In order to construct these algorithms, we develop new techniques for Blackwell approachability beyond $2$-player games. We provide a general characterization for sets which are approachable by $n-1$ players without correlated randomness.

translation.title: 超越双人博弈的不可操纵性与可达性
translation.abstract: 我们研究在具有一个优化者的 $n$ 人重复一般博弈中，为 $n-1$ 个独立学习者保证不可操纵性和低遗憾的问题。不可操纵性是一种性质，保证学习代理能够阻止策略性对手为了自身利益而利用其学习动态，而无遗憾则为学习者提供相对于固定静态基准的保证。这一问题在只有一个学习者和一个优化者的博弈中已被充分理解，其中不可操纵与无遗憾算法的交集恰好是所有 no-swap regret 算法的类。但拥有多个独立学习者引入了一个根本性约束：在没有共享随机性的情况下，学习者的联合混合动作必须保持乘积分布，且个体的 no-swap regret 保证不一定能提供不可操纵性保证。我们的核心贡献如下。我们引入了一组 $n-1$ 个算法，$n-1$ 个学习者可以各自使用，它们单独保证次线性 swap regret，并且当彼此配合使用时，共同保证对优化者的不可操纵性。这些算法需要在每个时间步计算 Nash 均衡，并且我们证明在一般博弈中这一计算代价是固有的。我们构造了一个从计算 $(n-1)$ 人博弈的 Nash 均衡到寻找 $n-1$ 个联合不可操纵的无外部遗憾算法的归约。因此，除非 PPAD $\subseteq$ FBPP，否则不存在能在多项式时间内保证多学习者不可操纵性并同时具备无外部遗憾的算法。为了构造这些算法，我们发展了超越双人博弈的 Blackwell 可达性新技术。我们为 $n-1$ 个玩家在没有相关随机性的情况下可达的集合提供了一般性刻画。
translation.brief: 研究多学习者重复博弈中同时保证不可操纵性与低遗憾的问题，通过扩展 Blackwell 可达性技术构造联合不可操纵的无遗憾算法，并证明其计算复杂度与 Nash 均衡计算等价。

papers.title: FIG-MAC: A Fine-grained Inspiration Graph Empowered Multi-Agent Collaboration for Automated Scientific Hypothesis Generation
papers.abstract: Automated Scientific Hypothesis Generation (ASHG) leveraging large language models (LLMs) aims to harness their strengths in knowledge integration, logical reasoning, and text generation for efficiently producing innovative, verifiable scientific hypotheses. However, existing approaches face three critical limitations: (i) insufficient fine-grained knowledge representation, as unstructured context impairs LLM comprehension and reasoning; (ii) lack of knowledge evolution traceability, constraining the generation of innovative cross-domain conjectures; (iii) absence of human-inspired and role-specialized multi-agent collaboration, failing to leverage the efficient innovation mechanisms arising from cognitive diversity and division of labor among expert roles to complete the full ASHG-evaluation loop. To address these limitations, we propose the Fine-grained Inspiration Graph-empowered Multi-Agent Collaboration framework (FIG-MAC) including: (i) Fine-grained Inspiration Graph module (FIG), to obtain fine-grained structured knowledge representations, where nodes represent academic semantic units and edges encode heuristic relationships among them; (ii) ontology-guided hybrid reasoning module, which follows the FIG ontology to construct structured reasoning paths and uses vector search to enrich them with semantic evidence, to obtain the traceable scientific conjecture paths; (iii) role-specialized Multi-Agent framework, inspired by real scientific teamwork, enabling a closed-loop process of scientific conjecture generation, screening, and validation. Experimental results demonstrate that FIG-MAC significantly outperforms state-of-the-art methods on source diversity, provenance-adjusted novelty, and raw novelty.

translation.title: FIG-MAC：细粒度灵感图赋能的多智能体协作自动科学假设生成
translation.abstract: 利用大语言模型（LLM）的自动科学假设生成（ASHG）旨在发挥其在知识整合、逻辑推理和文本生成方面的优势，以高效产出创新且可验证的科学假设。然而，现有方法面临三个关键局限：(i) 细粒度知识表示不足，非结构化上下文损害 LLM 的理解与推理；(ii) 缺乏知识演化可追溯性，限制了创新性跨领域猜想的形成；(iii) 缺少受人类启发且角色专门化的多智能体协作，未能利用专家角色间认知多样性与分工所带来的高效创新机制来完成完整的 ASHG-评估闭环。为解决这些局限，我们提出细粒度灵感图赋能的多智能体协作框架（FIG-MAC），包括：(i) 细粒度灵感图模块（FIG），用于获取细粒度结构化知识表示，其中节点表示学术语义单元，边编码它们之间的启发式关系；(ii) 本体引导的混合推理模块，遵循 FIG 本体构建结构化推理路径，并利用向量搜索以语义证据丰富这些路径，从而获得可追溯的科学猜想路径；(iii) 角色专门化的多智能体框架，受真实科研团队协作启发，实现科学猜想生成、筛选与验证的闭环流程。实验结果表明，FIG-MAC 在来源多样性、来源校正新颖性和原始新颖性方面显著优于最先进方法。
translation.brief: 针对 LLM 科学假设生成中知识表示粗粒度、缺乏可追溯性和协作机制不足的问题，提出细粒度灵感图与角色分工多智能体协作框架 FIG-MAC。

papers.title: LLMVC: Large Language Model-Guided Generative Video Compression
papers.abstract: Recent generative video methods achieve strong perceptual compression by encoding videos into compact latent representations and reconstructing them with powerful generative decoders. However, visual encoders must compress both high-level semantics and dense visual details into a unified latent space, which complicates entropy coding and decoding and may cause semantic drift under aggressive compression. In this work, we propose Large Language Model-Guided Video Compression (LLMVC), which leverages the summarization capability of frozen video large language models (Video-LLMs) to generate compact semantic tokens aligned with temporal latent slices for guiding video compression. Specifically, Hybrid Bidirectional Bimodal Attention (HBBA) enables bidirectional interactions between visual and semantic features during encoding and decoding. Semantic-Conditioned Cross-Attention (SCCA) incorporates semantic features into probability modeling during entropy coding. These semantic features provide high-level guidance throughout the pipeline, improving representation quality and encouraging semantic consistency through a transmitted text side channel. Experiments on UVG, MCL-JCV, and HEVC show that LLMVC consistently improves compression performance over traditional and recent neural video compression methods in terms of LPIPS and DISTS, while also achieving better fidelity than recent perceptual codecs.

translation.title: LLMVC：大语言模型引导的生成式视频压缩
translation.abstract: 近期的生成式视频方法通过将视频编码为紧凑的潜在表示并用强大的生成式解码器重建，实现了很强的感知压缩。然而，视觉编码器必须将高层语义和密集视觉细节压缩到统一的潜在空间中，这使熵编码和解码复杂化，并可能在激进压缩下导致语义漂移。在本工作中，我们提出大语言模型引导的视频压缩（LLMVC），利用冻结的视频大语言模型（Video-LLM）的摘要能力生成与时间潜在切片对齐的紧凑语义 token，以引导视频压缩。具体而言，混合双向双模态注意力（HBBA）在编码和解码过程中实现视觉特征与语义特征之间的双向交互。语义条件交叉注意力（SCCA）在熵编码期间将语义特征融入概率建模。这些语义特征在整个流程中提供高层引导，提升表示质量，并通过传输的文本辅助通道促进语义一致性。在 UVG、MCL-JCV 和 HEVC 上的实验表明，LLMVC 在 LPIPS 和 DISTS 指标上持续优于传统和近期的神经视频压缩方法，同时比近期的感知编解码器取得更好的保真度。
translation.brief: 针对生成式视频压缩中语义与细节混于统一潜在空间导致语义漂移的问题，提出用冻结 Video-LLM 生成的语义 token 引导编码、熵建模与解码的 LLMVC 框架。

papers.title: The Detour Is the Danger: Preserving Security During LLM Agent Recovery
papers.abstract: LLM agents increasingly rely on external tools and reusable Skills to execute complex workflows, autonomously replanning when operations fail. However, such recovery may preserve task functionality while silently discarding the security protections required by the original workflow. In this paper, we investigate workflow security downgrade, a failure-induced security threat in which agents execute sensitive operations without satisfying their original protection requirements. Unlike prompt injection, this threat exploits autonomous recovery decisions triggered by execution failures, without modifying instructions or tool definitions. We systematically evaluate this behavior through fault injection in an executable MCP/Skill environment spanning seven LLMs, twelve task templates, and three security-sensitive domains. To address this threat, we propose ARGUS, an obligation-preserving recovery framework that combines resource-bound security evidence, isolated recovery-plan validation, and execution-time enforcement. In a separate 864-run evaluation, ARGUS prevents all observed protection-loss events under enforcement, while recovery assistance yields model-dependent improvements in protected task completion over blocking alone. Our findings demonstrate that secure agent recovery requires preserving security obligations across workflow changes, rather than merely restoring task functionality.

translation.title: 绕道即危险：LLM 智能体恢复过程中的安全保障
translation.abstract: LLM 智能体日益依赖外部工具和可复用的 Skills 来执行复杂工作流，并在操作失败时自主重新规划。然而，这种恢复可能在保留任务功能的同时，悄然丢弃原始工作流所需的安全保护。本文研究工作流安全降级，这是一种由故障引发的安全威胁，即智能体在未满足其原始保护要求的情况下执行敏感操作。与提示注入不同，该威胁利用由执行失败触发的自主恢复决策，而无需修改指令或工具定义。我们通过在可执行的 MCP/Skill 环境中进行故障注入，系统性地评估了这一行为，涵盖七个 LLM、十二个任务模板和三个安全敏感领域。为应对这一威胁，我们提出 ARGUS，一个义务保持型恢复框架，它结合了资源绑定的安全证据、隔离的恢复计划验证和执行时强制。在单独的 864 次运行评估中，ARGUS 在强制执行下阻止了所有观察到的保护丢失事件，而恢复辅助相比单纯阻断在受保护任务完成率上带来了依赖模型的改进。我们的发现表明，安全的智能体恢复需要在工作流变更中保持安全义务，而不仅仅是恢复任务功能。
translation.brief: 研究 LLM 智能体故障自主恢复时可能丢失安全保护的工作流安全降级问题，提出结合安全证据、隔离验证与执行时强制的义务保持恢复框架 ARGUS。

papers.title: Failure Broadens, Success Sharpens: Continual Adaptation of Tool-Use Agents Across Diverse Tasks with Dual-Polarity Memory
papers.abstract: Large language model agents can self-improve over time by utilizing procedural memory derived from prior task trajectories, yet the distinct utilities of memories derived from local successes and failures remain underexplored. This work studies this question in a realistic setting with heterogeneous streams of multi-domain tool-use tasks and various environment constraints common in real-world scenarios. We develop \emph{Dual-Polarity Memory with Periodic Maintenance} (DualPM), a simple, retrieval-free memory workflow characterized by (1) customizable reflection and procedural memory generation from both local successes and failures within each trajectory, and (2) periodic memory consolidation over long task streams under a given memory capacity, preventing memory explosion. Online prequential evaluation with fine-grained metrics reveals that failure memory more strongly broadens coverage, success memory better streamlines execution, while combining both polarities effectively integrates both benefits. Further studies demonstrate that DualPM enables cross-domain memory generalization and continual memory adaptation, while external evaluation on EvoMemBench reveals the portability and effectiveness of DualPM as a general long-term procedural memory method.

translation.title: 失败拓宽，成功精炼：基于双极性记忆的工具使用智能体跨多样任务持续适应
translation.abstract: 大语言模型智能体可以通过利用从先前任务轨迹中提取的程序性记忆实现自我改进，然而来自局部成功与失败的记忆各自的独特效用仍未被充分探索。本工作在一个现实场景中研究这一问题，该场景包含多领域工具使用任务的异构流以及现实世界中常见的各种环境约束。我们开发了带周期性维护的双极性记忆（DualPM），这是一种简单、无需检索的记忆工作流，其特点是：(1) 可从每条轨迹中的局部成功与失败进行可定制的反思和程序性记忆生成；(2) 在给定记忆容量下对长任务流进行周期性记忆整合，防止记忆爆炸。采用细粒度指标的在线 prequential 评估表明，失败记忆更能拓宽覆盖面，成功记忆更能精简执行，而结合两种极性则有效整合了两者优势。进一步研究表明，DualPM 支持跨领域记忆泛化和持续记忆适应，而在 EvoMemBench 上的外部评估则揭示了 DualPM 作为通用长期程序性记忆方法的可移植性和有效性。
translation.brief: 研究工具使用智能体在多领域任务流中如何利用成功与失败两类记忆自我改进的问题，提出带周期性整合的双极性记忆工作流 DualPM。

papers.title: Controllable CAD Generation and Interactive Editing of Fluid Rotors
papers.abstract: Computer-aided design (CAD) provides the geometric foundation for rotors in fluid rotating machinery. However, creating models for different rotors requires different modeling processes, making it difficult to control geometry through design intent and reuse existing models. We introduce VaneCraft, an agent-driven framework for rotor generation, inverse recovery, and editing through a unified analytical representation. The agent interprets design requests and invokes geometric modeling operations. The representation defines geometric controls through meridional geometry and independent boundary angle laws. An anisotropic partial differential equation (PDE) maps these controls to the blade surfaces. Geometric parameter correction (GPC) uses a joint geometric encoder and a parameter decoder to refine controls initialized from rotor category and dimensions. Inverse recovery maps existing CAD to the same geometric controls for reconstruction and continued editing. Experiments demonstrate that VaneCraft supports anisotropy control and parameter editing and outperforms representative baselines in rotor CAD generation tasks. Project page is available on \href{this https URL}{GitHub}.

translation.title: 可控CAD生成与流体转子交互式编辑
translation.abstract: 计算机辅助设计（CAD）为流体旋转机械中的转子提供几何基础。然而，为不同转子创建模型需要不同的建模流程，难以通过设计意图控制几何并复用已有模型。我们提出VaneCraft，一个由智能体驱动的框架，通过统一解析表示实现转子生成、逆向恢复与编辑。智能体解释设计请求并调用几何建模操作。该表示通过子午面几何和独立的边界角规律定义几何控制。一个各向异性偏微分方程（PDE）将这些控制映射到叶片表面。几何参数校正（GPC）使用联合几何编码器和参数解码器，对由转子类别和尺寸初始化的控制参数进行精化。逆向恢复将已有CAD映射到相同的几何控制，以便重建和继续编辑。实验表明，VaneCraft支持各向异性控制和参数编辑，并在转子CAD生成任务中优于代表性基线。项目页面见\href{this https URL}{GitHub}。
translation.brief: 针对转子CAD难以按设计意图控制几何和复用模型的问题，提出VaneCraft框架，用统一解析表示结合智能体驱动的建模操作与几何参数校正实现转子生成、逆向恢复与编辑。

papers.title: Welfare-Enhancing Mechanism Design for Agent Ecosystems
papers.abstract: The emerging Agentic Web forms a multi-agent ecosystem: a decentralized service market where the user agent selects which content agents to query from their submitted profiles, before seeing any documents. Profiles therefore become a new target of optimization. Existing Generative Engine Optimization studies how a single supplier rewrites documents the engine can already retrieve, to improve their citation. In the Agentic Web, multiple content agents optimize profiles to compete for limited opportunities to deliver documents. To study this repeated interaction, we build WildRegistry, a simulation framework and benchmark based on a real agentic-search request stream, and model it as a dynamic game under private monitoring. Long-horizon experiments show that this competition lowers website-selection quality and settles at a harmful stable point, which our empirical criterion identifies as an approximate rewriting equilibrium. We therefore design a welfare-enhancing mechanism, DEC (Delivery-Evidence Credit), a platform-side policy that uses recorded delivery outcomes to reallocate later opportunities and reduce information asymmetry. DEC improves this endpoint, raising website-selection quality while preserving most of providers' exposure gains, for a Welfare Gain of +2.01 points and a healthier long-horizon outcome. More broadly, our findings highlight the importance of mechanism design in agent ecosystems: turning recorded delivery outcomes into evidence that endogenously shapes later user-agent selection and content-agent adaptation can steer long-horizon adaptation toward delivered capabilities.

translation.title: 面向智能体生态系统的福利提升机制设计
translation.abstract: 新兴的Agentic Web构成了一个多智能体生态系统：一个去中心化的服务市场，其中用户智能体在看到任何文档之前，根据内容智能体提交的profile选择要查询的对象。因此profile成为新的优化目标。现有的生成式引擎优化（Generative Engine Optimization）研究单个供应商如何改写引擎已能检索的文档以提升其被引用率。而在Agentic Web中，多个内容智能体通过优化profile来竞争有限的文档交付机会。为研究这种重复交互，我们构建了WildRegistry，一个基于真实智能体搜索请求流的仿真框架和基准，并将其建模为私有监控下的动态博弈。长期实验表明，这种竞争降低了网站选择质量，并收敛到一个有害的稳定点，我们的经验性判据将其识别为近似改写均衡。因此我们设计了一种福利提升机制DEC（Delivery-Evidence Credit），一种平台侧策略，利用记录的交付结果重新分配后续机会并减少信息不对称。DEC改善了这一终点，在保留供应商大部分曝光收益的同时提升了网站选择质量，福利增益为+2.01分，并带来更健康的长期结果。更广泛地说，我们的发现凸显了机制设计在智能体生态系统中的重要性：将记录的交付结果转化为内生塑造后续用户智能体选择和内容智能体适应的证据，可以引导长期适应朝着已交付能力方向发展。
translation.brief: 针对Agentic Web中内容智能体竞争优化profile导致网站选择质量下降的问题，基于真实请求流构建动态博弈仿真基准，并提出利用交付结果重新分配机会的平台侧机制DEC。

papers.title: How Much Effort Does an AI Code Reviewer Need? Evidence from Claude 5.5 Models on Plausible-but-Wrong Patches
papers.abstract: AI coding agents write code faster than people can review it, so teams add AI reviewers. Reasoning models let such a reviewer trade cost for diligence through an effort setting. We asked how much effort a reviewer needs to catch plausible-but-wrong patches, which pass a benchmark's tests but fail stronger ones. Claude Opus 5.5 (preregistered), Sonnet 5.5 and Haiku 5.5 (exploratory) each reviewed the same 90 agent-written Django patches from SWE-bench Verified at low, medium and high effort. By strengthened SWE-ABS tests, 55 patches were wrong and 35 correct. In every model, high effort accepted fewer wrong patches than low (false success .45 against .67 for Opus, .49 against .65 for Sonnet, .51 against .78 for Haiku), a supported difference for Opus and Haiku. For Opus, medium was non-inferior to high within 15 percentage points (difference .018, 95% CI [-.065, .108]) and cost 20% less, short of the preregistered 30%. For Sonnet and Haiku, medium cost 39% and 51% less than high but was not shown non-inferior. Opus at medium or high agreed best with the labels; Haiku at high cost about 8% as much per review as Opus at medium, accuracy difference unresolved. Exploratory coding showed that most rejections named the tested defect and that effort added such rejections. No setting is a strong gate: each accepted at least 45% of wrong patches. For 32 of the 55 wrong patches the issue may not require what the failing test checks; without them, neither accuracy hypothesis holds for any model.

translation.title: AI代码审查者需要多少投入？来自Claude 5.5模型对似是而非错误补丁的证据
translation.abstract: AI编程智能体编写代码的速度超过人工审查速度，因此团队引入AI审查者。推理模型允许审查者通过effort设置在成本与勤勉度之间权衡。我们探究审查者需要多少effort才能发现似是而非的错误补丁——这些补丁能通过基准测试但无法通过更强的测试。Claude Opus 5.5（预注册）、Sonnet 5.5和Haiku 5.5（探索性）各自以低、中、高effort审查相同的90个来自SWE-bench Verified的智能体编写的Django补丁。通过加强版SWE-ABS测试，55个补丁是错误的，35个是正确的。在所有模型中，高effort比低effort接受更少的错误补丁（Opus的假成功率为.45对.67，Sonnet为.49对.65，Haiku为.51对.78），Opus和Haiku的差异得到统计支持。对Opus，中等effort在15个百分点内不劣于高effort（差异.018，95% CI [-.065, .108]），且成本低20%，未达到预注册的30%。对Sonnet和Haiku，中等effort比高effort分别便宜39%和51%，但未证明不劣。Opus在中或高effort下与标签一致性最好；Haiku在高effort下每次审查成本约为Opus中等effort的8%，准确率差异未定。探索性编码显示大多数拒绝指出了被测缺陷，且effort增加了此类拒绝。没有任何设置是强力的把关：每个设置都至少接受了45%的错误补丁。在55个错误补丁中，有32个的问题可能不需要失败测试所检查的内容；若剔除它们，任何模型都不再支持任一准确率假设。
translation.brief: 研究AI代码审查者以不同effort设置审查似是而非错误补丁的效果与成本权衡，通过对Claude 5.5系列模型在90个Django补丁上的预注册实验进行分析。

papers.title: Fine-Grained Ego-Vehicle Action Recognition from Driving Video
papers.abstract: Fine-grained ego-vehicle action recognition turns large-scale driving video into structured, searchable driving scenarios, providing a foundation for discovering critical maneuvers and systematically developing and evaluating autonomous driving models. However, large-scale driving videos often lack explicit ego-action labels, and existing datasets vary in action definitions, annotation granularity, and available supervision. We introduce EgoManeuver, a unified benchmark of 16 lateral and 6 longitudinal actions constructed from seven public driving datasets. Our multi-source labeling system leverages existing annotations and complementary evidence available in each source dataset, including vehicle signals, ego poses, HD-map topology, and captions, to assign labels under a unified fine-grained action taxonomy. We further standardize temporal action boundaries across datasets and validate the resulting labels through kinematic consistency checks and targeted human review. The resulting benchmark contains 86.6K segments spanning 190.8 h across 26 countries and provides a long-tail-aware evaluation protocol. We also introduce DenseEgo, a video-based baseline that combines spatially aware representations with dense per-step action supervision. On the EgoManeuver, DenseEgo achieves 82.7 lateral and 83.5 longitudinal mAP, outperforming the strongest existing video model by 1.5 and 5.0 points, respectively. Finally, we demonstrate one way to integrate DenseEgo with a language-model agent for retrieving driving videos that match user-specified actions and scenarios. All code, datasets, and model weights will be publicly released.

translation.title: 从驾驶视频中进行细粒度自车动作识别
translation.abstract: 细粒度自车动作识别将大规模驾驶视频转化为结构化、可搜索的驾驶场景，为发现关键操作以及系统性地开发和评估自动驾驶模型提供基础。然而，大规模驾驶视频通常缺乏显式的自车动作标签，且现有数据集在动作定义、标注粒度和可用监督方面各不相同。我们提出EgoManeuver，一个由七个公开驾驶数据集构建的统一基准，包含16种横向和6种纵向动作。我们的多源标注系统利用每个源数据集中已有的标注和补充证据，包括车辆信号、自车位姿、高精地图拓扑和字幕，在统一的细粒度动作分类下分配标签。我们进一步跨数据集标准化时间动作边界，并通过运动学一致性检查和针对性人工审核验证所得标签。该基准包含跨越26个国家、总时长190.8小时的86.6K片段，并提供面向长尾的评估协议。我们还提出DenseEgo，一个结合空间感知表示与密集逐步动作监督的视频基线模型。在EgoManeuver上，DenseEgo取得82.7横向和83.5纵向mAP，分别超过最强现有视频模型1.5和5.0分。最后，我们展示了将DenseEgo与语言模型智能体集成的一种方式，用于检索符合用户指定动作和场景的驾驶视频。所有代码、数据集和模型权重将公开发布。
translation.brief: 针对大规模驾驶视频缺乏统一细粒度自车动作标签的问题，整合七个公开数据集构建统一基准EgoManeuver，并提出结合空间感知表示与密集逐步监督的基线模型DenseEgo。

papers.title: DynaSeek: Large Language Model-Driven Hybrid Dynamic Model Discovery for Grid-Tied Inverters from Limited Measurements
papers.abstract: Discovering the unknown governing equations of grid-tied inverters from limited measurements is essential for the stability analysis of modern inverter-dominated power systems. However, existing identification methods struggle to jointly resolve unmeasured internal control memory and saturation-induced mode transitions from accessible terminal waveforms. To address this challenge, this paper proposes DynaSeek, a large language model (LLM)-driven framework for discovering explicit hybrid differential-algebraic equations (DAEs) of current-limited inverters. The framework integrates physics-constrained symbolic skeleton synthesis with the joint numerical estimation of shared model parameters and record-specific latent initial states across multi-island experience archives. Furthermore, two complementary structural diagnostics evaluating cross-record state closure and cross-window consistency are established to detect structural deficiencies across distinct input histories and transient stages. Guided by diagnostic feedback, DynaSeek directs variable-dimensional latent-state expansion and current-limiting and anti-windup refinement to yield self-contained hybrid DAEs unifying unsaturated regulation, current limiting, and post-fault recovery. Controller-hardware-in-the-loop (CHIL) experiments and closed-loop system-level simulations demonstrate that DynaSeek reduces transient trajectory reconstruction errors by one to two orders of magnitude compared with symbolic and neural baselines while accurately preserving reference critical clearing times, enabling reliable large-signal stability assessment of inverters with inaccessible internal controls.

translation.title: DynaSeek：基于大语言模型的并网逆变器有限量测混合动态模型发现
translation.abstract: 从有限量测中发现并网逆变器的未知控制方程，对现代逆变器主导电力系统的稳定性分析至关重要。然而，现有辨识方法难以从可获取的端口波形中同时解析未量测的内部控制记忆和饱和引起的模式切换。为应对这一挑战，本文提出DynaSeek，一个由大语言模型（LLM）驱动的框架，用于发现限流逆变器的显式混合微分代数方程（DAE）。该框架将物理约束的符号骨架综合与跨多孤岛经验档案的共享模型参数及记录特定隐式初始状态的联合数值估计相结合。此外，建立了两个互补的结构诊断指标——评估跨记录状态闭合性和跨窗口一致性——以检测不同输入历史和暂态阶段的结构缺陷。在诊断反馈的引导下，DynaSeek引导可变维度的隐状态扩展以及限流和抗积分饱和的精化，得到统一未饱和调节、限流和故障后恢复的自洽混合DAE。控制器硬件在环（CHIL）实验和闭环系统级仿真表明，与符号和神经基线相比，DynaSeek将暂态轨迹重构误差降低一到两个数量级，同时准确保持参考临界清除时间，实现了对内部控制不可访问逆变器的大信号稳定性可靠评估。
translation.brief: 针对有限量测下难以辨识并网逆变器内部控制记忆与饱和模式切换的问题，提出LLM驱动的DynaSeek框架，结合物理约束符号骨架综合与结构诊断来发现显式混合微分代数方程。

papers.title: SlicePlanner: Logic-Guided Agentic AI for Online QoS-Aware Network Slicing in Open RAN
papers.abstract: Adaptive network slicing in Open Radio Access Network (O-RAN) demands reconfiguration decisions that respond to live traffic conditions while remaining safe with respect to Service Level Agreement (SLA) constraints, a combination that purely data-driven controllers cannot reliably guarantee without continuous retraining. We present SlicePlanner, a logic-guided closed-loop framework that treats each RAN reconfiguration as a controlled hypothesis: proposed from live and historical KeyPerformance Indicator (KPI) evidence, filtered through explicit SLA constraints and mined RAN control rules, and committed only when post-action measurements confirm improvement. SlicePlanner comprises two cooperating agents: SliceSense, which monitors live KPIs, retrieves context-conditioned evidence, and ranks candidate RAN actions through a surrogate-guided admissibility filter; and SliceGuard, which validates post-action KPI responses, rolls back harmful configurations, and refreshes rules under distribution drift. Validated over the air using OpenAirInterface, FlexRIC, and commercial Sierra Wireless 5G devices, SlicePlanner reduces SLA latency violations by up to 86% over static slicing and 50% over Deep Reinforcement Learning (DRL)-based slicing, while maintaining comparable cell throughput and auditable decisions without online retraining.

translation.title: SlicePlanner：面向 Open RAN 在线 QoS 感知网络切片的逻辑引导智能体 AI
translation.abstract: Open Radio Access Network (O-RAN) 中的自适应网络切片要求重配置决策既能响应实时流量状况，又能在 Service Level Agreement (SLA) 约束下保持安全，而纯数据驱动的控制器若不持续重训练则难以可靠地保证这一点。我们提出 SlicePlanner，一个逻辑引导的闭环框架，它将每次 RAN 重配置视为一个受控假设：由实时与历史 Key Performance Indicator (KPI) 证据提出，经显式 SLA 约束和挖掘出的 RAN 控制规则过滤，仅当动作后的测量确认有改进时才提交。SlicePlanner 包含两个协作智能体：SliceSense 监控实时 KPI、检索上下文条件下的证据，并通过代理引导的可准入性过滤器对候选 RAN 动作排序；SliceGuard 验证动作后的 KPI 响应、回滚有害配置，并在分布漂移下刷新规则。通过 OpenAirInterface、FlexRIC 和商用 Sierra Wireless 5G 设备进行空口验证，SlicePlanner 相比静态切片最多减少 86% 的 SLA 时延违规，相比基于 Deep Reinforcement Learning (DRL) 的切片减少 50%，同时保持相当的蜂窝吞吐量和可审计的决策，且无需在线重训练。
translation.brief: 该论文解决 O-RAN 网络切片中重配置决策难以同时满足实时性与 SLA 安全性的问题，采用逻辑引导的闭环框架，将每次重配置作为受控假设，由 SliceSense 提出候选动作、SliceGuard 验证并回滚。

papers.title: Verifiable but Not Predictable: What Sentence Embeddings Know About Propositional Decomposition
papers.abstract: Quality control for proposition decomposition by large language models (LLMs) raises two asymmetric questions. After decomposition, one can verify: given a sentence and a candidate proposition, does the proposition belong to that sentence? Before decomposition, one would like to predict: how many propositions should the sentence yield? On PropSegmEnt, a corpus of English Wikipedia sentences each segmented by three human annotators, we find that the two questions live in different representational spaces. A natural language inference (NLI) judge verifies membership with 92.8% accuracy and an area under the ROC curve (AUC) of 0.977, and its residual errors turn out to be mostly propositions that are true in document context rather than genuine entailment mistakes. Vector geometry cannot verify: cosine similarity saturates, and a sentence embedding is not a linear combination of its propositions' embeddings. For prediction, every symbolic anchor we test, namely token count, the CPIDR idea-density counter, and a Neo-Davidsonian predicate count, reduces to a length proxy once token count is controlled. A linear ridge probe on sentence embeddings is the only predictor that keeps genuine count signal: its length-partialled correlation with human counts is 0.40-0.49 with bootstrap confidence intervals (CIs) excluding zero, and it orders length-matched sentence pairs correctly 67-71% of the time against a 50% chance level, statistically matching the inter-annotator agreement ceiling. This signal survives INT8 quantization without loss, INT4 at a small cost, and Matryoshka truncation to 256 dimensions, and it works as well in a 2021 encoder as in a 2025 one. Its structured weakness is a systematic under-splitting of long sentences. We distill the protocol lessons, including a retracted pilot study, into a checklist for probing length-confounded quantities.

translation.title: 可验证但不可预测：句子嵌入对命题分解知道什么
translation.abstract: 对大语言模型 (LLM) 命题分解的质量控制提出两个不对称的问题。分解之后可以验证：给定一个句子和一个候选命题，该命题是否属于该句子？分解之前则希望预测：该句子应产生多少个命题？在 PropSegmEnt（一个由三位人工标注者对英文 Wikipedia 句子进行分割的语料库）上，我们发现这两个问题处于不同的表示空间。一个 natural language inference (NLI) 判别器以 92.8% 的准确率和 0.977 的 ROC 曲线下面积 (AUC) 验证成员关系，其残余错误大多是文档上下文中为真的命题，而非真正的蕴含错误。向量几何无法验证：余弦相似度饱和，且句子嵌入不是其各命题嵌入的线性组合。对于预测，我们测试的所有符号锚点，即 token 数、CPIDR 思想密度计数器和 Neo-Davidsonian 谓词计数，在控制 token 数后都退化为长度代理。句子嵌入上的线性 ridge 探针是唯一保留真实计数信号的预测器：其与人工计数的长度偏置相关系数为 0.40-0.49，bootstrap 置信区间 (CI) 不含零，且对长度匹配的句子对能以 67-71% 的比例正确排序（随机水平为 50%），在统计上达到标注者间一致性上限。该信号在 INT8 量化下无损保留，INT4 下有轻微损失，在 Matryoshka 截断至 256 维后依然有效，并且在 2021 年的编码器与 2025 年的编码器中表现相当。其结构性弱点是对长句存在系统性欠拆分。我们将协议层面的经验教训（包括一项撤回的试点研究）提炼为一份针对探测受长度混淆的量的检查清单。
translation.brief: 该论文研究 LLM 命题分解质量控制中验证与预测两个任务的可实现性差异，通过在 PropSegmEnt 上对比 NLI 判别器、向量几何与嵌入探针等方法，发现验证可行而计数预测仅句子嵌入探针有效。

papers.title: Interactive Proofs as a Unified Framework for Evaluating and Leveraging Verifiable Proof Generation by LLM Agents
papers.abstract: Recent advances in LLM-assisted theorem proving and program verification have attracted widespread attention. Beyond determining whether a proposition is true, LLM agents must produce evidence that can be independently checked by humans or formal verification tools. To evaluate the underlying, protocol-agnostic ability of LLM agents to construct verifiable proofs-rather than their proficiency with any particular proof language or verification tool, we introduce Merlin-Bench. Drawing on interactive proof systems from computational complexity theory, we cast an LLM agent as the prover: under a designated protocol, the agent interacts with a formal verifier to substantiate its claimed answer to a problem instance. We develop an automated framework for constructing test cases and use it to create 100 cases across 15 problem families, each formulated within this prover-verifier framework. Experiments with 10 frontier LLMs across multiple agent harnesses show that reliably producing verifiable proofs in accordance with specified protocols remains a substantial challenge. Our case studies further provide actionable insights into improving agents' ability to generate verifier-accepted proofs: tool use is essential for completing practical proof tasks; different forms of guidance, ranging from engineering instructions to problem-specific knowledge, substantially affect success rates on interactive-proof tasks; and proof-solving experience distilled from abstract tasks can transfer to concrete, real-world verification tasks.

translation.title: 交互式证明作为评估与利用 LLM 智能体可验证证明生成的统一框架
translation.abstract: LLM 辅助定理证明和程序验证的最新进展引起了广泛关注。除了判断一个命题是否为真之外，LLM 智能体还必须产生可由人类或形式化验证工具独立检查的证据。为了评估 LLM 智能体构建可验证证明的底层、与协议无关的能力，而非其对任何特定证明语言或验证工具的熟练程度，我们提出 Merlin-Bench。借鉴计算复杂性理论中的交互式证明系统，我们将 LLM 智能体视为证明者：在指定协议下，智能体与形式化验证器交互，以证实其对问题实例所声称的答案。我们开发了构建测试用例的自动化框架，并用它创建了横跨 15 个问题族的 100 个用例，每个用例均在此证明者-验证者框架内表述。对 10 个前沿 LLM 在多种智能体框架下的实验表明，按照指定协议可靠地产出可验证证明仍然是一项重大挑战。我们的案例研究进一步为提升智能体生成验证器可接受证明的能力提供了可操作的洞见：工具使用对完成实际证明任务至关重要；不同形式的引导，从工程指令到问题特定知识，都会显著影响交互式证明任务的成功率；从抽象任务中提炼的证明求解经验可以迁移到具体的现实世界验证任务。
translation.brief: 该论文解决如何评估 LLM 智能体生成可验证证明的协议无关能力的问题，借鉴交互式证明系统构建 Merlin-Bench 基准，将智能体作为证明者与形式化验证器交互。

papers.title: Faster and Better Query (FBQ): Learning Future-Position Probes from the First Generated Token
papers.abstract: When a large language model (LLM) evicts prompt keys and values at the end of prefill, it must decide what to keep before it sees the queries from subsequent decoding steps. Generating a draft continuation can approximate those queries at the cost of extra autoregressive steps. Can we use the embedding of the first output token, already available from the final prefill logits, to construct low-cost pseudo queries that approximate future decoding queries? We start with FTQ-8, which places eight copies of the first token ID at consecutive future positions and reads their attention to the prompt in one causal forward pass. Each copy sees a different prefix, but a generic opening such as the offers a poor literal guess for seven successive tokens. Faster and Better Query (FBQ) preserves the first embedding and learns an additive offset at each of the seven remaining positions. We train these offsets to predict the average prompt attention of a full-cache continuation. On LongBench, FBQ performs comparably to eight-step Lookahead Q-Cache at the same cache budget, using a single forward pass to compute all probe queries.

translation.title: 更快更好的查询 (FBQ)：从首个生成 token 学习未来位置探针
translation.abstract: 当大语言模型 (LLM) 在 prefill 结束时驱逐 prompt 的键和值时，它必须在看到后续解码步骤的查询之前决定保留什么。生成草稿续写可以近似这些查询，但代价是额外的自回归步骤。我们能否利用首个输出 token 的嵌入（已可从最终 prefill logits 获得）来构建低成本的伪查询以近似未来的解码查询？我们从 FTQ-8 出发，它将首个 token ID 的八个副本放置在连续的未来位置，并在一次因果前向传播中读取它们对 prompt 的注意力。每个副本看到不同的前缀，但像 the 这样的通用开头对连续七个 token 的字面猜测很差。Faster and Better Query (FBQ) 保留第一个嵌入，并在其余七个位置各学习一个加性偏移。我们训练这些偏移来预测完整缓存续写的平均 prompt 注意力。在 LongBench 上，FBQ 在相同缓存预算下与八步 Lookahead Q-Cache 表现相当，且只需一次前向传播即可计算所有探针查询。
translation.brief: 该论文解决 KV 缓存驱逐时无法预知未来解码查询的问题，通过学习首个 token 嵌入在各未来位置的加性偏移，用单次前向传播生成近似未来查询的探针。

papers.title: WorldUAV: Scaling UAV Data Synthesis via World Models
papers.abstract: UAV detection and tracking remain constrained by the scarcity of high-quality training data. Existing game-engine-based synthetic UAV data suffer from a substantial synthetic-to-real gap, while the high cost of manually collected real-world UAV data limits dataset scale. Therefore, we introduce WorldUAV, a high-quality UAV dataset constructed through an efficient framework powered by world models. Specifically, WorldUAV directly integrates UAVs into readily available real-world videos, naturally preserving realistic backgrounds, illumination, and scene dynamics. Leveraging the spatiotemporal priors of world models, it generates UAV videos with plausible motion, pose variations, and cross-frame consistency, effectively narrowing the gap between synthetic and real data. We further develop an agentic pipeline orchestrated by a multimodal large language model that acquires sources, plans UAV trajectories, invokes synthesis, and verifies generated videos, enabling fully automated dataset construction. WorldUAV comprises 6,878 UAV videos and 205,778 UAV images. Experiments show that WorldUAV significantly improves the performance of UAV detectors. Moreover, it substantially reduces dataset construction costs, requiring only 15 seconds and USD 0.0005 API cost per high-quality UAV image. Our work offers both a high-quality dataset and a scalable data generation paradigm for UAV detection and tracking.

translation.title: WorldUAV：借助世界模型扩展无人机数据合成
translation.abstract: 无人机 (UAV) 检测与跟踪仍受限于高质量训练数据的稀缺。现有的基于游戏引擎的合成 UAV 数据存在显著的合成到真实差距，而人工采集真实世界 UAV 数据的高昂成本限制了数据集规模。因此，我们提出 WorldUAV，一个由世界模型驱动的高效框架构建的高质量 UAV 数据集。具体而言，WorldUAV 将无人机直接融入现成的真实世界视频中，自然地保留真实的背景、光照和场景动态。利用世界模型的时空先验，它生成具有合理运动、姿态变化和跨帧一致性的无人机视频，有效缩小合成数据与真实数据之间的差距。我们进一步开发了一个由多模态大语言模型编排的智能体流水线，负责获取素材、规划无人机轨迹、调用合成并验证生成的视频，实现完全自动化的数据集构建。WorldUAV 包含 6,878 个无人机视频和 205,778 张无人机图像。实验表明，WorldUAV 显著提升了无人机检测器的性能。此外，它大幅降低了数据集构建成本，每张高质量无人机图像仅需 15 秒和 0.0005 美元的 API 成本。我们的工作为无人机检测与跟踪提供了高质量数据集和可扩展的数据生成范式。
translation.brief: 该论文解决无人机检测跟踪训练数据稀缺及合成数据与真实数据差距大的问题，利用世界模型将无人机融入真实视频并配合多模态大模型智能体流水线实现全自动数据集构建。

papers.title: Read Before You Use: Improving Visual Memory Utilization in Vision-Language Models
papers.abstract: Multimodal memory enables long-horizon vision-language agents to preserve and retrieve past experiences. While prior research has focused on memory construction and retrieval, effectively using the provided memory remains a challenge for vision-language models (VLMs). We find that VLMs often fail to answer downstream questions even when sufficient multimodal evidence is provided. To investigate why VLMs struggle, we replace memory images with reference captions and observe substantial performance gains, suggesting difficulties in reading visual evidence directly. However, model-generated captions may omit critical information, limiting this approach in practice. These limitations motivate a closer examination of memory utilization, revealing failures in both evidence reading and downstream question answering. Building on this distinction, we propose \textbf{MemRU}, a two-stage training framework that improves evidence reading through supervised fine-tuning (Read SFT) and downstream evidence utilization through Group Relative Policy Optimization (Use GRPO). Experimental results demonstrate that our 8B model generalizes across three unseen multimodal memory systems, outperforming Qwen3-VL-32B and approaching GPT-5-mini.

translation.title: 先读再用：提升视觉-语言模型中的视觉记忆利用率
translation.abstract: 多模态记忆使长时程视觉-语言智能体能够保存和检索过去的经验。尽管已有研究聚焦于记忆的构建与检索，但如何有效利用所提供的记忆对视觉-语言模型（VLM）而言仍是一个挑战。我们发现，即使提供了充分的多模态证据，VLM 也常常无法回答下游问题。为探究 VLM 为何表现不佳，我们将记忆图像替换为参考描述（caption），观察到显著的性能提升，这表明模型在直接读取视觉证据方面存在困难。然而，模型生成的描述可能遗漏关键信息，限制了该方法的实际应用。这些局限促使我们更深入地审视记忆利用问题，揭示出证据读取和下游问答两个环节均存在失败。基于这一区分，我们提出 MemRU，一个两阶段训练框架：通过监督微调（Read SFT）改进证据读取，通过 Group Relative Policy Optimization（Use GRPO）改进下游证据利用。实验结果表明，我们的 8B 模型能够泛化到三个未见过的多模态记忆系统，性能超过 Qwen3-VL-32B，并接近 GPT-5-mini。
translation.brief: 针对 VLM 无法有效利用多模态记忆的问题，提出 MemRU 两阶段训练框架，用监督微调改进证据读取、用 GRPO 改进证据利用。

papers.title: Refusal Is Not Scored: A Coverage Limit in Content-Based Bias Evaluation
papers.abstract: Bias audits of conversational models often discard refusals (responses such as "I can't assist with that request") before scoring, a filtering step which is rarely examined as a measurement decision even though it determines which responses an audit is capable of evaluating. This work examines what the step removes, applying seven bias-evaluation instruments spanning both deployed paradigms, three dictionary-based and four LLM-as-judge, to two intersectional datasets of 360 generated responses each. In both datasets, the filter removed a demographically skewed subset produced entirely by one of the three responder models, which refused North Korean prompts at 2.15 times the rate of American prompts on declarative content and 1.76 times on operational content. We then remove the filter and pass every refusal to all seven instruments. Bias-Lexicon scores refusals as clean, and including them shrinks the nationality disparity it reports. HurtLex appears to register the disparity, but we trace this entirely to a single lexicon entry matching the token "can" in "I can't". The LLM judges either flag most responses or rate refusals as unbiased. For the two judges that discriminate, including refusals lowers the nationality disparity they report, and no instrument identifies the refusal disparity. The failure is therefore a coverage limit upstream of scoring rather than a calibration gap that a better lexicon or judge prompt would be expected to close, which makes the behavioral channel an instrument is sensitive to a question of construct validity rather than one of method selection.

translation.title: 拒答未被计分：基于内容的偏见评估中的覆盖局限
translation.abstract: 对对话式模型的偏见审计通常在计分前丢弃拒答（如"我无法协助该请求"之类的回复），这一过滤步骤很少被当作测量决策加以审视，尽管它决定了审计能够评估哪些回复。本文考察该步骤究竟移除了什么，将七种偏见评估工具（涵盖两种已部署范式：三种基于词典的方法和四种 LLM-as-judge 方法）应用于两个各含 360 条生成回复的交叉性数据集。在两个数据集中，过滤器移除的子集在人口统计上存在偏斜，且完全由三个响应模型之一产生——该模型对朝鲜相关提示的拒答率是美国的 2.15 倍（陈述性内容）和 1.76 倍（操作性内容）。随后我们移除过滤器，将所有拒答输入全部七种工具。Bias-Lexicon 将拒答评为无偏见，纳入拒答后其报告的国籍差异缩小。HurtLex 似乎捕捉到了这一差异，但我们追溯发现这完全源于词典中一个匹配"I can't"中"can"一词的词条。LLM 裁判要么标记大多数回复，要么将拒答评为无偏见。对于两个能区分差异的裁判，纳入拒答会降低其报告的国籍差异，且没有任何工具识别出拒答差异。因此，这一失败是计分上游的覆盖局限，而非更好的词典或裁判提示所能弥合的校准差距，这使得工具所敏感的行为通道问题属于构念效度问题，而非方法选择问题。
translation.brief: 针对偏见审计在计分前丢弃拒答导致系统性覆盖缺失的问题，通过七种评估工具的实证分析揭示这是计分上游的构念效度局限而非校准问题。

papers.title: L2C2: Enhancing Large-scale Chiplets for Agent Long-Context LLM Inference with Sparse and Distributed Attention
papers.abstract: Long-context inference is a rising demand for LLMs, especially for agent applications. Sparse attention (SpAt) and chiplet technology are promising solutions to reduce computations and scale hardware performance. However, deploying SpAt on distributed chiplets necessitates context parallelism for workload partitioning, introducing complex distributed attention. In this work, we present L2C2, a system optimization for distributed SpAt in long-context inference. During the partial-prefill stage, we propose a novel Split-Comm Attention mechanism that leverages the high-bandwidth interconnect of chiplets to trade communication overhead for reduced memory access. We combine it with conventional Ring Attention to form a Bi-Mode method that adapts to varying input sequence lengths. During the decoding stage, we analyze the cause of memory access imbalance and address it by static interleaved token assignment. Dynamic agile cache balancing is also proposed to adapt to SpAt skewness. Evaluations show our optimization can achieve 1.45$\times$ and 1.53$\times$ speedup in partial-prefill and decoding with SpAt on large-scale chiplets.

translation.title: L2C2：基于稀疏分布式注意力的大规模 Chiplet 智能体长上下文 LLM 推理增强
translation.abstract: 长上下文推理是 LLM 日益增长的需求，在智能体应用中尤为突出。稀疏注意力（SpAt）和 chiplet 技术是减少计算量和扩展硬件性能的有前景方案。然而，在分布式 chiplet 上部署 SpAt 需要上下文并行来进行负载划分，从而引入复杂的分布式注意力。本文提出 L2C2，一个面向长上下文推理中分布式 SpAt 的系统优化方案。在部分预填充（partial-prefill）阶段，我们提出新颖的 Split-Comm Attention 机制，利用 chiplet 的高带宽互连，以通信开销换取内存访问的减少；并将其与传统的 Ring Attention 结合，形成可适应不同输入序列长度的 Bi-Mode 方法。在解码阶段，我们分析了内存访问不均衡的成因，并通过静态交错 token 分配加以解决；同时提出动态敏捷缓存均衡以适应 SpAt 的偏斜性。评估表明，我们的优化在大规模 chiplet 上使用 SpAt 时，可在部分预填充和解码阶段分别实现 1.45 倍和 1.53 倍的加速。
translation.brief: 针对分布式 chiplet 上部署稀疏注意力进行长上下文推理的难题，提出 L2C2 系统，通过 Split-Comm Attention、Bi-Mode 方法及缓存均衡优化预填充与解码阶段。

papers.title: Sports Agent: A Self-Evolving System for Conversational Data Analytics
papers.abstract: Conversational sports analytics requires accurate, evidence-based responses with low latency. Changes in query distributions, data resources, and model behavior can degrade static agent configurations, motivating controlled evolution guided by runtime evidence. We present Sports Agent, a self-evolving framework integrating an Agentic SQL Model for structured-data reasoning, a harness for planning and tool orchestration, and a unified Feedback Engine connecting online execution with offline evolution. The engine assesses responses and execution trajectories, verifies factual claims, diagnoses failures, and generates evolution signals. Model evolution combines SQL-to-Question Scaling for coverage expansion with Graph-Guided Scaling for error-targeted synthesis. Generated questions undergo trajectory distillation and quality filtering for iterative supervised fine-tuning, followed by a separate Post-RL stage. Harness evolution translates recurrent failures into bounded prompt and skill updates, validated through independent audits, execution replay, and regression testing. Performance-tolerance checks guard against unacceptable degradation during simplification. The resulting Qwen3.6-35B-A3B-based model outperforms Qwen3.8-Max on sports question answering and analysis while achieving approximately three times the inference efficiency. Across 30 harness-evolution rounds, the aggregate performance score improves by 10.8 points. In a live sports analytics product, the evolved system improves factual correctness by 10.5 points and average response length, a proxy for answer richness, by 158.1%, while reducing average latency by 41.3% relative to the baseline.

translation.title: Sports Agent：面向对话式数据分析的自进化系统
translation.abstract: 对话式体育数据分析要求低延迟的准确、有据可依的回复。查询分布、数据资源和模型行为的变化会使静态智能体配置性能退化，因此需要由运行时证据引导的受控进化。我们提出 Sports Agent，一个自进化框架，集成了用于结构化数据推理的 Agentic SQL Model、用于规划与工具编排的 harness，以及连接在线执行与离线进化的统一 Feedback Engine。该引擎评估回复与执行轨迹、验证事实性声明、诊断失败并生成进化信号。模型进化结合了用于覆盖扩展的 SQL-to-Question Scaling 与面向错误定向合成的 Graph-Guided Scaling。生成的问题经过轨迹蒸馏和质量过滤用于迭代监督微调，随后是独立的 Post-RL 阶段。Harness 进化将反复出现的失败转化为有界的提示与技能更新，并通过独立审计、执行回放和回归测试加以验证。性能-容差检查用于防范简化过程中不可接受的性能退化。基于 Qwen3.6-35B-A3B 的最终模型在体育问答与分析上超越 Qwen3.8-Max，同时实现约三倍的推理效率。在 30 轮 harness 进化中，综合性能得分提升 10.8 分。在一个线上体育分析产品中，进化后的系统将事实正确性提升 10.5 分，将平均回复长度（答案丰富度的代理指标）提升 158.1%，同时相对基线将平均延迟降低 41.3%。
translation.brief: 针对静态对话式体育分析智能体随环境变化而退化的问题，提出 Sports Agent 自进化框架，通过反馈引擎驱动的模型进化与 harness 进化实现持续改进。

papers.title: EVA: Evidence-seeking Visual Agent for Hallucination-Resistant Multimodal Reasoning
papers.abstract: Hallucinations in multimodal large language models (MLLMs) often arise from visual assumptions that go unchecked. Self-reflection, multi-agent debate, and counterfactual verification can reinforce erroneous conclusions when they rely on the same unverified visual assumptions. External visual tools can provide verifiable evidence, but models may select the wrong tools, supply incorrect parameters, or ignore or contradict the evidence they obtain. In this work, we propose EVA, an Evidence-seeking Visual Agent that reframes multimodal reasoning as an explicit process of evidence acquisition and verification. At the core of EVA is a unified evidence-grounded execution pipeline designed to address the above challenges through two tightly coupled mechanisms. First, we introduce Iterative Tool Replanning, which dynamically refines tool selection and parameters based on intermediate observations, improving the reliability of tool usage. Second, we develop Evidence Consistency Verification, an answer validation mechanism that improves alignment between the final prediction and the collected evidence, mitigating evidence--reasoning inconsistencies. In addition, to balance robustness and efficiency, EVA incorporates Selective Evidence Routing, an adaptive fast--slow reasoning strategy that determines when external evidence is necessary. Visually straightforward queries are handled via direct reasoning, while complex or high-risk cases trigger tool-based evidence acquisition. By jointly addressing how to reliably acquire evidence and how to use it consistently, EVA transforms multimodal reasoning from passive answer validation into explicit evidence-backed decision making. Experimental results demonstrate that EVA achieves significantly improved reasoning reliability over direct VLM inference and multi-agent methods, while maintaining efficiency through selective tool invocation.

translation.title: EVA：面向抗幻觉多模态推理的证据寻求型视觉智能体
translation.abstract: 多模态大语言模型（MLLM）的幻觉往往源于未经检验的视觉假设。当自我反思、多智能体辩论和反事实验证依赖同样的未验证视觉假设时，它们反而可能强化错误结论。外部视觉工具可以提供可验证的证据，但模型可能选错工具、提供错误参数，或忽视乃至与所获证据相矛盾。本文提出 EVA，一个证据寻求型视觉智能体（Evidence-seeking Visual Agent），将多模态推理重构为显式的证据获取与验证过程。EVA 的核心是一个统一的证据落地执行流水线，通过两个紧密耦合的机制应对上述挑战。首先，我们引入迭代式工具重规划（Iterative Tool Replanning），基于中间观察动态调整工具选择与参数，提升工具使用的可靠性。其次，我们开发了证据一致性验证（Evidence Consistency Verification），一种答案验证机制，用于提升最终预测与所收集证据之间的一致性，缓解证据-推理不一致问题。此外，为平衡鲁棒性与效率，EVA 引入选择性证据路由（Selective Evidence Routing），一种自适应的快-慢推理策略，用于判断何时需要外部证据：视觉上直观的查询通过直接推理处理，而复杂或高风险的情形则触发基于工具的证据获取。通过同时解决如何可靠获取证据以及如何一致使用证据，EVA 将多模态推理从被动的答案验证转变为显式的有证据支撑的决策。实验结果表明，EVA 相比直接 VLM 推理和多智能体方法显著提升了推理可靠性，同时通过选择性工具调用保持了效率。
translation.brief: 针对 MLLM 因未验证视觉假设产生幻觉的问题，提出 EVA 智能体，通过迭代工具重规划、证据一致性验证和选择性证据路由实现显式的证据获取与验证。

papers.title: P-FedSkill: A Personalized Federated Skill Learning Framework under Task Heterogeneity
papers.abstract: Skill learning has become an important way to improve agent performance. However, agent trajectories often contain sensitive information and cannot be shared across clients, hindering collaborative skill learning. To tackle this issue, federated skill learning (FSL) has emerged as a solution by distilling trajectories into compact skill representations and uploading them to a central server for sharing. However, existing FSL methods typically share skills based on skill similarity without considering their contributions to heterogeneous tasks across clients, thereby degrading agent performance. To address this challenge, we propose P-FedSkill, a personalized FSL framework that comprises three key components: local skill extraction (LSE), personalized skill selection (PSS), and task-aware skill routing (TASR). Specifically, LSE first extracts skill patches (i.e., task applicability conditions and execution strategies) and task execution outcomes from trajectories. PSS then uses these outcomes to evaluate each skill patch's performance on client tasks and incorporates its task applicability condition to construct a personalized skill set for each client. Finally, TASR adaptively selects a task-relevant subset of skill patches based on their applicability conditions to guide agent execution. We further provide a theoretical guarantee for personalized skill selection in P-FedSkill, and extensive experiments also demonstrate its effectiveness.

translation.title: P-FedSkill：一种任务异构性下的个性化联邦技能学习框架
translation.abstract: 技能学习已成为提升智能体性能的重要方式。然而，智能体轨迹往往包含敏感信息，无法在客户端之间共享，阻碍了协作式技能学习。为解决这一问题，联邦技能学习（FSL）应运而生，其做法是将轨迹蒸馏为紧凑的技能表示并上传至中央服务器进行共享。然而，现有FSL方法通常仅基于技能相似度共享技能，而未考虑其对客户端异构任务的贡献，从而降低了智能体性能。为应对这一挑战，我们提出P-FedSkill，一个个性化FSL框架，包含三个关键组件：本地技能提取（LSE）、个性化技能选择（PSS）和任务感知技能路由（TASR）。具体而言，LSE首先从轨迹中提取技能片段（即任务适用条件与执行策略）以及任务执行结果。PSS随后利用这些结果评估每个技能片段在客户端任务上的表现，并结合其任务适用条件为每个客户端构建个性化技能集。最后，TASR根据适用条件自适应地选择与任务相关的技能片段子集来指导智能体执行。我们进一步为P-FedSkill中的个性化技能选择提供了理论保证，大量实验也证明了其有效性。
translation.brief: 针对联邦技能学习中技能共享忽略异构任务贡献的问题，提出包含本地技能提取、个性化技能选择和任务感知技能路由的P-FedSkill框架。

papers.title: PowerFix: Physics-Guided Iterative Repair for LLM-Assisted Power Converter Design
papers.abstract: Large language model (LLM) agents are increasingly being explored for automated engineering design. However, repairing power-converter designs that fail engineering validation remains challenging: the system must identify physical causes, locate responsible design variables, and resolve violations without compromising other constraints. We introduce PowerFix, a physics-guided iterative repair framework that converts validation failures into structured diagnoses and executable patches while preserving topology and design requirements. PowerDiagGraph links failed checks to possible physical causes and constrains repair routes. An LLM prioritizes these routes, while a deterministic compiler translates selected repairs into authorized field-level edits. Candidates are validated on isolated design copies and committed only after all required engineering checks pass; failed validation can guide replanning. On our constructed 96-task flyback repair benchmark, comprising injected single faults, coupled faults, and held-out natural failures from our design generator, PowerFix achieves 78.7% verified repair success rate (VRSR), compared with 30.1% for the strongest of three LLM baselines. Three additional replanning rounds increase VRSR to 88.4%. These offline results provide pilot-stage evidence within a simulation-based design workflow, with hardware prototype validation and transfer to a second converter topology as the next steps toward deployment.

translation.title: PowerFix：面向LLM辅助电源变换器设计的物理引导迭代修复框架
translation.abstract: 大语言模型（LLM）智能体正被越来越多地探索用于自动化工程设计。然而，修复未通过工程验证的电源变换器设计仍然具有挑战性：系统必须识别物理原因、定位相关设计变量，并在不损害其他约束的前提下解决违规问题。我们提出PowerFix，一个物理引导的迭代修复框架，它将验证失败转化为结构化诊断和可执行补丁，同时保持拓扑结构和设计要求。PowerDiagGraph将失败的检查项与可能的物理原因关联并约束修复路径。LLM对这些路径进行优先级排序，而确定性编译器将选定的修复转换为经授权的字段级编辑。候选方案在隔离的设计副本上进行验证，只有通过所有必需的工程检查后才被提交；验证失败可指导重新规划。在我们构建的包含96个任务的flyback修复基准上（涵盖注入的单故障、耦合故障以及来自我们设计生成器的保留自然故障），PowerFix达到78.7%的验证修复成功率（VRSR），而三个LLM基线中最强者为30.1%。额外的三轮重新规划将VRSR提升至88.4%。这些离线结果为基于仿真的设计流程提供了试点阶段证据，硬件原型验证和向第二种变换器拓扑的迁移是迈向部署的下一步。
translation.brief: 针对LLM修复电源变换器设计验证失败的问题，提出将失败转化为结构化诊断并由确定性编译器执行字段级编辑的物理引导迭代修复框架PowerFix。

papers.title: NORMCRAFT: Cultural Norm Generation for Context-Aware Language Model Alignment
papers.abstract: Cultural alignment requires large language models (LLMs) to infer often-implicit social norms from a scenario and its cultural context. Existing approaches typically adapt individual models or supply external cultural knowledge, while learning norm inference independently of downstream response generation remains underexplored. We introduce NORMCRAFT, a modular framework that decouples norm inference from response generation. Through norm-centric multi-view supervision, we train an LLM as a norm generator to recover shared norms from prospective, adherence, and violation scenarios without downstream response labels. The generated norms guide a separate, frozen LLM (the responder). With Qwen3.5-4B as the responder, NORMCRAFT outperforms prompting and supervised fine-tuning (SFT) baselines on four of five downstream metrics. On SafeWorld, its responses reflect the reference norms more often (Coverage) and more precisely (Faithfulness), exceeding Responder SFT by 18.0 and 14.1 percentage points, respectively. Direct norm evaluation also shows higher norm quality than the base and few-shot generators. The same trained generator improves cultural alignment on SafeWorld across fourteen frozen LLMs spanning five families and 0.8B to 27B parameters, with the largest gains for the smallest models.

translation.title: NORMCRAFT：面向情境感知语言模型对齐的文化规范生成
