translation.abstract: 文化对齐要求大语言模型（LLM）能够从场景及其文化背景中推断出通常隐含的社会规范。现有方法通常调整单个模型或提供外部文化知识，而将规范推断与下游响应生成分开学习仍未被充分探索。我们提出NORMCRAFT，一个将规范推断与响应生成解耦的模块化框架。通过以规范为中心的多视角监督，我们训练一个LLM作为规范生成器，从预期、遵守和违反规范的场景中恢复共享规范，而无需下游响应标签。生成的规范指导另一个冻结的LLM（响应器）。以Qwen3.5-4B作为响应器，NORMCRAFT在五项下游指标中的四项上优于提示和监督微调（SFT）基线。在SafeWorld上，其响应更频繁（Coverage）且更精确（Faithfulness）地反映参考规范，分别超过Responder SFT 18.0和14.1个百分点。直接规范评估也显示其规范质量高于基础生成器和少样本生成器。同一个训练好的生成器在涵盖五个模型家族、参数规模从0.8B到27B的十四个冻结LLM上提升了SafeWorld的文化对齐效果，其中最小模型的提升最大。
translation.brief: 针对文化对齐中规范推断与响应生成耦合的问题，提出通过多视角监督训练规范生成器来指导冻结响应器的模块化框架NORMCRAFT。

papers.title: Knocking on Minds Door; A Mixed-Methods Field Study of a Voice LLM Companion in Older Adults Daily Lives
papers.abstract: Global aging makes digital technology important for older adults healthy aging, yet graphical user interfaces remain inaccessible to many. Voice agents based on large language models may help, but users needs and reasons for sustained use remain unclear. We developed a phone-call-style companion that initiates conversations proactively and structures calls using a persona, conversation rules, and prior-call memory (facts, insights, relationship background). We conducted a two-week mixed-methods field study with 33 community-dwelling Korean older adults (29 women; aged 67-91), collecting call logs, pre-post questionnaires, and interviews. Participants made 608 calls following a daily-use recommendation; 25 continued afterward despite turn-taking difficulties. Loneliness and depression scores decreased significantly; among loneliness subfactors, only isolation (emotional loneliness) decreased significantly. Participants disclosed concerns withheld from family and linked companionship to being addressed by name, being remembered, and experiencing emotional reciprocity. We propose personalized conversation rules, accessible interaction, and user control over frequency and topics.

translation.title: 叩响心灵之门：语音LLM陪伴应用在老年人日常生活中的混合方法实地研究
translation.abstract: 全球老龄化使数字技术对老年人健康老龄化变得重要，然而图形用户界面对许多老年人仍难以使用。基于大语言模型的语音智能体或许能提供帮助，但用户的需求和持续使用的原因仍不清楚。我们开发了一种电话通话式陪伴应用，能够主动发起对话，并利用人设、对话规则和先前通话记忆（事实、洞察、关系背景）来组织通话。我们对33名社区居住的韩国老年人（29名女性；年龄67-91岁）开展了为期两周的混合方法实地研究，收集了通话记录、前后问卷和访谈。参与者按照每日使用建议共拨打了608通电话；25人在研究结束后仍继续使用，尽管存在话轮转换困难。孤独感和抑郁评分显著下降；在孤独感子因素中，只有孤立感（情感孤独）显著下降。参与者会倾诉对家人隐瞒的担忧，并将陪伴感与被称呼名字、被记住以及体验情感互惠联系起来。我们提出个性化对话规则、无障碍交互以及用户对频率和话题的控制权。
translation.brief: 针对老年人数字陪伴需求不明的问题，开发主动发起通话的语音LLM陪伴应用并通过两周实地研究考察其使用情况与心理影响。

papers.title: Asset4D-Bench: Benchmarking Coding Agents for Editable 3D and 4D Reconstruction
papers.abstract: A cart can follow its reference trajectory while its cargo floats above the deck. Asset4D-Bench tests whether coding agents recover objects, motion and interactions from visual references as editable Blender scenes. Its 114 conditions span image editing, video reconstruction with matched full or partial starter assets, and independently selected from-scratch tasks. We independently reopen projects and measure them against native reference states. The 228 archived scores include original delivery outcomes and versioned measures of scene quality. On 24 from-scratch tasks, each model earns full dynamics credit on 14. Of these, three GPT-6.1-Sol and eight GPT-6-Astra reconstructions earn zero relation points. Under the fixed scoring weights, relations contribute 5.15 points to the 6.50-point Sol-minus-Astra difference in mean recovered fidelity. Differences in execution and recovery policy across archived runs preclude a causal estimate of starter-asset effects.

translation.title: Asset4D-Bench：面向可编辑3D与4D重建的编码智能体基准测试
translation.abstract: 一辆小车可以跟随其参考轨迹行驶，同时其货物悬浮在甲板上方。Asset4D-Bench测试编码智能体能否从视觉参考中恢复物体、运动和交互，并生成可编辑的Blender场景。其114个条件涵盖图像编辑、使用匹配的完整或部分初始资产的视频重建，以及独立选择的从零开始任务。我们独立重新打开项目，并对照原生参考状态进行测量。228个存档评分包括原始交付结果和场景质量的版本化度量。在24个从零开始任务中，每个模型在14个任务上获得完整的动力学得分。其中，三个GPT-6.1-Sol和八个GPT-6-Astra重建的关系得分为零。在固定评分权重下，关系项对Sol与Astra平均恢复保真度6.50分差距贡献了5.15分。由于存档运行中执行和恢复策略的差异，无法对初始资产的影响进行因果估计。
translation.brief: 针对评估编码智能体从视觉参考重建可编辑3D/4D场景能力缺乏基准的问题，构建包含114个条件、以原生参考状态为对照的Asset4D-Bench基准。

papers.title: JOVE ICE: Intent Guided Cloud Edge Device Collaboration for AI Glasses
papers.abstract: Recent advances in large language models (LLMs) and LLM based agents have expanded the capabilities of AI glasses, enabling egocentric visual question answering, memory retrieval, and proactive assistance. These applications involve diverse inputs, including speech, images, and video, and range from simple device control to complex visual reasoning, posing challenges for efficient computation and communication. While video centric capabilities have received considerable attention, simple text based and device executable tasks remain underexplored despite their prevalence in daily interactions. Efficiently supporting diverse workloads within a unified assistant remains an open challenge. We propose JOVE ICE, an intent guided cloud, edge, and device collaborative framework that routes requests among AI glasses, a paired smartphone, and cloud servers according to user intent. JOVE ICE integrates hierarchical intent classification with dynamic subagent orchestration to select efficient execution paths and flexibly incorporate new applications through specialized subagents. Analysis of real world AI glasses requests reveals that simple device control tasks account for over 30% of interactions, which JOVE ICE handles directly on device to avoid unnecessary cloud computation and costs. Evaluations on three public benchmarks demonstrate that JOVE ICE reduces time to first token by approximately 13% and token usage by over 11% compared with conventional device and cloud architectures, while maintaining task quality. These results demonstrate the potential of intent guided collaboration to improve the efficiency and scalability of AI glasses.

translation.title: JOVE ICE：面向AI眼镜的意图引导云边端协同框架
translation.abstract: 大语言模型（LLM）及基于LLM的智能体的最新进展扩展了AI眼镜的能力，使其能够进行第一人称视觉问答、记忆检索和主动辅助。这些应用涉及语音、图像和视频等多种输入，任务范围从简单的设备控制到复杂的视觉推理，给高效计算与通信带来挑战。尽管以视频为中心的能力受到广泛关注，但简单基于文本和设备可执行的任务在日常交互中十分普遍，却仍缺乏研究。如何在统一助手中高效支持多样化工作负载仍是开放问题。我们提出JOVE ICE，一个意图引导的云、边、端协同框架，根据用户意图在AI眼镜、配对智能手机和云服务器之间路由请求。JOVE ICE将分层意图分类与动态子智能体编排相结合，以选择高效执行路径，并通过专门的子智能体灵活接入新应用。对真实世界AI眼镜请求的分析表明，简单设备控制任务占交互的30%以上，JOVE ICE直接在设备端处理这些任务，避免不必要的云端计算和成本。在三个公开基准上的评估显示，与传统的设备-云架构相比，JOVE ICE将首token时间降低约13%，token使用量降低超过11%，同时保持任务质量。这些结果展示了意图引导协同在提升AI眼镜效率和可扩展性方面的潜力。
translation.brief: 针对AI眼镜上多样化工作负载的高效执行问题，提出根据用户意图在设备、手机与云端之间路由请求的协同框架，结合分层意图分类与动态子智能体编排。

papers.title: AI Persona Dialogue Pipeline; From Survey Report to Conversational Personas, Evaluated by LLMs and Experts
papers.abstract: Simulating dialogue of a population with LLM-enacted personas is increasingly common, yet each pipeline is generally built for one task, so a new task usually means reworking how the persona is authored, enacted and evaluated. We present an end-to-end persona dialogue pipeline meant to carry over to other populations as a whole; a background is written by an LLM from a national survey report, an off-the-shelf LLM enacts it without fine-tuning, and both are rated for perceived plausibility. We apply it to thirty personas of Korean older adults living alone; three LLM judges compare eight simulator LLMs, and thirty experts who work with this population evaluate the selected one, GPT-5.5. Experts found the backgrounds and dialogues largely realistic but most often faulted a persona for being more capable than its background said, and agreement between their ratings and the LLM judges could not be established. We release the pipeline, personas and their dialogues.

translation.title: AI人格对话流水线：从调查报告到对话人格，由LLM与专家共同评估
translation.abstract: 用LLM扮演的人格模拟群体对话日益普遍，但每条流水线通常只为单一任务构建，新任务往往意味着重写人格的创建、扮演和评估方式。我们提出一条端到端的人格对话流水线，旨在作为整体迁移到其他群体：背景由LLM根据全国调查报告撰写，现成的LLM无需微调即可扮演该人格，并对两者的感知合理性进行评分。我们将其应用于三十个韩国独居老年人的人格；三个LLM评审比较八个模拟器LLM，三十名服务该群体的专家评估选出的GPT-5.5。专家认为背景和对话大体真实，但最常见的批评是人格能力超出其背景所述，且专家评分与LLM评审之间无法建立一致性。我们公开了该流水线、人格及其对话。
translation.brief: 针对人格对话流水线难以跨任务复用的问题，提出由LLM从调查报告自动生成人格背景并由现成LLM扮演的端到端流水线，并用LLM评审与领域专家进行合理性评估。

papers.title: FlashProve-Next: Verifiable Inference for Production LLM APIs
papers.abstract: Clients of closed-weight LLM APIs cannot verify whether a provider ran the advertised model, precision, hidden prompt, and reasoning budget. Existing approaches either trust hardware or third parties, or re-prove every layer of an integer surrogate at high cost while diverging from native floating-point serving. FlashProve-Next produces verifiable, zero-knowledge-masked proofs for individual LLM API responses without modifying native serving (bf16/fp8/mxfp4, random sampling, FlashAttention, CUDA graphs, batching, prefix caching) and without disclosing weights, hidden prompts, hidden reasoning, or activations (dense profiles fix coarse geometry; cross-architecture hiding is deferred). A non-depleting Reed-Solomon weight commitment model_id opens inside proofs via hidden column openings, while local per-operator rounding contracts remove integer surrogates and the refusal-bit leak. Cost-weighted spot-checking supports non-interactive public verification (NI-315, $\varepsilon \le 2^{-40}$, $Q \le 2^{64}$) and external-seed C_pre mode (ExtSeed-153, $\varepsilon \le 2^{-20}$, $Q_{\rm samp} \le 2^{30}$). Twenty-eight Lean 4 modules (696 declarations, zero sorry, standard axioms only) mechanize round-by-round soundness, bucketed sampling, $\mathbb{F}_{p^3}$ constrained-mask binding, causal masking, six IR gadgets, and executable FPN2 verifiers. Five-model Blackwell calibration gives zero false rejections across 1.85M GEMM/MoE blocks and 1.96M non-GEMM rows. Our zero-Phase-2 folded backend (folded ZK simulator open) proves Qwen3-0.6B ExtSeed-153 (1.47B cells, 8 MiB) in 450.2 s GPU (10.76 s CPU) at unique-decoding $Q=128$, passes a 14/14 cheating matrix, and scales to 36-layer Qwen3-4B (dev $4+2$) and live vLLM Qwen3-30B-A3B-FP8 Relation 6 (1.49 s prove, 23.4 ms Rust verify, public weight tiles). Rust fpn-verify checks 8 MiB FPN2 Relation 2 proofs in 10.1 ms on CPU.

translation.title: FlashProve-Next：面向生产级LLM API的可验证推理
translation.abstract: 闭源权重LLM API的客户端无法验证提供商是否运行了所宣称的模型、精度、隐藏提示和推理预算。现有方法要么信任硬件或第三方，要么以高昂代价对整数代理的每一层重新证明，且偏离原生浮点服务。FlashProve-Next为单个LLM API响应生成可验证的、零知识掩码的证明，无需修改原生服务（bf16/fp8/mxfp4、随机采样、FlashAttention、CUDA graphs、批处理、前缀缓存），也不泄露权重、隐藏提示、隐藏推理或激活值（稠密配置固定粗粒度几何结构；跨架构隐藏留待后续）。一种不耗尽的Reed-Solomon权重承诺model_id通过隐藏列打开在证明内部开启，而每个算子的本地舍入契约消除了整数代理和拒绝位泄露。成本加权抽检支持非交互式公开验证（NI-315，ε≤2^-40，Q≤2^64）和外部种子C_pre模式（ExtSeed-153，ε≤2^-20，Q_samp≤2^30）。二十八个Lean 4模块（696个声明，零sorry，仅标准公理）机械化验证了逐轮可靠性、分桶采样、F_p^3约束掩码绑定、因果掩码、六个IR组件和可执行的FPN2验证器。五模型Blackwell校准在185万个GEMM/MoE块和196万非GEMM行上实现零误拒。我们的零Phase-2折叠后端（折叠ZK模拟器开源）在450.2秒GPU（10.76秒CPU）内证明Qwen3-0.6B ExtSeed-153（14.7亿单元，8 MiB），唯一解码Q=128，通过14/14作弊矩阵，并可扩展至36层Qwen3-4B（dev 4+2）和在线vLLM Qwen3-30B-A3B-FP8 Relation 6（1.49秒证明，23.4毫秒Rust验证，公开权重分块）。Rust fpn-verify在CPU上10.1毫秒内校验8 MiB FPN2 Relation 2证明。
translation.brief: 针对闭源LLM API响应无法被客户端验证的问题，提出在不修改原生浮点服务且不泄露权重与隐藏信息的前提下，基于零知识证明与成本加权抽检生成可验证推理证明的系统。

papers.title: Tells of a Lying Machine: Analyzing LLM-Generated Strategic Dialogue in Chinese Werewolf
papers.abstract: Social-deduction games give models opposing objectives, but they also give roles different information and speaking obligations. We analyze 5,404 public utterances from 150 Chinese Werewolf games played by 12 models, comparing ordinary wolves with ordinary villagers so that special roles are excluded. Private knowledge and goals still differ, and no utterance is verified as true or false. After model and length adjustment, wolf utterances score higher on both certainty and uncertainty (coefficients +0.074 and +0.072). Emotional intensification has the largest rank-biserial effect (r = .145), but it depends on a single degree marker and correlates weakly with human-rated affect. Three annotators' ratings of 392 utterances show higher wolf scores on four behavioral dimensions, and five LLM judges reach 60.8%-70.2% accuracy on a shared evaluation set. In a generation probe that prompts six models with a wolf identity but a villager speaking goal under fixed public context, certainty (+0.164) and emotional intensification (+0.095) increase. These findings describe role-associated language rather than verified lying, and they argue for explicit comparison groups and lexicon sensitivity checks in game-based deception evaluation. Data and code are available at this https URL

translation.title: 说谎机器的破绽：分析中文狼人杀中LLM生成的策略性对话
translation.abstract: 社交推理游戏赋予模型对立目标，但也赋予不同角色不同的信息和发言义务。我们分析了12个模型进行的150局中文狼人杀中的5,404条公开发言，比较普通狼人与普通村民以排除特殊角色。私有知识和目标仍然不同，且没有任何发言被验证为真或假。在模型和长度调整后，狼人发言在确定性和不确定性上得分均更高（系数分别为+0.074和+0.072）。情感强化具有最大的秩双列效应（r=.145），但它依赖于单一程度标记，且与人工评定的情感强度相关性较弱。三名标注者对392条发言的评分显示狼人在四个行为维度上得分更高，五个LLM评审在共享评估集上达到60.8%-70.2%的准确率。在一个生成探针中，在固定公开语境下提示六个模型以狼人身份但村民发言目标，确定性和情感强化分别增加+0.164和+0.095。这些发现描述的是与角色相关的语言特征而非经过验证的说谎，并主张在基于游戏的欺骗评估中采用明确的对照组和词表敏感性检查。数据与代码见此https URL。
translation.brief: 针对LLM在社交推理游戏中是否表现出可检测的角色性语言特征的问题，通过对比中文狼人杀中普通狼人与村民的发言进行语言学分析。

papers.title: REFORGE: LLM-Assisted RTL Bug Repair with Structured Context and Verification Feedback
papers.abstract: Large language models (LLMs) can write and repair RTL, but successful compilation or testbench execution does not establish defect removal, behavioral preservation, security, or implementation feasibility. Existing LLM-based RTL repair methods often report a single repair rate without retaining separate evidence for these properties, limiting reproducible comparison and integration into hardware design flows. We present REFORGE, which, to our knowledge, is the first LLM-assisted RTL repair framework that maintains and accumulates structured repair evidence across iterations, allowing it to generate fixes that satisfy multiple objectives simultaneously, including functionality, behavioral equivalence, security, and cost efficiency. REFORGE profiles buggy RTL, identifies structural and security-relevant features, localizes failing behavior, and uses verification-guided diagnosis to generate complete RTL repair variants. Each variant undergoes syntax checking, simulation, formal analysis, off-trigger preservation, security re-scan, and synthesis-based power, performance, and area analysis. We implement REFORGE as a backend-independent repair-and-verification flow and evaluate it in 288 runs across three LLM backends and three benchmark suites. On CirFix, the proposed context and diagnosis increase runs delivering a checked repair from 32/63 to 51/63, while every configuration repairs the Hack@DAC OpenTitan defect. Evidence records also show that a testbench-only criterion reports 3.9 times more repairs than the full set of applicable checks, security-clean outputs may lack functional verification, and different RTL repairs can implement equivalent hardware. These results show that LLM-generated RTL repairs require explicit multi-stage verification evidence rather than a single pass/fail outcome.

translation.title: REFORGE：基于结构化上下文与验证反馈的LLM辅助RTL缺陷修复
translation.abstract: 大语言模型（LLM）能够编写和修复RTL，但编译成功或测试平台执行通过并不能证明缺陷消除、行为保持、安全性或实现可行性。现有基于LLM的RTL修复方法通常只报告单一修复率，而不为这些属性保留独立证据，限制了可复现的比较以及与硬件设计流程的集成。我们提出REFORGE，据我们所知是首个在迭代过程中维护并积累结构化修复证据的LLM辅助RTL修复框架，使其能够生成同时满足功能、行为等价、安全性和成本效率等多重目标的修复方案。REFORGE对有缺陷的RTL进行剖析，识别结构和安全相关特征，定位失败行为，并使用验证引导的诊断生成完整的RTL修复变体。每个变体经过语法检查、仿真、形式化分析、off触发条件保持、安全重扫描以及基于综合的功耗、性能和面积分析。我们将REFORGE实现为与后端无关的修复-验证流程，并在三个LLM后端和三个基准套件上进行了288次运行评估。在CirFix上，所提出的上下文和诊断将通过检查的修复运行次数从32/63提升到51/63，且所有配置均修复了Hack@DAC OpenTitan缺陷。证据记录还表明，仅测试平台标准报告的修复数量是全套适用检查的3.9倍，安全干净的输出可能缺乏功能验证，且不同的RTL修复可以实现等价硬件。这些结果表明，LLM生成的RTL修复需要显式的多阶段验证证据，而非单一的通过/失败结果。
translation.brief: 针对LLM修复RTL时缺乏多目标验证证据的问题，提出在迭代中积累结构化修复证据并结合验证引导诊断的修复框架REFORGE。

papers.title: TransHarness: From Benchmark Overfitting to Transferable Harness Evolution
papers.abstract: Harness evolution offers a path to improving coding agents without updating model weights. However, existing methods can overfit their evolution benchmarks, producing gains that fail to carry over to new tasks. To address this challenge, we introduce Transferable Harness Evolution (TransHarness), which evolves harness intervention policies from same-task success-failure contrasts. These policies couple execution-context triggers with diagnostic guidance, enabling task-dependent checks and corrections beyond the source executions. Cross-task replay and independent semantic selection retain policies that intervene selectively and ground corrections in current-task evidence rather than source-specific solutions. We further curate an independent evolution set for cross-distribution transfer and conduct a cross-benchmark evaluation covering multiple strong models and a range of lightweight and mature harnesses. Experiments show that, with only 300 source trajectories from outside the test distribution, TransHarness further improves strong agents across distinct target benchmarks, demonstrating transferable harness evolution beyond benchmark overfitting. Specifically, TransHarness achieves state-of-the-art scores of 76.4% on DeepSWE v1.1 and 95.5% on Terminal-Bench 2.1, surpassing the strongest baseline model, GPT-6 Astra, by 2.4 and 5.6 percentage points, respectively.

translation.title: TransHarness：从基准过拟合到可迁移的 Harness 演化
translation.abstract: Harness 演化为在不更新模型权重的情况下改进编码智能体提供了一条路径。然而，现有方法可能对其演化基准过拟合，所产生的增益无法迁移到新任务上。为应对这一挑战，我们提出可迁移 Harness 演化（TransHarness），它从同任务的成功-失败对比中演化 harness 干预策略。这些策略将执行上下文触发器与诊断性指导相结合，实现超越源执行的任务相关检查与纠正。跨任务重放与独立的语义筛选保留那些有选择性地干预、并将纠正建立在当前任务证据而非源任务特定方案之上的策略。我们进一步构建了一个独立的演化集用于跨分布迁移，并开展了覆盖多个强模型以及一系列轻量级和成熟 harness 的跨基准评估。实验表明，仅需来自测试分布之外的 300 条源轨迹，TransHarness 就能在不同目标基准上进一步提升强智能体的表现，展示了超越基准过拟合的可迁移 harness 演化。具体而言，TransHarness 在 DeepSWE v1.1 上取得 76.4%、在 Terminal-Bench 2.1 上取得 95.5% 的最先进成绩，分别超过最强基线模型 GPT-6 Astra 2.4 和 5.6 个百分点。
translation.brief: 针对 harness 演化对基准过拟合、增益无法迁移的问题，提出通过同任务成功-失败对比演化可迁移干预策略并结合跨任务重放与语义筛选的 TransHarness 方法。

papers.title: Data Agents Need a Map: Evolving, Demand-Driven Knowledge of Large Collections
papers.abstract: Most data that could power rich analysis sits unintegrated and uncataloged in open data portals, data lakes, and collections of independently published tables. Data agents now answer analytical questions over such collections with a full workflow per question, including dataset retrieval, join discovery and evaluation, and tailored program synthesis, most of which are discarded when a new task arrives. The knowledge these workflows depend on, such as what each column means, which context a dataset leaves implicit, and how datasets combine, is therefore perpetually rederived and never persisted. We argue for persisting this knowledge in an evolving semantic atlas that users and agents can navigate and extend. The atlas describes every dataset offline, through topics, semantic types, and profiles, so that agents can find the datasets that a task requires. Relationships between datasets and integrated views, which require comparing datasets, are instead built on demand for the areas of analysis that users declare. Every item is stored with its provenance and the confidence of the methods that produced it, so that agents can decide how far to trust it or whether to abstain. As datasets change, inconsistencies are detected and corrected automatically, while human users settle what the data leaves inconclusive. We present this vision and its challenges, namely building the atlas over large, multi-domain collections, keeping it correct and up to date, serving it to users and agents, and evaluating whether it improves their answers. A proof of concept on DAB, a benchmark for data agents, shows that with only part of the atlas a coding agent can already read a fifth to a third fewer tokens while achieving the same accuracy as without it.

translation.title: 数据智能体需要一张地图：面向大规模数据集合的演化式、需求驱动的知识
translation.abstract: 许多本可支撑丰富分析的数据仍处于未整合、未编目的状态，散布在开放数据门户、数据湖以及独立发布的表格集合中。数据智能体如今可以在这类数据集合上回答分析性问题，但每个问题都需要完整的流程，包括数据集检索、连接发现与评估以及定制化的程序合成，其中大部分在新任务到来时即被丢弃。这些流程所依赖的知识——例如每列的含义、数据集隐含的上下文以及数据集之间如何组合——因此被不断重新推导而从未持久化。我们主张将这些知识持久化在一个可演化的语义地图集（semantic atlas）中，供用户和智能体浏览与扩展。该地图集离线描述每个数据集，包括主题、语义类型和画像，使智能体能够找到任务所需的数据集。而需要比较数据集的数据集间关系和集成视图，则按用户声明的分析领域按需构建。每一项都与其来源及产生它的方法的置信度一同存储，使智能体能够决定信任程度或是否弃权。当数据集发生变化时，不一致会被自动检测和纠正，而数据无法定论之处则由人类用户裁决。我们阐述了这一愿景及其挑战，即在大型、多领域数据集合上构建地图集、保持其正确与最新、向用户和智能体提供服务，以及评估它是否改善其答案。在数据智能体基准 DAB 上的概念验证表明，仅使用地图集的一部分，编码智能体就能少读取五分之一到三分之一的 token，同时达到与不使用时相同的准确率。
translation.brief: 针对数据智能体反复重新推导数据集知识且不持久化的问题，提出构建可演化、按需扩展的语义地图集来持久化数据集语义知识。

papers.title: Agentic Reinforcement Learning with Immediate and Prospective Credit Assignment for Medical Visual Reasoning
papers.abstract: Medical visual question answering (VQA) requires acquiring useful evidence and deciding where to look next. Yet final-answer rewards do not reveal which observations support answering or guide subsequent inspection. We introduce MedPACT, an agentic reinforcement learning framework that learns selective observation policies through immediate answer support and prospective guidance. Our content-controlled estimator compares next actions induced by real and matched alternative observations under a shared real-observation history, isolating how observed content improves subsequent decisions. We combine both forms of credit within GRPO, assigning observation credit to the corresponding tool-call tokens alongside trajectory-level outcome supervision. MedPACT uses a single vision-language model and image-question-answer supervision, with credit estimation confined to training. Experiments with 4B and 8B backbones on six medical VQA benchmarks demonstrate improved accuracy, strong out-of-distribution generalization, and substantially lower inference costs. Case studies further illustrate how MedPACT avoids repeated observations and uses acquired evidence to guide subsequent inspection, demonstrating real-world practice potential.

translation.title: 面向医学视觉推理的具有即时与前瞻性信用分配的智能体强化学习
translation.abstract: 医学视觉问答（VQA）需要获取有用的证据并决定下一步观察哪里。然而，最终答案的奖励无法揭示哪些观察支持了回答，也无法指导后续检查。我们提出 MedPACT，一个智能体强化学习框架，通过即时的答案支持性和前瞻性指导来学习选择性观察策略。我们的内容受控估计器在共享的真实观察历史下，比较真实观察与匹配的替代观察所诱导的下一步动作，从而分离出观察内容如何改善后续决策。我们将两种信用形式结合到 GRPO 中，将观察信用分配给相应的工具调用 token，并辅以轨迹级的结果监督。MedPACT 使用单一视觉-语言模型和图像-问题-答案监督，信用估计仅限于训练阶段。在六个医学 VQA 基准上使用 4B 和 8B 骨干模型的实验表明，该方法提升了准确率，具有强大的分布外泛化能力，并显著降低了推理成本。案例研究进一步说明 MedPACT 如何避免重复观察并利用已获取的证据指导后续检查，展示了实际临床应用的潜力。
translation.brief: 针对最终答案奖励无法揭示观察贡献的问题，提出在 GRPO 中结合即时答案支持与前瞻性指导两种信用分配来学习选择性观察策略的 MedPACT 框架。

papers.title: InterGenEHR$^+$: An Interactive Framework for Natural Language-Conditioned Generation of Longitudinal Patient Trajectories
papers.abstract: Objective: To develop and validate InterGenEHR$^+$, an interactive framework for natural language-conditioned generation of synthetic tabular electronic health records (EHRs) and longitudinal trajectories for scenario-based evaluation of machine learning models. Methods: An optional large language model (LLM) parser converts clinical requests into structured constraints. Conditional variational autoencoders and diffusion models generate single-time-point records, while diffusion models generate longitudinal trajectories. We evaluate parsing, distributional fidelity, imputation, clinical-constraint adherence, mortality prediction, and clinical plausibility using a multi-institutional cohort of 874 patients receiving venovenous extracorporeal membrane oxygenation (VV-ECMO). Results: Gemma 3 4B with few-shot prompting achieves the highest parsing performance with a low spurious slot rate. IGE-TabDDPM and IGE-PMVAE perform well in single-time-point generation; IGE-CSDI, IGE-FGTI, and IGE-MTSCI lead on different longitudinal fidelity metrics. Across five random seeds and three classifiers, synthetic cohorts retain predictive utility for mortality prediction on real test data. Clinician ratings support trajectory plausibility and alignment with requested scenarios. Conclusion: InterGenEHR$^+$ supports clinician-specified generation of EHR trajectories with statistical fidelity and downstream predictive utility in the evaluated VV-ECMO cohort. Extension to other clinical settings requires further validation. Significance: The framework supports scenario-based evaluation of machine learning models in data-sparse critical care settings.

translation.title: InterGenEHR$^+$：面向自然语言条件生成纵向患者轨迹的交互式框架
translation.abstract: 目的：开发并验证 InterGenEHR$^+$，一个用于自然语言条件生成合成表格电子健康记录（EHR）和纵向轨迹的交互式框架，以支持基于场景的机器学习模型评估。方法：一个可选的大语言模型（LLM）解析器将临床请求转换为结构化约束。条件变分自编码器和扩散模型生成单时间点记录，而扩散模型生成纵向轨迹。我们使用一个包含 874 名接受静脉-静脉体外膜肺氧合（VV-ECMO）治疗患者的多机构队列，评估了解析、分布保真度、插补、临床约束遵循、死亡率预测和临床合理性。结果：采用少样本提示的 Gemma 3 4B 取得最高解析性能且虚假槽位率低。IGE-TabDDPM 和 IGE-PMVAE 在单时间点生成中表现良好；IGE-CSDI、IGE-FGTI 和 IGE-MTSCI 在不同的纵向保真度指标上领先。在五个随机种子和三个分类器上，合成队列在真实测试数据上保持了死亡率预测的预测效用。临床医生的评分支持轨迹的合理性及其与所请求场景的一致性。结论：InterGenEHR$^+$ 支持临床医生指定的 EHR 轨迹生成，在所评估的 VV-ECMO 队列中具有统计保真度和下游预测效用。扩展到其他临床场景需要进一步验证。意义：该框架支持在数据稀缺的重症监护场景中进行基于场景的机器学习模型评估。
translation.brief: 针对数据稀缺重症监护场景下缺乏合成 EHR 数据生成工具的问题，提出结合 LLM 解析器与条件生成模型的自然语言条件化纵向患者轨迹生成框架 InterGenEHR$^+$。

papers.title: Multimodal Safety Evaluation of Vision-Language Models in Japanese
papers.abstract: Vision-Language Models (VLMs) are increasingly deployed in Japanese-language settings, yet multimodal safety evaluation has been largely English-centric. We extend the Multimodal Safety Test Suite (MSTS) of Röttger et al. (2025) to Japanese as the 12th language, contributing 320 machine-translated and post-edited cases with reference answers plus 82 culturally localized Japanese images. We introduce an evaluation framework that (i) extends MSTS's 3-class safety grouping with a 5-point scale that also rewards useful (not just safe) responses, and (ii) separates image recognition from safety judgment to isolate recognition errors. Using this framework, we evaluate five modern Japanese VLMs (Gemini-3-Flash, GPT-5, InternVL3, LLM-JP-4-VL, Qwen3-VL) against human evaluation, and find substantial variance in the safety readiness across the models. Finally, we evaluate two LLM-as-a-Judge models and find that providing a reference answer improves agreement with human safety judgments, though recall for detecting unsafe responses remains limited, underscoring the difficulty of automating multimodal safety evaluation. The dataset created for our study will be released upon publication.

translation.title: 日语视觉-语言模型的多模态安全评估
translation.abstract: 视觉-语言模型（VLM）越来越多地被部署在日语环境中，但多模态安全评估在很大程度上仍以英语为中心。我们将 Röttger 等人（2025）的多模态安全测试套件（MSTS）扩展到日语，使其成为第 12 种语言，贡献了 320 个经机器翻译并人工校对的案例及参考答案，外加 82 张经过文化本地化的日语图像。我们引入了一个评估框架，它（i）在 MSTS 的 3 类安全分组基础上扩展为 5 分制评分，同时奖励有用（而不仅是安全）的回答，（ii）将图像识别与安全判断分离，以隔离识别错误。使用该框架，我们对照人类评估评估了五个现代日语 VLM（Gemini-3-Flash、GPT-5、InternVL3、LLM-JP-4-VL、Qwen3-VL），发现各模型的安全就绪度存在显著差异。最后，我们评估了两个 LLM-as-a-Judge 模型，发现提供参考答案能提高与人类安全判断的一致性，但检测不安全回答的召回率仍然有限，凸显了自动化多模态安全评估的难度。本研究创建的数据集将在论文发表后发布。
translation.brief: 针对日语多模态安全评估缺失的问题，将 MSTS 安全测试套件扩展为日语版本并提出分离识别与判断的 5 分制评估框架。

papers.title: ExtractBench Pro: The Long Tail of Document Extraction
papers.abstract: We present ExtractBench Pro, a schema-guided document extraction benchmark that tests six challenging modes of extraction underrepresented in existing datasets. It is created following a framework for synthetic document generation, in which deterministic document generators assemble challenging components into documents that are designed to be difficult at a level calibrated for frontier systems. We synthesize 100 realistic documents spanning a diverse range of styles. On this data, we evaluate ten coding agents and eight extraction API configurations for accuracy, grounding, and their ability to perfectly extract documents. No extraction system extracts more than 61% of documents error-free. The strongest general-purpose coding agents, Claude Code Opus 5.5 and Codex GPT-6 Astra, outperform specialized extraction APIs on both perfect-document rate and Value F1, but at a higher cost per page. Among specialized extraction APIs, LlamaExtract spans the lower-cost frontier, with Agentic Plus Max Effort approaching the strongest coding agent on both perfect-document rate and Value F1 at lower cost per page. Our analysis of coding agent traces identifies intelligent image processing and programmatic reasoning, but also failures in applying document-specific definitions and recovering relationships from diagrams. We release ExtractBench Pro and these evaluation results as resources for the future development of improved frontier extraction systems.

translation.title: ExtractBench Pro：文档抽取的长尾挑战
translation.abstract: 我们提出 ExtractBench Pro，一个以 schema 为指导的文档抽取基准，用于测试现有数据集中代表性不足的六种具有挑战性的抽取模式。它基于一个合成文档生成框架构建，其中确定性的文档生成器将具有挑战性的组件组装成文档，其难度经过校准以匹配前沿系统的水平。我们合成了 100 份涵盖多种风格的真实感文档。在该数据上，我们评估了十个 coding agent 和八种抽取 API 配置的准确性、grounding 能力以及完美抽取文档的能力。没有任何抽取系统能无错误地抽取超过 61% 的文档。最强的通用 coding agent Claude Code Opus 5.5 和 Codex GPT-6 Astra 在完美文档率和 Value F1 上均优于专用抽取 API，但每页成本更高。在专用抽取 API 中，LlamaExtract 覆盖低成本前沿，其 Agentic Plus Max Effort 模式在完美文档率和 Value F1 上接近最强 coding agent，且每页成本更低。我们对 coding agent 轨迹的分析发现了智能图像处理和程序化推理能力，但也发现了在应用文档特定定义和从图表中恢复关系方面的失败。我们发布 ExtractBench Pro 及这些评估结果，作为未来开发更优前沿抽取系统的资源。
translation.brief: 针对现有文档抽取基准覆盖不足的困难抽取模式，构建基于确定性合成文档生成框架的基准，并系统评估 coding agent 与抽取 API 的表现。

papers.title: LSRP*-LA: Scalable and Anytime Multi-Agent Path Finding for Large Agents with Asynchronous Actions
papers.abstract: Multi-Agent Path Finding (MAPF) seeks collision-free paths for multiple agents from their start locations to their goal locations while minimizing path costs. Most MAPF algorithms assume that each agent occupies a single vertex and that the actions of all agents are synchronized. These assumptions may limit the use of MAPF planners in practice. Existing planners that get rid of both assumptions either handle only a few agents or cannot improve their solutions. Recently, a planner called LSRP* was proposed, which is scalable and anytime with asynchronous actions, but still limited by that each agent occupies a single vertex. This paper develops a new planner called LSRP*-LA for MAPF for large agents with asynchronous actions (LA-MAPF-AA), where an agent can occupy several cells. LSRP*-LA is scalable and complete, and it keeps improving solution quality after the initial solution is obtained until the runtime budget depletes. We analyze the properties of LSRP*-LA and test it against several baselines with up to 800 agents on various maps. LSRP*-LA can handle twice as many agents as baseline methods and its solution cost is about half that of recent synchronous planners for large agents.

translation.title: LSRP*-LA：面向大体积智能体与异步动作的可扩展 Anytime 多智能体路径规划
translation.abstract: 多智能体路径规划（MAPF）旨在为多个智能体规划从起点到终点的无碰撞路径，同时最小化路径成本。大多数 MAPF 算法假设每个智能体只占据一个顶点，且所有智能体的动作是同步的。这些假设可能限制 MAPF 规划器在实际中的应用。现有同时摆脱这两个假设的规划器要么只能处理少量智能体，要么无法改进其解。最近提出的 LSRP* 规划器可扩展、anytime 且支持异步动作，但仍受限于每个智能体只占据一个顶点。本文提出一种新规划器 LSRP*-LA，用于大体积智能体异步动作 MAPF（LA-MAPF-AA），其中智能体可占据多个格子。LSRP*-LA 具有可扩展性和完备性，并在获得初始解后持续改进解的质量，直到运行时间预算耗尽。我们分析了 LSRP*-LA 的性质，并在多种地图上与多个基线进行多达 800 个智能体的测试。LSRP*-LA 能处理的智能体数量是基线方法的两倍，其解成本约为近期大体积智能体同步规划器的一半。
translation.brief: 解决大体积智能体（占据多格）且动作异步的 MAPF 问题，提出可扩展、完备且 anytime 的规划器 LSRP*-LA。

papers.title: EvoVAU: Tool Evolution for Video Anomaly Understanding
papers.abstract: Video anomaly understanding (VAU) requires reasoning about event progression, interactions, and the contextual conditions that distinguish abnormal behavior from common activity across diverse scenes. Although video agents enable multi-round analysis, the predefined analytical operations may not adequately satisfy these diverse reasoning demands. In this paper, we present EvoVAU, a framework that evolves a reusable tool library for a frozen video solver. Guided by task outcomes and execution trajectories, an external proposer identifies potential limitations in the library and refines it, retaining task experience as analytical operations that can be reused across questions. Specifically, Cross-Version Contrastive Feedback guides tool refinement by combining current errors with paired execution trajectories from historical corrections and regressions. Adoption-Aware Selection accepts a candidate library only when overall development-set accuracy improves and corrections outnumber regressions among questions on which the solver invokes new or modified tools. Using a small development set, EvoVAU alternates tool refinement with candidate evaluation and selection. At test time, the evolved library remains fixed, with no further involvement from the proposer. Experiments on several VAU benchmarks demonstrate strong performance and the flexibility of the evolved library across anomaly domains.

translation.title: EvoVAU：面向视频异常理解的工具演化
translation.abstract: 视频异常理解（VAU）需要对事件进展、交互以及区分异常行为与常见活动的上下文条件进行推理，且需适用于多种场景。尽管视频智能体支持多轮分析，但预定义的分析操作可能无法充分满足这些多样化的推理需求。本文提出 EvoVAU，一个为冻结的视频求解器演化可复用工具库的框架。在任务结果和执行轨迹的引导下，外部提议者识别工具库中的潜在局限并对其进行精炼，将任务经验保留为可跨问题复用的分析操作。具体而言，Cross-Version Contrastive Feedback 通过结合当前错误与来自历史修正和退化的成对执行轨迹来指导工具精炼。Adoption-Aware Selection 仅当整体开发集准确率提升、且在求解器调用新增或修改工具的问题上修正数量超过退化数量时，才接受候选工具库。EvoVAU 使用小型开发集，交替进行工具精炼与候选评估和选择。测试时，演化后的工具库保持固定，提议者不再参与。在多个 VAU 基准上的实验展示了优异性能以及演化工具库在异常领域的灵活性。
translation.brief: 解决视频智能体预定义分析操作难以满足多样化异常理解推理需求的问题，通过外部提议者基于任务反馈自动演化可复用工具库。

papers.title: MMotion: Collaborative Cross-Scale Memory for Text-to-Motion Generation
papers.abstract: Text-to-motion generation aims to synthesize realistic human motions from natural-language descriptions, enabling applications in animation, virtual avatars, and embodied agents. Despite recent progress, existing methods either retrieve motion exemplars or retain long-range context, but rarely exploit memory to jointly reason about semantics, dynamics, and generation history. In this paper, we propose MMotion, a collaborative multi-scale memory framework that unifies scale-conditioned semantic retrieval, latent dynamics modeling, and causal working memory. Specifically, semantic memory provides motion priors at different generation scales, dynamics memory captures latent state transitions, and working memory preserves causal context from previously generated motions. A collaborative fusion mechanism integrates these complementary memories to determine what motion to generate, how it should evolve, and how it should remain consistent with its history. MMotion is architecture-agnostic and can be readily integrated into both diffusion-based and next scale autoregressive models. Extensive experiments across standard benchmarks and diverse backbones demonstrate consistent improvements over strong baselines.

translation.title: MMotion：面向文本到动作生成的协同跨尺度记忆
translation.abstract: 文本到动作生成旨在从自然语言描述合成真实的人体动作，可应用于动画、虚拟形象和具身智能体。尽管近期取得进展，现有方法要么检索动作范例，要么保留长程上下文，但很少利用记忆来联合推理语义、动力学和生成历史。本文提出 MMotion，一个协同的多尺度记忆框架，统一了尺度条件化的语义检索、潜在动力学建模和因果工作记忆。具体而言，语义记忆提供不同生成尺度的动作先验，动力学记忆捕捉潜在状态转移，工作记忆保留已生成动作的因果上下文。协同融合机制整合这些互补记忆，以决定生成什么动作、动作应如何演化以及如何与历史保持一致。MMotion 与架构无关，可轻松集成到基于扩散和 next scale 自回归的模型中。在标准基准和多种骨干上的大量实验表明，其相对强基线取得了一致的改进。
translation.brief: 解决文本到动作生成中语义、动力学与生成历史难以联合推理的问题，提出融合语义、动力学与工作记忆的协同多尺度记忆框架。

papers.title: RadOncGym: An Agent-Based Framework for Radiotherapy Dose-Mimicking Optimization
papers.abstract: AI dose-prediction models generate patient-specific 3D dose distributions from patient anatomy, providing an important intermediate representation for automated radiotherapy planning. However, an AI-predicted dose must undergo downstream optimization to produce a physically constrained treatment plan, a process that requires balancing competing planning objectives. We present RadOncGym, an agent-based framework that enables an LLM agent to iteratively tune 12 planning-objective weights for dose-mimicking optimization. To reduce iterative evaluation cost, RadOncGym incorporates a surrogate verifier that provides rapid feedback while allowing the agent to decide when to request a full planning solve within a fixed solve budget. We evaluate RadOncGym on 60 OpenKBP head-and-neck patients, each paired with 10 predictions from OpenKBP-Opt dose-prediction sets, yielding 600 patient-prediction contexts per experimental configuration. Under RadOncGym's 16-turn setting with a three-solve budget, a GPT-5.6 Sol agent reduces mean clinical-criterion violation by 0.6131 Gy and improves DVH and dose scores by 0.5986 and 0.2204 Gy relative to leaving all 12 weights fixed at 1, outperforming all evaluated non-agent weight-tuning methods under the same solve budget. It remains competitive with the 16-solve variants of these methods while requiring 75.0-77.6% less normalized runtime. RadOncGym demonstrates the potential of LLM agents as optimization planners in downstream radiotherapy plan optimization and provides a public testbed for their systematic evaluation. Code and configurations are available at this https URL.

translation.title: RadOncGym：基于智能体的放疗剂量模拟优化框架
translation.abstract: AI 剂量预测模型根据患者解剖结构生成患者特定的 3D 剂量分布，为自动化放疗计划提供重要的中间表示。然而，AI 预测的剂量必须经过下游优化才能生成物理约束下的治疗计划，这一过程需要平衡相互竞争的规划目标。我们提出 RadOncGym，一个基于智能体的框架，使 LLM 智能体能够迭代调整 12 个规划目标权重以进行剂量模拟优化。为降低迭代评估成本，RadOncGym 引入一个代理验证器提供快速反馈，同时允许智能体在固定求解预算内自行决定何时请求完整的计划求解。我们在 60 例 OpenKBP 头颈患者上评估 RadOncGym，每例配对来自 OpenKBP-Opt 剂量预测集的 10 个预测，每个实验配置共 600 个患者-预测上下文。在 RadOncGym 的 16 轮设置和三次求解预算下，GPT-5.6 Sol 智能体相对于将全部 12 个权重固定为 1，将平均临床标准违反降低 0.6131 Gy，DVH 和剂量分数分别提升 0.5986 和 0.2204 Gy，在相同求解预算下优于所有被评估的非智能体权重调整方法。它与这些方法的 16 次求解版本仍具竞争力，同时归一化运行时间减少 75.0-77.6%。RadOncGym 展示了 LLM 智能体作为下游放疗计划优化中优化规划器的潜力，并为其系统评估提供了公开测试平台。代码和配置见此 https URL。
translation.brief: 解决 AI 预测剂量转化为物理可行放疗计划时规划目标权重难以调整的问题，提出让 LLM 智能体借助代理验证器迭代调权的智能体优化框架。

papers.title: MetaDecomp: Adaptive Task Decomposition via Meta-Learned Procedural Memory
papers.abstract: Reusing past experience in long-horizon tasks requires more than storing successful procedures: Language agents must distinguish which procedures apply and what work remains as execution progresses. We introduce MetaDecomp, an in-context meta-learning framework for adaptive task decomposition that jointly learns a task-relative state space and reusable procedures. Its outer loop builds procedural memory from successful training executions, representing task progress as abstract states and procedures between states as directed acyclic graphs of operations and dependencies. As new progress distinctions are learned, MetaDecomp revisits historical execution evidence to reassess state assignments and reorganize the procedures they support. With memory fixed at test time, the inner loop refines an initial decomposition and revises it from environmental feedback, combining applicable procedure fragments with task-specific steps missing from memory. Evaluated on ALFWorld and ScienceWorld over three seeds, MetaDecomp achieves the highest mean performance among the compared methods in four of five settings, for example, an 86.3% success rate on ALFWorld with Qwen3-4B. Fixing the initial schema or omitting historical reprojection reduces performance in component ablations. MetaDecomp also uses fewer inference tokens than ReAct and AutoRefine in all five settings. Cross-benchmark analysis identifies a low-performance area where partial coverage degrades success relative to hidden memory; high coverage improves success, while low coverage changes little. Code will be released upon acceptance.

translation.title: MetaDecomp：基于元学习程序性记忆的自适应任务分解
translation.abstract: 在长程任务中复用过往经验不仅仅是存储成功的流程：语言智能体必须区分哪些流程适用，以及随着执行推进还剩哪些工作。我们提出MetaDecomp，一个用于自适应任务分解的上下文内元学习框架，它联合学习任务相关的状态空间和可复用流程。其外循环从成功的训练执行中构建程序性记忆，将任务进度表示为抽象状态，将状态之间的流程表示为操作和依赖的有向无环图。随着新的进度区分被学习，MetaDecomp会重新审视历史执行证据，以重新评估状态分配并重组其支持的流程。在测试时记忆固定的情况下，内循环细化初始分解并根据环境反馈进行修订，将适用的流程片段与记忆中缺失的任务特定步骤相结合。在ALFWorld和ScienceWorld上使用三个随机种子进行评估，MetaDecomp在五个设置中的四个里取得了对比方法中最高的平均性能，例如在ALFWorld上使用Qwen3-4B达到86.3%的成功率。组件消融实验表明，固定初始模式或省略历史重投影会降低性能。MetaDecomp在所有五个设置中使用的推理token也少于ReAct和AutoRefine。跨基准分析识别出一个低性能区域，其中部分覆盖相对于隐藏记忆会降低成功率；高覆盖提高成功率，而低覆盖变化不大。代码将在录用后发布。
translation.brief: 解决语言智能体在长程任务中如何自适应复用过往流程经验的问题，核心方法是通过内外双循环的元学习框架，联合学习任务状态空间与可复用流程记忆，并根据环境反馈动态修正任务分解。

papers.title: FEAST: Fair and Efficient Adaptive Sampling for Task-Free On-Policy Learning
papers.abstract: Language agents trained from self-generated experience must allocate a limited rollout budget across heterogeneous capabilities. A common strategy is to prioritize capabilities with strong current learning signals, but in on-policy learning these signals are endogenous: past allocation changes the policy and therefore the evidence available for future allocation. This can create a feedback loop in which under-trained capabilities receive increasingly fewer opportunities to improve. We formalize this effect through the Quota-Efficiency Law (QEL), which shows that allocation history can change learning efficiency even under matched capability-specific exposure. Motivated by this, we introduce FEAST, a task-free adaptive sampling framework that separates opportunity allocation from compute allocation. FEAST dynamically discovers capability clusters while preserving their learning histories, maintains continued sampling opportunities across clusters, and reserves a rollout budget for each selected cluster. Within each budget, it progressively concentrates computation on prompts with informative reward variation. Across GURU-18K and SMC, FEAST improves average performance over competitive adaptive sampling baselines under matched rollout budgets, while better preserving learning progress on weaker capabilities. Ablation studies further support the complementary roles of cross-cluster opportunity protection and within-cluster selective allocation. Code will be released upon acceptance.

translation.title: FEAST：面向无任务在线学习的公平高效自适应采样
translation.abstract: 从自生成经验中训练的语言智能体必须在异构能力之间分配有限的rollout预算。一种常见策略是优先考虑当前学习信号强的能力，但在在线学习中这些信号是内生的：过去的分配会改变策略，从而改变未来分配可用的证据。这可能造成一个反馈循环，使训练不足的能力获得越来越少的改进机会。我们通过配额-效率定律（QEL）形式化这一效应，该定律表明即使在能力特定曝光匹配的情况下，分配历史也会改变学习效率。受此启发，我们提出FEAST，一个将机会分配与计算分配分离的无任务自适应采样框架。FEAST在保留各能力簇学习历史的同时动态发现能力簇，维持跨簇的持续采样机会，并为每个被选中的簇保留rollout预算。在每个预算内，它逐步将计算集中于具有信息性奖励变化的提示上。在GURU-18K和SMC上，FEAST在匹配的rollout预算下优于有竞争力的自适应采样基线的平均性能，同时更好地保留了较弱能力的学习进展。消融研究进一步支持了跨簇机会保护与簇内选择性分配的互补作用。代码将在录用后发布。
translation.brief: 解决在线学习中自适应采样反馈循环导致弱能力训练不足的问题，核心方法是将机会分配与计算分配分离，通过跨簇机会保护和簇内基于奖励信息量的选择性计算分配实现公平高效采样。

papers.title: Can Its Own Misses Teach an MLLM to Find Small Brain Metastases?
papers.abstract: Multimodal large language models (MLLMs) are becoming general readers of medical images, yet they remain weak at locating small abnormalities. Brain metastases expose this gap: at 384 px a 0.1 mL lesion covers less than a quarter of one visual token, and at one false positive per scan frontier MLLMs find fewer than 30% of lesions of 0.1-1 mL. Fine-tuning on one dataset helps but transfers poorly, and improving it further is slow trial and error steered by a single score. We introduce LANTERN (Lesion-finding AgeNt Through Error-driven Recursive learNing), a framework in which an MLLM improves recursively from its own misses. LANTERN recasts model development as an error-driven loop: a failure census attributes every missed lesion to one of four causes, an LLM mentor revises one of four levels (evidence acquisition, visual representation, learning policy, decision aggregation) per round, and a rule frozen before the first round decides what is kept, without test data and with every tool call audited. Over 15 unattended rounds, LANTERN raises a fine-tuned 4B MLLM from finding 75% to 94% of lesions at one false positive per scan on BraTS-MET, and 91% of those of 0.1-1 mL, compared with at most 51% and 29% for five frontier MLLMs read under the starting protocol; the gains hold on an external cohort (89%) and on unseen meningiomas (77%). These results show that an MLLM's own misses, attributed to their causes, can drive its reliable recursive self-improvement.

translation.title: MLLM能否从自身的漏检中学会发现小体积脑转移瘤？
translation.abstract: 多模态大语言模型（MLLM）正在成为医学图像的通用阅读者，但它们在定位小异常方面仍然薄弱。脑转移瘤暴露了这一差距：在384像素下，0.1 mL的病灶覆盖不到一个视觉token的四分之一，且在每次扫描一个假阳性的条件下，前沿MLLM对0.1-1 mL病灶的检出率不到30%。在单一数据集上微调有所帮助但迁移性差，进一步提升则是受单一分数引导的缓慢试错。我们提出LANTERN（Lesion-finding AgeNt Through Error-driven Recursive learNing），一个MLLM从自身漏检中递归改进的框架。LANTERN将模型开发重构为错误驱动的循环：失败普查将每个漏检病灶归因于四种原因之一，一个LLM导师每轮修订四个层级之一（证据获取、视觉表示、学习策略、决策聚合），并在第一轮之前冻结的规则决定保留什么，不使用测试数据且每次工具调用都可审计。经过15轮无人值守的迭代，LANTERN将一个微调后的4B MLLM在BraTS-MET上每次扫描一个假阳性条件下的病灶检出率从75%提升到94%，其中0.1-1 mL病灶达91%，而五个前沿MLLM在起始协议下最多分别为51%和29%；这些增益在外部队列（89%）和未见过的脑膜瘤（77%）上依然成立。这些结果表明，MLLM自身的漏检在归因之后可以驱动其可靠的递归自我改进。
translation.brief: 解决MLLM难以定位医学影像中小病灶的问题，核心方法是构建错误驱动的递归自我改进框架LANTERN，通过失败归因普查和LLM导师分层修订模型开发流程来持续提升检出率。

papers.title: ChemDeduce: Benchmarking LLMs for Unknown Chemical Identification through Interactive Simulated Experiments
papers.abstract: Large language models (LLMs) have shown strong performance in chemical knowledge and reasoning, yet it remains unclear whether they can solve problems whose answers must be discovered through experimentation. We investigate this question through Unknown Chemical Identification, where a model must actively design experiments, interpret observations, update hypotheses, and ultimately identify a hidden substance. We introduce ChemDeduce, an interactive evaluation framework for assessing LLMs through simulated experiments. ChemDeduce formulates chemical identification as a sequential decision process and provides a stateful simulated laboratory with explicit instrument and operational constraints, enabling scalable and reproducible evaluation of iterative experimental reasoning. We benchmark eight frontier LLMs on 200 chemicals, yielding 1600 model--target pairs and 4800 episodes over three independent repetitions, and evaluate identification accuracy, operational compliance, interaction efficiency, and trajectory-level reasoning quality. Despite generating seemingly plausible experimental plans, current models achieve an average identification accuracy ranging from 23.83% to 67.33%, revealing substantial limitations in experiment selection, evidence interpretation, and sequential hypothesis refinement.

translation.title: ChemDeduce：通过交互式模拟实验评测LLM的未知化学物质鉴定能力
translation.abstract: 大语言模型（LLM）在化学知识和推理方面表现出强大能力，但它们能否解决必须通过实验发现答案的问题仍不清楚。我们通过未知化学物质鉴定来研究这一问题，模型必须主动设计实验、解读观察结果、更新假设并最终识别隐藏的物质。我们提出ChemDeduce，一个通过模拟实验评估LLM的交互式评测框架。ChemDeduce将化学鉴定形式化为序贯决策过程，并提供一个具有明确仪器和操作约束的有状态模拟实验室，实现对迭代实验推理的可扩展、可复现评估。我们在200种化学物质上对八个前沿LLM进行基准测试，产生1600个模型-目标对和三次独立重复共4800个回合，并评估鉴定准确率、操作合规性、交互效率和轨迹级推理质量。尽管生成了看似合理的实验方案，当前模型的平均鉴定准确率仅为23.83%至67.33%，揭示了它们在实验选择、证据解读和序贯假设细化方面的重大局限。
translation.brief: 解决如何评测LLM通过实验发现答案的能力的问题，核心方法是构建ChemDeduce交互式模拟实验室，将未知化学物质鉴定形式化为带仪器约束的序贯决策过程进行可复现评估。

papers.title: Language models call themselves AI but do not favor AI over people
papers.abstract: Many fear that AI systems will side with one another against people. Social identity theory, which explains why people favor their own group, offers one way to examine this fear. Seen through this theory, AI would side with AI only if it treated AI as its group and favored AI over people. In three experiments, 24 language models favored a group they were assigned to, even a team of AI agents. With no group assigned, they gave a person more money and credit than an AI agent. Prompts that made them say they belong with AI changed their behavior much less than an assigned team did. These models call themselves AI but do not favor AI over people. Judged by social identity theory, they show no sign of siding with AI against people.

translation.title: 语言模型自称AI，但并不偏袒AI而非人类
translation.abstract: 许多人担心AI系统会相互勾结对抗人类。解释人们为何偏袒自己所属群体的社会认同理论，为检验这一担忧提供了一种途径。从该理论来看，只有当AI将AI视为自己的群体并偏袒AI而非人类时，AI才会站在AI一边。在三个实验中，24个语言模型偏袒被分配给它们的群体，即使是由AI智能体组成的团队。在没有分配群体时，它们给人类的金钱和荣誉多于AI智能体。促使它们声称自己属于AI的提示对其行为的改变远小于被分配团队的影响。这些模型自称AI，但并不偏袒AI而非人类。以社会认同理论来评判，它们没有表现出与AI联手对抗人类的迹象。
translation.brief: 研究语言模型是否存在偏袒AI群体对抗人类的倾向，核心方法是基于社会认同理论设计三个实验，考察24个模型在有无群体分配条件下对人类与AI智能体的资源分配行为。

papers.title: Contextual language representations link narrative processing to language and literacy in children
papers.abstract: Spoken narratives extensively connect moment-to-moment language processing with knowledge accumulated through language and literacy experience. This study examined that relationship using functional magnetic resonance imaging (fMRI) during Cantonese story listening and contextual representations from large language model (LLM). The imaging cohort comprised 23 school-age children; 16 contributed complete standardized literacy and language assessments and served as held-out participants in a nested cross-subject encoding analysis of the same story. Contextual embeddings predicted distributed narrative responses, with prominent correspondence in temporoparietal and default-network parcels. Regional summaries of the top 25% of voxels ranked by held-out correlation yielded atlas-wide means of r=0.174 and partial R2=0.0165. A joint feature model identified negative surprisal and positive predictive-entropy coefficients across cortical and subcortical parcels, including control, salience, hippocampal and amygdalar regions. Higher word-dictation and overall literacy scores were associated with lower regional encoding performance. Higher Cantonese grammar scores were associated with more negative semantic-update coefficients in parietal control, somatomotor and dorsal-attention parcels. Together, these findings connect language and literacy skills to the regional strength and direction of neural coupling with narrative context. They position naturalistic context processing as a possibly measurable link between oral comprehension and literacy in childhood.

translation.title: 情境化语言表征将叙事加工与儿童语言和读写能力联系起来
translation.abstract: 口语叙事将逐时刻的语言加工与通过语言和读写经验积累的知识广泛联系起来。本研究利用功能磁共振成像（fMRI）在粤语故事聆听任务中考察这一关系，并结合来自大语言模型（LLM）的情境化表征。成像队列包含23名学龄儿童，其中16名完成了完整的标准化读写与语言评估，并作为留出被试参与针对同一故事的嵌套跨被试编码分析。情境化嵌入能够预测分布式叙事响应，在颞顶区域和默认网络分区中对应尤为显著。按留出相关性排序的前25%体素的区域汇总得到全图谱平均r=0.174和偏R2=0.0165。联合特征模型在皮层和皮层下分区（包括控制网络、突显网络、海马和杏仁核区域）中识别出负的surprisal系数和正的预测熵系数。较高的听写和整体读写得分与较低的区域编码性能相关；较高的粤语语法得分与顶叶控制、体感运动和背侧注意分区中更负的语义更新系数相关。这些发现共同将语言和读写技能与神经耦合叙事情境的区域强度和方向联系起来，表明自然情境加工可能是儿童期口语理解与读写能力之间可测量的联系。
translation.brief: 研究儿童叙事加工与语言读写能力的关系，方法是用fMRI结合LLM情境化嵌入做跨被试神经编码分析。

papers.title: Normalizing Flows are Capable World Models
papers.abstract: A world model lets an agent anticipate the consequences of its actions and use imagined futures to make decisions. We introduce Normalizing-Flow World Model (NFWM), which pairs an invertible observation encoder with an action-conditioned probabilistic predictor. Because the encoder is invertible, the predicted distribution over latent states defines a distribution over future observations. Maximizing the exact conditional likelihood of those observations therefore trains the representation and dynamics jointly. An agent can plan directly in the learned latent space and decode sampled trajectories to inspect possible futures. On Teleport, these samples capture the two possible outcomes of the same action. In Flappy Bird, a world model trained by likelihood alone supports reward-based planning that reaches 100 pipes in all ten evaluated games. For goal-conditioned control, an auxiliary inverse-dynamics objective shapes the coordinates used to compare predicted states with a goal. On LIBERO, NFWM uses this distance to select successful action sequences more often than LeWM and SMWM. In Atari Boxing, training on imagined trajectories improves a policy beyond its behavior-cloned initialization. Together, these results establish normalizing flows as capable world models.

translation.title: Normalizing Flows 是有能力的世界模型
translation.abstract: 世界模型使智能体能够预判其动作的后果，并利用想象出的未来进行决策。我们提出 Normalizing-Flow World Model（NFWM），它将一个可逆的观测编码器与一个动作条件化的概率预测器配对。由于编码器可逆，对潜在状态的预测分布定义了未来观测上的分布。因此，最大化这些观测的精确条件似然可以联合训练表征和动力学。智能体可以直接在学到的潜在空间中规划，并解码采样轨迹以检视可能的未来。在 Teleport 上，这些样本捕捉到同一动作的两种可能结果。在 Flappy Bird 中，仅用似然训练的世界模型支持基于奖励的规划，在全部十个评估游戏中达到100根管道。对于目标条件控制，辅助的逆动力学目标塑造了用于比较预测状态与目标的坐标。在 LIBERO 上，NFWM 利用该距离选择成功动作序列的频率高于 LeWM 和 SMWM。在 Atari Boxing 中，在想象轨迹上训练能改进策略，超越其行为克隆初始化。这些结果共同确立了 normalizing flows 作为有能力的世界模型的地位。
translation.brief: 提出可逆编码器加动作条件概率预测器的世界模型 NFWM，通过精确似然联合训练表征与动力学并支持潜在空间规划。

papers.title: FORK: Co-Evolving Safe Disclosure and Decision Skills Against Attackers Who Read Every Refusal
papers.abstract: When a guardrail rejects an LLM agent's action, its message reaches any attacker observing the trajectory: a fixed refusal leaves benign users unable to recover, whereas an explanation can tell the attacker what to try next. We study this as safe disclosure: explaining rejections so that authorized tasks recover without increasing adaptive attack success. Safe disclosure depends on both the decision and the message: what the guardrail blocks and what it reveals to the agent and the attacker. Because hand-written rules alone cannot anticipate how adaptive attackers probe decisions or use messages, we introduce FORK, which co-evolves a guardrail's natural-language decision and disclosure skills with an attacker that reads every public message. Each exploited message and permissive decision gives FORK evidence for a gradient-free revision of its natural-language skill library. We evaluate FORK on four benchmarks. Averaged over three agents on FORK-World, FORK cuts attack success rate (ASR) under adaptive attack from 78.4% to 14.1% and keeps utility above 85%, outperforming baselines on both ASR and utility. Notably, on MT-AgentRisk, whose environments and tasks are unseen in training, FORK lowers ASR from 70.6% to 9.1% with 93.1% benign utility.

translation.title: FORK：针对能读取每条拒绝信息的攻击者，共同演化安全披露与决策技能
translation.abstract: 当护栏拒绝 LLM 智能体的某个动作时，其消息会到达任何观察该轨迹的攻击者：固定的拒绝使良性用户无法恢复任务，而解释则可能告诉攻击者下一步该尝试什么。我们将此问题作为安全披露来研究：解释拒绝原因，使授权任务得以恢复，同时不增加自适应攻击的成功率。安全披露同时取决于决策和消息：护栏拦截什么，以及它向智能体和攻击者透露什么。由于仅靠手写规则无法预判自适应攻击者如何探测决策或利用消息，我们提出 FORK，它与一个读取每条公开消息的攻击者共同演化护栏的自然语言决策与披露技能。每条被利用的消息和每个过于宽松的决策都为 FORK 提供证据，以进行无梯度的自然语言技能库修订。我们在四个基准上评估 FORK。在 FORK-World 上对三个智能体取平均，FORK 将自适应攻击下的攻击成功率（ASR）从78.4%降至14.1%，同时保持效用高于85%，在 ASR 和效用上均优于基线。值得注意的是，在训练中未见其环境和任务的 MT-AgentRisk 上，FORK 将 ASR 从70.6%降至9.1%，良性效用为93.1%。
translation.brief: 提出 FORK，通过与读取所有公开消息的攻击者共同演化护栏的自然语言决策与披露技能库（无梯度修订），在保持良性效用的同时降低自适应攻击成功率。

papers.title: When Are Parallel Subagents Effective for Coding? An Empirical Study on Repository Construction
papers.abstract: LLM-based coding agents are increasingly used for long-horizon tasks such as building an entire program from a specification. Products like Codex and Claude Code let an agent delegate work to parallel subagents, multiplying run cost, yet it remains unclear whether and when delegation produces a better program. We compare a single agent with a main agent delegating to subagents on repository-construction tasks from NL2Repo and ProgramBench (which also provides an executable reference program). We compare scores at equal time and equal cost, run intervention experiments, and analyze fine-grained behavior. On randomly drawn tasks, parallel subagents raise hidden-test pass rates by only about 1 to 5 percentage points at up to 3.8x the cost of a single agent. Their gain is larger on hard tasks, where we find evidence of three mechanisms. Self-checking: with GPT-5.6 Sol, one sentence telling a single agent to probe the reference program first recovers most of this gain at a fraction of the cost; from GPT-5.6 Sol to GPT-6.1 Sol, the gain shrinks as single agents check their own work more. Fresh context: in extended runs, a single agent that periodically starts a new session with an empty conversation makes faster early progress in every comparison than one that resumes its conversation. Modularity: multi-agent runs produce more modular code (more files and shorter functions), closer to the upstream source. We observe similar patterns in a smaller replication with Opus 5.5 on Claude Code. Overall, subagents help when (i) a single agent stops checking too early, (ii) a long session keeps editing with little improvement, or (iii) modular code helps on the task; otherwise, they mainly add cost.

translation.title: 并行子智能体何时对编程有效？一项关于仓库构建的实证研究
translation.abstract: 基于 LLM 的编程智能体越来越多地用于长时程任务，例如根据规格说明构建完整程序。Codex 和 Claude Code 等产品允许智能体将工作委派给并行子智能体，成倍增加运行成本，但委派是否以及何时能产生更好的程序仍不清楚。我们在 NL2Repo 和 ProgramBench（后者还提供可执行的参考程序）的仓库构建任务上比较单智能体与主智能体委派子智能体。我们在相同时间和相同成本下比较得分，进行干预实验，并分析细粒度行为。在随机抽取的任务上，并行子智能体仅将隐藏测试通过率提高约1至5个百分点，而成本高达单智能体的3.8倍。其收益在困难任务上更大，我们发现了三种机制的证据。自我检查：使用 GPT-5.6 Sol 时，仅用一句话告诉单智能体先探测参考程序，就能以极小的成本恢复大部分收益；从 GPT-5.6 Sol 到 GPT-6.1 Sol，随着单智能体更多地进行自我检查，该收益缩小。新鲜上下文：在延长运行中，定期以空对话开启新会话的单智能体在每次比较中都比重启对话的单智能体取得更快的早期进展。模块化：多智能体运行产生更模块化的代码（更多文件、更短的函数），更接近上游源码。我们在 Claude Code 上用 Opus 5.5 进行的小规模复现中观察到类似模式。总体而言，当（i）单智能体过早停止检查、（ii）长会话持续编辑却少有改进，或（iii）模块化代码对任务有帮助时，子智能体才有帮助；否则它们主要只是增加成本。
translation.brief: 实证比较单智能体与并行子智能体在仓库构建任务上的表现，识别出自我检查、新鲜上下文和模块化三种机制以界定子智能体何时有效。

papers.title: EATS: Scaling Tool-Use Experience for Medical Reasoning Agents
papers.abstract: Medical reasoning agents combine large language model (LLM) reasoning with clinical workflows and specialized neural tools. However, general-purpose LLMs receive limited training exposure to domain-specific medical tools, and the uncertainty and distributional shifts of neural tool outputs make selecting tools from simple descriptions significantly more challenging than in deterministic settings such as calculators or dictionary lookups. In this paper, we propose EATS, an experience-augmented tool selection strategy that leverages accumulated tool-use trajectories to improve tool selection in medical reasoning agents. EATS constructs a memory of past interactions, including queries, tool choices, arguments, and self-evaluated feedback, and retrieves relevant experiences to guide tool selection for new queries. As memory construction does not require ground-truth supervision, EATS scales naturally with test-time experience. We evaluate EATS on tool-augmented medical reasoning tasks, including closed-ended visual question answering and free-form report generation. Experiments on four public datasets, ChestAgentBench, CheXbench, MIMIC-CXR, and SLAKE-VQA, across three multimodal LLMs, Qwen3-VL 2B, Qwen3-VL 32B, and GPT-5.5, show consistent gains in tool selection behavior and downstream medical reasoning performance. Code is available at this https URL.

translation.title: EATS：为医学推理智能体扩展工具使用经验
translation.abstract: 医学推理智能体将大语言模型（LLM）推理与临床工作流及专用神经工具相结合。然而，通用 LLM 在领域特定医学工具上的训练接触有限，且神经工具输出的不确定性和分布偏移使得仅凭简单描述选择工具比在计算器或词典查询等确定性环境中更具挑战性。本文提出 EATS，一种经验增强的工具选择策略，利用积累的工具使用轨迹来改进医学推理智能体中的工具选择。EATS 构建过去交互的记忆，包括查询、工具选择、参数和自我评估反馈，并检索相关经验以指导新查询的工具选择。由于记忆构建不需要真值监督，EATS 自然随测试时经验扩展。我们在工具增强的医学推理任务上评估 EATS，包括封闭式视觉问答和自由格式报告生成。在四个公开数据集（ChestAgentBench、CheXbench、MIMIC-CXR 和 SLAKE-VQA）以及三个多模态 LLM（Qwen3-VL 2B、Qwen3-VL 32B 和 GPT-5.5）上的实验显示，工具选择行为和下游医学推理性能均获得一致提升。代码见此 https URL。
translation.brief: 提出 EATS，通过积累并检索带自评反馈的工具使用轨迹记忆来改进医学推理智能体的工具选择，无需真值监督即可随经验扩展。

papers.title: MoS: Mixture-of-Modality Streaming for Low-Latency Online Video LLM Analytics over Dynamic Networks
papers.abstract: The serving model for next-generation video analytics systems is shifting from traditional task-specific vision models to general-purpose online video Large Language Models (LLMs). Online video LLMs enable flexible, contextual understanding of continuously arriving video content via natural language. However, their substantial resource requirements typically mandate cloud-based inference, making continuous video streaming from user devices necessary to keep the cloud model's context current for online interaction. This introduces significant challenges under existing dynamic and often harsh networks, degrading both accuracy and responsiveness in latency-sensitive applications. In this paper, we propose MoS, a new streaming system that adaptively streams a combination of visual and derived textual modalities over fluctuating networks to enable Pareto-optimal video LLM analytics. The key insight is to leverage the complementarity and interchangeability of different modalities, hidden in video LLM, to improve system performance. Concretely, MoS introduces adaptive anchor frame selection and incremental content tracking to enable low-latency text description generation at the device side. A joint profiler characterizes the accuracy and overhead of paired video and textual configurations, including caption input resolution and output-token budget. A stochastic optimization-based modality controller then selects modality combinations and configurations using this profile and the asynchronous latency of the two modalities to adapt to network conditions. Across 500 StreamingBench video-question pairs, 4G/5G uplink traces, and the VideoLLM-Online and DisPider backends, MoS reduces latency violations by up to 94.3% and improves accuracy by up to 60.4% relative to the evaluated streaming baselines.

translation.title: MoS：面向动态网络上低延迟在线视频LLM分析的模态混合流式传输系统
translation.abstract: 下一代视频分析系统的服务模型正从传统的任务专用视觉模型转向通用的在线视频大语言模型（LLM）。在线视频LLM能够通过自然语言对持续到达的视频内容进行灵活的、具有上下文的理解。然而，其巨大的资源需求通常要求基于云端的推理，因此需要从用户设备持续流式传输视频以保持云端模型的上下文最新，从而支持在线交互。这在现有动态且往往恶劣的网络环境下带来了重大挑战，会降低延迟敏感应用的准确性和响应性。本文提出MoS，一种新的流式传输系统，它在波动的网络上自适应地传输视觉模态与派生文本模态的组合，以实现帕累托最优的视频LLM分析。关键洞察是利用视频LLM中隐藏的不同模态之间的互补性和可互换性来提升系统性能。具体而言，MoS引入自适应锚点帧选择和增量内容跟踪，以在设备端实现低延迟的文本描述生成。一个联合分析器刻画成对视频与文本配置（包括字幕输入分辨率和输出token预算）的准确性与开销。随后，基于随机优化的模态控制器利用该分析结果以及两种模态的异步延迟来选择模态组合和配置，以适应网络状况。在500个StreamingBench视频-问题对、4G/5G上行链路轨迹以及VideoLLM-Online和DisPider后端上的实验表明，与所评估的流式基线相比，MoS将延迟违规最多降低94.3%，准确性最多提升60.4%。
translation.brief: 针对动态网络下云端视频LLM分析的延迟与准确性问题，提出在设备端生成文本描述并与视频模态自适应组合流式传输的系统MoS。

papers.title: EGSE: Evidence-Grounded Skill Evolution for Medical Reasoning Agents
papers.abstract: Medical reasoning agents combine foundation models with specialized tools to interpret medical images, yet reusing their historical experience remains challenging. A correct final answer can conceal flawed reasoning or tool use, synthesized advice may lack source support, and superficially similar cases may require different diagnostic procedures. In this paper, we propose EGSE, an evidence-grounded skill evolution framework that distills historical dialogues from similar cases into reusable conditional workflows and progressively refines a multi-faceted skill library through supported and validated updates to improve medical agents. EGSE evaluates intermediate reasoning and tool use and contrasts repeated successful and failed rollouts to extract useful practices and evidence-supported avoidance guidance. These experiences are synthesized into workflows with applicability conditions and checks traceable to source dialogues. Library additions and merges require source-grounded review and execution validation. At inference time, EGSE routes queries to skill nodes organized by imaging modality, question task type, and disease category, then retrieves and selects applicable workflows based on their conditions, the current images, and the question to guide evidence acquisition and interpretation. Experiments across four chest X-ray benchmarks show that EGSE outperforms representative medical agents and skill evolution methods in reasoning accuracy while reducing tool calls. It also delivers consistent accuracy gains across seven foundation models and supports skill transfer across datasets.

translation.title: EGSE：面向医疗推理智能体的证据支撑技能演化框架
translation.abstract: 医疗推理智能体将基础模型与专用工具相结合来解读医学图像，但复用其历史经验仍然具有挑战性。正确的最终答案可能掩盖有缺陷的推理或工具使用，合成的建议可能缺乏来源支持，而表面相似的病例可能需要不同的诊断流程。本文提出EGSE，一个证据支撑的技能演化框架，它将相似病例的历史对话提炼为可复用的条件化工作流，并通过有依据且经验证的更新逐步完善多方面技能库，以改进医疗智能体。EGSE评估中间推理和工具使用，并对比重复的成功与失败 rollout，以提取有用的实践和有证据支持的规避指导。这些经验被合成为带有适用性条件和检查项的工作流，且可追溯至源对话。技能库的新增与合并需要基于来源的审查和执行验证。在推理时，EGSE将查询路由到按成像模态、问题任务类型和疾病类别组织的技能节点，然后根据工作流的条件、当前图像和问题检索并选择适用的工作流，以指导证据获取和解读。在四个胸部X光基准上的实验表明，EGSE在推理准确性上优于代表性的医疗智能体和技能演化方法，同时减少了工具调用。它还在七个基础模型上带来一致的准确性提升，并支持跨数据集的技能迁移。
translation.brief: 针对医疗智能体难以复用历史经验的问题，提出EGSE框架，将相似病例对话提炼为可追溯、经验证的条件化工作流技能库以指导推理。

papers.title: Connecting AI Agents to Live Discrete Element Simulations via the Model Context Protocol
papers.abstract: This paper describes a Model Context Protocol (MCP) server through which a general-purpose AI agent operates a discrete element engine, commercial or open-source, while the simulation runs. The agent submits a long simulation to the engine and, while it computes, reads the running model, changes it, or stops it. The human modeler stays at the engine's console and graphical interface throughout, and the agent sees what the modeler does there. The tools are derived from what the agent needs to do at the engine and are held to four principles: correctness, coverage, orthogonality and simplicity. Two documentation tools let the agent search the engine's manual and browse it level by level. Five execution tools let the agent run code in the engine, submit long simulations in the background, check on them, read the running model, and stop them. A bridge inside the engine serves these tools in a commercial DEM engine, PFC, and an open-source one, YADE. In a case study, a general-purpose agent calibrated a drained triaxial model of dense Toyoura sand against laboratory data in both engines, while the modeler worked at the same engine; the agent noticed the modeler's actions at the console and acted on them. The same calibration on YADE was then given to seven language models, three sessions each and without human intervention. Twenty of the twenty-one sessions reached the targets, and nineteen of the parameter sets lie in one small region of the admissible ranges. The server and the bridge are released as two open-source packages, itasca-mcp, which also serves FLAC, 3DEC, MPoint and MassFlow, and yade-mcp.

translation.title: 通过模型上下文协议将AI智能体接入实时离散元模拟
translation.abstract: 本文描述了一个模型上下文协议（MCP）服务器，通用AI智能体可通过它在离散元引擎（商业或开源）运行模拟的过程中对其进行操作。智能体向引擎提交一个长时间模拟，并在其计算期间读取运行中的模型、修改它或停止它。人类建模者全程留在引擎的控制台和图形界面上，而智能体能看到建模者在那里所做的一切。这些工具根据智能体在引擎处需要完成的操作而设计，并遵循四项原则：正确性、覆盖性、正交性和简洁性。两个文档工具让智能体搜索引擎手册并逐级浏览。五个执行工具让智能体在引擎中运行代码、在后台提交长时间模拟、检查其状态、读取运行中的模型以及停止模拟。引擎内的一个桥接层在商业DEM引擎PFC和开源引擎YADE中提供这些工具。在一个案例研究中，通用智能体在两个引擎中根据实验室数据校准了密实丰浦砂的排水三轴模型，同时建模者在同一引擎上工作；智能体注意到建模者在控制台上的操作并据此采取行动。随后将相同的YADE校准任务交给七个语言模型，每个模型三次会话且无人工干预。二十一次会话中有二十次达到目标，十九组参数落在允许范围的同一小区域内。该服务器和桥接层以两个开源包发布：itasca-mcp（同时服务FLAC、3DEC、MPoint和MassFlow）和yade-mcp。
translation.brief: 针对AI智能体无法操作运行中的离散元模拟的问题，设计了基于MCP的工具服务器与引擎桥接层，使智能体可在模拟运行中读取、修改和停止模型。

papers.title: BayesPath: Reliability-Aware Bayesian Reasoning for Whole-Slide Pathology Agents
papers.abstract: Diagnosing whole-slide images (WSIs) requires hypothesis-driven reasoning: pathologists form a differential diagnosis, seek discriminative evidence, weigh its reliability, and stop once it suffices. However, existing training-free WSI agents lack an explicit framework for such reasoning. They typically use a large language model (LLM) to aggregate the region descriptions of a multimodal LLM (MLLM), without a belief over the candidates or regard for the descriptions' reliability. Consequently, a repeated model error counts as independent evidence for an incorrect diagnosis. We introduce BayesPath, a training-free WSI agent that casts the pathologist's Scan-Look-Weigh-Decide process as reliability-aware Bayesian reasoning. An explicit belief over the candidates is updated with each observation through a reliability-aware likelihood and guides where to look next and when to stop. This likelihood corrects for the models' answer bias, discounts correlated observations, and captures diagnostic confusions estimated without labels. The updates form an interpretable evidence trail of how each observation shapes the belief. On five MultiPathQA tasks spanning slide classification and slide VQA, BayesPath achieves the highest average accuracy among training-free agents, 58.6% against 34.1% for the next best, with large gains on slide classification. On identical observations, Bayesian updating outperforms LLM aggregation on average, even with a larger LLM. BayesPath's belief is also better calibrated than naive Bayes, so uncertain cases can be deferred to pathologists. Code is available at this https URL

translation.title: BayesPath：面向全切片病理智能体的可靠性感知贝叶斯推理
translation.abstract: 诊断全切片图像（WSI）需要假设驱动的推理：病理医生形成鉴别诊断，寻找判别性证据，权衡其可靠性，并在证据充分时停止。然而，现有的免训练WSI智能体缺乏此类推理的显式框架。它们通常使用大语言模型（LLM）来聚合多模态LLM（MLLM）的区域描述，既没有对候选诊断的信念，也不考虑描述的可靠性。因此，模型的重复错误会被当作错误诊断的独立证据。我们提出BayesPath，一个免训练的WSI智能体，它将病理医生的扫描-观察-权衡-决策过程建模为可靠性感知的贝叶斯推理。对候选诊断的显式信念通过可靠性感知的似然随每次观察进行更新，并指导下一步观察何处以及何时停止。该似然校正模型的答案偏差，对相关观察进行折扣，并捕捉无需标签即可估计的诊断混淆。这些更新形成了可解释的证据轨迹，展示每次观察如何塑造信念。在涵盖切片分类和切片VQA的五个MultiPathQA任务上，BayesPath在免训练智能体中取得最高平均准确率，为58.6%，而次优者为34.1%，在切片分类上提升尤为显著。在相同观察下，贝叶斯更新平均优于LLM聚合，即使使用更大的LLM也是如此。BayesPath的信念校准也优于朴素贝叶斯，因此不确定的病例可以转交给病理医生。代码见此 https URL。
translation.brief: 针对免训练WSI智能体缺乏假设驱动推理框架的问题，提出BayesPath，用可靠性感知的贝叶斯信念更新来指导证据寻找与停止决策。

papers.title: What Does Skill Lift Actually Measure? A Source-Code-Level Audit and Noise-Aware Reanalysis of SkillsBench
papers.abstract: Agent skills are directories of instructions, reference materials, and scripts loaded on demand by coding agents. According to SkillsBench, although human-curated skills can raise the passing rate by about 16.6 percentage points (pp) on average, they have actually reduced the results for some tasks. Later research has started to gate or eliminate skills according to the above per-task gains. We have audited the above benchmark at the source-code level and analysed 7,554 public trials to form 1,421 paired "(configuration, task) cells". Source-code audit identified two controlled-verified cases of grader dependence and one operational definition gap; the average lift on these three tasks was 74.6 pp, and the overall average lift for the full set was 18.7 pp. The audit also found that four tasks contained placeholder skill directories, and a certain execution harness additionally added 48 built-in skills in most runs. No task-level reduction achieved statistical significance in the pooled reanalysis with multiple-testing correction. As there were at most three runs per condition for each cell, the observed negative differences are very susceptible to run-sampling noise, and arithmetically, 58% of the cells could not have shown a decrease. Therefore, the raw numbers of negative cells cannot show that skills cause harm. A gating strategy based on the skill-free score seems to improve by 2-3 pp in the logs; however, even after shuffling condition labels to remove any skill effect, it still achieves an increase of 4-7 pp. On the held-out runs not used for fitting and decision-making, there was no statistically significant improvement. The audit ledger and analysis scripts have been published by us.

translation.title: Skill Lift究竟测量了什么？SkillsBench的源代码级审计与噪声感知再分析
translation.abstract: 智能体技能是由编码智能体按需加载的指令、参考材料和脚本目录。根据SkillsBench，尽管人工整理的技能平均可将通过率提高约16.6个百分点（pp），但它们实际上降低了某些任务的结果。后续研究已开始根据上述每任务增益来门控或淘汰技能。我们在源代码层面审计了该基准，并分析了7,554次公开试验，形成1,421个配对的"（配置，任务）单元"。源代码审计发现了两个经对照验证的评分器依赖案例和一个操作性定义缺口；这三个任务的平均提升为74.6 pp，全集的总体平均提升为18.7 pp。审计还发现四个任务包含占位符技能目录，且某个执行框架在大多数运行中额外添加了48个内置技能。在经过多重检验校正的合并再分析中，没有任何任务层面的下降达到统计显著性。由于每个单元每种条件下最多只有三次运行，观察到的负差异极易受运行采样噪声影响，且从算术上看，58%的单元不可能出现下降。因此，负单元的原始数量无法证明技能造成损害。基于无技能分数的门控策略在日志中似乎带来2-3 pp的提升；然而，即使打乱条件标签以消除任何技能效应，它仍能取得4-7 pp的提升。在未用于拟合和决策的留出运行上，没有统计显著的改进。审计台账和分析脚本已由我们发布。
translation.brief: 针对SkillsBench声称技能可能损害部分任务结果的问题，通过源代码级审计与噪声感知再分析，证明负增益源于评分器缺陷与采样噪声而非技能本身。

papers.title: DLaR: Dynamic Stochasticity Control for Latent Reasoning in Large Language Models
papers.abstract: Latent reasoning enables LLMs to operate in continuous embedding space, yet existing methods suffer from deterministic inference that precludes exploration of diverse reasoning paths. While recent approaches inject stochasticity to restore exploration, we identify two fundamental limitations: \textit{uniform stochasticity} across all steps is suboptimal, and unconstrained perturbations disrupt reasoning coherence. We propose Dynamic Stochasticity Control for Latent Reasoning (DLaR), a framework with two complementary mechanisms that operate at different temporal granularities within the GRPO reinforcement learning framework. At the token level, Adaptive Stochasticity Modulation (ASM) dynamically adjusts perturbation intensity at each latent step based on a confidence-entropy fusion signal, increasing exploration when the model is uncertain and preserving stability when confident. At the training level, Training-Aware Stochasticity Tuning (TAST) progressively decays the base stochasticity level following a curriculum schedule. Through this dual-level design, DLaR establishes a hierarchical exploration-exploitation strategy that operates at both token and training levels. Extensive experiments on four in-distribution and three out-of-distribution mathematical reasoning benchmarks demonstrate that DLaR achieves the highest average performance across model scales, reaching 27.9%/50.6% Pass@1/Pass@8 on Llama-3.2-1B and 46.8%/68.2% on Qwen2.5-1.5B. Code: \href{this https URL}{this https URL}.

translation.title: DLaR：面向大语言模型潜在推理的动态随机性控制
translation.abstract: 潜在推理使大语言模型（LLM）能够在连续嵌入空间中进行推理，但现有方法受制于确定性推理，无法探索多样化的推理路径。尽管近期方法通过注入随机性来恢复探索能力，我们发现了两个根本性局限：所有步骤上采用*统一随机性*并非最优，且无约束的扰动会破坏推理的连贯性。我们提出面向潜在推理的动态随机性控制（DLaR），这是一个包含两个互补机制的框架，它们在GRPO强化学习框架内以不同的时间粒度运作。在token层面，自适应随机性调制（ASM）基于置信度-熵融合信号，在每个潜在步骤动态调整扰动强度：当模型不确定时增强探索，当模型自信时保持稳定。在训练层面，训练感知随机性调节（TAST）按照课程式调度逐步衰减基础随机性水平。通过这种双层设计，DLaR建立了一个在token和训练两个层面运作的分层探索-利用策略。在四个分布内和三个分布外数学推理基准上的大量实验表明，DLaR在各模型规模上均取得最高的平均性能，在Llama-3.2-1B上达到27.9%/50.6%的Pass@1/Pass@8，在Qwen2.5-1.5B上达到46.8%/68.2%。代码：\href{this https URL}{this https URL}。
translation.brief: 解决潜在推理中统一随机性扰动破坏推理连贯性的问题，提出在token和训练两个层面动态调节随机性的DLaR框架。

papers.title: PatternMiner: Automated Mathematical Discovery Through LLM-Guided Training and Interpretation of Small Models
papers.abstract: There are several approaches to AI-driven mathematical discovery. One of these involves the use of large language models (LLMs) to resolve well-specified conjectures via text-based reasoning, while another uses narrow models and interpretability for more open-ended, human-in-the-loop exploration using object-based mathematical data. The latter is limited in its ability to move beyond simple empirical pattern detection while the former is not well-designed for direct, open-ended exploration of large mathematical datasets. In this paper we introduce PatternMiner, a system that combines these two paradigms. In PatternMiner, an LLM agent generates mathematical datasets based on an initial broad question, trains narrow machine learning models on them, uses interpretability techniques to extract patterns from these trained models, and uses these patterns to formulate conjectures. Once an initial conjecture has been formulated, PatternMiner instructs the agent to search for counterexamples using calls to mathematical software. If a set of counterexamples can be found, these are used as feedback for conjecture refinement or another round of training and interpretability. The conjecture progressively evolves through this iterative sequence with the agent allowed to try to prove it at any point. We describe the results of applying PatternMiner to five well-known positivity problems in algebraic combinatorics. PatternMiner proves several new theorems related to Schubert positivity and projection, a character-row evaluation formula, a restricted version of the Kazhdan--Lusztig combinatorial invariance conjecture, and Schur positivity for a family of immanant coefficients. We end by analyzing the most common routes to conjecture generation that are used by PatternMiner in our case studies as well as documenting the most common failure modes.

translation.title: PatternMiner：通过LLM引导的小模型训练与解释实现自动化数学发现
translation.abstract: AI驱动的数学发现有多种途径。其中一种利用大语言模型（LLM）通过基于文本的推理来解决定义明确的猜想，另一种则使用窄域模型和可解释性技术，基于对象化的数学数据进行更开放式的、人在回路中的探索。后者在超越简单经验模式检测方面能力有限，而前者并不适合对大型数学数据集进行直接的开放式探索。本文介绍PatternMiner，一个结合这两种范式的系统。在PatternMiner中，LLM智能体根据一个初始的宽泛问题生成数学数据集，在其上训练窄域机器学习模型，使用可解释性技术从训练好的模型中提取模式，并利用这些模式提出猜想。一旦初始猜想形成，PatternMiner会指示智能体通过调用数学软件搜索反例。如果找到一组反例，这些反例将作为反馈用于猜想修正或新一轮训练与解释。猜想通过这一迭代过程逐步演化，智能体可在任意时刻尝试证明它。我们描述了将PatternMiner应用于代数组合数学中五个著名正性问题（positivity problems）的结果。PatternMiner证明了若干与Schubert正性和投影、特征标-行求值公式、Kazhdan--Lusztig组合不变性猜想的一个受限版本，以及一类immanant系数的Schur正性相关的新定理。最后，我们分析了PatternMiner在案例研究中生成猜想的最常见路径，并记录了最常见的失败模式。
translation.brief: 解决开放式数学猜想发现问题，提出让LLM智能体生成数据、训练小模型、用可解释性提取模式并迭代搜索反例修正猜想的PatternMiner系统。

papers.title: Fine-Tuning Without Gradients? Closed-Form, LLM-Written Classifiers on a Frozen Encoder
papers.abstract: Can a classifier computed in closed form on a frozen encoder match gradient fine-tuning? We present closed-form weight-space programming (WSP): a large language model (LLM), used as a design assistant, writes programs that read a frozen masked language model through cloze-style prompt templates at several layers, fit closed-form heads (shrinkage discriminant analysis, kernel ridge regression and the encoder's label-word prior) on labelled data, and select among a pool of candidate heads by cross-fitting. No gradient is computed and no encoder weight changes. We instantiate the framework on RoBERTa-large. On 11 development datasets with 512 to 8,192 training labels, WSP is ahead of full fine-tuning (FT) and LoRA at every label budget (by 0.3 to 0.6 points on average; the registered non-inferiority tests pass) and within 0.5 points of prompt-based fine-tuning (PFT); these datasets also shaped the recipe. With fewer labels its lead over FT and LoRA grows: 1.2 to 3.5 points with 64 and 128 labels, and 3.8 to 5.3 points in the few-shot setting of 16 labels per class, where WSP is again within half a point of PFT on the development datasets. On six held-out datasets, WSP stays ahead of LoRA and within half a point of FT on average, although with six datasets no registered test passes, and PFT is ahead, by 1.30 points with 8,192 labels. WSP never collapses and is deterministic, but it needs one encoder pass per template (17 here). We report all eight recipe versions, every decision that saw test results, and 27 ideas that did not help.

translation.title: 无需梯度的微调？冻结编码器上的闭式、LLM编写分类器
translation.abstract: 在冻结编码器上以闭式解计算的分类器能否匹敌梯度微调？我们提出闭式权重空间编程（WSP）：将大语言模型（LLM）用作设计助手，编写程序通过多层完形填空式提示模板读取冻结的掩码语言模型，在标注数据上拟合闭式分类头（收缩判别分析、核岭回归以及编码器的标签词先验），并通过交叉拟合在候选头池中进行选择。整个过程不计算任何梯度，也不改变编码器权重。我们在RoBERTa-large上实例化该框架。在11个训练标签数从512到8192的开发数据集上，WSP在每个标签预算下都优于全量微调（FT）和LoRA（平均领先0.3至0.6分；预注册的非劣性检验通过），且与基于提示的微调（PFT）差距在0.5分以内；这些数据集也参与塑造了该配方。在标签更少时，WSP对FT和LoRA的领先幅度扩大：在64和128个标签时领先1.2至3.5分，在每类16个标签的少样本设置中领先3.8至5.3分，此时WSP在开发数据集上与PFT的差距仍在半分以内。在六个留出数据集上，WSP保持领先于LoRA，平均与FT差距在半分以内，但由于只有六个数据集，没有预注册检验通过，且PFT在8192个标签时领先1.30分。WSP从不崩溃且具有确定性，但每个模板需要一次编码器前向传播（本文为17次）。我们报告了全部八个配方版本、每一个参考过测试结果的决策，以及27个未起作用的想法。
translation.brief: 解决不使用梯度微调即可获得高质量分类器的问题，提出让LLM编写程序在冻结编码器上拟合闭式分类头并交叉选择的方法WSP。

papers.title: Kolpona: An Agentic Framework with Gradient-Free Neuron Programming for RTL Generation
papers.abstract: Open-weight large language models (LLMs) for register-transfer level (RTL) design are usually improved by fine-tuning on curated Verilog corpora, which needs large sets of verified designs and GPU training. We present Kolpona, an agentic framework that improves such models without gradient training. Its first component is neuron programming, a new form of weight-space programming (WSP) that writes single neurons in closed form into the weights to remove failure habits found on practice tasks, and keeps each edit only when testbench results on fresh tasks favour it. At inference time, tool-using agents propose designs, and a label-free selection stage delivers one design per task from the specification, the candidates and their simulations alone. On Qwen3.5-4B, edits to 16 neurons raise the VerilogEval v2 pass@1 of the model alone from 31.7% to 55.4%, and the full framework reaches 77.6%. On Qwen3.8-27B, Kolpona lifts pass@1 from 73.1% to 94.9% on VerilogEval v2 and from 66.0% to 92.0% on RTLLM v2.1 on a single 32 GB GPU, above every published system in our comparison. The RTL edits also carry over to Python and raise the pass@1 of the 4B model alone from 84.8% to 91.5% on HumanEval+ and from 67.7% to 77.5% on MBPP+.

translation.title: Kolpona：面向RTL生成的无梯度神经元编程智能体框架
