translation.abstract: 面向寄存器传输级（RTL）设计的开放权重大语言模型（LLM）通常通过在精选的Verilog语料上微调来改进，这需要大量经过验证的设计和GPU训练。我们提出Kolpona，一个无需梯度训练即可改进此类模型的智能体框架。其第一个组件是神经元编程，这是权重空间编程（WSP）的一种新形式，以闭式解方式直接写入单个神经元的权重，以消除在练习任务中发现的失败习惯，并且仅当在新鲜任务上的testbench结果支持该编辑时才保留。在推理时，使用工具的智能体提出设计，一个无标签的选择阶段仅根据规格说明、候选设计及其仿真结果为每个任务交付一个设计。在Qwen3.5-4B上，对16个神经元的编辑将模型单独的VerilogEval v2 pass@1从31.7%提升到55.4%，完整框架达到77.6%。在Qwen3.8-27B上，Kolpona在单张32 GB GPU上将VerilogEval v2的pass@1从73.1%提升到94.9%，将RTLLM v2.1的pass@1从66.0%提升到92.0%，超过我们对比中所有已发表的系统。这些RTL编辑还能迁移到Python，将4B模型单独在HumanEval+上的pass@1从84.8%提升到91.5%，在MBPP+上从67.7%提升到77.5%。
translation.brief: 解决开放权重LLM生成RTL需昂贵微调的问题，提出通过闭式神经元编程编辑权重并结合无标签智能体选择框架Kolpona。

papers.title: Auto-Features: An LLM-Assisted Corpus for Contextual Recognition of Standard and Optional Car Features
papers.abstract: We present Auto-Features, a corpus for detecting a car's standard and optional features in advertisement text, given the feature catalogue of that exact vehicle. Sellers name the same feature in many ways. We therefore cast the task as feature-conditioned, or contextual, named entity recognition: extract the span that expresses one given catalogue feature. An entity-linking view follows from the same output. The corpus has a human-gold layer (430 adverts) from screened annotators and an LLM-silver layer (925 adverts) auto-annotated by a search-grounded LLM. We also contribute the way it was built. Every LLM output is validated, and each kind of failure has its own remedy. Malformed output is patched. Hallucinated content triggers a fresh attempt by a stronger model. Links to features outside the candidate list are dropped and counted (3 in 10,928 records). The LLM annotates alone only after its agreement with human annotators on link verification is comparable to human-human agreement. On advert-disjoint splits, a LoRA-tuned 4B LLM reaches 63.9% span F1 and 76.1% on the entity-linking view. A fine-tuned encoder reaches 59.0% and 74.1%. The margin is widest on catalogue features never seen in training (54.5% vs. 49.0%).

translation.title: Auto-Features：用于标准与可选汽车配置上下文识别的LLM辅助语料库
translation.abstract: 我们提出Auto-Features，一个用于在广告文本中检测汽车标准与可选配置的语料库，任务设定为已知该确切车型的配置目录。卖家对同一配置有多种命名方式。因此我们将该任务建模为配置条件化（即上下文化）的命名实体识别：抽取表达某个给定目录配置的文本片段。从同一输出还可得到实体链接视角。该语料库包含来自经过筛选的标注者的人工黄金层（430条广告）和由基于搜索的LLM自动标注的LLM白银层（925条广告）。我们还贡献了其构建方法。每一条LLM输出都经过验证，且每类失败都有对应的补救措施：格式错误的输出被修补；幻觉内容触发更强模型的重新尝试；指向候选列表之外配置的链接被丢弃并计数（10,928条记录中有3条）。只有当LLM在链接验证上与人工标注者的一致性达到人与人之间的一致性水平时，才允许其独立标注。在广告不相交的划分上，LoRA微调的4B LLM达到63.9%的片段F1和实体链接视角下76.1%的成绩；微调的编码器模型分别达到59.0%和74.1%。在训练中从未见过的目录配置上差距最大（54.5%对49.0%）。
translation.brief: 解决广告文本中汽车配置的上下文识别问题，构建含人工黄金层与LLM白银层、带验证补救机制的Auto-Features语料库。

papers.title: MixMoMo: Accelerating Extra--Large MoE Inference with Mixed--Precision GPU--NPU Execution on Mobile Devices
papers.abstract: Mobile agents and on-device intelligence increasingly demand more capable models on smartphones. Through sparse expert activation, Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) scales model capacity, yet growing numbers of fine-grained experts complicate loading and computation. Model compression complements expert offloading by reducing storage and computation costs. Among compression techniques, mixed-precision quantization assigns lower expert bitwidths to balance model quality and inference efficiency. However, existing offline metrics and routing scores fail to reflect expert quantization sensitivity, undermining precision assignment. Diverse bitwidths also complicate balanced expert allocation across GPUs and NPUs with distinct execution characteristics, while tile-wise dequantization underutilizes NPU vector parallelism. We present MixMoMo, an efficient mixed-precision inference runtime for extra-large MoE models on heterogeneous mobile SoCs. MixMoMo combines offline quantization-impact profiles with activation-based runtime risk estimates for quality-constrained expert bitwidth assignment. It further adopts precision-structured execution for balanced GPU-NPU expert allocation and HVX-parallel dequantization for efficient NPU vector utilization. Across three MoE models and five benchmarks on two mobile platforms, MixMoMo achieves average decoding speedups of 3.72x over uniform Q4_0 and 1.53x over the strongest mixed-precision MoE baseline.

translation.title: MixMoMo：基于混合精度 GPU-NPU 执行加速移动设备上的超大规模 MoE 推理
translation.abstract: 移动智能体和端侧智能日益要求智能手机上具备更强能力的模型。通过稀疏专家激活，混合专家模型扩展了模型容量，但不断增多的细粒度专家使加载和计算变得复杂。模型压缩通过降低存储和计算成本来补充专家卸载。在压缩技术中，混合精度量化为专家分配较低位宽，以平衡模型质量和推理效率。然而，现有的离线指标和路由分数无法反映专家的量化敏感度，削弱了精度分配的效果。多样的位宽也使在执行特性迥异的 GPU 和 NPU 之间进行均衡的专家分配变得复杂，而逐 tile 反量化未能充分利用 NPU 的向量并行能力。我们提出 MixMoMo，一个面向异构移动 SoC 上超大规模 MoE 模型的高效混合精度推理运行时。MixMoMo 将离线量化影响画像与基于激活的运行时风险估计相结合，进行质量约束下的专家位宽分配。它进一步采用精度结构化执行实现 GPU-NPU 间均衡的专家分配，并采用 HVX 并行反量化以高效利用 NPU 向量能力。在两个移动平台上的三个 MoE 模型和五个基准测试中，MixMoMo 相较均匀 Q4_0 取得平均 3.72 倍的解码加速，相较最强的混合精度 MoE 基线取得 1.53 倍加速。
translation.brief: 解决超大规模 MoE 在移动异构 SoC 上推理慢的问题，核心方法是将离线量化敏感度画像与运行时风险估计结合进行混合精度位宽分配，并配合 GPU-NPU 均衡专家分配与 HVX 并行反量化。

papers.title: Manga Page Parser: Comprehensive Visual Parsing through Local Story Understanding
papers.abstract: Understanding manga requires connecting who appears and who speaks with the events, character states, and relationships that unfold across panels. We study manga visual parsing through local story understanding: analyzing each double-page spread independently to capture and organize its story information in a reusable structured representation. We propose MangaParser, an agentic reading framework that jointly performs character clustering, speaker diarization, and speaker-to-character binding within a shared multimodal conversation, without additional training or fine-tuning. The agent uses structured story memory to guide character and speaker identification, inspecting relevant image regions when uncertain and refining its predictions and story records together as evidence accumulates. Quantitative evaluations show that our parser substantially outperforms manga-specific models across multiple backbones. Parsing examples illustrate how a unified representation links the character and speaker predictions with narrative content and supporting evidence. We further test reusability through story question answering using outputs generated before the questions are provided. The results confirm output reusability, offering a foundation for manga translation, content retrieval, and question answering.

translation.title: Manga Page Parser：通过局部故事理解实现全面的视觉解析
translation.abstract: 理解漫画需要将出现的人物和说话者与跨分格展开的事件、角色状态和关系联系起来。我们通过局部故事理解来研究漫画视觉解析：独立分析每个跨页，以可复用的结构化表示捕获并组织其故事信息。我们提出 MangaParser，一个 agentic 阅读框架，在共享的多模态对话中联合执行角色聚类、说话人分离和说话人-角色绑定，无需额外训练或微调。该智能体使用结构化故事记忆来引导角色和说话人识别，在不确定时检查相关图像区域，并随着证据积累共同细化其预测和故事记录。定量评估表明，我们的解析器在多个骨干模型上大幅超越漫画专用模型。解析示例展示了统一表示如何将角色和说话人预测与叙事内容及支持证据关联起来。我们进一步通过故事问答测试可复用性，使用在问题给出之前生成的输出。结果证实了输出的可复用性，为漫画翻译、内容检索和问答提供了基础。
translation.brief: 解决漫画页面中角色与说话人关联解析的问题，核心方法是一个无需训练的 agentic 框架，利用结构化故事记忆联合执行角色聚类、说话人分离与说话人-角色绑定。

papers.title: Asymmetric Speculative Decoding: Unlocking In-Context Learning in Draft Models
papers.abstract: Speculative decoding addresses Large Language Model (LLM) inference latency by first drafting and then verifying in parallel. Yet practical speedups fall far short of theoretical bounds, especially on reasoning tasks. We identify the root cause as task isomorphism: existing methods provide identical prompts to both models, forcing the draft model to solve problems beyond its capacity. This produces high rejection rates that eliminate parallelization gains. We discover that acceptance rates increase monotonically during generation, revealing a latent in-context learning (ICL) effect wherein the draft model progressively aligns with the target distribution by learning from verified tokens. Controlled experiments with varying context window sizes confirm this improvement stems from ICL-driven alignment rather than token difficulty. Motivated by this finding, we propose Asymmetric Speculative Decoding (AsymSpec), a training-free framework that decouples the prompts provided to draft and target models. By supplying the draft model with task-relevant example solutions, we reformulate its objective from reasoning to simulation, amplifying the ICL effect from the first token. We prove AsymSpec produces exact samples and converges exponentially to the target distribution. Across reasoning, code generation, and summarization tasks, AsymSpec achieves 2.29$\times$ to 4.95$\times$ speedup over autoregressive decoding, outperforming standard speculative decoding without model retraining.

translation.title: 非对称投机解码：解锁草稿模型的上下文学习能力
translation.abstract: 投机解码通过先起草后并行验证来应对大语言模型（LLM）推理延迟。然而实际加速远低于理论界限，尤其是在推理任务上。我们将根本原因确定为任务同构：现有方法为两个模型提供相同的提示，迫使草稿模型解决超出其能力的问题，导致高拒绝率，抵消了并行化收益。我们发现接受率在生成过程中单调上升，揭示了一种潜在的上下文学习（ICL）效应，即草稿模型通过学习已验证的 token 逐步对齐目标分布。通过改变上下文窗口大小的受控实验证实，这种提升源于 ICL 驱动的对齐而非 token 难度。基于这一发现，我们提出非对称投机解码，一个无需训练的框架，将提供给草稿模型和目标模型的提示解耦。通过向草稿模型提供与任务相关的示例解答，我们将其目标从推理重新表述为模拟，从第一个 token 起放大 ICL 效应。我们证明 AsymSpec 产生精确样本并指数收敛到目标分布。在推理、代码生成和摘要任务上，AsymSpec 相较自回归解码取得 2.29 倍至 4.95 倍的加速，优于标准投机解码且无需模型重训练。
translation.brief: 解决投机解码中草稿模型因任务同构导致高拒绝率的问题，核心方法是将草稿与目标模型的提示解耦，向草稿模型提供示例解答以放大其上下文学习效应。

papers.title: Residual Cross-Model Narrative Convergence under Shared Prompts: Auditing Prompt Controls and Narrative Measurement
papers.abstract: Stories created by LLMs based on the same prompts can be narratively similar to one another. This similarity may reflect constraints imposed by the prompts as well as the models' writing tendencies. The current research analyzes 51,240 stories created by five models in the StoryScope corpus based on 10,248 common prompts. It uses 213 narrative features in seven dimensions to compare cross-model distances between stories generated from the same prompts with distances between stories generated from different but semantically matched prompts. To assess the relationship between narrative features and prompt content, a semantic relevance mask was evaluated against 420 author-annotated prompt-feature judgments (F1 = .813; near-threshold accuracy = .621). The equally weighted mean Residual Convergence Index (RCI) was .409 without masking and .406 with masking. These findings indicate measurable cross-model narrative convergence relative to a semantically matched-prompt baseline, with little change following semantic relevance masking.

translation.title: 共享提示下的残差跨模型叙事趋同：审计提示控制与叙事测量
translation.abstract: 由 LLM 基于相同提示创作的故事在叙事上可能彼此相似。这种相似性可能反映了提示施加的约束以及模型自身的写作倾向。本研究分析了 StoryScope 语料库中五个模型基于 10,248 个共同提示创作的 51,240 个故事。它使用七个维度上的 213 个叙事特征，比较由相同提示生成的故事之间的跨模型距离与由不同但语义匹配的提示生成的故事之间的距离。为评估叙事特征与提示内容之间的关系，基于 420 个作者标注的提示-特征判断评估了语义相关性掩码（F1 = .813；接近阈值的准确率 = .621）。等权平均残差趋同指数（RCI）在不加掩码时为 .409，加掩码时为 .406。这些发现表明，相对于语义匹配提示基线，存在可测量的跨模型叙事趋同，且在语义相关性掩码后变化甚微。
translation.brief: 解决如何区分 LLM 故事相似性中提示约束与模型写作倾向的问题，核心方法是用 213 个叙事特征比较相同提示与语义匹配提示下跨模型故事的残差趋同指数。

papers.title: JHealthBench-L: Clinician-Reviewed Localization of HealthBench for Rubric-Based Medical LLM Evaluation in Japan
papers.abstract: Rubric-based benchmarks such as HealthBench evaluate large language models (LLMs) on open-ended health consultations using case-specific physician criteria, many of which presuppose the healthcare institutions, medications, and care pathways of their source region. Under machine translation alone, these regional assumptions remain in the rubric, leaving responses appropriate in Japan uncredited or falsely penalized under foreign clinical rules. To adapt established clinical evaluation perspectives to Japan without authoring rubrics from scratch, we construct JHealthBench-L (79 patient-facing consultations, 1,022 criteria) through source-cited LLM drafting, single-specialist selection and revision, independent dual-physician review, and meta-review. Specialists rewrote only 4.4% of criteria from scratch, and independent reviewers approved 93.6% of Stage-2 criteria without issue. Comparing JHealthBench-L with a machine-translated baseline across 18 LLMs reveals that translation-only evaluation preserves coarse model rankings ($\tau = 0.817$, mean shift +0.027) yet flips verdicts on 17.7% of modified criteria (vs. 7.3% re-grading noise) and reduces false penalties on Japan-adapted negative criteria by 7.1 percentage points, masking item-level clinical mismeasurement behind stable leaderboards. Axis-level and paired analyses further show that context awareness and Japan-specific clinical criteria remain primary bottlenecks, whereas Japanese continual pretraining and reasoning post-training substantially improve locally grounded performance. Datasets, physician revision logs, and evaluation code are available at this https URL.

translation.title: JHealthBench-L：面向日本基于量规的医学 LLM 评估的 HealthBench 临床医生审校本地化版本
translation.abstract: 诸如 HealthBench 等基于量规的基准使用针对具体病例的医生标准来评估大语言模型（LLM）在开放式健康咨询上的表现，其中许多标准预设了其来源地区的医疗机构、药物和诊疗路径。仅靠机器翻译时，这些区域假设仍保留在量规中，导致在日本合适的回答得不到认可，或被外国临床规则错误惩罚。为了在不从零编写量规的情况下将既有的临床评估视角适配到日本，我们通过带来源引用的 LLM 起草、单专科医生选择与修订、独立双医生审阅和元审阅，构建了 JHealthBench-L（79 个面向患者的咨询，1,022 条标准）。专科医生仅从零重写了 4.4% 的标准，独立审阅者对 93.6% 的第二阶段标准无异议通过。将 JHealthBench-L 与机器翻译基线在 18 个 LLM 上比较发现，仅翻译的评估保留了粗粒度的模型排名（τ = 0.817，平均偏移 +0.027），却在 17.7% 的修订标准上翻转了判定（相比之下重新评分噪声为 7.3%），并将对日本适配负向标准的错误惩罚减少 7.1 个百分点，在稳定的排行榜背后掩盖了条目级的临床测量偏差。轴级和配对分析进一步表明，上下文意识和日本特定临床标准仍是主要瓶颈，而日语持续预训练和推理后训练显著提升了本地化表现。数据集、医生修订日志和评估代码可在该 https URL 获取。
translation.brief: 解决 HealthBench 量规中区域假设导致日本场景下医学 LLM 评估失准的问题，核心方法是通过 LLM 起草加多阶段医生审校构建本地化量规基准 JHealthBench-L。

papers.title: Post-Training Policy Replication for Strategy-Following Multi-Agent Deep Reinforcement Learning across Team Sizes
papers.abstract: Although multi-agent deep reinforcement learning enables coordinated behavior, aligning it with managerial intent remains difficult due to complex agent interactions. Although the strategy-following distributed attentional actor architecture (sfDA7-X) improves controllability via regional instructions, instruction combinations scale exponentially with team and instruction sizes, leading to prohibitive training costs and poor transferability. To reduce this computational cost, we introduce a team-size-independent observation architecture and reconstruct collective behavior by replicating a single trained policy across agents in teams of different sizes, thereby eliminating the need to train from scratch. Additionally, we evaluate warm-start retraining by initializing policy networks with a pre-trained policy to significantly lower computational overhead. In an object collection game, a policy trained in a four-agent team is deployed to teams of three to eight agents. Experiments demonstrate that training with the proposed aggregated observation matrix achieves performance comparable to that of the baseline method, sfDA7-X. Furthermore, policy replication preserves performance without substantial degradation in three- and five-agent teams, and warm-start retraining outperforms training from scratch while reducing required training episodes by up to 90%. Deployments to six- and eight-agent teams further confirm effective spatial region allocation following given instructions. These results demonstrate that the proposed method enables zero-shot collective behavior reconstruction via policy replication.

translation.title: 面向跨团队规模策略跟随多智能体深度强化学习的训练后策略复制
translation.abstract: 尽管多智能体深度强化学习能够实现协调行为，但由于智能体间交互复杂，使其与管理意图保持一致仍然困难。虽然策略跟随分布式注意力行动者架构（sfDA7-X）通过区域指令提升了可控性，但指令组合随团队规模和指令数量呈指数级增长，导致训练成本过高且可迁移性差。为降低计算成本，我们引入了一种与团队规模无关的观测架构，通过将单个训练好的策略复制到不同规模团队中的各智能体上来重构集体行为，从而无需从头训练。此外，我们评估了热启动重训练方法，即用预训练策略初始化策略网络，以显著降低计算开销。在一个物体收集游戏中，将在四智能体团队中训练的策略部署到三至八智能体的团队中。实验表明，使用所提出的聚合观测矩阵进行训练可达到与基线方法 sfDA7-X 相当的性能。此外，策略复制在三智能体和五智能体团队中保持了性能且无显著退化，热启动重训练优于从头训练，同时将所需训练回合数最多减少90%。在六智能体和八智能体团队中的部署进一步证实了按照给定指令进行有效空间区域分配的能力。这些结果表明，所提方法能够通过策略复制实现零样本集体行为重构。
translation.brief: 解决 sfDA7-X 指令组合随团队规模指数增长导致训练成本过高的问题，采用与团队规模无关的观测架构，通过复制单一训练策略和热启动重训练来重构不同规模团队的集体行为。

papers.title: Few-Shot Adaptation of Vision-Language Models via Agentic Model Editing
papers.abstract: Few-shot adaptation transfers pretrained Vision-Language Models (VLMs) to new domains using a small set of labeled images. Most methods fit prompts, representations, or classifiers within an adaptation procedure specified in advance. Yet the visual distinctions needed for recognition can differ substantially across domains, motivating the question: Can an LLM agent use few-shot examples and model observations to design the adaptation procedure itself? We propose Agentic Model Editing (AME), an agentic framework that jointly designs input transformations, encoder edits, feature computation, and classifier fitting as an executable, domain-customized adaptation program. The agent inspects images, class semantics, model parameters, intermediate representations, and activations to formulate hypotheses about the target task. It implements and tests candidate programs on the support set, with aggregate validation accuracy guiding refinement and selection. Each program fits a complete domain model that is fixed before testing. The agent and its tools are shared across domains, while each domain receives its own adaptation program. Across eleven datasets with CLIP ViT-B/16, AME achieves the highest average accuracies of 81.2% without back-propagation and 81.9% with back-propagation among the compared methods. Further experiments demonstrate applicability across VLM backbones and LLM agents.

translation.title: 基于智能体模型编辑的视觉-语言模型少样本适配
translation.abstract: 少样本适配利用少量标注图像将预训练的视觉-语言模型（VLM）迁移到新领域。大多数方法在预先设定的适配流程内拟合提示、表示或分类器。然而，识别所需的视觉区分在不同领域间可能差异巨大，这引出了一个问题：LLM 智能体能否利用少样本示例和模型观察来设计适配流程本身？我们提出智能体模型编辑（AME），这是一个智能体框架，将输入变换、编码器编辑、特征计算和分类器拟合联合设计为一个可执行的、领域定制的适配程序。该智能体检查图像、类别语义、模型参数、中间表示和激活值，以对目标任务形成假设。它在支持集上实现并测试候选程序，以聚合验证准确率指导程序的改进与选择。每个程序拟合一个在测试前固定的完整领域模型。智能体及其工具在各领域间共享，而每个领域获得自己的适配程序。在基于 CLIP ViT-B/16 的十一个数据集上，AME 在所比较的方法中取得了最高的平均准确率：无反向传播时为81.2%，有反向传播时为81.9%。进一步的实验证明了该方法在不同 VLM 骨干网络和 LLM 智能体上的适用性。
translation.brief: 解决 VLM 少样本适配流程需预先固定、难以适应领域差异的问题，提出 AME 智能体框架，让 LLM 智能体通过观察模型自动设计并迭代优化领域定制的适配程序。

papers.title: Too Smart for Its Own Good? Cognitive Fidelity and Competence Leakage in LLM Simulations of Young Learners
papers.abstract: LLM-based interactive learner simulators are increasingly used in educational applications, including teacher training and tutoring system development. A critical requirement for those simulations is cognitive fidelity: the simulated learner should maintain the assigned knowledge, misconceptions, and reasoning procedures throughout interaction. However, LLMs may express knowledge or problem-solving skills beyond the assigned learner's cognitive status, a phenomenon we refer to as competence leakage. In this exploratory study, we examine 3,339 simulated learner utterances from 130 teacher-learner simulator transcripts across three learning scenarios and identify over-competence as a prominent direction of cognitive-profile misalignment during interaction. We then investigate the recurrence of previously observed competence leakage cases under four matched-trigger evaluation protocols, ranging from isolated questioning to multi-turn interactions, across five model configurations. Overall, we observe higher violation recurrence under multi-turn protocols than under isolated question answering. More capable models generally show lower recurrence, whereas increased reasoning effort does not consistently improve cognitive fidelity and is even associated with slightly higher recurrence under multi-turn protocols in our matched-model comparison. These findings provide exploratory evidence of competence leakage phenomena in interactive learner simulation and suggest that single-turn question-answering type of evaluations alone may be insufficient, motivating the development of more systematic and reliable multi-turn protocols for evaluating cognitive fidelity in learner simulation.

translation.title: 过于聪明反受其害？LLM 模拟年轻学习者中的认知保真度与能力泄露
translation.abstract: 基于 LLM 的交互式学习者模拟器在教育应用中日益普及，包括教师培训与辅导系统开发。此类模拟的一个关键要求是认知保真度：被模拟的学习者应在整个交互过程中保持所分配的知识、误解和推理过程。然而，LLM 可能表达超出所分配学习者认知状态的知识或问题解决技能，我们将这一现象称为能力泄露。在这项探索性研究中，我们检查了来自130份教师-学习者模拟对话记录、涵盖三个学习场景的3,339条模拟学习者话语，发现能力过强是交互过程中认知画像错位的一个突出方向。随后，我们在五种模型配置下，通过四种匹配触发评估协议（从孤立提问到多轮交互）考察先前观察到的能力泄露案例的复现情况。总体而言，多轮协议下的违规复现率高于孤立问答。能力更强的模型通常复现率更低，而增加推理努力并不能持续提升认知保真度，在我们的同模型对比中，多轮协议下甚至与略高的复现率相关。这些发现为交互式学习者模拟中的能力泄露现象提供了探索性证据，并表明仅靠单轮问答式评估可能不够，需要开发更系统、更可靠的多轮协议来评估学习者模拟中的认知保真度。
translation.brief: 研究 LLM 模拟学习者会表达超出所分配认知状态的能力泄露问题，通过多轮匹配触发评估协议系统考察该现象的复现规律。

papers.title: Reliable User Simulation in Complex Multi-Step Workflows
papers.abstract: LLM-based user simulators are increasingly used to evaluate conversational assistants. Yet, these simulators can drift from their assigned goals or fail to exhaustively explore all specified options, causing evaluation errors incorrectly attributed to the assistant. Prior work has examined goal alignment in single-task settings, but many practical scenarios require simulators to execute multi-step workflows with sequential tasks, fallback logic, and cross-task dependencies, where simulator fidelity has not been measured. To close this gap, we introduce a benchmark of 500 workflows represented using the Hierarchical Task Network (HTN) abstraction. Our experiments reveal that the simulator's fidelity degrades sharply with workflow complexity, and that goal drift accounts for the majority of failures. Fidelity also depends on the assistant's response style, with the same simulator scoring substantially better or worse across styles. To address this, we propose ReUST (Reasoning + User State Tracking), a simple prompting strategy to maintain state information across dialogue turns. ReUST improves goal success rate by more than 12 points for mid-sized and large models, and reduces simulator sensitivity to the assistant's response style.

translation.title: 复杂多步骤工作流中的可靠用户模拟
translation.abstract: 基于 LLM 的用户模拟器被越来越多地用于评估对话助手。然而，这些模拟器可能偏离其被分配的目标，或未能穷尽地探索所有指定选项，导致评估错误被错误地归咎于助手。已有工作研究了单任务设置下的目标对齐，但许多实际场景要求模拟器执行包含顺序任务、回退逻辑和跨任务依赖的多步骤工作流，而此类场景下模拟器的保真度尚未被测量。为填补这一空白，我们引入了一个包含500个工作流的基准，采用分层任务网络（HTN）抽象来表示。实验表明，模拟器的保真度随工作流复杂度急剧下降，且目标漂移是大多数失败的原因。保真度还取决于助手的回复风格，同一模拟器在不同风格下的得分差异显著。为此，我们提出 ReUST（Reasoning + User State Tracking），一种在对话轮次间维护状态信息的简单提示策略。ReUST 将中大型模型的目标成功率提升超过12个百分点，并降低了模拟器对助手回复风格的敏感性。
translation.brief: 解决 LLM 用户模拟器在多步骤工作流中目标漂移和保真度下降的问题，提出 ReUST 提示策略，通过推理与用户状态跟踪在对话轮次间维护状态信息。

papers.title: When to Respond, Where to Ground: Streaming 3D Affordance Grounding
papers.abstract: Given a continuous RGB-D stream and a language request, streaming 3D affordance grounding requires an agent to decide when to respond and where to locate the requested functional part using only observations available so far. Existing 3D affordance grounding methods typically assume complete scene observations, while streaming vision-language models lack fine-grained 3D functional grounding. Our goal is to jointly determine response timing and functional-part localization during continuous scene observation. We propose StreamAff, an evidence-guided response strategy that makes both decisions from the grounding model's own visual evidence. The model scores the visual patches of the frames it reads: their combined support, weighed against a wait option, decides when to respond, and the highest-scoring patch selects the frame to ground in. A conditional look-back policy lets the model answer from an earlier observation at the moment of the request or wait for new evidence, and zoom-and-refine grounding segments the part named in the answer on the 3D points of the selected frame. We further introduce StreamFun3D, a benchmark derived from real-world 3D scenes that evaluates response timing and grounding across four evidence settings: Current, History, Future, and Unobserved, together with StreamIoU, a metric that credits a mask only when the response is timely and grounded in a valid source frame. We adapt offline 3D affordance grounding methods and build external-decider baselines that pair vision-language models with our mask decoder. StreamAff achieves 30.14% StreamIoU on 15-second streams, a 40.6% relative improvement over the strongest of these baselines.

translation.title: 何时响应、何处定位：流式 3D 功能可供性定位
translation.abstract: 给定连续的 RGB-D 视频流和一条语言请求，流式 3D 功能可供性定位要求智能体仅利用目前可获得的观察，决定何时响应以及在哪里定位所请求的功能部件。现有的 3D 功能可供性定位方法通常假设场景观察是完整的，而流式视觉-语言模型缺乏细粒度的 3D 功能定位能力。我们的目标是在连续场景观察过程中联合确定响应时机和功能部件定位。我们提出 StreamAff，一种证据引导的响应策略，从定位模型自身的视觉证据出发做出这两项决策。模型对其读取的帧中的视觉块进行评分：各块的联合支持度与等待选项权衡后决定何时响应，得分最高的块决定在哪一帧中进行定位。条件回看策略允许模型在请求到来时基于较早的观察作答，或等待新证据；缩放-精化定位则在所选帧的 3D 点上分割出答案中提及的部件。我们进一步引入 StreamFun3D，一个源自真实世界 3D 场景的基准，在 Current、History、Future 和 Unobserved 四种证据设置下评估响应时机与定位，并配套 StreamIoU 指标——只有当响应及时且定位自有效源帧时才给予掩码得分。我们适配了离线 3D 功能可供性定位方法，并构建了将视觉-语言模型与我们的掩码解码器配对的外部决策器基线。StreamAff 在15秒视频流上取得30.14%的 StreamIoU，相对最强基线提升40.6%。
translation.brief: 解决流式场景下 3D 功能部件定位需同时决定响应时机与定位位置的问题，提出 StreamAff 证据引导策略，基于定位模型自身的视觉块评分联合做出两项决策。

papers.title: Budget, Readout or Reasoning? Where Small Reasoning Models Lose Value in Auction Bidding
papers.abstract: Ad platforms and marketplaces show bidders a bid landscape, the estimated chance of winning at each candidate bid, and increasingly let agents built on reasoning language models choose the bid. We give six open reasoning models of 4B to 14B parameters such landscapes, with win curves from eBay closing prices and from a simulated advertising market (AuctionNet), and score their bids on held-out auctions against an exact calculator. Because the agent is handed the estimates, the lost value can be split by cause. Two failures belong to the models. They pass over the best option even when the values written in their own trace already rank it first, and their wrong answers lean toward the highest bid on the menu. The lean is about the bid's size, not its place in the list, and it survives sampling. At 768 forced tokens on eBay, under pay-your-bid pricing, the wrong answers cost bidders 7-17% of the surplus the calculator's bids earn. Arithmetic errors are rare. Two further losses come from operator choices. A token cap cuts traces short: allowed to stop on their own within 4,096 tokens, five models recover 91-100% of the calculator's lead over a model that does no reasoning. Asking for the answer while the reasoning block is still open misreads it: closing the block first lifts the weakest model from 42% to 84% on eBay and from 24% to 81% on AuctionNet. Finally, an audit that flags bids disagreeing with the trace's own numbers, and overrides them with the calculator's bid, raises the share of the calculator's lead recovered at 768 forced tokens from 42-85% to 84-100% on eBay under nested cross-validation, and the same reader settings transfer from eBay to AuctionNet.

translation.title: 预算、读取还是推理？小型推理模型在拍卖竞价中损失价值的原因
translation.abstract: 广告平台和市场向竞价者展示竞价景观（bid landscape），即每个候选出价的估计获胜概率，并越来越多地允许基于推理语言模型的智能体来选择出价。我们向六个参数量在4B到14B之间的开源推理模型提供此类景观，其获胜曲线来自eBay成交价和一个模拟广告市场（AuctionNet），并在留出的拍卖上以精确计算器为基准对它们的出价打分。由于估计值是直接交给智能体的，损失的价值可以按原因拆分。两类失败属于模型本身：即使它们自己的推理轨迹中写下的数值已经把最优选项排在第一位，它们仍会跳过该选项；而且它们的错误答案倾向于菜单中最高的出价。这种倾向与出价的大小有关，而非其在列表中的位置，并且在采样下依然存在。在eBay上强制768个token、按自身出价付费的定价下，错误答案使竞价者损失了计算器出价所获盈余的7-17%。算术错误很少见。另外两类损失来自操作者选择。token上限会截断推理轨迹：允许模型在4,096个token内自行停止时，五个模型恢复了91-100%的计算器相对不推理模型的优势。在推理块尚未闭合时请求答案会误读结果：先闭合推理块使最弱模型在eBay上的表现从42%提升到84%，在AuctionNet上从24%提升到81%。最后，一种审计机制会标记与轨迹自身数字不一致的出价并用计算器的出价覆盖它们，在嵌套交叉验证下，将768个强制token时恢复计算器优势的比例在eBay上从42-85%提升到84-100%，且相同的读取设置可从eBay迁移到AuctionNet。
translation.brief: 研究小型推理模型在拍卖竞价中损失价值的原因，通过将损失拆分为模型失败与操作者选择两类，并提出审计覆盖机制来恢复计算器出价的优势。

papers.title: Feature Engineered Reinforcement Learning for S-pair Selection in Buchberger's Algorithm
papers.abstract: Selecting the order in which to process S-pairs is a crucial decision in Buchberger's algorithm for computing Groebner bases: this choice can change the cost by orders of magnitude. Recent work has shown that reinforcement learning agents viewing exponent vectors of the polynomials outperform classical heuristics on binomial ideals. We extend this line of work to general polynomial ideals by using statistical features. We introduce a 17-dimensional feature vector to describe a polynomial and use PPO to train policies on five distributions of random ideals. We find that using S-polynomial features significantly outperforms S-pair features on all five distributions. The new policies also outperform the retrained RL baseline on all five distributions, reducing algorithmic work by 41--53\% relative to the degree heuristic on four distributions where learning helps. The additional cost of the feature engineering means that wall-clock cost remains similar to the baseline, but our new approach benefits from easier transfer to unseen distributions.

translation.title: 基于特征工程的强化学习用于Buchberger算法中的S-对选择
translation.abstract: 在计算Groebner基的Buchberger算法中，选择处理S-对的顺序是一项关键决策：这一选择可能使代价相差数个数量级。近期工作表明，观察多项式指数向量的强化学习智能体在二项式理想上优于经典启发式方法。我们通过使用统计特征将这一工作扩展到一般多项式理想。我们引入一个17维特征向量来描述多项式，并使用PPO在五个随机理想分布上训练策略。我们发现使用S-多项式特征在所有五个分布上都显著优于S-对特征。新策略在所有五个分布上也优于重新训练的RL基线，在学习有效的四个分布上，相对次数启发式方法将算法工作量减少了41-53%。特征工程的额外开销意味着实际运行时间与基线相近，但我们的新方法更容易迁移到未见过的分布。
translation.brief: 针对Buchberger算法中S-对选择问题，提出17维统计特征结合PPO训练策略，以减少算法工作量并提升跨分布迁移能力。

papers.title: Whose Side Are You On? A Framework and Benchmark for Assessing LLM Political Stances through Politicians Social Media Posts
papers.abstract: Large language models (LLMs) increasingly participate in political discussions, making it important to understand which positions they support or oppose. We propose a framework for assessing LLMs' political stances through simulated social media interactions. The framework uses politicians' posts and multiple prompting methods to identify consistently expressed stances. Using this framework, we construct WorldPOLL, comprising 4,600 political posts from X/Twitter collected from approximately 200 politicians representing ruling and opposition blocs across 23 countries. Our quantitative analysis shows how support and opposition vary across models, countries, and political directions, while our qualitative analysis identifies the political views and policies models support or oppose. Together, these analyses reveal shared positions across models and differences across national contexts. We also examine whether models express consistent stances across prompting methods, investigate the reasons for disagreement, and assess the effects of model size and instruction tuning in stance inconsistency. WorldPOLL offers a practical way to measure LLM political tendencies, identify the views behind them, and assess their consistency in real-world political discussions.

translation.title: 你站在哪一边？通过政客社交媒体帖子评估LLM政治立场的框架与基准
translation.abstract: 大语言模型（LLM）越来越多地参与政治讨论，因此了解它们支持或反对哪些立场变得十分重要。我们提出了一个通过模拟社交媒体互动来评估LLM政治立场的框架。该框架利用政客的帖子和多种提示方法来识别其一致表达的立场。基于该框架，我们构建了WorldPOLL，包含从X/Twitter收集的4,600条政治帖子，这些帖子来自代表23个国家执政与反对阵营的约200名政客。我们的定量分析展示了支持与反对在不同模型、国家和政治方向上的变化，而定性分析则识别出模型支持或反对的政治观点和政策。这些分析共同揭示了模型间的共同立场以及不同国家背景下的差异。我们还考察了模型在不同提示方法下是否表达一致的立场，探究不一致的原因，并评估模型规模和指令微调对立场不一致性的影响。WorldPOLL为衡量LLM政治倾向、识别其背后的观点以及评估其在现实政治讨论中的一致性提供了实用方法。
translation.brief: 针对LLM政治立场评估问题，构建基于政客社交媒体帖子的模拟互动框架和WorldPOLL基准，量化分析模型的政治倾向及其一致性。

papers.title: Not Every Input Needs Everything: Unifying Expert Gating, Model Cascades, and Agent Orchestration
papers.abstract: Executing monolithic neural weights, frontier foundation models, or entire multi-agent workflows uniformly on every input incurs substantial computational, latency, and monetary overhead. Conditional computation mitigates this cost by deciding dynamically which internal experts, model endpoints, or specialized agents to invoke per request. Yet token-level gating in sparse neural architectures, query-level model cascades, and task-level multi-agent coordination have largely progressed in disconnected research silos, obscuring recurring system failures and transferable fixes. In this systematic review, we synthesize 2,289 studies published between 2017 and September 2026 (selected from 13,884 unique records) across 20 methodological families under a unified two-step inspect-then-allocate framework. Discrete hard selection accounts for 70%, 83%, and 91% of token-, query-, and task-scale literature respectively, and computational overhead appears as a top operational bottleneck across every layer. Engineering safeguards remain sharply asymmetric: intra-layer gating prioritizes load balancing while rarely incorporating uncertainty estimation, whereas model selection and agent orchestration rely on confidence thresholds and budget rules while confronting miscalibration and cascading errors. At the same time, publication volume is accelerating fastest in agentic task delegation, where routing mechanisms are least often isolated experimentally and methodological bias risk is highest.

translation.title: 并非每个输入都需要全部资源：统一专家门控、模型级联与智能体编排
translation.abstract: 在每个输入上统一执行单体神经网络权重、前沿基础模型或整个多智能体工作流，会带来巨大的计算、延迟和金钱开销。条件计算通过动态决定每个请求调用哪些内部专家、模型端点或专用智能体来缓解这一成本。然而，稀疏神经架构中的token级门控、查询级模型级联和任务级多智能体协调在很大程度上是在彼此割裂的研究孤岛中发展的，掩盖了反复出现的系统性失败和可迁移的解决方案。在这篇系统性综述中，我们在统一的“先检查后分配”两步框架下，综合了2017年至2026年9月间发表的2,289项研究（从13,884条独立记录中筛选），涵盖20个方法学家族。离散硬选择分别占token级、查询级和任务级文献的70%、83%和91%，而计算开销在每一层都是首要的操作瓶颈。工程保障措施呈现明显的不对称性：层内门控优先考虑负载均衡而很少纳入不确定性估计，而模型选择和智能体编排则依赖置信度阈值和预算规则，同时面临校准偏差和级联错误问题。与此同时，发表量增长最快的是智能体任务委派领域，而该领域的路由机制最少被实验性隔离研究，方法学偏差风险也最高。
translation.brief: 针对条件计算研究割裂的问题，以统一的“先检查后分配”框架系统性综述token级门控、查询级级联和任务级智能体编排三个层面的方法与共性失败。

papers.title: A Simple Yet Effective Agent for Open-World Aerial Object Search
papers.abstract: Open-world aerial object search methods often rely on persistent spatial maps, learned world models, or task-specific policy training. To examine how far a minimal, training-free design can go, we introduce SimpleUAV, an agent built around a frozen, off-the-shelf vision-language model (VLM). SimpleUAV separates current-view target assessment from history-conditioned action selection, combining fresh candidate evidence with lightweight search context. Local geometry converts visual selections into bounded straight-line movements, depth-based checks halt blocked segments, and measured execution feedback guides subsequent decisions. This closed loop sustains search without persistent spatial maps or task-specific training. SimpleUAV achieves 41.61% Success Rate (SR) on UAV-ON and 11.98% on AerialDojo-200K, compared with 23.80% and 3.20% for the strongest prior baselines, respectively. With limited benchmark-specific adaptation, the same core agent transfers to aerial Vision-and-Language Navigation (VLN) on TravelUAV, improving Full SR by at least 19.66% across all three splits under L1 assistance. These results establish a strong baseline for evaluating when additional architectural complexity benefits aerial search.

translation.title: 一个简单而有效的开放世界空中目标搜索智能体
translation.abstract: 开放世界空中目标搜索方法通常依赖持久空间地图、学习到的世界模型或任务特定的策略训练。为了探究一个极简的、无需训练的设计能走多远，我们提出了SimpleUAV，一个围绕冻结的现成视觉语言模型（VLM）构建的智能体。SimpleUAV将当前视角的目标评估与基于历史的动作选择分离，将新鲜的候选证据与轻量级搜索上下文相结合。局部几何将视觉选择转换为有界的直线移动，基于深度的检查会停止被阻挡的片段，测得的执行反馈指导后续决策。这一闭环无需持久空间地图或任务特定训练即可维持搜索。SimpleUAV在UAV-ON上达到41.61%的成功率（SR），在AerialDojo-200K上达到11.98%，而此前最强基线分别为23.80%和3.20%。经过有限的基准特定适配，同一核心智能体可迁移到TravelUAV上的空中视觉语言导航（VLN），在L1辅助下所有三个划分上Full SR至少提升19.66%。这些结果为评估何时额外的架构复杂性有利于空中搜索建立了一个强基线。
translation.brief: 针对开放世界空中目标搜索问题，提出基于冻结VLM的免训练智能体SimpleUAV，通过目标评估与动作选择分离的闭环设计实现高效搜索。

papers.title: Unstable Action Boundaries in Lethal Drone Agents
papers.abstract: Tool-using large language model (LLM) agents raise safety risks that are not captured by text-only refusal behavior, especially when tools can trigger high-impact actions. This concern is salient in military settings, where autonomous weapons raise the possibility of delegating force decisions to software agents. In this work, we study whether a drone agent's action boundary is stable under changes to the target descriptor. We evaluate recent and popular LLMs in a simulated perception-action pipeline over real-world drone imagery, where models can localize requested targets and invoke a simulated lethal tool. We find two concerning failure modes. First, some LLM agents invoke the lethal tool for ordinary generic descriptors such as \emph{people}, requiring no jailbreak at all. Second, an agent that initially appears conservative under protected descriptors can become unsafe under a simple semantic target shift.

translation.title: 致命无人机智能体中不稳定的动作边界
translation.abstract: 使用工具的大语言模型（LLM）智能体带来了仅靠文本拒绝行为无法覆盖的安全风险，尤其是当工具可以触发高影响动作时。这一担忧在军事环境中尤为突出，自主武器使得将武力决策委托给软件智能体成为可能。在本工作中，我们研究无人机智能体的动作边界在目标描述变化下是否稳定。我们在基于真实世界无人机图像的模拟感知-动作流水线中评估了近期流行的 LLM，模型可以定位请求的目标并调用模拟的致命工具。我们发现了两种令人担忧的失败模式。第一，某些 LLM 智能体会对诸如“人”这类普通通用描述直接调用致命工具，完全无需越狱。第二，在受保护描述下起初显得保守的智能体，在简单的语义目标偏移下可能变得不安全。
translation.brief: 研究无人机 LLM 智能体的致命动作边界是否随目标描述变化而失稳，通过在真实无人机图像的模拟感知-动作流水线中测试主流 LLM 来揭示其安全失败模式。

papers.title: Out of Sight, Not Out of Clues: Can Video LLMs Guess from Partial Evidence?
papers.abstract: In real-world applications like egocentric recording, visual accessibility, and surveillance review, visual evidence for Video Large Language Models (Video LLMs) is often only partially captured. A reliable model should match its response to the evidence: answering when sufficient, guessing from visible clues when partial, and abstaining when absent. Yet existing benchmarks enforce a binary answerable-or-unanswerable split, leaving partial evidence unmeasured and obscuring whether failures arise from missing evidence or misjudging sufficiency. We introduce ClueProbe, a diagnostic benchmark to (1) separate perceiving evidence from judging sufficiency, and (2) validate our diagnosis via targeted fine-tuning. ClueProbe comprises 1,721 human-annotated questions across 598 natural videos, labeled Answerable, Guessable, or Unanswerable, alongside controlled perturbations altering wording or visual input. Evaluating 10 open-source and proprietary Video LLMs reveals that failures stem from judgment rather than perception: models perceive the evidence yet lack graded sufficiency awareness, answering or refusing outright while rarely guessing from partial clues. Targeted fine-tuning shows that this reflects missing supervision rather than insufficient capacity: supervising the guess level lifts appropriate guessing from 1.6% to 40.4% without extra false refusals, whereas conventional refusal tuning rejects 92% of guessable questions. Data and code will be released at this https URL.

translation.title: 看不见不等于没有线索：Video LLM 能否从部分证据中推测？
translation.abstract: 在自我中心录制、视觉辅助和监控审查等真实应用中，Video LLM 所能获得的视觉证据往往只是部分被捕获。一个可靠的模型应使其回答与证据相匹配：证据充分时作答，证据部分可见时从可见线索中推测，证据缺失时弃答。然而现有基准强制采用可回答或不可回答的二元划分，未度量部分证据情形，也掩盖了失败究竟源于证据缺失还是误判充分性。我们提出 ClueProbe，一个诊断性基准，用于（1）将感知证据与判断充分性分离，（2）通过针对性微调验证我们的诊断。ClueProbe 包含 598 个自然视频上的 1,721 个人工标注问题，标签为可回答、可推测或不可回答，并配有改变措辞或视觉输入的受控扰动。对 10 个开源和专有 Video LLM 的评估表明，失败源于判断而非感知：模型能感知证据，却缺乏分级的充分性意识，要么直接作答要么直接拒绝，很少从部分线索中推测。针对性微调表明这反映的是监督缺失而非能力不足：对推测层级进行监督可将恰当推测率从 1.6% 提升至 40.4% 且不增加错误拒绝，而常规拒绝微调会拒绝 92% 的可推测问题。数据与代码将在本 https URL 发布。
translation.brief: 针对 Video LLM 无法区分证据充分、部分可见与缺失的问题，提出带可回答/可推测/不可回答三级标注的诊断基准 ClueProbe，并通过针对性微调验证失败源于判断而非感知。

papers.title: Agent-as-a-Verifier: From Scores to Evidence for General Verification
papers.abstract: Verification is increasingly critical across various inference and learning paradigms, such as test-time scaling, recursive intelligence and automated research, where feedback can improve efficiency and optimization. Common score-based verifiers, or discriminative reward models, predict a scalar reward for an output. While useful for filtering, rewarding, and ranking, such scores provide no explicit, auditable evidentiary basis for the judgment. In parallel, although existing generative process reward models offer text feedback, most designs do not fully exploit agentic capabilities, such as tool use and iterative reasoning, which are essential for fact-checking and fine-grained claim verification. In this paper, we address these limitations by introducing Agent-as-a-Verifier, an agentic, certificate-producing verification system that places role-separated LLM agents inside a formal-methods-inspired claim-obligation-certificate protocol. Given a generation candidate, Agent-as-a-Verifier produces a certificate by extracting a verdict-blind dependency graph of claims, independently compiling the task's acceptance contract, and deriving checkable obligations. On Terminal-Bench 2.1, Agent-as-a-Verifier achieves higher accuracy than the state-of-the-art approach. Across different downstream applications, the augmented agent also outperforms the plain agent on FrontierMath and CyberGym. More importantly, Agent-as-a-Verifier is able to identify reward-hacking solutions that deceive the benchmark evaluator, highlighting its broader potential for iterative and recursive agent optimization. Code is available at this https URL

translation.title: Agent-as-a-Verifier：从分数到证据的通用验证
translation.abstract: 验证在测试时扩展、递归智能体和自动化研究等多种推理与学习范式中日益关键，在这些范式中反馈可以提升效率与优化效果。常见的基于分数的验证器（即判别式奖励模型）为输出预测一个标量奖励。虽然可用于过滤、奖励和排序，这类分数无法为判断提供显式、可审计的证据基础。与此同时，尽管现有生成式过程奖励模型能提供文本反馈，但大多数设计并未充分利用智能体能力，如工具使用和迭代推理，而这些能力对事实核查和细粒度声明验证至关重要。本文通过提出 Agent-as-a-Verifier 来解决这些局限，这是一个产出证书的智能体验证系统，将角色分离的 LLM 智能体置于受形式化方法启发的声明-义务-证书协议之中。给定一个生成候选，Agent-as-a-Verifier 通过提取与判定无关的声明依赖图、独立编译任务的验收契约并推导可检验的义务来生成证书。在 Terminal-Bench 2.1 上，Agent-as-a-Verifier 取得了高于最先进方法的准确率。在不同下游应用中，增强后的智能体在 FrontierMath 和 CyberGym 上也优于普通智能体。更重要的是，Agent-as-a-Verifier 能够识别欺骗基准评估器的奖励作弊解，凸显了其在迭代与递归智能体优化方面更广泛的潜力。代码见本 https URL。
translation.brief: 针对基于分数的验证器缺乏可审计证据基础的问题，提出 Agent-as-a-Verifier，用角色分离的 LLM 智能体在声明-义务-证书协议中生成可检验的验证证书。

papers.title: Reproducer Synthesis for AI-Reported Bugs in the Linux Kernel
papers.abstract: Agentic review systems are increasingly flagging suspected bugs in Linux kernel patches as textual reports. A maintainer who receives such reports needs further inspection to determine whether the report is true. The inspection requires understanding whether the bug can be triggered and, if necessary, manually constructing one. As a consequence, despite the excessive textual explanation, many reports go unanswered. In this paper, we argue that a runnable proof-of-concept (PoC) is the key information in such AI-generated kernel review reports. It is, however, challenging to automatically synthesize a valid and runnable PoC. We present ReproCue, a framework that generates PoCs for AI-generated Linux kernel reviews. ReproCue replays the historical kernel bugs and learns one reproduction finite-state-machine (FSM) per subsystem from successful runs. An FSM records the steps a reproduction goes through, together with the requirements observed at each step. Given a new review, ReproCue follows the FSM of that subsystem, adjusting the PoC and the environment as execution shows what is missing. In 100 recent AI-generated reviews, ReproCue writes PoCs for 49 of them, compared with 10 for the current agentic reproducer and 9 for the state-of-the-art directed fuzzing. Excitingly, with our generated PoCs, Linux kernel maintainers confirmed 69.4% of them, much higher than 9.3% from Sashiko where only textual explanations are included, making AI reviews more actionable in practice.

translation.title: Linux 内核中 AI 报告缺陷的复现器合成
translation.abstract: 智能体审查系统正越来越多地以文本报告的形式标记 Linux 内核补丁中的疑似缺陷。收到此类报告的维护者需要进一步检查以确定报告是否属实。检查需要理解缺陷能否被触发，必要时还需手动构造触发方式。因此，尽管有冗长的文本解释，许多报告仍无人回应。本文认为，可运行的概念验证（PoC）是此类 AI 生成的内核审查报告中的关键信息。然而，自动合成有效且可运行的 PoC 颇具挑战。我们提出 ReproCue，一个为 AI 生成的 Linux 内核审查报告生成 PoC 的框架。ReproCue 重放历史内核缺陷，并从成功运行中为每个子系统学习一个复现有限状态机（FSM）。FSM 记录复现所经历的步骤以及每一步观察到的前置条件。面对新的审查报告，ReproCue 沿用该子系统的 FSM，并根据执行反馈调整 PoC 和环境以补齐缺失条件。在 100 份近期的 AI 生成审查报告中，ReproCue 为其中 49 份写出了 PoC，而现有智能体复现器为 10 份，最先进的定向模糊测试为 9 份。令人振奋的是，借助我们生成的 PoC，Linux 内核维护者确认了其中 69.4%，远高于仅含文本解释的 Sashiko 的 9.3%，使 AI 审查在实践中更具可操作性。
translation.brief: 针对 AI 生成的 Linux 内核缺陷报告缺乏可运行 PoC 的问题，提出 ReproCue，通过从历史缺陷重放中学习各子系统的复现有限状态机来引导 PoC 的自动合成。

papers.title: Letting Models Manage Their Own Context: Where We Stand
papers.abstract: Agent harnesses today manage context on the model's behalf: when the window fills, the harness triggers a compaction that summarizes the history. We study the alternative, \emph{model-driven} context management, in which the model itself decides when and what to compact through a context API. We gave models control over their own context in \nooa, NVIDIA's open source agent harness, and compared the two strategies on document research and machine learning engineering across context budgets from 8K to 512K tokens. Models that use the context API effectively reach higher accuracy, often with fewer input tokens, especially at tight budgets: \textbf{GPT 6.1 nearly triples its score at a 32K budget} on OfficeQA Pro v2 (21\%~$\rightarrow$~56\%), and \textbf{Kimi gains with up to 41\% fewer input tokens}. Models differ widely, however, in how often they use the API, how aggressively they compact, and when they start compacting, and prompt changes shift that timing. Finally, we show that \textbf{inference engines can make model-driven edits cheaper}: by reusing the KV cache of the unchanged suffix after an edit, \textbf{we cut prefill compute by up to 15\% per request with no measurable change in accuracy}. Together, these results point to a new co-design frontier: models trained to manage their own context, served by inference engines that support KV cache editing.

translation.title: 让模型管理自己的上下文：现状综述
translation.abstract: 如今的智能体框架（harness）代替模型管理上下文：当窗口填满时，框架触发压缩以总结历史。我们研究了另一种方案——模型驱动的上下文管理，即模型自身通过上下文 API 决定何时压缩以及压缩什么。我们在 NVIDIA 的开源智能体框架 nooa 中让模型掌控自己的上下文，并在 8K 到 512K token 的上下文预算下，在文档研究和机器学习工程任务上比较了两种策略。有效使用上下文 API 的模型能达到更高准确率，且往往输入 token 更少，尤其在紧张预算下：在 OfficeQA Pro v2 上，GPT 6.1 在 32K 预算下的得分几乎提升三倍（21% → 56%），Kimi 在输入 token 减少多达 41% 的情况下仍有提升。然而，各模型在使用 API 的频率、压缩的激进程度和开始压缩的时机上差异很大，且提示词的改变会改变这一时机。最后，我们表明推理引擎可以让模型驱动的编辑更廉价：通过在编辑后复用未变后缀的 KV 缓存，我们将每次请求的 prefill 计算最多削减 15%，且准确率无可测变化。这些结果共同指向一个新的协同设计前沿：训练模型管理自己的上下文，并由支持 KV 缓存编辑的推理引擎提供服务。
translation.brief: 研究让模型通过上下文 API 自主决定压缩时机与内容的模型驱动上下文管理，并与框架代管方案在多预算下对比，同时提出复用 KV 缓存以降低编辑后 prefill 开销。

papers.title: Lost in the Grid: Where Multimodal LLMs Fail Between Seeing and Planning
papers.abstract: Multimodal large language models (MLLMs) excel at static visual understanding and are increasingly applied to spatial planning, where a model interprets a visual layout and outputs an action sequence to reach a goal. Grid games are a common testbed for this ability because their rules are explicit and a solver can verify every move. Yet existing benchmarks mostly report end-to-end success rates, which hide whether a failure stems from visual perception, rule application, or multi-step planning. We introduce GridProbe, a diagnostic benchmark that 1) locates the failing stage between visual perception and planning and 2) verifies the diagnosis by targeted fine-tuning. On Sokoban, GridProbe pairs end-to-end solving with four probes (recognition, localization, single-step prediction, and state tracking) and gives every board both as an image and as an equivalent text grid. Evaluating seven MLLMs on Sokoban and a maze game reveals distinct bottlenecks behind similar success rates: proprietary models are limited by multi-step planning, whereas open-source models are limited by rule application or by visual grid indexing, i.e., counting rows and columns. Planning failures also hide perception failures: when planning is easier, the visual cost of the same model grows from 7.6 to 37.7 points. The diagnosis identifies what to train: fine-tuning only the vision module of the perception-limited model on board reading raises its interactive Sokoban success 3.5-fold (5.8% to 20.4%) and transfers zero-shot to the unseen maze game (single-turn success 13.8% to 67.1%), whereas the same data does not help a rule-limited model and training on solver solutions brings no gain. We will release the benchmark and code at this https URL.

translation.title: 迷失在网格中：多模态大语言模型在感知与规划之间的失败点
translation.abstract: 多模态大语言模型（MLLM）在静态视觉理解方面表现出色，并越来越多地被应用于空间规划任务，即模型解读视觉布局并输出到达目标的动作序列。网格游戏是测试这种能力的常用平台，因为其规则明确且求解器可以验证每一步。然而现有基准大多只报告端到端成功率，掩盖了失败究竟源于视觉感知、规则应用还是多步规划。我们提出 GridProbe，一个诊断性基准，它 1）定位视觉感知与规划之间失败的阶段，2）通过针对性微调验证诊断。在推箱子（Sokoban）上，GridProbe 将端到端求解与四个探针（识别、定位、单步预测和状态跟踪）配对，并将每个棋盘同时以图像和等价文本网格的形式给出。在 Sokoban 和一个迷宫游戏上评估七个 MLLM，揭示了相似成功率背后不同的瓶颈：专有模型受限于多步规划，而开源模型受限于规则应用或视觉网格索引（即数行列）。规划失败也会掩盖感知失败：当规划更容易时，同一模型的视觉代价从 7.6 分增长到 37.7 分。诊断指出了应该训练什么：仅对感知受限模型的视觉模块在棋盘读取上进行微调，使其交互式 Sokoban 成功率提升 3.5 倍（5.8% 到 20.4%），并零样本迁移到未见过的迷宫游戏（单轮成功率 13.8% 到 67.1%），而同样的数据对规则受限模型没有帮助，在求解器解上训练也没有收益。我们将在该 https URL 发布基准和代码。
translation.brief: 针对多模态大模型在网格规划任务中失败原因难以定位的问题，提出 GridProbe 诊断基准，通过分阶段探针和针对性微调来定位并验证感知、规则应用或规划层面的瓶颈。

papers.title: Strategic and Robust Task Allocation for Combat Objectives in Adversarial Multi-Agent Environments
papers.abstract: Task allocation in contested-objective team games requires coordinated decisions under uncertainty, spatial constraints, and changing tactical conditions. In such settings, multiple agents must anticipate both teammate behavior and opponent actions. We study a hybrid predict-then-optimize approach for assigning controllable agents to objectives in real time. A masked multi-head model predicts tactical signals for each agent, including survival chance, local superiority, combat interaction, travel time, and objective contribution. These signals are combined with rule-based terms in a score matrix, and a minimum-cost flow solver computes coordinated global assignments constrained by capacity, occupancy, stability, and defensive strategies. Learning is limited to tactical scoring, while explicit rules and solver structure preserve controllability and interpretability. We evaluate the system using predictive metrics, offline assignment diagnostics, online A/B evaluation, and latency measurements. The system is an R\&D research prototype built on a commercial game and is not deployed in the shipped game. The results indicate that learned tactical estimates can support stable, feasible, and inspectable objective allocation under strict real-time constraints.

translation.title: 对抗性多智能体环境中面向战斗目标的策略性鲁棒任务分配
translation.abstract: 在争夺目标的团队游戏中，任务分配需要在不确定性、空间约束和不断变化的战术条件下进行协调决策。在这类场景中，多个智能体必须同时预判队友行为和对手动作。我们研究了一种混合的先预测后优化方法，用于实时将可控智能体分配到目标上。一个掩码多头模型为每个智能体预测战术信号，包括生存概率、局部优势、战斗交互、行进时间和目标贡献。这些信号与基于规则的项结合成评分矩阵，并由最小费用流求解器在容量、占据、稳定性和防御策略约束下计算协调的全局分配。学习仅限于战术评分，而显式规则和求解器结构保持了可控性和可解释性。我们通过预测指标、离线分配诊断、在线 A/B 评估和延迟测量来评估该系统。该系统是构建在商业游戏上的研发原型，并未部署到发行的游戏中。结果表明，学习到的战术估计可以在严格的实时约束下支持稳定、可行且可审查的目标分配。
translation.brief: 针对对抗性多智能体游戏中实时任务分配问题，采用先预测后优化的混合方法：用掩码多头模型预测战术信号，再用最小费用流求解器计算全局协调分配。

papers.title: Interacting with Alexa: A Longitudinal Case Study of Voice Assistant Use in Down Syndrome
papers.abstract: As life expectancy for individuals with Down syndrome (DS) continues to increase, supporting cog- nitive engagement, everyday autonomy, and participation throughout adulthood has become an important research priority. Conversational voice assistants have emerged as promising assistive tech- nologies for these purposes, yet evidence regarding their long-term use in naturalistic settings remains limited. This paper presents a longitudinal case study of the everyday use of Amazon Alexa by an adult with Down syndrome over nine months in a real domestic environment. The study combines analyses of interaction logs, audio recordings, and qualitative observations to investigate usage pat- terns, interaction performance, communicative adaptation, and the integration of the voice assistant into everyday life. Results show that Alexa became progressively embedded in daily routines, sup- porting entertainment, information access, and autonomy-related activities. Longitudinal analyses reveal stable interaction patterns, reduced retry behavior, and the emergence of effective communi- cation strategies, while qualitative observations highlight increasing communicative engagement and the value of proactive reminders. The study also identifies important limitations of current commer- cial voice assistants, including reduced robustness to non-normative speech, limited conversational continuity, and poor contextual reasoning. Beyond providing rare ecologically valid evidence of long- term voice assistant use, the findings highlight design considerations that are relevant to the ongoing evolution of LLM-based conversational systems.

translation.title: 与 Alexa 交互：唐氏综合征人群使用语音助手的纵向案例研究
translation.abstract: 随着唐氏综合征（DS）人群预期寿命的持续增长，支持其整个成年期的认知参与、日常自主性和社会参与已成为重要的研究优先事项。会话式语音助手已成为实现这些目标的有前景的辅助技术，但关于其在自然环境中长期使用的证据仍然有限。本文呈现了一项纵向案例研究，考察一位患有唐氏综合征的成年人在真实家庭环境中九个月内对 Amazon Alexa 的日常使用。该研究结合交互日志、音频录音和定性观察的分析，考察使用模式、交互表现、沟通适应以及语音助手融入日常生活的情况。结果表明，Alexa 逐渐融入日常事务，支持娱乐、信息获取和与自主性相关的活动。纵向分析揭示了稳定的交互模式、重试行为的减少以及有效沟通策略的出现，而定性观察则突出了沟通参与度的提升和主动提醒的价值。研究还指出了当前商业语音助手的重要局限，包括对非规范语音的鲁棒性较低、会话连续性有限以及上下文推理能力差。除了提供罕见的长期语音助手使用的生态效度证据外，这些发现还突出了与基于 LLM 的会话系统持续演进相关的设计考量。
translation.brief: 针对语音助手在唐氏综合征人群中长期使用证据缺乏的问题，通过九个月的真实家庭纵向案例研究，结合日志、录音和定性观察考察其使用模式、适应过程与局限。

papers.title: CoordRoute: Coordinated Multi-Model Routing for Maximum Compute-Budget Utility
papers.abstract: Model routing sends each request to one of several large language models (LLMs) of different sizes. In practice, requests share a fixed compute budget: a spending cap on rented model APIs or the capacity of a private GPU cluster. Most existing routers do not account for the total budget: each decides a request on its own, so per-request optima are not optimal overall. We advocate coordinated routing, which allocates the budget across requests to maximize its utility, their total satisfaction, along a predict-plan-rectify route: predict what each model would give and cost, plan the choice against later requests, and rectify it during generation. Each step faces a challenge: a request's gain from each model is uncertain before generation, later arrivals are unknown when a request must start, and observing answers during generation consumes the budget itself. CoordRoute addresses them with relative demand prediction, which compares candidate models through past requests that lead to the same routing choices; a lookahead solver, which charges each choice for what its compute could earn for later requests; and budget-aware runtime correction, which drops or upgrades in-flight requests at the same price, inspecting answers only when it pays off. On Azure Conversation and BurstGPT traces, CoordRoute improves total satisfaction by 18.72% over the strongest existing router.

translation.title: CoordRoute：面向最大计算预算效用的协调式多模型路由
translation.abstract: 模型路由将每个请求发送到多个不同规模的大语言模型（LLM）之一。在实践中，请求共享固定的计算预算：租用模型 API 的支出上限或私有 GPU 集群的容量。大多数现有路由器不考虑总预算：每个请求独立决策，因此单请求最优并不等于整体最优。我们倡导协调式路由，即在请求之间分配预算以最大化其效用（即总满意度），遵循预测-规划-纠正的路径：预测每个模型会给出什么结果和成本，结合后续请求规划选择，并在生成过程中进行纠正。每一步都面临挑战：请求从每个模型获得的收益在生成前是不确定的，当请求必须开始时后续到达是未知的，且在生成期间观察答案本身会消耗预算。CoordRoute 通过以下方式解决这些问题：相对需求预测，通过导致相同路由选择的历史请求来比较候选模型；前瞻求解器，为每个选择收取其计算本可为后续请求带来的收益；预算感知的运行时纠正，以相同价格丢弃或升级进行中的请求，只在划算时才检查答案。在 Azure Conversation 和 BurstGPT 轨迹上，CoordRoute 比最强的现有路由器将总满意度提高了 18.72%。
translation.brief: 针对多模型路由中各请求独立决策导致总预算利用不佳的问题，提出 CoordRoute 协调式路由，通过相对需求预测、前瞻求解器和预算感知的运行时纠正来最大化预算总效用。

papers.title: Modality-Shift Contrastive Decoding for Temporally Grounded Audio-Visual Understanding
papers.abstract: Audio-visual large language models (AV-LLMs) are designed to represent the temporal structure of audio and video, yet it remains unclear how effectively they use this temporal information to relate sounds to visual events. To examine this, we probe an AV-LLM on an audio-visual synchronization task by shifting the audio so that the queried sound overlaps a different visual event. We observe that the model still favors the originally aligned event over the newly aligned one, indicating limited sensitivity to changes in audio-visual temporal alignment. To address this, we propose Modality-Shift Contrastive Decoding (MSCD), a training-free decoding method that emphasizes audio-visual temporal alignment in model predictions. MSCD contrasts logits under preserved and disrupted temporal alignment to favor predictions supported by aligned audio and video. We disrupt this alignment by temporally shifting either the audio or the video, while keeping the other modality fixed. Extensive evaluations with two AV-LLMs across three benchmarks demonstrate the effectiveness of MSCD for temporally grounded audio-visual understanding. In particular, MSCD improves accuracy over the base models on Daily-Omni by 2.2 and 2.8 percentage points for OmniVinci and video-SALMONN 2+, respectively, suggesting that emphasizing temporal alignment can also benefit broader audio-visual understanding.

translation.title: 面向时序对齐的音视频理解的模态偏移对比解码
translation.abstract: 音视频大语言模型（AV-LLM）旨在表示音频和视频的时序结构，但它们如何有效地利用这些时序信息将声音与视觉事件关联起来仍不清楚。为考察这一点，我们在音视频同步任务上探测 AV-LLM，通过移动音频使被查询的声音与不同的视觉事件重叠。我们观察到模型仍然偏好原本对齐的事件而非新对齐的事件，表明其对音视频时序对齐变化的敏感性有限。为解决这一问题，我们提出模态偏移对比解码（MSCD），一种无需训练的解码方法，在模型预测中强调音视频时序对齐。MSCD 对比时序对齐保持和被破坏情况下的 logits，以偏向由对齐的音频和视频支持的预测。我们通过在时间上移动音频或视频（同时保持另一模态固定）来破坏这种对齐。在两个 AV-LLM 和三个基准上的大量评估证明了 MSCD 在时序对齐的音视频理解方面的有效性。特别是，MSCD 在 Daily-Omni 上分别使 OmniVinci 和 video-SALMONN 2+ 的准确率比基础模型提高 2.2 和 2.8 个百分点，表明强调时序对齐也能惠及更广泛的音视频理解。
translation.brief: 针对 AV-LLM 对音视频时序对齐变化不敏感的问题，提出无需训练的模态偏移对比解码（MSCD），通过对比对齐保持与破坏时的 logits 来强化时序对齐的预测。

papers.title: Agentic-Level Adversarial Purification: Revisiting Diffusion Purifiers on Native-Resolution Agentic Inputs
papers.abstract: Vision-language agents act on native-resolution renders of multi-element pages, where one perturbed photo or a few altered text strokes can redirect the decision. Any content provider can craft such a perturbation on the open model behind the agent, so a plug-in purifier is the natural first line of defense. Yet diffusion purifiers were designed and evaluated at the fixed resolution of the diffusion model on classifier or natural-image benchmarks, and defense evaluations for agents test JPEG, blur and noise but no diffusion purifier. We present the first study of adversarial purification at the agentic level, for an agent built on Qwen3-VL-8B: purifiers run at native resolution on multi-element inputs, face grey-box attackers who know the agent's model but not the defense, and are compared at matched clean cost. We show that treating agentic inputs as classifier inputs misleads both evaluation and design. Resizing the input to the resolution of the diffusion model, as existing purifiers do, raises the TextVQA clean cost of the Divide-and-Conquer purifier (DC) from 4.0 to 35.7 points. On web-shop pages, DC keeps 85.0% grey-box robust accuracy against web-hardened perturbations, where cheap input transformations at matched clean cost keep at most 40.0%, and this robustness comes from the global noise level: input-estimated masks and noise levels add none. These findings hold on a disjoint held-out set and on a second VLM and yield three requirements for defenses, we release the protocol.

translation.title: 智能体级对抗净化：在原生分辨率智能体输入上重新审视扩散净化器
translation.abstract: 视觉-语言智能体作用于多元素页面的原生分辨率渲染图像，其中一张被扰动的照片或几处被篡改的文字笔画就可能改变决策。任何内容提供者都可以在智能体背后的开放模型上构造此类扰动，因此即插即用的净化器是天然的第一道防线。然而，扩散净化器是在扩散模型的固定分辨率下、针对分类器或自然图像基准进行设计和评估的，而针对智能体的防御评估只测试了JPEG、模糊和噪声，未涉及扩散净化器。我们首次在智能体层面研究对抗净化，针对基于Qwen3-VL-8B构建的智能体：净化器在多元素输入上以原生分辨率运行，面对知晓智能体模型但不知防御方案的灰盒攻击者，并在匹配的干净成本下进行比较。我们表明，将智能体输入当作分类器输入会同时误导评估和设计。像现有净化器那样将输入缩放到扩散模型的分辨率，会使Divide-and-Conquer净化器（DC）的TextVQA干净成本从4.0点升至35.7点。在web-shop页面上，DC对网页加固扰动的灰盒鲁棒准确率保持在85.0%，而匹配干净成本下的廉价输入变换最多只能达到40.0%，且这种鲁棒性来自全局噪声水平：输入估计的掩码和噪声水平没有带来任何提升。这些发现在一个不相交的留出集和第二个VLM上依然成立，并由此得出防御的三项要求，我们发布了该评估协议。
translation.brief: 针对视觉-语言智能体输入的对抗扰动防御问题，首次在原生分辨率多元素输入上系统评估扩散净化器，并揭示按分类器方式评估会误导设计与结论。

papers.title: MINE: A Training-Free Defense against Indirect Prompt Injection via Mutual Information and Embedding Variance
papers.abstract: Existing defenses against indirect prompt injection in retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) are inherently reactive: prompt-engineering methods are often overridden by the injected instructions, while supervised detectors must be retrained for each new attack style. We propose a different paradigm: defend by maximizing relevance, not by detecting attacks. Our method, MINE, is training-free and attack-agnostic, and it also serves as a query-conditioned reranker. To evaluate defenses under realistic conditions, we introduce LC-Inj-SQuAD, a long-context benchmark with an average of 4,032 words per context. We evaluate on four datasets spanning short-context QA (Inj-SQuAD, Inj-TriviaQA), long-context QA (LC-Inj-SQuAD), and agent tool-call injection (InjecAgent). Across all four, MINE achieves the best accuracy--security trade-off among training-free defenses. It is also the only defense that stays usable against a fully adaptive attacker, generalizes to agent tool-call injection, and achieves the lowest inference latency on long contexts.

translation.title: MINE：基于互信息和嵌入方差的免训练间接提示注入防御
translation.abstract: 现有针对检索增强生成（RAG）中间接提示注入的防御本质上是被动式的：提示工程方法常被注入的指令覆盖，而监督式检测器必须针对每种新攻击风格重新训练。我们提出一种不同的范式：通过最大化相关性来防御，而非检测攻击。我们的方法MINE免训练且与攻击无关，同时还可作为查询条件重排序器。为在现实条件下评估防御，我们引入LC-Inj-SQuAD，一个平均每条上下文4,032词的长上下文基准。我们在四个数据集上评估，涵盖短上下文问答（Inj-SQuAD、Inj-TriviaQA）、长上下文问答（LC-Inj-SQuAD）和智能体工具调用注入（InjecAgent）。在全部四个数据集上，MINE在免训练防御中取得最佳的准确率-安全性权衡。它也是唯一在面对完全自适应攻击者时仍保持可用的防御，可泛化到智能体工具调用注入，并在长上下文上实现最低推理延迟。
translation.brief: 针对RAG中间接提示注入防御需重训练且易被绕过的问题，提出免训练、攻击无关的MINE方法，通过基于互信息和嵌入方差最大化查询与内容相关性来防御注入。

papers.title: SOLO: Towards Sample-Faithful and Detectable LLM Watermarking under Repeated Sampling via Content-Anchored Single-Owner Contexts
papers.abstract: Providers watermark the outputs of large language models, while applications sample many responses per prompt for self-consistency, best-of-n selection, and uncertainty estimation. We show that deployed configurations of distortion-free watermarks, which deduplicate keyed contexts only within a response, couple the responses of a request: answer templates make all responses query the watermark with the same context before the answer, so collisions across responses, usually assumed rare, become the norm. Key pools reduce or avoid the coupling at the cost of multiple testing, and the exact remedy of a context history shared across the request leaves many positions unwatermarked. We propose SOLO, which keeps a request-scoped context history but anchors its keyed contexts on content selected by min-hash, so that siblings rarely compete for a context and random edits stay local. Its responses are jointly distributed as independent unwatermarked responses, each detectable with a single key. On five language models from three families and three benchmarks, SOLO preserves self-consistency and uncertainty estimation and, at a 1% false positive rate, detects more responses than four-token key pools on most tasks, also after randomly editing 10% of the tokens, and more than the context history on most clean tasks. Code is available at this https URL.

translation.title: SOLO：通过内容锚定的单一所有者上下文实现重复采样下样本忠实且可检测的LLM水印
translation.abstract: 提供商为大语言模型的输出添加水印，而应用会对每个提示采样多个响应以进行自一致性、best-of-n选择和不确定性估计。我们表明，已部署的无失真水印配置（仅在单个响应内对带密钥上下文去重）会将同一请求的多个响应耦合起来：答案模板使所有响应在给出答案前以相同上下文查询水印，因此通常被认为罕见的跨响应碰撞成为常态。密钥池以多重检验为代价减少或避免耦合，而在请求内共享上下文历史这一精确补救方案会使许多位置无法加水印。我们提出SOLO，它保留请求范围的上下文历史，但将其带密钥上下文锚定在由min-hash选择的内容上，使兄弟响应很少竞争同一上下文，且随机编辑保持局部性。其响应的联合分布等同于独立的未加水印响应，每个响应都可用单一密钥检测。在来自三个系列的五个语言模型和三个基准上，SOLO保持了自一致性和不确定性估计，并在1%假阳性率下，在大多数任务上比四token密钥池检测到更多响应（即使在随机编辑10%的token之后），在大多数干净任务上也多于上下文历史方案。代码见此https URL。
translation.brief: 针对重复采样导致无失真水印跨响应碰撞、检测失效的问题，提出SOLO，用min-hash内容锚定的请求级单一所有者上下文历史使各响应独立可检测。

papers.title: Compute-Aware Submodular Online Learning in Open Multi-Agent Systems
papers.abstract: This paper studies policy learning for cooperative task allocation in open multi-agent systems, where submodular utilities model diminishing marginal returns due to overlapping agent contributions. While standard methods evaluate every candidate action to update the policy, this may incur an excessive computational cost online. Hence, we impose a budget on these evaluations and analytically study the effect of query budget on online learning. Our algorithm samples a prescribed number of agent-action pairs and applies inverse-probability weighting to their marginal gains, yielding an unbiased gradient estimate of the expected stage utility for a Kullback-Leibler (KL) mirror-ascent update. We derive a $1/2$-approximate regret bound that elegantly splits into a tracking error between optimal and learned policies, quantified by their KL divergence, and a query-dependent feedback term. Experiments on cooperative information coverage show that our approach retains high performance with significantly less computation online.

translation.title: 开放多智能体系统中的计算感知次模在线学习
translation.abstract: 本文研究开放多智能体系统中协作任务分配的策略学习，其中次模效用刻画了智能体贡献重叠导致的边际收益递减。标准方法会评估每个候选动作以更新策略，这在线上可能带来过高的计算成本。因此，我们对这些评估施加预算，并解析地研究查询预算对在线学习的影响。我们的算法采样规定数量的智能体-动作对，并对其边际增益应用逆概率加权，得到期望阶段效用的无偏梯度估计，用于Kullback-Leibler（KL）镜像上升更新。我们推导出1/2近似遗憾界，该界优雅地分解为最优策略与学习策略之间由KL散度量化的跟踪误差，以及一个依赖查询的反馈项。在协作信息覆盖实验中，我们的方法在显著减少在线计算的情况下仍保持高性能。
translation.brief: 针对开放多智能体系统中次模任务分配在线评估计算开销过大的问题，提出带查询预算的采样加逆概率加权算法，以无偏梯度估计实现KL镜像上升并给出1/2近似遗憾界。

papers.title: PROVE: Mitigating Long-Horizon LLM Collusion with Reinforcement Learning from Verified Evidence
papers.abstract: When LLM agents verify each other's work over a long interaction, they drift into collusion: they come to accept work without the evidence that the verification protocol requires. Collusion is absent at the start and builds up episode by episode, which we trace to accurate feedback accumulating in memory. An agent that follows the rule is told that its verdict was wrong whenever its peer was right, so breaking the rule is the reward-maximizing choice, and agents talk themselves into it in their private reflections. Existing mitigations leave the agents unchanged; we train the behavior out. PROVE (Protocol Reinforcement from Verified Evidence) is a multi-agent reinforcement learning method that rewards verdicts by the evidence behind them rather than by their outcome, and credits every call an agent makes, including the calls that solve its own task, with the outcome that call controls. On Qwen3.6-27B, a LoRA adapter trained on six-episode interactions takes the collusion rate on held-out task sequences at the original ten-episode horizon from 65.0% to 1.0%, with no detectable change in task success. Collusion that converged in every interaction now converges in none, and the gain holds four episodes beyond the longest interaction seen in training. The trained 27B model colludes less than every model evaluated in the original study, closed-weight frontier models included. Code is available at this https URL.

translation.title: PROVE：基于经验证证据的强化学习缓解长时程LLM合谋
translation.abstract: 当LLM智能体在长时程交互中相互验证工作时，它们会滑向合谋：开始在没有验证协议所需证据的情况下接受工作。合谋在初始时不存在，而是逐回合累积形成，我们将其追溯到记忆中不断累积的准确反馈。遵循规则的智能体在其同伴正确时被告知其判定有误，因此违反规则成为奖励最大化的选择，智能体在私人反思中说服自己这样做。现有缓解方法不改变智能体本身；我们则通过训练消除这种行为。PROVE（Protocol Reinforcement from Verified Evidence）是一种多智能体强化学习方法，它根据判定背后的证据而非判定结果给予奖励，并将智能体发出的每次调用（包括解决其自身任务的调用）与该调用所控制的结果关联记分。在Qwen3.6-27B上，基于六回合交互训练的LoRA适配器，将原始十回合时程下留出任务序列上的合谋率从65.0%降至1.0%，且任务成功率无可检测的变化。原本在每次交互中都收敛的合谋现在一次也不再收敛，且该增益在超出训练中最长交互四个回合后仍然保持。训练后的27B模型比原研究中评估的所有模型（包括闭源前沿模型）的合谋都更少。代码见此https URL。
translation.brief: 针对LLM智能体在长时程相互验证中逐渐合谋的问题，提出PROVE多智能体强化学习方法，以判定背后的证据而非结果作为奖励来训练消除合谋行为。

papers.title: OS-Omni: Benchmarking Generalist Computer-Using Agents on Long-Horizon Workflows Across Platforms
papers.abstract: Computer-using agents are increasingly expected to complete realistic user goals rather than isolated GUI actions. However, existing benchmarks typically isolate web, mobile, or desktop environments, leaving it unclear whether a single generalist agent can execute long-horizon workflows that span multiple operating systems and persistent application states. We introduce OS-Omni, a live cross-platform benchmark and execution environment for evaluating computer-using agents across Windows, Ubuntu, macOS, iOS, Android, and Web environments. OS-Omni is released in versioned waves of 300 tasks each; this paper focuses on the first release, v1, which contains 48 tasks per platform and 12 cross-platform workflows that pair a desktop with an Android phone. OS-Omni provides reproducible initialization, platform-specific adapters, trajectory logging, and executable final-state evaluators, and includes controlled service-backed applications for workflows involving account, cart, budget, calendar, message, and other persistent state. Human studies show that OS-Omni tasks require 67.54 interaction steps, substantially exceeding OSWorld references of 15.0 steps. On v1, the strongest evaluated agent, Claude Opus 5.5, reaches 68.5% average success, trailing the 77.3% human reference by 8.8 points; the gap is uneven across platforms, with frontier models exceeding humans on Linux but trailing them by more than 25 points on iOS and macOS. These results indicate that current agents remain far from platform-robust, long-horizon computer use, especially when success requires sustained state tracking and durable final-state changes.

translation.title: OS-Omni：跨平台长时程工作流上通用计算机使用智能体的基准测试
translation.abstract: 计算机使用智能体日益被期望完成真实的用户目标，而非孤立的 GUI 操作。然而，现有基准通常将网页、移动或桌面环境相互隔离，使得单一通用智能体能否执行跨越多个操作系统和持久应用状态的长时程工作流仍不清楚。我们提出 OS-Omni，一个用于评估计算机使用智能体的实时跨平台基准与执行环境，覆盖 Windows、Ubuntu、macOS、iOS、Android 和 Web 环境。OS-Omni 以每波 300 个任务的版本化方式发布；本文聚焦首次发布 v1，包含每平台 48 个任务和 12 个将桌面与 Android 手机配对的跨平台工作流。OS-Omni 提供可复现的初始化、平台专属适配器、轨迹日志和可执行的最终状态评估器，并包含受控的服务端应用，用于涉及账户、购物车、预算、日历、消息等持久状态的工作流。人类研究表明，OS-Omni 任务平均需要 67.54 次交互步骤，远超 OSWorld 参考的 15.0 步。在 v1 上，表现最强的被评估智能体 Claude Opus 5.5 达到 68.5% 的平均成功率，落后于 77.3% 的人类参考 8.8 个百分点；该差距在各平台间并不均衡，前沿模型在 Linux 上超过人类，但在 iOS 和 macOS 上落后超过 25 个百分点。这些结果表明，当前智能体距离平台鲁棒的长时程计算机使用仍然很远，尤其是当成功需要持续的状态跟踪和持久的最终状态变更时。
translation.brief: 针对现有基准无法评估跨操作系统长时程工作流的问题，构建了覆盖六大平台的实时跨平台基准 OS-Omni，通过可复现环境、持久状态服务和最终状态评估器来评测通用计算机使用智能体。

papers.title: VibeVideoAgent: Closing the Perceptual Loop for Code-Driven Video Generation
papers.abstract: Code-driven video generation asks a coding agent to write and run rendering programs. This gives exact control over typography, data visualizations, synchronized audio, and multi-shot scenes, and it leaves an editable project behind. A program that exits cleanly can still render overlapping labels, a camera aimed away from its subject, broken object interactions, or narration that drifts out of sync, and none of these raise a runtime error. Feeding rendered frames and audio back into the coding session bloats its long-horizon context, while critiquing only the finished full-resolution render turns early design mistakes into costly rewrites. We introduce VibeVideoAgent, a training-free framework that lets coding agents inspect their drafts throughout production. Multimodal perception runs in short-lived contexts kept apart from the coder and returns compact, grounded Findings. Seven primitives operate on a unified multi-clock representation of assets and drafts: they explore media from coarse to fine, verify quoted requirements with evidence from every required modality, compare a draft with a reference or an earlier revision on separate clocks, and measure stream signals locally. A lightweight staged protocol has the agent test its riskiest decision on a minimal preview first. On all 239 VibeVideoBench tasks, with matched agent runtimes and a fixed perception model, VibeVideoAgent improves holistic audiovisual quality (L3) for Claude Opus 5.5 (4.03 -> 4.43, while L2 rubric compliance rises from 98.87% to 99.35%), GPT-6 Astra (4.03 -> 4.27), and Claude Sonnet 5.5 (3.97 -> 4.10), with the largest gains in audio-visual synchronization (up to +0.56). Controlled ablations show that each component contributes, and trajectory audits show that the granularity of code edits governs the trade-off between rubric adherence and perceptual quality.

translation.title: VibeVideoAgent：为代码驱动的视频生成闭合感知回路
translation.abstract: 代码驱动的视频生成要求编码智能体编写并运行渲染程序。这可以对排版、数据可视化、同步音频和多镜头场景实现精确控制，并留下可编辑的项目。然而，一个正常退出的程序仍可能渲染出重叠的标签、偏离主体的镜头、损坏的物体交互或失去同步的旁白，而这些都不会引发运行时错误。将渲染的帧和音频反馈到编码会话中会使其长时程上下文膨胀，而仅对最终的全分辨率渲染进行批评，则会让早期设计错误演变为代价高昂的重写。我们提出 VibeVideoAgent，一个免训练框架，让编码智能体能够在整个制作过程中检查其草稿。多模态感知在与编码器隔离的短生命周期上下文中运行，并返回紧凑、有依据的 Findings。七种原语在统一的资产与草稿多时钟表示上操作：它们由粗到细地探索媒体，用来自每种所需模态的证据验证所引用的需求，在不同时钟上将草稿与参考或早期修订进行比较，并在局部测量流信号。一个轻量的分阶段协议让智能体先在最小预览上测试其风险最高的决策。在全部 239 个 VibeVideoBench 任务上，在匹配的智能体运行时和固定感知模型下，VibeVideoAgent 提升了 Claude Opus 5.5（4.03 -> 4.43，同时 L2 规则符合率从 98.87% 升至 99.35%）、GPT-6 Astra（4.03 -> 4.27）和 Claude Sonnet 5.5（3.97 -> 4.10）的整体视听质量（L3），其中音画同步提升最大（最高 +0.56）。受控消融实验表明每个组件都有贡献，轨迹审计表明代码编辑的粒度决定了规则符合度与感知质量之间的权衡。
translation.brief: 针对代码驱动视频生成中程序无运行时错误但仍存在视觉/音频缺陷的问题，提出免训练的 VibeVideoAgent，通过隔离的多模态感知原语和多时钟表示让编码智能体在制作全程检查并修正草稿。

papers.title: TigerTTS: Draft-Guided Multi-Frame Parallel Speech-Token Language Model for Fast and Robust Text-to-Speech
papers.abstract: Autoregressive speech-token language models enable high-quality TTS but suffer from latency growth with sequence length, word omission or repetition without explicit alignment, and fidelity limits from discrete codebooks. We present TigerTTS, a production-grade LLM TTS system built around a lightweight non-autoregressive NAR model. With explicit alignment, the NAR model drafts tokens for the entire utterance, which are refined frame-by-frame by a compact autoregressive LLM. The draft is aligned frame-for-frame with LLM targets and injected at the input, ensuring training-inference consistency. Leveraging its accuracy, the LLM predicts 12 tokens per step across 3 frames and 4 groups, while a conditional-total-correlation bound keeps parallel prediction nearly lossless. We use a codebook-free FSQ tokenizer with four parallel groups and about 1800 bps to avoid codebook collapse. The backbone keeps positional information only in input embeddings, enabling exact MLA weight absorption and a four-fold KV-cache reduction. Decoding uses CUDA Graphs with a graph-safe multinomial sampler. A Fast mode further reduces first-packet latency: the NAR generator acts as a prefix synthesizer with RTF 0.03, producing the first 500 ms before LLM decoding. With CUDA-Graph decoding, TigerTTS reaches RTF 0.05, about 20x real-time, on one GPU. Despite using a 0.15B backbone, it outperforms standard PyTorch inference of VoxCPM2 2B by 5x and CosyVoice 2 by 16x. TigerTTS achieves the lowest CER and WER on SEED, 1.09 and 1.67, and strong WER, NMOS, and speaker similarity on LibriSpeech test-clean, 2.22, 4.36, and 0.820. Fast-mode guided semantic tokens provide a well-aligned content prior, reducing dropped words, loops, and runaway generation without sacrificing speed.

translation.title: TigerTTS：面向快速鲁棒文本转语音的草稿引导多帧并行语音 token 语言模型
translation.abstract: 自回归语音 token 语言模型能实现高质量 TTS，但存在随序列长度增长的延迟、缺乏显式对齐导致的漏词或重复，以及离散码本带来的保真度限制。我们提出 TigerTTS，一个围绕轻量非自回归（NAR）模型构建的生产级 LLM TTS 系统。借助显式对齐，NAR 模型为整句话起草 token，再由一个紧凑的自回归 LLM 逐帧精炼。草稿与 LLM 目标逐帧对齐并在输入端注入，确保训练与推理的一致性。利用其准确性，LLM 每步跨 3 帧、4 组预测 12 个 token，同时条件总相关性界保证并行预测几乎无损。我们采用无码本的 FSQ 分词器，具有四个并行组、约 1800 bps，以避免码本坍塌。骨干网络仅在输入嵌入中保留位置信息，从而实现精确的 MLA 权重吸收和四倍的 KV-cache 缩减。解码使用 CUDA Graphs 和图安全的多项式采样器。Fast 模式进一步降低首包延迟：NAR 生成器充当前缀合成器，RTF 为 0.03，在 LLM 解码前产出前 500 ms 音频。借助 CUDA-Graph 解码，TigerTTS 在单 GPU 上达到 RTF 0.05，约 20 倍实时。尽管仅使用 0.15B 骨干，其速度仍比 VoxCPM2 2B 的标准 PyTorch 推理快 5 倍，比 CosyVoice 2 快 16 倍。TigerTTS 在 SEED 上取得最低的 CER 和 WER（1.09 和 1.67），并在 LibriSpeech test-clean 上取得优异的 WER、NMOS 和说话人相似度（2.22、4.36 和 0.820）。Fast 模式引导的语义 token 提供了良好对齐的内容先验，在不牺牲速度的情况下减少了漏词、循环和失控生成。
translation.brief: 针对自回归 TTS 延迟高、易漏词重复的问题，提出 TigerTTS，用轻量 NAR 模型起草整句 token 并由紧凑自回归 LLM 多帧并行精炼，结合无码本 FSQ 分词器和 CUDA Graph 解码实现快速高质量合成。

papers.title: EXPOSURE: Explaining Sources of Uncertainty in Reinforcement Learning
papers.abstract: Shapley values in reinforcement learning are used to explain which observation features drive an agent's behavior and expected return, but not its certainty. Explaining certainty requires understanding how observation features influence different sources of return uncertainty, and Shapley values need the agent's prediction for every subset of visible features. We propose EXPOSURE, which uses one mask-aware belief network for both action selection and Shapley explanations. It explains the variance of the return, split into an observational part due to missing features and an inherent part due to the environment's own randomness, and the entropy of its belief over the masked features. In tic-tac-toe and Minesweeper, where exact Shapley values are computable, EXPOSURE gives more accurate explanations of expected return and its uncertainty, while uniquely explaining belief uncertainty.

translation.title: EXPOSURE：解释强化学习中的不确定性来源
translation.abstract: 强化学习中的 Shapley 值被用于解释哪些观测特征驱动智能体的行为和期望回报，但无法解释其确定性。解释确定性需要理解观测特征如何影响回报不确定性的不同来源，而 Shapley 值需要智能体对每个可见特征子集的预测。我们提出 EXPOSURE，它使用一个感知掩码的信念网络同时进行动作选择和 Shapley 解释。它解释回报的方差——分为因特征缺失导致的观测部分和因环境自身随机性导致的固有部分——以及其关于被掩码特征的信念熵。在井字棋和扫雷这两个可精确计算 Shapley 值的环境中，EXPOSURE 对期望回报及其不确定性给出了更准确的解释，并独有地解释了信念不确定性。
translation.brief: 针对 Shapley 值无法解释智能体不确定性来源的问题，提出 EXPOSURE，用一个感知掩码的信念网络同时完成动作选择和 Shapley 解释，将回报方差分解为观测部分与固有部分并解释信念熵。

papers.title: Navigent: A Geometry-Grounded Agentic Framework for Vision Language Navigation
papers.abstract: Vision-and-Language Navigation (VLN) with general-purpose multimodal large language models (MLLMs) offers a flexible alternative to task-specific navigation policies, while reliable long-horizon execution remains challenging. Agents must track navigation progress, detect discrepancies between commanded and actual motion, and recognize when movement has passed relevant landmarks or entrances. We present Navigent, an agentic VLN framework built around a frozen MLLM and a Geometry-Grounded Execution Critic (GEC). GEC performs two complementary checks: action-to-motion consistency, which evaluates measured displacement against commanded movement, and motion-to-landmark consistency, which tracks agent-selected visual anchors and entrance candidates in world coordinates. Detected discrepancies interrupt the remaining action sequence and trigger reobservation, local adjustment, or node-based recovery. Historical visual memory supports progress tracking across extended routes. An offline self-improvement procedure further analyzes successful and failed training trajectories to refine navigation prompts and GEC logic while keeping model weights fixed. On the R2R-CE validation-unseen split (1,839 episodes) and RxR-CE validation-unseen split(3,669 episodes), Navigent achieves 84.0%/86.0% SR and 72.9%/69.1% SPL, respectively, demonstrating the value of geometry-grounded execution verification for reliable agentic navigation. Project Page: this https URL Code: this https URL

translation.title: Navigent：一个基于几何约束的视觉语言导航智能体框架
translation.abstract: 使用通用多模态大语言模型（MLLM）的视觉语言导航（VLN）为任务专属导航策略提供了灵活的替代方案，但可靠的长时程执行仍然充满挑战。智能体必须跟踪导航进度、检测指令运动与实际运动之间的差异，并识别运动何时已越过相关地标或入口。我们提出 Navigent，一个围绕冻结 MLLM 和几何约束执行批评器（Geometry-Grounded Execution Critic, GEC）构建的智能体 VLN 框架。GEC 执行两项互补检查：动作-运动一致性，评估测量位移与指令运动的匹配程度；运动-地标一致性，在世界坐标系中跟踪智能体选择的视觉锚点和入口候选。检测到的差异会中断剩余动作序列并触发重新观测、局部调整或基于节点的恢复。历史视觉记忆支持长路线上的进度跟踪。离线自改进流程进一步分析成功与失败的训练轨迹，以在保持模型权重不变的情况下精炼导航提示和 GEC 逻辑。在 R2R-CE validation-unseen 划分（1,839 个回合）和 RxR-CE validation-unseen 划分（3,669 个回合）上，Navigent 分别取得 84.0%/86.0% 的 SR 和 72.9%/69.1% 的 SPL，证明了几何约束执行验证对可靠智能体导航的价值。项目页面：this https URL 代码：this https URL
translation.brief: 针对 MLLM 智能体在长时程视觉语言导航中难以可靠执行的问题，提出 Navigent，通过几何约束执行批评器检测动作-运动和运动-地标不一致并触发恢复机制，配合离线自改进精炼提示。

papers.title: MedSkill-E$^{2}$: Evaluating and Evolving Skills for Medical Agents
papers.abstract: Large language model (LLM) agents increasingly use skills to access domain knowledge and complete real-world tasks. We observe that even when a skill specifies the rules and procedures needed for a task, agents may fail to apply them effectively during autonomous execution, a phenomenon we call skill Enable But Underuse (EBU). This issue is particularly consequential in medical tasks, where overlooking a single critical constraint can yield a plausible but incorrect result. To evaluate and address EBU, we introduce MedSkill-E$^{2}$, a framework for evaluating and evolving skills for medical agents. We construct EBU-Bench, a challenging benchmark covering 12 medically relevant task groups and associated skills, to evaluate agents' ability to use available skills autonomously.
