We quantify the EBU gap as the difference in skill-use accuracy between autonomous use and explicitly guided reading and application of the same skill. On EBU-Bench, all evaluated model-harness combinations exhibit EBU, with a mean gap of 43.94 percentage points (pp). For the same model, skill-use accuracy under autonomous use differs by up to 38.96 pp across harnesses. Motivated by these observations, we propose EBU-Evolve, which uses execution feedback from autonomous and explicitly guided skill use to distill effective guidance into reusable skill instructions. Relative to their pre-evolution versions, the revised skills improve skill-use accuracy during autonomous execution by 33.33 to 55.17 pp and continue to yield improvements when transferred across multiple models and harnesses. Our results show that autonomous skill-use accuracy varies across harnesses with the model and skill held fixed, and model rankings can change. EBU can persist even after a skill is opened. EBU-Evolve improves autonomous skill-use accuracy on unseen tasks within the same skill, with gains transferring across models and harnesses.

translation.title: MedSkill-E$^{2}$：面向医疗智能体的技能评估与演化
translation.abstract: 大语言模型（LLM）智能体日益使用技能来获取领域知识并完成真实世界任务。我们观察到，即使技能规定了任务所需的规则和流程，智能体在自主执行时也可能无法有效应用它们，我们将这一现象称为技能“可用但未用”（Enable But Underuse，EBU）。这一问题在医疗任务中尤为严重，因为忽视单个关键约束就可能产生看似合理但错误的结果。为了评估并解决 EBU，我们提出了 MedSkill-E$^{2}$，一个用于评估和演化医疗智能体技能的框架。我们构建了 EBU-Bench，一个涵盖 12 个医疗相关任务组及相应技能的具有挑战性的基准，用于评估智能体自主使用可用技能的能力。我们将 EBU 差距量化为自主使用技能与在明确引导下阅读并应用同一技能之间的技能使用准确率之差。在 EBU-Bench 上，所有被评估的模型-框架组合均表现出 EBU，平均差距为 43.94 个百分点（pp）。对于同一模型，不同框架下自主使用技能的准确率差异高达 38.96 pp。基于这些观察，我们提出 EBU-Evolve，它利用自主使用和明确引导使用技能的执行反馈，将有效引导蒸馏为可复用的技能指令。相对于演化前的版本，修订后的技能在自主执行中将技能使用准确率提升了 33.33 至 55.17 pp，并且在跨多个模型和框架迁移时仍能带来提升。我们的结果表明，在模型和技能固定的情况下，自主技能使用准确率因框架而异，且模型排名可能发生变化。即使技能被打开，EBU 仍可能持续存在。EBU-Evolve 提升了同一技能下未见任务的自主技能使用准确率，且增益可跨模型和框架迁移。
translation.brief: 针对医疗智能体拥有技能却不会自主有效使用（EBU）的问题，提出 EBU-Bench 基准量化该差距，并用执行反馈演化技能指令（EBU-Evolve）来提升自主技能使用准确率。

papers.title: From Telemetry to Intelligence: A Data-Centric Survey of O-RAN
papers.abstract: The Open Radio Access Network (O-RAN) has emerged as a new architecture for enabling programmability, intelligence, automation, and multi-vendor interoperability in the wireless domain of public telecommunications networks. Artificial Intelligence/Machine Learning (AI/ML), and more recently Agentic AI, are considered key enablers of automation and intelligentization in O-RAN. However, the effectiveness of such systems is constrained by the availability, quality, and structure of O-RAN data. In this survey, we present a data-centric perspective of O-RAN, focusing on how data support rule-based, AI/ML-driven, and emerging Agentic AI applications across various timescale control loops. We analyze O-RAN data along multiple dimensions, including source, accessibility, abstraction level, and application. We further identify key data challenges, and discuss their implications for intelligent control. The overarching objective of this work is to present the first comprehensive review of the data-centric perspective on intelligent applications in O-RAN. To this end, it introduces a unified framework for understanding the role of O-RAN data in enabling network intelligence and automation.

translation.title: 从遥测到智能：以数据为中心的 O-RAN 综述
translation.abstract: 开放无线接入网（O-RAN）已成为一种新架构，用于在公共电信网络的无线领域实现可编程性、智能化、自动化和多厂商互操作性。人工智能/机器学习（AI/ML）以及近期的 Agentic AI 被视为 O-RAN 自动化和智能化的关键使能技术。然而，此类系统的有效性受限于 O-RAN 数据的可用性、质量和结构。在本综述中，我们提出了以数据为中心的 O-RAN 视角，聚焦数据如何支持跨多种时间尺度控制回路的基于规则的、AI/ML 驱动的以及新兴 Agentic AI 应用。我们从多个维度分析 O-RAN 数据，包括来源、可访问性、抽象层次和应用。我们进一步识别关键数据挑战，并讨论其对智能控制的影响。本工作的总体目标是首次全面综述 O-RAN 智能应用中以数据为中心的视角。为此，它引入了一个统一框架，用于理解 O-RAN 数据在实现网络智能与自动化中的作用。
translation.brief: 针对 O-RAN 智能化受数据可用性、质量和结构制约的问题，首次以数据为中心系统综述 O-RAN 数据的多维特征、挑战及其对各类智能控制应用的支持。

papers.title: LLM-coupled interpretable tool wear monitoring with multi-evidence reasoning in CNC machining
papers.abstract: Interpretable tool wear assessment in CNC machining is challenging. Existing diagnostic models have high accuracy but provide limited guidance for tool replacement. This study proposes a two layer framework combining deep learning wear classification and LLM assisted reasoning. The first layer uses PCA Loading feature selection and optimized GRU to recognize three wear states, achieving 98.38 percent macro F1 score on the PHM2010 dataset. The second layer uses LLMs to generate natural language reports and replacement suggestions from classification results and feature trends. Engineer evaluation shows the reports outperform rule templates. Cross dataset tests on NASA milling data support the generalizability of this framework.

translation.title: LLM 耦合的可解释刀具磨损监测：CNC 加工中的多证据推理
translation.abstract: CNC 加工中可解释的刀具磨损评估具有挑战性。现有诊断模型准确率高，但对换刀的指导有限。本研究提出一个结合深度学习磨损分类与 LLM 辅助推理的两层框架。第一层使用 PCA Loading 特征选择和优化的 GRU 识别三种磨损状态，在 PHM2010 数据集上达到 98.38% 的宏 F1 分数。第二层使用 LLM 根据分类结果和特征趋势生成自然语言报告和更换建议。工程师评估表明，这些报告优于规则模板。在 NASA 铣削数据上的跨数据集测试支持了该框架的泛化能力。
translation.brief: 针对刀具磨损诊断缺乏可解释换刀指导的问题，提出深度学习磨损分类与 LLM 生成自然语言报告和建议相结合的两层框架。

papers.title: Latent-in-the-Middle: On the Security of Cross-Model Latent Communication in Multi-Agent Systems
papers.abstract: As large language models increasingly collaborate in heterogeneous multi-agent systems, latent communication has emerged as an efficient alternative to exchanging natural-language messages. By sharing internal representations, agents can avoid repeatedly processing the same context, reducing communication overhead and prefill computation. One such mechanism is cross-model Key-Value (KV) cache transfer, which uses a learned mapper to translate a source model's KV cache into one a target model can use. However, this handoff means the target model consumes context it did not encode itself, thus calling into question whether its safety alignment still holds. In this work, we investigate the security implications of latent handoffs by introducing Chasm, a framework characterizing cross-model handoff attacks across three new attack surfaces: the source model, mapper, and handoff mechanism itself. Our experiments reveal that latent handoffs substantially undermine safety alignment and prompt-injection defenses. Notably, a target model that follows only 0.4% of benchmark prompt injections natively, follows up to 44.2% when transferred through a mapper from a source model. On the other hand, for jailbreak attacks, transfer alone raises attack success by up to 24.6 pp within a model family and zero-shot attacks by up to 69.2 pp, whereas white-box optimization through the mapper boosts the attack success rate to 92.5%, against 37.5% for ordinary GCG on the same target. To address these vulnerabilities, we propose a lightweight target-side cache guard that corrects transferred caches to restore the target model's refusal, considerably mitigating these attacks.

translation.title: Latent-in-the-Middle：多智能体系统中跨模型潜在通信的安全性
translation.abstract: 随着大语言模型日益在异构多智能体系统中协作，潜在通信已成为交换自然语言消息的高效替代方案。通过共享内部表示，智能体可以避免重复处理相同上下文，从而降低通信开销和预填充计算。其中一种机制是跨模型 Key-Value（KV）缓存传输，它使用学习到的映射器将源模型的 KV 缓存转换为目标模型可用的形式。然而，这种交接意味着目标模型消费了它自己未编码的上下文，因此其安全对齐是否仍然有效值得质疑。在这项工作中，我们通过引入 Chasm 来研究潜在交接的安全影响，该框架刻画了跨模型交接攻击的三个新攻击面：源模型、映射器和交接机制本身。我们的实验表明，潜在交接会严重破坏安全对齐和提示注入防御。值得注意的是，一个原本仅遵循 0.4% 基准提示注入的目标模型，在通过映射器从源模型传输后，遵循率高达 44.2%。另一方面，对于越狱攻击，仅传输就使模型族内的攻击成功率提升高达 24.6 pp，零样本攻击提升高达 69.2 pp，而通过映射器的白盒优化将攻击成功率提升至 92.5%，而同一目标上普通 GCG 仅为 37.5%。为应对这些漏洞，我们提出一种轻量级的目标端缓存防护，通过纠正传输的缓存来恢复目标模型的拒绝行为，从而显著缓解这些攻击。
translation.brief: 针对跨模型 KV 缓存传输破坏目标模型安全对齐的问题，提出 Chasm 框架刻画三类攻击面，并设计轻量级目标端缓存防护来恢复拒绝行为。

papers.title: StateWeaver: Multi-Agent Coordination of Story-State Transitions for Long-Horizon Video Generation
papers.abstract: Modern video foundation models generate high-quality short clips, but preserving long-video consistency and correctly depicting event-driven state changes remain challenging. Existing agentic workflows face these challenges because continual planning and repair accumulate context, while reference updates remain limited. We introduce StateWeaver, which combines Active States and Hierarchical Collaboration to connect review-driven visual reference updates with cross-shot state inheritance. Active States translate state discrepancies identified during review into concrete visual asset requirements that guide reference construction, validation, and regeneration, preserving identity and already-correct content while repairing target attributes. Confirmed generation results are linked to the corresponding asset states, story time, and reference versions for verification and reuse by subsequent shots. Hierarchical Collaboration isolates execution contexts by task, clip, and repair round, and uses hierarchical memory to organize this process across multiple sets. Across multiple benchmarks, StateWeaver outperforms existing methods and produces long videos with sustained cross-shot consistency under predefined and autonomously planned storyboards.

translation.title: StateWeaver：面向长时程视频生成的多智能体故事状态转换协调
translation.abstract: 现代视频基础模型可以生成高质量的短片段，但保持长视频一致性并正确刻画事件驱动的状态变化仍然具有挑战性。现有智能体工作流面临这些挑战，因为持续规划和修复会累积上下文，而参考更新仍然有限。我们提出 StateWeaver，它结合主动状态（Active States）和分层协作（Hierarchical Collaboration），将基于审查的视觉参考更新与跨镜头状态继承连接起来。主动状态将审查中发现的状态差异转化为具体的视觉资产需求，指导参考的构建、验证和再生成，在修复目标属性的同时保留身份和已正确的内容。确认的生成结果与相应的资产状态、故事时间和参考版本关联，供后续镜头验证和复用。分层协作按任务、片段和修复轮次隔离执行上下文，并使用分层记忆在多组之间组织这一过程。在多个基准上，StateWeaver 优于现有方法，并在预定义和自主规划的故事板下生成了具有持续跨镜头一致性的长视频。
translation.brief: 针对长视频生成中跨镜头状态变化难以保持一致性的问题，提出结合主动状态驱动的参考更新与分层协作记忆的多智能体协调框架 StateWeaver。

papers.title: WebVibe: Multimodal Interactive Website Generation via Reverse Synthesis and Visual Self-Distillation
papers.abstract: Although multimodal large language models translate single screenshots into static HTML, generating interactive functional websites from design specifications still struggles with multi-page routing and stateful widget transitions. Examining existing training pipelines reveals two bottlenecks: (1) in forward data synthesis (X -> Y), writing the specification X before code execution leaves unimplemented or altered requirements in X as supervision noise; and (2) in reinforcement learning, scalar rewards discard the rich state transitions observed during replay. Based on these findings, we introduce WebVibe and Interactive-SDPO to train InteractiveCoder. WebVibe reverses synthesis into Y -> X by verifying cross-page and in-page interactions in the browser before deriving multimodal inputs from replay-confirmed states to build the 31,542-site WebVibe-32K corpus with reusable execution contracts. Interactive-SDPO then conditions a weight-sharing self-teacher on the replay trace and a 2x2 state-transition montage to provide token-level supervision at zero inference-time overhead. On the public Vision2Web L2, one-shot InteractiveCoder-9B nearly 3x its base model's functional score (20.2 to 55.2 FS) and matches a 1T-parameter coding agent in a single pass with 111x fewer total parameters and 78x fewer tokens. On our WebVibeBench, InteractiveCoder-4B and 9B further outperform all evaluated baselines by over 23 points.

translation.title: WebVibe：基于逆向合成与视觉自蒸馏的多模态交互式网站生成
translation.abstract: 尽管多模态大语言模型能够将单张截图转换为静态HTML，但从设计规范生成交互式功能网站在多页面路由和有状态组件过渡方面仍然困难重重。审视现有训练流程可以发现两个瓶颈：(1) 在前向数据合成（X -> Y）中，先写规范X再执行代码，导致X中未实现或被更改的需求成为监督噪声；(2) 在强化学习中，标量奖励丢弃了replay过程中观察到的丰富状态转移。基于这些发现，我们提出WebVibe和Interactive-SDPO来训练InteractiveCoder。WebVibe将合成方向反转为Y -> X，先在浏览器中验证跨页面和页面内交互，再从replay确认的状态中导出多模态输入，构建了包含31,542个网站、带有可复用执行契约的WebVibe-32K语料库。Interactive-SDPO随后以replay轨迹和2x2状态转移拼图为条件训练权重共享的自教师，在零推理时开销下提供token级监督。在公开的Vision2Web L2上，一次性推理的InteractiveCoder-9B的功能得分接近其基座模型的3倍（20.2提升至55.2 FS），并以少111倍的总参数量和少78倍的token数在单次推理中媲美1T参数的编码智能体。在我们的WebVibeBench上，InteractiveCoder-4B和9B进一步以超过23分的优势超越所有评测基线。
translation.brief: 解决从设计规范生成交互式网站时监督噪声和标量奖励信息丢失的问题，核心方法是将数据合成方向反转为先验证浏览器交互再生成规范，并结合基于replay轨迹的自蒸馏训练。

papers.title: Energy-Aware Distributed Task Allocation via Local Submodular Maximization
papers.abstract: This paper studies distributed task allocation under time-varying agent sets, task sets, and communication graphs. At each decision epoch, the stage allocation problem is formulated as monotone submodular maximization over a time-varying, energy-filtered admissible ground set subject to a partition-matroid constraint. We develop a Distributed Adaptive Greedy Bidding Algorithm (DAGBA) that combines local admissible-set construction, conditional marginal bidding, and neighbor-based conflict resolution under limited communication. We prove that DAGBA guarantees per-epoch feasibility, finite-round convergence, and residual-energy safety. Theoretically, we identify a sequential-greedy regime where DAGBA recovers the classical $1/2$-approximation guarantee. For general executions with partial information, we derive a local-information-factor approximation bound and conservative bounds computable from the execution trace that quantify the degradation caused by local estimates and parallel fixing. Simulations on cooperative observation missions demonstrate that DAGBA achieves task-completion progress and utility close to centralized and complete-communication references, while improving communication efficiency and maintaining strict energy feasibility.

translation.title: 基于局部次模最大化的能量感知分布式任务分配
translation.abstract: 本文研究在时变的智能体集合、任务集合和通信图下的分布式任务分配问题。在每个决策时刻，阶段分配问题被建模为在受划分拟阵约束的、时变且经能量过滤的可容许基础集上的单调次模最大化。我们提出了分布式自适应贪心竞标算法（DAGBA），在有限通信条件下结合局部可容许集构建、条件边际竞标和基于邻居的冲突消解。我们证明DAGBA保证每个时刻的可行性、有限轮收敛和剩余能量安全。在理论上，我们识别出一个顺序贪心机制，使DAGBA能够恢复经典的1/2近似保证。对于具有部分信息的一般执行过程，我们推导了局部信息因子近似界，以及可从执行轨迹计算的保守界，用以量化局部估计和并行修复造成的性能退化。在协同观测任务上的仿真表明，DAGBA在任务完成进度和效用上接近集中式和完全通信参考方案，同时提高了通信效率并保持严格的能量可行性。
translation.brief: 解决时变智能体、任务和通信图下的分布式任务分配问题，核心方法是将阶段分配建模为能量过滤可容许集上的次模最大化，并提出结合局部竞标与邻居冲突消解的DAGBA算法。

papers.title: Can Large Language Models Estimate the Likely Technological Impact of Scientific Research? Evidence from Biotechnology
papers.abstract: This study provides large-scale empirical evidence about whether large language model (LLM)-based assessments of the likely technological impact of scientific publications are associated with their patent-based impact. Using this http URL, we constructed a biotechnology dataset of 107,615 papers published between 1980 and 2015 with their patent citation counts. We used GPT-5-mini, Qwen-Flash, and DeepSeek-V3.2 to estimate papers technological impact and technology relevance, benchmarking model outputs against log-transformed patent-citation counts through correlation analysis, distributional alignment, and lift-over-random measures. The results show that LLMs extract meaningful signals associated with technological impact from scientific text, although there are substantial differences at the meso-level such as between research fields, journals, and countries. LLMs also outperform random selection in screening for papers with high observed patent impact. Overall, this study identifies the strengths, contexts, and limitations of LLM-based technological impact evaluation and highlights its potential to support large-scale screening for scientific work with downstream technological value.

translation.title: 大语言模型能否估计科学研究的潜在技术影响？来自生物技术的证据
translation.abstract: 本研究提供了大规模实证证据，检验基于大语言模型（LLM）的科学论文潜在技术影响评估是否与其基于专利的影响力相关联。我们构建了一个生物技术数据集，包含1980年至2015年间发表的107,615篇论文及其专利引用次数。我们使用GPT-5-mini、Qwen-Flash和DeepSeek-V3.2来估计论文的技术影响和技术相关性，并通过相关性分析、分布对齐和相对随机提升等指标，将模型输出与对数变换后的专利引用次数进行基准比较。结果表明，LLM能够从科学文本中提取与技术影响相关的有意义信号，尽管在研究领域、期刊和国家等中观层面存在显著差异。LLM在筛选具有高观测专利影响的论文方面也优于随机选择。总体而言，本研究识别了基于LLM的技术影响评估的优势、适用情境和局限性，并强调其在大规模筛选具有下游技术价值的科学工作方面的潜力。
translation.brief: 研究LLM能否预测论文的技术影响，核心方法是用多个LLM评估生物技术论文并与专利引用数进行相关性基准比较。

papers.title: IRTIQA: Evolving in English, Evaluated in Urdu -- Does Agent Self-Evolution Transfer from English to Urdu and Code-Switched Input?
papers.abstract: As LLM agents increasingly learn from their own experience, the tasks they learn from and are evaluated on are almost always in English. We ask whether self-evolution transfers from English to Urdu, and release IRTIQA, a benchmark of aligned English, Urdu-translated, and Urdu code-switched variants of DROP, SNIPS, AppWorld, and SkillsBench, built with a matrix-language code-switching pipeline and human verification. Using IRTIQA, we evaluate three self-evolving frameworks, Tool-R0 (self-play RL), AgentEvolver (experience-guided RL), and Autogenesis (protocol-level evolution), against their unevolved backbones. Self-evolution often raises capability: AgentEvolver lifts AppWorld goal completion from near zero to 20-36% across all conditions, and Autogenesis improves SkillsBench pass rate from 16.48% to 22.22%. But it rarely closes the language gap. Evolved systems remain stronger in English, by up to 0.26 DROP F1, the gap is largest on multi-step tasks, and code-switching behaves as a distinct condition rather than degraded translation. On a shared Gemma-4 31B backbone, the gap exists before evolution, and RL-based evolution can hurt Urdu reasoning more than English. Language parity must therefore be an explicit design target, as it does not emerge from self-improvement alone.

translation.title: IRTIQA：用英语进化，用乌尔都语评测——智能体自我进化能否从英语迁移到乌尔都语及码切换输入？
translation.abstract: 随着LLM智能体越来越多地从自身经验中学习，它们学习和评测所用的任务几乎总是英语。我们探究自我进化能否从英语迁移到乌尔都语，并发布IRTIQA——一个包含DROP、SNIPS、AppWorld和SkillsBench的对齐英语、乌尔都语翻译和乌尔都语码切换变体的基准，该基准采用矩阵语言码切换流水线构建并经人工验证。利用IRTIQA，我们评估了三个自我进化框架——Tool-R0（自博弈强化学习）、AgentEvolver（经验引导强化学习）和Autogenesis（协议级进化）——与其未进化基座的对比。自我进化通常能提升能力：AgentEvolver将AppWorld目标完成率在所有条件下从接近零提升至20-36%，Autogenesis将SkillsBench通过率从16.48%提升至22.22%。但它很少能弥合语言差距。进化后的系统在英语上仍然更强，DROP F1差距最高达0.26，差距在多步任务上最大，且码切换表现为一种独立条件而非退化的翻译。在共享的Gemma-4 31B基座上，差距在进化前就存在，且基于强化学习的进化对乌尔都语推理的伤害可能大于英语。因此，语言对等必须成为显式的设计目标，它不会仅凭自我改进而自然涌现。
translation.brief: 研究智能体自我进化能力能否从英语迁移到乌尔都语，核心方法是构建对齐多语言码切换基准IRTIQA并系统评测三种自我进化框架的语言迁移表现。

papers.title: MeterRouter: Budget-Aware Dynamic Routing for Multi-Agent Systems
papers.abstract: Multi-agent systems (MAS) built on large language models (LLMs) outperform single-agent systems, but inter-agent communication incurs substantial token overhead. While assigning a large LLM to every agent is common, it results in inefficient resource utilization, leaving the system far from the Pareto frontier. The cost of answering a query is set jointly by how many agents are recruited, the role and LLM assigned to each, and communication topology among them. Most existing routers treat cost only implicitly rather than as an explicit optimization constraint. A fixed accuracy-cost preference also cannot express how much a caller is willing to pay for a particular query. We introduce MeterRouter, a budget-aware dynamic router that incrementally synthesizes a collaboration graph by selecting each agent's role, LLM, incoming connections, and termination conditioned on the query and a per-query monetary budget. We initialize the router by imitating successful execution graphs, then jointly refine its decisions with a variant of Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO) whose reward favors correct answers and penalizes spending and budget overruns. Across five benchmarks and a three-tier LLM pool, MeterRouter is (1) accurate, achieving performance comparable to the strongest MAS; (2) economical, reaching that accuracy at 82% lower cost than the strongest MAS router and extending the accuracy-cost frontier beyond the ceiling of single-agent systems; and (3) controllable, adapting its spending to the specified budget while rarely exceeding it.

translation.title: MeterRouter：面向多智能体系统的预算感知动态路由
translation.abstract: 基于大语言模型（LLM）的多智能体系统（MAS）优于单智能体系统，但智能体间通信会产生大量token开销。虽然为每个智能体分配大型LLM很常见，但这导致资源利用低效，使系统远离Pareto前沿。回答一个查询的成本由招募多少智能体、每个智能体的角色和LLM以及它们之间的通信拓扑共同决定。大多数现有路由器只是隐式地对待成本，而非将其作为显式优化约束。固定的准确率-成本偏好也无法表达调用者为特定查询愿意支付多少。我们提出MeterRouter，一个预算感知的动态路由器，它根据查询和每查询货币预算，通过逐步选择每个智能体的角色、LLM、入边连接和终止条件来增量合成协作图。我们通过模仿成功的执行图来初始化路由器，然后用GRPO（Group Relative Policy Optimization）的一个变体联合优化其决策，其奖励偏向正确答案并惩罚开销和预算超支。在五个基准和一个三层LLM池上，MeterRouter表现出：(1) 准确，性能与最强MAS相当；(2) 经济，以比最强MAS路由器低82%的成本达到该准确率，并将准确率-成本前沿扩展到超越单智能体系统的上限；(3) 可控，能根据指定预算调整开销且很少超支。
translation.brief: 解决多智能体系统中智能体间通信token开销高、成本未被显式优化的问题，核心方法是提出预算感知的动态路由器，通过模仿学习初始化并用GRPO变体联合优化智能体角色、LLM选择与协作拓扑。

papers.title: Puzzling-Bench: Evaluating Language Models on 23,777 Human-Written Puzzles with Community-Verified Answers
papers.abstract: We introduce Puzzling-Bench, a benchmark of 23,777 puzzles with community-verified answers drawn from the Puzzling Stack Exchange archive (2014-2026): riddles, ciphers, logic grids, lateral-thinking problems, wordplay and recreational mathematics, a third of them with images. Every puzzle carries the answer accepted by its author, a short reference answer taken from it (LLM-extracted for the evaluation sets and checked on a 50-puzzle human review), the author's own hints, community tags and a creation date, so that the benchmark supports hint ablations, category analysis and a rolling post-cutoff slice (254 puzzles posted after the training cutoff of six of the nine models we evaluate, including the best one) as a contamination check. We evaluate nine frontier and open models with a two-tier scorer (normalized exact match, then an LLM judge) and validate the judge with three judges from two model families: they agree on 95-97% of verdicts (kappa 0.82-0.96), move no model by more than 1.6 points, and show no own-family preference. The best model, GPT-6.1, reaches 74.8% on a shared 255-puzzle set; a hard core of 17 puzzles defeats all nine models; model failures are strongly correlated, and the second-best model contributes a single puzzle to a greedy ensemble, yet an oracle over all nine reaches 91%. On a 100-puzzle multimodal pilot, withholding the question's image costs the two best models 24 and 35 points. We release the dataset, the scoring pipeline and all per-row provenance.

translation.title: Puzzling-Bench：基于23,777道人类撰写、社区验证答案谜题的语言模型评测基准
translation.abstract: 我们提出Puzzling-Bench，一个包含23,777道谜题的基准，谜题来自Puzzling Stack Exchange存档（2014-2026）并带有社区验证的答案，涵盖谜语、密码、逻辑网格、横向思维题、文字游戏和趣味数学，其中三分之一配有图片。每道谜题都带有作者采纳的答案、从中提取的简短参考答案（评测集由LLM提取，并经50道谜题的人工审核校验）、作者自己的提示、社区标签和创建日期，因此该基准支持提示消融、类别分析以及滚动训练截止后切片（254道谜题发布于我们评测的九个模型中六个的训练截止之后，包括最佳模型）作为污染检查。我们采用两级评分器（归一化精确匹配，然后LLM裁判）评测九个前沿和开源模型，并用来自两个模型家族的三个裁判验证裁判的有效性：他们在95-97%的判定上一致（kappa 0.82-0.96），不会使任何模型的分数变动超过1.6分，且无同族偏好。最佳模型GPT-6.1在共享的255道谜题集上达到74.8%；17道硬核谜题击败了全部九个模型；模型失败高度相关，次优模型在贪心集成中仅贡献一道谜题，但九个模型的oracle达到91%。在100道谜题的多模态试点中，隐藏问题图片使两个最佳模型分别损失24分和35分。我们发布了数据集、评分流程和所有逐行溯源信息。
translation.brief: 该论文构建了带社区验证答案的大规模谜题基准Puzzling-Bench，采用两级评分器和污染检查来系统评测语言模型的谜题求解能力。

papers.title: Learning from Unreliable Operator References: Claim-Level Rewards for Customer Support Agents
papers.abstract: Even a correct operator reply can be an unreliable training target for a customer-support agent. About a quarter of the factual claims in these replies lacked full support in the agent's knowledge base and tool records. We treat operator replies as claims to verify rather than answers to imitate. Unverified claims guide revisions to the knowledge base and tools. Verified claims serve as coverage targets in a claim-level GRPO reward that scores factual precision against the evidence the agent retrieved for its answer. On an offline benchmark, 8.6% of the GRPO agent's text answers were flagged for hallucinations, compared with 13.6% for the supervised fine-tuning baseline. In a randomized A/B test against the existing procedural bot, the deployed system increased the share of conversations closed without a human operator from 63.3% to 80.8%.

translation.title: 从不可靠的客服坐席参考中学习：面向客服智能体的声明级奖励
translation.abstract: 即使是正确的坐席回复，对客服智能体而言也可能是不可靠的训练目标。这些回复中约四分之一的事实性声明在智能体的知识库和工具记录中缺乏完整支持。我们将坐席回复视为需要验证的声明而非需要模仿的答案。未验证的声明用于指导知识库和工具的修订。已验证的声明作为声明级GRPO奖励中的覆盖目标，该奖励根据智能体为其答案检索到的证据来评估事实精确度。在离线基准上，GRPO智能体的文本答案有8.6%被标记为幻觉，而监督微调基线为13.6%。在与现有流程机器人的随机A/B测试中，部署的系统将无需人工坐席即可结束的对话比例从63.3%提升到80.8%。
translation.brief: 该论文将坐席回复视为待验证声明而非模仿目标，通过声明级GRPO奖励基于检索证据评估事实精确度来训练客服智能体。

papers.title: AIRIS: Benchmarking Social Embodied Intelligence in Egocentric Streaming Videos
papers.abstract: Embodied agents operating around people must not only recognize social cues, but also decide when the available evidence is sufficient, whether to intervene, and how to respond without violating social norms. Existing benchmarks typically evaluate these abilities in isolation or with access to completed videos, obscuring where an online social decision fails. We introduce AIRIS, a causal streaming benchmark that formulates social embodied intelligence as a time-anchored chain of Attention, Intention, Reaction, and Interaction (A-I-R-I). AIRIS contains 8,000 expert-curated questions grounded in 357 egocentric clips across 11 context categories and 36 capability dimensions. At each query, models receive only the observation prefix available at that time; decision-aware metrics reward calibrated waiting and complete reactions while penalizing premature commitment. Evaluating 45 proprietary and open-source general-purpose, embodied, streaming-video, and omni-modal models reveals fragmented and temporally miscalibrated competence. General-purpose VLMs excel at passive cue grounding and intent recognition, whereas embodied specialists lead on isolated reaction sub-decisions; yet across all families, models frequently guess intents before sufficient evidence emerges and fail to jointly align intervention timing, action domain, and concrete execution within the same episode. AIRIS thus provides a diagnostic foundation for bridging the gap between passive social perception and reliable embodied interaction.

translation.title: AIRIS：在自我中心流式视频中评测社会具身智能
translation.abstract: 在人群中运作的具身智能体不仅要识别社会线索，还要判断可用证据何时足够、是否干预以及如何在不违反社会规范的情况下做出回应。现有基准通常孤立地评测这些能力，或允许访问完整视频，掩盖了在线社会决策失败的位置。我们提出AIRIS，一个因果流式基准，将社会具身智能形式化为时间锚定的注意力、意图、反应和交互链。AIRIS包含8,000道专家策划的问题，基于357个自我中心视频片段，覆盖11个情境类别和36个能力维度。在每次查询时，模型只能获得当时可用的观察前缀；决策感知指标奖励校准良好的等待和完整反应，同时惩罚过早承诺。对45个专有和开源的通用、具身、流式视频及全模态模型的评测揭示了碎片化且时间校准不佳的能力。通用VLM在被动线索定位和意图识别上表现出色，而具身专家模型在孤立的反应子决策上领先；但所有模型家族都经常在证据充分之前猜测意图，且无法在同一情节内联合对齐干预时机、动作领域和具体执行。AIRIS因此为弥合被动社会感知与可靠具身交互之间的差距提供了诊断基础。
translation.brief: 该论文提出流式因果基准AIRIS，将社会具身智能形式化为时间锚定的注意力-意图-反应-交互链，以诊断模型在线社会决策能力。

papers.title: Single-Database Rewards Are Hackable: Counterfactual Execution for Trustworthy Text-to-SQL RL
papers.abstract: Reinforcement learning (RL) for text-to-SQL agents pays a query when its result matches the reference on one database. However, a wrong query can match by luck when the data lack the rows that expose its bug. We study a counterfactual-database (CF) reward that also runs the final query on a few hidden, code-generated copies of the database and pays only if all results match (strict form) or by the share matched (mean form). On 1,302 synthetic audit questions, the strict form lowers the share of buggy queries paid in full from 29.5% to 16.8% and of reward hacks from 54.1% to 1.9%, rejecting 0 of 2,847 correct queries; copies from a family-blind generator do about as well. In a controlled GRPO comparison on a 3.35B model with three seeds per arm, training on the mean form did not improve in-domain accuracy (8.4% vs 11.7%), because the two rewards disagreed on only 5-7% of rollouts; on Spider it gained 1.6 points. One seed reverses both signs, so single-seed reward comparisons mislead. Code: this https URL ; data, models, demo: this https URL

translation.title: 单数据库奖励可被钻空子：面向可信Text-to-SQL强化学习的反事实执行
translation.abstract: Text-to-SQL智能体的强化学习（RL）通常在查询结果与参考结果在一个数据库上匹配时给予奖励。然而，当数据缺乏暴露其缺陷的行时，错误的查询可能碰巧匹配。我们研究一种反事实数据库奖励，它还在几个隐藏的、代码生成的数据库副本上运行最终查询，仅在所有结果匹配（严格形式）或按匹配比例（均值形式）时给予奖励。在1,302个合成审计问题上，严格形式将有缺陷查询被全额奖励的比例从29.5%降至16.8%，奖励钻空子比例从54.1%降至1.9%，且未拒绝2,847个正确查询中的任何一个；来自家族盲生成器的副本效果相当。在一个3.35B模型、每个实验组三个种子的受控GRPO比较中，均值形式的训练并未提升域内准确率（8.4% vs 11.7%），因为两种奖励仅在5-7%的rollout上不一致；在Spider上提升了1.6分。一个种子即可反转两个符号，因此单种子的奖励比较具有误导性。代码：this https URL；数据、模型、演示：this https URL
translation.brief: 该论文针对单数据库奖励易被错误查询碰巧匹配的问题，提出在隐藏的反事实数据库副本上执行查询的奖励机制以提升Text-to-SQL RL的可信度。

papers.title: Under the Influence -- of What? A Controlled Evaluation of Influence Functions
papers.abstract: Influence functions are a promising way to identify which training examples are responsible for a model's output. However, so far empirical evaluations on LLM pretraining level only assumed that they work as intended. This is the first work to systematically evaluate whether the 'influential' examples actually have properties relevant to a language model output, based on re-training with controlled data splits. We investigate three prominent Hessian approximation methods (GradSim, TrackStar, K-FAC) in two settings (linguistic phenomena and factual knowledge) in GPT-2 type models (68M-5.6B training tokens). We find that on average, the `influential' examples are indeed relevant, but they do not always bear the target properties directly, and the ratio and kind of relevance varies by setting.

translation.title: 在影响之下——受什么影响？影响函数的受控评估
translation.abstract: 影响函数是识别哪些训练样本导致模型输出的有前景的方法。然而，迄今为止在LLM预训练规模上的实证评估只是假设它们按预期工作。这是首个基于受控数据划分的重新训练，系统评估'有影响力'样本是否真正具有与语言模型输出相关属性的工作。我们在GPT-2类型模型（6800万-56亿训练token）中，在两种设置（语言现象和事实知识）下研究了三种著名的Hessian近似方法。我们发现平均而言，'有影响力'的样本确实相关，但它们并不总是直接带有目标属性，且相关性的比例和类型因设置而异。
translation.brief: 该论文通过受控数据划分的重新训练，首次系统验证影响函数识别的'有影响力'训练样本是否真正携带与模型输出相关的目标属性。

papers.title: SmartLens: Turning AI Agent Changes into Learning, Review, and Risk Signals in the IDE
papers.abstract: Developers increasingly act as managers of AI agents: they hand tasks to AI coding agents and then have to understand, verify, ship, and learn from what the agents produce. IDEs and recent tools can show which committed lines were written by AI, but they do not attribute the pending changes of external agents, and they do not use attribution to help the developer review, learn, or judge risk. We present SmartLens, an IntelliJ IDEA plugin that attributes changes to an AI agent, the developer, or both. It combines this attribution with the Git history to support three goals: (i) Learn compares the skills (APIs, language features, annotations) that agents used with the skills the developer has used in their own commits; (ii) Understand ranks pending changes by review priority; and (iii) Risk shows hotspots: files that change often, are mostly written by AI, and that the developer barely knows. In a preliminary evaluation, SmartLens attributed 8 of 12 scripted IDE scenarios correctly; all failures were in (expected) blind spots. On 8 Open Source Software repositories with agent co-authored commits, agents introduced up to 253 skills that do not appear in the main developer's own commits. The Risk ranking was as good as or better than plain churn at predicting later bug fixes, but part of this gain is due to recency.

translation.title: SmartLens：在 IDE 中将 AI Agent 的代码变更转化为学习、审查与风险信号
translation.abstract: 开发者日益扮演 AI agent 管理者的角色：他们将任务交给 AI 编码 agent，然后需要理解、验证、交付 agent 产出的代码并从中学习。IDE 和近期工具可以显示哪些已提交的行是由 AI 编写的，但它们无法归因外部 agent 的未提交变更，也没有利用归因来帮助开发者进行审查、学习或判断风险。我们提出 SmartLens，一个 IntelliJ IDEA 插件，可将变更归因于 AI agent、开发者或两者。它将这种归因与 Git 历史相结合，支持三个目标：(i) Learn 比较 agent 使用的技能（API、语言特性、注解）与开发者在自己提交中使用的技能；(ii) Understand 按审查优先级对未提交变更进行排序；(iii) Risk 展示热点：频繁变更、主要由 AI 编写且开发者几乎不了解的文件。在初步评估中，SmartLens 在 12 个脚本化 IDE 场景中正确归因了 8 个；所有失败都发生在（预期的）盲区。在 8 个包含 agent 共同署名提交的开源软件仓库上，agent 引入了多达 253 个在主要开发者自己的提交中从未出现过的技能。Risk 排名在预测后续 bug 修复方面与单纯的代码变更率相当或更好，但部分收益来自时间新近性。
translation.brief: 解决外部 AI agent 未提交变更无法归因且难以辅助审查的问题，提出 IntelliJ 插件 SmartLens，通过变更归因结合 Git 历史实现学习、审查排序和风险热点识别。

papers.title: AgentLens: Graph-guided Security Auditing for LLM-based Agents
papers.abstract: LLM-based agents are emerging as a key paradigm for automating software engineering by coupling LLM-driven decision-making with external tools, files, APIs, and execution environments. However, weaknesses in agent implementations and insecure interactions between the agent and external resources can lead to severe consequences, including remote code execution, arbitrary file access, SQL injection, and data leakage. This makes pre-deployment auditing essential for systematically identifying implementation weaknesses and validating whether they can manifest as concrete security risks in realistic agent workflows. Existing approaches either focus on specific vulnerability classes or lack the capability to validate whether identified static weaknesses correspond to executable exploits. In this paper, we propose AgentLens, a systematic auditing framework for LLM-based agents. AgentLens analyzes the target agent's implementation, component interactions, and built-in defenses, and organizes them into an Audit Knowledge Graph that captures how these factors interact to expose potential security risks. Based on this graph, AgentLens derives candidate attack paths, generates path-specific validation payloads, and constructs realistic multi-turn audit scenarios that place these payloads in task-relevant contexts to validate whether suspected risks manifest as security-violating behaviors during execution. Across five widely-used agent applications, each with over 24,000 GitHub stars, AgentLens identifies 44 vulnerabilities, and every vulnerability is validated by being triggered during execution. Compared with the state-of-the-art approach (AgentFuzz), AgentLens detects 3.67$\times$ more vulnerabilities. To date, 12 reported issues have been assigned CVE IDs.

translation.title: AgentLens：面向基于 LLM 的 Agent 的图引导安全审计
translation.abstract: 基于 LLM 的 agent 正在成为自动化软件工程的关键范式，它将 LLM 驱动的决策与外部工具、文件、API 和执行环境相耦合。然而，agent 实现中的弱点以及 agent 与外部资源之间的不安全交互可能导致严重后果，包括远程代码执行、任意文件访问、SQL 注入和数据泄露。这使得部署前审计对于系统性识别实现弱点并验证它们是否会在真实 agent 工作流中表现为具体安全风险至关重要。现有方法要么只关注特定漏洞类别，要么缺乏验证所识别的静态弱点是否对应可执行利用的能力。本文提出 AgentLens，一个针对基于 LLM 的 agent 的系统性审计框架。AgentLens 分析目标 agent 的实现、组件交互和内置防御，并将它们组织成审计知识图谱，刻画这些因素如何相互作用以暴露潜在安全风险。基于该图谱，AgentLens 推导候选攻击路径，生成针对路径的验证载荷，并构建真实的多轮审计场景，将这些载荷置于任务相关上下文中，以验证疑似风险是否在执行期间表现为违反安全的行为。在五个广泛使用的 agent 应用（每个均超过 24,000 GitHub stars）上，AgentLens 识别出 44 个漏洞，且每个漏洞都通过在执行中被触发而得到验证。与最先进方法（AgentFuzz）相比，AgentLens 检测到的漏洞多 3.67 倍。迄今为止，12 个已报告问题已获得 CVE 编号。
translation.brief: 解决 LLM agent 部署前安全审计中静态弱点无法验证为可执行漏洞的问题，提出 AgentLens 框架，通过审计知识图谱推导攻击路径并生成多轮验证场景来确认真实风险。

papers.title: Towards Democratized Academic LLM Hosting: Practical insights from needs, implementations, and governance across Dutch institutions
papers.abstract: Academic LLM hosting is emerging as an operational infrastructure domain with recurring socio-technical patterns, tensions, and governance requirements across institutions. Based on a workshop with academic infrastructure, research-support, education, and policy-adjacent stakeholders, this paper synthesizes current practices and open questions around institutionally governed LLM services for Dutch academia. It highlights challenges around deployment models, energy and utilization, governance, tooling, commercial integration, and research and education use cases, and identifies emerging directions for service pathways, coordination, and responsible operation.
authors: Towards Democratized Academic LLM Hosting Workshop Consortium

translation.title: 迈向民主化的学术 LLM 托管：来自荷兰各机构需求、实施与治理的实践洞见
translation.abstract: 学术 LLM 托管正在成为一个运营性基础设施领域，各机构间呈现出反复出现的社会技术模式、张力和治理需求。基于一次由学术基础设施、科研支持、教育和政策相关利益方参与的研讨会，本文综合了荷兰学术界在机构治理的 LLM 服务方面的当前实践与开放问题。文章重点讨论了部署模式、能耗与利用率、治理、工具、商业集成以及科研和教育用例方面的挑战，并指出了服务路径、协调和负责任运营的新兴方向。
translation.brief: 总结荷兰学术机构在自建 LLM 托管服务中的需求、实施与治理实践，通过研讨会梳理挑战并提出服务路径与协调方向。

papers.title: When Skills Fail to Compose: Compatibility and Retention in Language Models
papers.abstract: Skill acquisition alone does not establish a reusable skill library: task proficiency does not specify a compositional interface. Motivated by agents that acquire and refine skills, we study independently learned soft-prompt skills on frozen language models, with skill identities and execution order supplied. Across four digit-task bases and three record-editing models, mean composition accuracy in one call is at most 7.6%, compared with 88.2% to 100% over two calls that add computation and an explicit intermediate output. Neutral-insertion training improves robustness but leaves substantial interference, which block length and per-token norm alone cannot explain on two of four digit bases. Blocks of the same operation need not be interchangeable: after training next to frozen learned partners, a post hoc test on two Qwen bases shows that replacing those partners with independently learned blocks of the same operations lowers median composition accuracy from 98.0% and 95.3% to 12.7% and 0.5%, although every replacement scores at least 90% alone. Repair can improve a composition while impairing the original skill, and rehearsal improves retention while transfer remains limited on Qwen2.5-0.5B. Internal interventions constrain explanations without identifying a shared failure mechanism. These findings motivate evaluating compatibility, retention and transfer alongside acquisition when building skill libraries for self-evolving agents. Code is available at this https URL.

translation.title: 当技能无法组合：语言模型中的兼容性与保持性
translation.abstract: 技能习得本身并不能构成可复用的技能库：任务熟练度并不规定一个可组合的接口。受获取和精炼技能的 agent 启发，我们研究在冻结语言模型上独立学习的软提示技能，其中技能身份和执行顺序是给定的。在四个数字任务基座和三个记录编辑模型上，单次调用中的平均组合准确率至多为 7.6%，而增加计算量和显式中间输出的两次调用可达 88.2% 至 100%。中性插入训练提高了鲁棒性，但仍留下大量干扰，在四个数字基座中的两个上，仅凭块长度和每 token 范数无法解释这种干扰。同一操作的块未必可互换：在冻结的已学习伙伴旁边训练后，对两个 Qwen 基座的事后测试表明，用独立学习的相同操作块替换这些伙伴，会使组合准确率中位数从 98.0% 和 95.3% 降至 12.7% 和 0.5%，尽管每个替换块单独得分至少 90%。修复可以改善一个组合却损害原有技能，排练能改善保持性，但在 Qwen2.5-0.5B 上迁移仍然有限。内部干预约束了解释空间，但未能识别出共享的失败机制。这些发现表明，在为自进化 agent 构建技能库时，应将兼容性、保持性和迁移与技能习得一同评估。代码见此 https URL。
translation.brief: 研究冻结语言模型上独立学习的软提示技能难以组合的问题，通过组合实验揭示技能间兼容性、保持性与迁移的失败模式。

papers.title: EvoLink-Bench: A Benchmark for Evaluating Self-Evolving Agents in Long-Horizon Interdependent Task Streams
papers.abstract: Large language model (LLM) agents are evolving from passive chatbots into autonomous systems that operate continuously in dynamic environments. Such agents need not only solve current tasks but also learn from past interactions to improve future performance. However, existing streaming benchmarks often rely on short task sequences or largely independent tasks, providing limited evidence of whether agents can effectively reuse experience when later tasks depend on earlier outcomes. To address this gap, we introduce \textbf{EvoLink-Bench}, a benchmark for evaluating self-evolving agents in long-horizon, interdependent task streams. It covers daily office work, multi-turn dialogue, and AutoResearch-style workflows, with persistent workspaces and dependencies across tasks. The benchmark includes two complementary levels: \textbf{L1}, which evaluates the acquisition and revision of language-expressible knowledge, and \textbf{L2}, which assesses the development of task-level capabilities through execution and feedback. Its evaluation further distinguishes within-task recovery, persistent-state updates, and experience reuse in later tasks. We evaluate five agent frameworks across three backbone configurations under three persistence conditions, covering 19,635 scored task slots from selected evaluation cohorts. Results show that no framework consistently performs best across both levels, retries recover only a limited proportion of failed tasks, and persistent-state updates do not necessarily improve subsequent performance. Furthermore, the effects of evolution differ between knowledge- and capability-level tasks, suggesting that these two forms of evolution require different learning mechanisms. Performance gains also vary across domains and task streams, with improvements on some tasks not necessarily extending to others.

translation.title: EvoLink-Bench：评估长时程相互依赖任务流中自进化 Agent 的基准
translation.abstract: 大语言模型（LLM）agent 正从被动聊天机器人进化为在动态环境中持续运行的自主系统。这类 agent 不仅需要解决当前任务，还需要从过去的交互中学习以提升未来表现。然而，现有的流式基准通常依赖短任务序列或基本独立的任务，对于 agent 能否在后续任务依赖先前结果时有效复用经验提供的证据有限。为填补这一空白，我们提出 EvoLink-Bench，一个用于评估自进化 agent 在长时程、相互依赖任务流中表现的基准。它涵盖日常办公工作、多轮对话和 AutoResearch 风格的工作流，具有持久工作区和跨任务依赖。该基准包含两个互补层级：L1 评估语言可表达知识的获取与修订，L2 评估通过执行和反馈发展任务级能力。其评估进一步区分任务内恢复、持久状态更新和后续任务中的经验复用。我们在三种持久化条件下评估了五种 agent 框架和三种骨干配置，覆盖来自选定评估队列的 19,635 个计分任务槽。结果表明，没有框架在两个层级上始终表现最佳，重试只能恢复有限比例的失败任务，持久状态更新不一定提升后续表现。此外，进化的效果在知识型和能力型任务之间有所不同，表明这两种进化形式需要不同的学习机制。性能提升也因领域和任务流而异，某些任务上的改进未必能延伸到其他任务。
translation.brief: 解决现有基准无法评估 agent 在长时程相互依赖任务流中经验复用能力的问题，提出 EvoLink-Bench，通过持久工作区和跨任务依赖从知识与能力两个层级评估自进化 agent。

papers.title: Any-Rate: Half-Bit Multi-Precision LLM Quantization with Coded Bit-Planes
papers.abstract: Nested multi-precision quantization derives multiple precisions from a single checkpoint by reading only the leading bits of each weight, which makes it attractive for on-device deployment under varying memory and energy budgets. However, existing methods offer only integer bits, leaving large accuracy gaps between adjacent precisions and severe degradation at 2 bits. To address this, we propose Any-Rate, which serves 2-8 bits from one checkpoint, in half-bit steps over 2-4 bits. Any-Rate restricts some bit-planes to extended Hamming codewords in 8-weight blocks (0.5 bits per weight), shares one LUT per row across precisions, and encodes all precisions jointly with a separate target for each, reducing the loss from sharing bit-planes. Across four LLMs, Any-Rate achieves state-of-the-art accuracy among multi-precision methods at 2 and 3 bits, keeping 69% of FP16 accuracy at 2 bits, and is within one point of the best at 4 bits. It decodes about as fast as existing kernels, and an LPDDR energy model estimates up to 27% less energy at equal accuracy. Code is available at this https URL.

translation.title: Any-Rate：基于编码位平面的半比特多精度大语言模型量化
translation.abstract: 嵌套多精度量化通过只读取每个权重的前导比特，从单一检查点派生出多种精度，这使其在内存和能耗预算多变的端侧部署中颇具吸引力。然而，现有方法只提供整数比特精度，导致相邻精度之间存在较大的准确率差距，且在2比特时性能严重退化。为解决这一问题，我们提出Any-Rate，可从单一检查点提供2-8比特的精度，并在2-4比特范围内以半比特为步长。Any-Rate将部分位平面限制为8权重块中的扩展Hamming码字（每权重0.5比特），在各精度间共享每行一个LUT，并对所有精度进行联合编码且为每个精度设置独立目标，从而减少共享位平面带来的损失。在四个大语言模型上，Any-Rate在2比特和3比特下达到多精度方法中的最先进准确率，在2比特下保持FP16准确率的69%，在4比特下与最佳方法相差不到一个百分点。其解码速度与现有内核相当，LPDDR能耗模型估计在相同准确率下最多可节省27%的能耗。代码见此 https URL。
translation.brief: 解决多精度量化只能提供整数比特、低比特精度差距大的问题，核心方法是将部分位平面约束为扩展Hamming码字以实现半比特粒度并联合编码多种精度。

papers.title: Agentic Waterfall: An Intent-Driven Information Discovery Framework for Reclaiming User Control in the Attention Economy
papers.abstract: We formalize Agentic Waterfall Feed, a new problem of personalized information discovery in which users actively direct recommendations and the system adapts to evolving needs inferred from both explicit requests and browsing behavior. We address this problem with the Agentic Waterfall framework, whose language-model controller maintains persistent user state and coordinates content retrieval, ranking, and state updates. To evaluate systems on this task, we contribute the Agentic Waterfall Dataset and a replay-based evaluation protocol. The dataset combines real content metadata with simulated interaction histories. The protocol compares systems under shared histories using relevance scores and blind judgments of how well recommendations satisfy current user goals and constraints. Agentic Waterfall remains competitive with strong baselines on conventional recommendation tasks across five public benchmarks. On the Agentic Waterfall Dataset, it outperforms the strongest baseline in both evaluations, with relative improvements of up to 16.1%.

translation.title: Agentic Waterfall：一种在注意力经济中夺回用户控制权的意图驱动信息发现框架
translation.abstract: 我们形式化了Agentic Waterfall Feed这一新问题，即个性化信息发现：用户主动引导推荐，系统根据显式请求和浏览行为推断出的不断变化的需求进行自适应。我们用Agentic Waterfall框架解决该问题，其语言模型控制器维护持久的用户状态，并协调内容检索、排序和状态更新。为在该任务上评估系统，我们贡献了Agentic Waterfall数据集和基于回放的评估协议。该数据集将真实内容元数据与模拟交互历史相结合。该协议在共享历史下比较各系统，使用相关性得分以及对推荐满足当前用户目标和约束程度的盲评。Agentic Waterfall在五个公开基准的常规推荐任务上与强基线保持竞争力。在Agentic Waterfall数据集上，它在两项评估中均优于最强基线，相对提升最高达16.1%。
translation.brief: 解决用户在推荐系统中缺乏主动控制权的问题，核心方法是用语言模型控制器维护用户状态并协调检索、排序与状态更新的智能体瀑布框架。

papers.title: SemProxy: Semantic 3D Proxies for Controllable Agentic 3D Modeling
papers.abstract: Coding agents are increasingly capable of generating 3D models, yet enabling users to effectively control the modeling process remains challenging. Existing workflows rely primarily on text prompts and reference images, which often struggle to convey precise spatial intentions and require iterative corrections. We introduce SemProxy, a lightweight intermediate representation that bridges intuitive human interaction and agentic 3D modeling. Instantiated as labeled 3D bounding boxes, semantic 3D proxies allow users to directly specify object parts and spatial arrangements while leaving geometric details to coding agents. These proxies can be serialized into structured text and rendered as images, making them directly accessible to existing coding agents without additional training or modifications. We further develop ProxyStudio, a user interface that integrates text, image references, and interactive 3D proxy editing into agentic modeling workflows. We demonstrate the versatility of SemProxy across object- and scene-level modeling tasks with different coding agents, and evaluate its effectiveness in supporting controllable human-agent collaborative 3D modeling through a user study.

translation.title: SemProxy：面向可控智能体3D建模的语义3D代理
translation.abstract: 编码智能体生成3D模型的能力日益增强，但让用户有效控制建模过程仍具挑战性。现有工作流主要依赖文本提示和参考图像，往往难以传达精确的空间意图，且需要反复迭代修正。我们提出SemProxy，一种连接直观人机交互与智能体3D建模的轻量级中间表示。语义3D代理以带标签的3D边界框形式实例化，允许用户直接指定物体部件和空间布局，而将几何细节留给编码智能体。这些代理可序列化为结构化文本并渲染为图像，使现有编码智能体无需额外训练或修改即可直接使用。我们进一步开发了ProxyStudio用户界面，将文本、图像参考和交互式3D代理编辑整合到智能体建模工作流中。我们展示了SemProxy在不同编码智能体下跨物体级和场景级建模任务的通用性，并通过用户研究评估其在支持可控人机协作3D建模方面的有效性。
translation.brief: 解决用户难以精确控制智能体3D建模的问题，核心方法是用带标签的3D边界框作为语义代理中间表示，让用户指定部件与空间布局而由智能体补全几何细节。

papers.title: Grounding User Preferences in Shared Multimodal Concepts for Recommendation
papers.abstract: Multimodal recommendation has substantially advanced item understanding by incorporating rich visual and textual content. Yet user preferences are still commonly encoded as implicit signals tied to individual items, leaving recurring semantic factors without persistent identities that can be shared across items. We introduce MKGE, a multimodal knowledge graph framework that represents these factors as canonical, addressable concepts. MKGE induces a domain-adaptive concept vocabulary from item images and titles, grounds each user's interaction history in supported concepts, and jointly models direct user-item evidence and concept-mediated preference signals. By turning recurring semantics into shared coordinates, MKGE enables evidence from different items to accumulate around the same preference factors. Extensive experiments on three public benchmarks demonstrate that MKGE consistently outperforms collaborative, knowledge-graph, multimodal, and recent LLM/MLLM-based recommenders across all six reported metrics. Controlled studies further demonstrate the importance of canonical concept identities and personalized user-concept correspondence, with especially pronounced gains over removing or rewiring the user graph for low-activity users. These results establish canonical multimodal concepts as effective units for preference modeling and transfer. Code, constructed knowledge graphs, and prompts are available at this https URL.

translation.title: 将用户偏好锚定于共享多模态概念的推荐方法
translation.abstract: 多模态推荐通过融入丰富的视觉和文本内容，大幅提升了物品理解能力。然而，用户偏好通常仍被编码为与单个物品绑定的隐式信号，使得反复出现的语义因素缺乏可在物品间共享的持久身份。我们提出MKGE，一个多模态知识图谱框架，将这些因素表示为规范、可寻址的概念。MKGE从物品图像和标题中归纳出领域自适应的概念词表，将每个用户的交互历史锚定到所支持的概念上，并联合建模直接的用户-物品证据和经由概念中介的偏好信号。通过将反复出现的语义转化为共享坐标，MKGE使来自不同物品的证据能够围绕相同的偏好因素累积。在三个公开基准上的大量实验表明，MKGE在全部六项报告指标上持续优于协同过滤、知识图谱、多模态以及近期基于LLM/MLLM的推荐器。对照研究进一步证明了规范概念身份和个性化用户-概念对应关系的重要性，对于低活跃用户，在移除或重连用户图时增益尤为显著。这些结果确立了规范多模态概念作为偏好建模与迁移的有效单元。代码、构建的知识图谱和提示见此 https URL。
translation.brief: 解决用户偏好仅绑定单个物品、缺乏可共享语义身份的问题，核心方法是用多模态知识图谱将反复出现的语义因素表示为规范可寻址的概念并联合建模直接与概念中介的偏好信号。

papers.title: vSFT: Learning to Verbally Tune Agents at Test Time
papers.abstract: Large language model agents are increasingly improved via agentic reinforcement learning, which can be on-policy but suffers from expensive rollouts and sparse rewards, limiting its application at test time. In this paper, we present a verbally Supervised Fine-Tuning (vSFT) framework that enables the conjunction of dense feedback in natural language and weight updates at test time. Specifically, our vSFT forms a closed loop between an agent and a supervisor via a hypernetwork, in which the supervisor generates verbal supervision from the agent's failed trajectories, and the hypernetwork converts that supervision into low-rank weight updates to tune the agent. We validate that this test-time in-parameter evolving process outperforms both its in-context counterparts and prevalent reinforcement learning methods. In particular, our vSFT using Qwen3-4B outperforms GRPO and Reflexion by 8.7% and 13.9% in success rate on ALFWorld, and by 4.8% and 18.2% on WebShop, respectively. We believe that learning how to adapt a model, rather than an adapted model, offers a promising path towards more capable agents that improve themselves.

translation.title: vSFT：在测试时学习对智能体进行言语微调
translation.abstract: 大语言模型智能体越来越多地通过智能体强化学习进行改进，该方法可以是在线的，但存在昂贵的 rollout 和稀疏奖励的问题，限制了其在测试时的应用。本文提出言语监督微调框架，使自然语言的密集反馈与测试时的权重更新得以结合。具体而言，我们的vSFT通过一个超网络在智能体与监督者之间形成闭环：监督者从智能体的失败轨迹中生成言语监督，超网络将该监督转化为低秩权重更新以调整智能体。我们验证了这种测试时的参数内演化过程优于其上下文内对应方法以及主流强化学习方法。特别是，使用Qwen3-4B的vSFT在ALFWorld上的成功率分别超过GRPO和Reflexion 8.7%和13.9%，在WebShop上分别超过4.8%和18.2%。我们相信，学习如何适配模型而非得到一个已适配的模型，为构建能够自我改进的更强智能体提供了一条有前景的路径。
translation.brief: 解决智能体强化学习 rollout 代价高、奖励稀疏难以在测试时改进的问题，核心方法是用超网络将监督者基于失败轨迹生成的自然语言监督转化为低秩权重更新。

papers.title: Least Restrictive Halfplane Control Barrier Functions for an Autonomous Hydrofoil Boat with Moving Obstacles
papers.abstract: Finding valid Control Barrier Functions (CBFs) is difficult for non-linear systems subject to actuation constraints and moving in complex environments. One way to enable analytically derived CBFs is to represent obstacles as supporting halfplanes, allowing the agent to move safely on one side. In this paper, we propose such a CBF for an agent with Dubins car dynamics. A potential drawback of halfplane CBFs is that they can be highly conservative, overestimating the obstacles and thereby restricting the agent's motion. To address this problem, we make the CBF halfplanes less restrictive as follows. First, the orientation of the supporting halfplane for a single obstacle is optimised to find a safe control input as close as possible to the desired one. Second, we use multiple halfplanes to better approximate complex geometries, and derive rules for handling halfplane intersections. Comparative simulations show that our method reduces conservatism compared to existing CBF techniques, enabling tighter obstacle clearance and faster goal arrival, with delays reduced by more than 33%. Finally, experiments on an autonomous hydrofoil boat demonstrate successful real-world implementation.

translation.title: 面向具有移动障碍物的自主水翼船的最小约束半平面控制障碍函数
translation.abstract: 对于受执行器约束并在复杂环境中运动的非线性系统，寻找有效的控制障碍函数（CBF）十分困难。实现解析推导CBF的一种方法是将障碍物表示为支撑半平面，使智能体可以在其一侧安全运动。本文针对具有Dubins车动力学的智能体提出了这样一种CBF。半平面CBF的一个潜在缺点是可能高度保守，高估障碍物从而限制智能体的运动。为解决该问题，我们通过以下方式降低CBF半平面的约束性：首先，优化单个障碍物支撑半平面的朝向，以找到尽可能接近期望控制输入的安全控制输入；其次，使用多个半平面更好地逼近复杂几何形状，并推导处理半平面相交的规则。对比仿真表明，与现有CBF技术相比，我们的方法降低了保守性，实现了更紧凑的障碍物间距和更快的目标到达，延迟减少超过33%。最后，在自主水翼船上的实验验证了该方法在真实环境中的成功实现。
translation.brief: 解决半平面CBF过于保守限制运动的问题，方法是通过优化半平面朝向并用多个半平面逼近复杂障碍物几何来降低约束性。

papers.title: EgoUseBench: Benchmarking Computer-Use Agents under Evolving First-Person Contexts
papers.abstract: AI wearables, such as smart glasses, extend the context available to agents beyond digital environments to users' physical surroundings. With these devices, computer tasks can originate from users' ongoing activities rather than solely from explicit instructions. Through first-person observations, agents can identify objects and activities relevant to user requests and ground digital tasks in the surrounding context. We call this interaction paradigm Ego Use. However, first-person observations are limited by the wearer's viewpoint and may provide incomplete or ambiguous evidence of ongoing activities. As new observations arrive, agents may need to revise their understanding of the physical context and user intent, and reassess whether prior digital actions remain valid. Whether current agents can reliably handle these changes remains insufficiently evaluated. We introduce EgoUseBench, a benchmark for evaluating Ego Use across three interaction settings with different levels of first-person context. Computer-Use relies on explicit instructions, Offline Ego Use provides prerecorded first-person context before execution, and Online Ego Use provides continuous observations as user intent evolves. Based on over 74 hours of real-world first-person recordings, we construct 693 tasks across the three interaction settings. To capture task evolution, we track first-person observations, user requirements, and website state separately. We further group tasks by how information changes during execution, resulting in three types: Graft (revised user requirements), Refresh (new first-person observations), and Clarify (agent-initiated information seeking). We evaluate advanced models and find that average success rates in Online Ego Use are 26.3% lower than in Computer-Use. This result reveals the difficulty of keeping task execution aligned with evolving first-person context and user intent.

translation.title: EgoUseBench：在演化的第一人称情境下评测计算机使用智能体
translation.abstract: AI可穿戴设备（如智能眼镜）将智能体可用的上下文从数字环境扩展到用户的物理环境。借助这些设备，计算机任务可以源于用户正在进行的活动，而不仅仅来自明确指令。通过第一人称观察，智能体可以识别与用户请求相关的对象和活动，并将数字任务落地到周围情境中。我们将这种交互范式称为Ego Use。然而，第一人称观察受佩戴者视角限制，可能提供不完整或模糊的进行中活动证据。随着新观察的到来，智能体可能需要修正其对物理情境和用户意图的理解，并重新评估先前的数字操作是否仍然有效。当前智能体能否可靠地处理这些变化仍缺乏充分评估。我们提出EgoUseBench，一个在三种具有不同第一人称上下文程度的交互设置下评测Ego Use的基准：Computer-Use依赖明确指令，Offline Ego Use在执行前提供预录制的第一人称上下文，Online Ego Use在用户意图演化时提供连续观察。基于超过74小时的真实第一人称录制，我们构建了跨三种交互设置的693个任务。为捕捉任务演化，我们分别跟踪第一人称观察、用户需求和网站状态。我们进一步按执行期间信息变化方式对任务分组，得到三种类型：Graft（用户需求被修改）、Refresh（新的第一人称观察）和Clarify（智能体主动寻求信息）。我们对先进模型进行评测，发现Online Ego Use的平均成功率比Computer-Use低26.3%。这一结果揭示了使任务执行与不断演化的第一人称情境和用户意图保持一致的难度。
translation.brief: 解决现有智能体在第一人称情境演化下执行计算机任务能力缺乏评估的问题，方法是构建基于74小时真实第一人称录像、含693个任务和三种交互设置的基准EgoUseBench。

papers.title: Computing Feasible EF1 Allocations under Generalized Assignment Constraints
papers.abstract: We study the fair allocation of indivisible goods under generalized assignment constraints, where each agent's bundle must fit within her budget, the sizes of goods may differ across agents, and unallocated goods go to a charity. A natural fairness notion here is feasible envy-freeness up to one good (FEF1), which requires an agent's envy towards any feasible subset of another bundle to disappear after some good is removed from this subset. While FEF1 allocations always exist, they could previously be computed efficiently only when sizes are common to all agents. We show that FEF1 allocations can be computed in strongly polynomial time, and more generally whenever each agent's value can be almost exactly maximized over her feasible bundles, a requirement that cannot be relaxed substantially. Our analysis relies on an essentially tight quadratic bound on how often each agent's bundle is repaired. Moreover, the allocation can be made approximately envy-free up to any good while retaining nearly half the Nash welfare of any given allocation. In contrast, requiring a single good to eliminate an agent's envy towards all feasible subsets of another bundle at once, which makes no difference without constraints, renders the problem NP-hard and may halve the attainable Nash welfare.

translation.title: 在广义分配约束下计算可行的EF1分配
translation.abstract: 我们研究广义分配约束下不可分割物品的公平分配问题，其中每个智能体的物品束必须在其预算内，物品的大小因智能体而异，未分配的物品归入慈善机构。这里一个自然的公平概念是可行无嫉妒性至多一件物品（FEF1），即要求智能体对他人物品束任意可行子集的嫉妒在从该子集中移除某件物品后消失。虽然FEF1分配总是存在，但此前只有在所有智能体共享相同物品大小时才能高效计算。我们证明FEF1分配可以在强多项式时间内计算，更一般地，只要每个智能体的价值能在其可行物品束上被几乎精确最大化即可，而这一要求无法被大幅放宽。我们的分析依赖于对每个智能体物品束被修复次数的一个本质上紧的二次界。此外，该分配可以做到对任意多件物品近似无嫉妒，同时保留任意给定分配近一半的Nash福利。相反，若要求移除单件物品就能一次性消除智能体对他人物品束所有可行子集的嫉妒——在无约束时这并无区别——则会使问题变为NP难，并可能使可达到的Nash福利减半。
translation.brief: 解决广义分配约束下FEF1分配此前仅能在统一物品大小时高效计算的问题，方法是通过物品束修复次数的紧二次界证明其可在强多项式时间内计算。

papers.title: Know the Design, Pick the Attack: Sentence-Keyed Watermarks for LLMs
papers.abstract: A watermark lets the provider of a language model recognise the text its model wrote, which matters more as generated text becomes hard to tell from human writing: provenance underpins academic integrity, the fight against misinformation and new regulation. Providers have started to watermark the text of their models, and to explain how their watermarks work. Explaining a watermark, however, also tells an attacker how to break it, and there are two ways to do so: reword the text to erase the mark, or learn the mark and copy it onto text the model never wrote. Each attack has been studied on its own. We study an attacker that reads the published design to choose between them: it erases the watermarks that are hard to learn and forges the ones that survive rewording. Against it, every existing watermark we compare fails. We propose KeyedLex, which reads its secret key from the grammar of the previous sentence, which rewording changes little, and whose detector does not need to recover the key exactly. It outperforms every watermark we compare on both models we test, losing about half of its signal where the best alternative loses two thirds, at no extra cost in text quality over the best-known watermarks.

translation.title: 了解设计，选择攻击：面向LLM的句子密钥水印
translation.abstract: 水印使语言模型提供商能够识别其模型生成的文本，随着生成文本越来越难以与人类写作区分，这一点愈发重要：来源追溯是学术诚信、打击虚假信息和新法规的基础。提供商已开始为其模型文本添加水印，并公开解释其水印的工作原理。然而，解释水印同时也告诉了攻击者如何破解它，破解方式有两种：改写文本以擦除水印，或学习水印并将其复制到模型从未写过的文本上。这两种攻击此前都被单独研究过。我们研究一种阅读已公开设计来在两者之间做出选择的攻击者：它擦除难以学习的水印，伪造能在改写下存活的水印。面对这种攻击者，我们比较的所有现有水印都会失效。我们提出KeyedLex，它从前一句的语法中读取其密钥——改写对其影响很小——且其检测器无需精确恢复密钥。在我们测试的两个模型上，它的表现优于所有被比较的水印，其信号损失约为最佳替代方案（损失三分之二）的一半，且文本质量不逊于最知名的水印。
translation.brief: 解决现有LLM水印易被擦除或伪造攻击破解的问题，方法是提出KeyedLex，从前一句语法中读取密钥，使水印对改写鲁棒且难以伪造。

papers.title: SMOTE 25 Years of Magic: What Has Been Done, What the Evidence Shows, and Whom It Reached
papers.abstract: Background. SMOTE was published in this journal in 2002 and reviewed here at its fifteenth anniversary in 2018. At twenty-five it is cited by more than 34,000 indexed works, half of them outside computer science. Objectives. To establish what the methods built on SMOTE change, how strong the evidence for them is, and whom the technique has reached. Methods. We audited a curated corpus of 76 papers, 37 of which propose a SMOTE-family generator, and tested its coverage with a systematic search of 22,426 records in the PRISMA 2020 format. From the corpus we collected 1,756 dataset entries, 1,511 published comparisons with SMOTE and the evaluation design of 71 studies; from the search we drew 300 applications of SMOTE at random. We used an agentic AI approach to extract, screen and code under our written rules, and we report how each step was checked. Results. Every variant re-decides some of the six decisions of the SMOTE rule, and 24 of the 37 are only ever run on two classes. In their own papers, proposed methods beat SMOTE in 79.0% of the decided comparisons, but independent studies find that the gains shrink with strong learners and tuned thresholds, and that resampling damages calibration. The corpus holds 52 of the 3,097 records that pass the screen and covers the early years closely, the recent ones thinly. The reach is very wide, but a benefit at the level of outcomes is undemonstrated, four harms are documented, and an estimated 37% of applications resample the whole data set before splitting it. Conclusions. For tabular classification, a new SMOTE variant should no longer count as a contribution in itself: a new generator should be tested one decision at a time against class weighting and a tuned threshold with a strong learner, with calibration reported. We close with a selection guide, a reporting checklist of fifteen items and a research agenda.

translation.title: SMOTE的25年魔法：已做了什么、证据显示了什么、以及它影响了谁
translation.abstract: 背景。SMOTE于2002年发表在本刊，并在2018年其十五周年时被本刊综述。到二十五周年时，它已被超过34,000篇索引文献引用，其中一半来自计算机科学之外。目标。确定基于SMOTE的方法改变了什么、其证据强度如何，以及该技术影响了哪些领域。方法。我们审计了一个包含76篇论文的精选语料库，其中37篇提出SMOTE家族的生成器，并以PRISMA 2020格式对22,426条记录进行系统检索来检验其覆盖范围。从语料库中我们收集了1,756条数据集条目、1,511次与SMOTE的已发表比较以及71项研究的评估设计；从检索中我们随机抽取了300个SMOTE应用。我们使用agentic AI方法在书面规则下进行提取、筛选和编码，并报告每一步的核查情况。结果。每个变体都重新决定SMOTE规则六项决策中的若干项，37个中有24个仅在两类问题上运行。在其自身论文中，所提方法在79.0%的已判定比较中胜过SMOTE，但独立研究发现，在使用强学习器和调优阈值时增益会缩小，且重采样会损害校准。语料库仅涵盖通过筛选的3,097条记录中的52条，对早期年份覆盖较密，对近期覆盖稀疏。其影响范围非常广泛，但在结果层面的收益未被证明，已记录了四种危害，估计37%的应用在划分数据前对整个数据集进行了重采样。结论。对于表格分类，新的SMOTE变体本身不应再被视为贡献：新生成器应逐项决策地与类别加权及调优阈值配合强学习器进行测试，并报告校准情况。我们最后给出选择指南、包含十五项的报告清单和研究议程。
translation.brief: 解决SMOTE变体贡献评估标准缺失的问题，方法是通过审计76篇论文语料库和22,426条记录的系统检索系统评估其方法变化、证据强度与应用范围。

papers.title: Decoder-as-a-Probe: Verbalizing and Steering Visual Representations in LVLMs
papers.abstract: It is commonly accepted that high-level concepts are represented linearly in the representation space of large neural networks. For Large Vision Language Models (LVLMs), finding those interpretable directions in visual representations is important for interpretability. To find them, the classical approach is to train a linear classifier on the representations, but it needs a large amount of labels and only recovers what can be read from the representations, not what the model actually uses. In this paper we start from the following insight: The LLM Decoder of an LVLM is also a classifier whose classes are the possible next tokens. So we use its first-order Taylor expansion as a linear classifier. Hence, we introduce Decoder-as-a-Probe (DaP), which significantly outperforms classical probing and steering baselines especially when training data is sparse. (1) It verbalizes what an LVLM perceives in a given image. (2) It can surgically change the perception of the LVLM about specific attributes (e.g. change only the color, the clothes worn or the action done). Due to its simplicity and data efficiency, we believe DaP can serve as a plug-and-play tool for LVLM research, such as interpretability, hallucination mitigation or instruction tuning.

translation.title: Decoder-as-a-Probe：LVLM 中视觉表示的言语化与调控
translation.abstract: 人们普遍认为，高级概念在大型神经网络的表示空间中以线性方式表示。对于大型视觉语言模型（LVLM），在视觉表示中找到那些可解释的方向对可解释性研究非常重要。经典做法是在表示上训练线性分类器，但这需要大量标注，且只能恢复表示中可读出的信息，而非模型实际使用的信息。本文基于如下洞察：LVLM 的 LLM 解码器本身也是一个分类器，其类别就是可能的下一个 token，因此我们将其一阶泰勒展开用作线性分类器。由此我们提出 Decoder-as-a-Probe（DaP），在训练数据稀疏时显著优于经典探测与调控基线。（1）它能言语化 LVLM 对给定图像的感知内容；（2）它能精准地改变 LVLM 对特定属性的感知（例如只改变颜色、穿着或动作）。凭借其简洁性和数据高效性，我们相信 DaP 可作为 LVLM 研究的即插即用工具，应用于可解释性、幻觉缓解或指令微调等方向。
translation.brief: 该论文解决 LVLM 视觉表示可解释性探测需要大量标注且无法反映模型实际使用信息的问题，核心方法是将 LLM 解码器的一阶泰勒展开直接用作线性探针，实现视觉概念的言语化与精准调控。

papers.title: AliceAI-Foundation-80B-A3B-Base
papers.abstract: We present AliceAI-Foundation-80B-A3B-Base, a mixture-of-experts language model with 80 billion total parameters and approximately 3 billion active parameters per token, trained from scratch at Yandex and released under the Apache 2.0 license. The model combines Kimi Delta Attention with full attention, uses Attention Residuals, and is trained with Muon. Training comprises general pretraining on 17.5 trillion tokens, two context-extension stages, and a dedicated stage for reasoning and agentic interaction. We describe the data collection and augmentation pipelines, evaluation protocols, architectural ablations, and scaling-law experiments. We identify the limitations of held-out training loss as a proxy for downstream performance and introduce an auxiliary loss on mixture-of-experts outputs to stabilize training at the predicted learning rate. Domain-specific data selection and augmentation improve factual knowledge, mathematics, and programming skills, while agent trajectories introduced during pretraining improve performance on agentic benchmarks after supervised fine-tuning. In zero-shot reasoning evaluation, the model achieves leading results among open base models of comparable size, with 88.7% pass@8 on IMO-AnswerBench and 82.9% pass@8 on LiveCodeBench v5-v6. To evaluate Russian-language factual knowledge, we introduce and release two benchmarks with their evaluation protocols: WikiWebFacts, which tests short factual questions drawn from encyclopedic sources and search queries, and HardMultiQA, which tests more demanding factual questions inspired by user interactions. Our model scores 86.5% on WikiWebFacts and 67.9% on HardMultiQA, compared with 83.2% and 65.4% for DeepSeek-V4-Flash-Base (284B total and 13B active parameters) and 72.8% and 54.5% for Nemotron-3-Super-120B-A12B-Base (120B total and 12B active parameters), outperforming both larger models on these benchmarks.

translation.title: AliceAI-Foundation-80B-A3B-Base
translation.abstract: 我们介绍 AliceAI-Foundation-80B-A3B-Base，这是由 Yandex 从零训练并以 Apache 2.0 许可发布的混合专家语言模型，总参数量 800 亿，每个 token 激活约 30 亿参数。该模型将 Kimi Delta Attention 与全注意力相结合，采用 Attention Residuals，并使用 Muon 训练。训练过程包括在 17.5 万亿 token 上的通用预训练、两个上下文扩展阶段，以及一个专门用于推理和智能体交互的阶段。我们描述了数据收集与增强流水线、评估协议、架构消融实验和缩放律实验。我们发现留出训练损失作为下游性能代理指标的局限性，并在混合专家输出上引入辅助损失，以在预测学习率下稳定训练。领域特定的数据选择与增强提升了事实知识、数学和编程能力，而预训练期间引入的智能体轨迹在监督微调后提升了智能体基准上的表现。在零样本推理评估中，该模型在同等规模的开放基座模型中取得领先结果：IMO-AnswerBench 上 pass@8 为 88.7%，LiveCodeBench v5-v6 上 pass@8 为 82.9%。为评估俄语事实知识，我们发布两个基准及其评估协议：WikiWebFacts（测试来自百科来源和搜索查询的简短事实问题）和 HardMultiQA（测试受用户交互启发的更难事实问题）。我们的模型在 WikiWebFacts 上得分 86.5%，HardMultiQA 上得分 67.9%，而 DeepSeek-V4-Flash-Base（总参数 284B、激活 13B）分别为 83.2% 和 65.4%，Nemotron-3-Super-120B-A12B-Base（总参数 120B、激活 12B）分别为 72.8% 和 54.5%，该模型在这两个基准上均优于这两个更大的模型。
translation.brief: 该论文介绍 Yandex 从零训练的 80B 总参数、3B 激活参数的混合专家基座模型，核心方法包括 Kimi Delta Attention 与全注意力混合架构、Muon 优化器、多阶段训练以及 MoE 辅助损失稳定训练。

papers.title: DéjàVu: Plurality Consensus by First Repetition
papers.abstract: We analyze DéjàVu, a simple protocol for plurality consensus: in each synchronous round, each agent samples one uniformly random agent and adopts the first opinion it observes twice, resetting its memory after every adoption. The rule requires neither frequency counters nor knowledge of the population size or the number of opinions. It relies only on repetition detection, an ability documented in single neurons and reflected in the mere-exposure effect. For a population of $n$ agents with $k$ initial opinions, let $M_0$ be the initial count of the plurality opinion (so $n/M_0 \le k$) and $\Delta_0$ its bias, the difference between $M_0$ and the count of the second most popular opinion. We prove that, whenever $\Delta_0 = \Omega(\sqrt{M_0 \log n})$, DéjàVu reaches consensus on the initial plurality opinion within $O(\sqrt{n/M_0} \log(e M_0 / \Delta_0) + \log\log n)$ rounds with high probability. Moreover, we show that, for the same bias regime, DéjàVu is asymptotically never slower than the $h$-majority protocol, collecting its $h$ samples one per round, for every fixed choice of $h$, even one chosen optimally for the initial configuration. There are also initial configurations for which DéjàVu is asymptotically faster for every $h$. The opinion counts alone do not determine the dynamics: each adoption depends on a hidden memory filled over many rounds while the population changed, and agents with older (hence fuller) memories tend to reset sooner, so an advantage held mostly by them can be lost. The few rigorous convergence results we are aware of for such dynamics concern only two opinions. We derive the exact law of the memories given the history of opinions and resets, and track how the plurality opinion's advantage is distributed across memory ages, giving more weight to recently reset agents as they are less likely to reset again soon.

translation.title: DéjàVu：通过首次重复实现多数派共识
translation.abstract: 我们分析了 DéjàVu，一个简单的多数派共识协议：在每个同步轮次中，每个智能体均匀随机采样一个智能体，并采纳其第二次观察到的意见，每次采纳后重置记忆。该规则既不需要频率计数器，也不需要知道种群规模或意见数量，仅依赖重复检测——这一能力已在单个神经元中被记录，并体现于单纯曝光效应。对于由 $n$ 个智能体组成、初始有 $k$ 种意见的种群，设 $M_0$ 为多数派意见的初始计数（故 $n/M_0 \le k$），$\Delta_0$ 为其偏差，即 $M_0$ 与第二受欢迎意见计数之差。我们证明，只要 $\Delta_0 = \Omega(\sqrt{M_0 \log n})$，DéjàVu 就能以高概率在 $O(\sqrt{n/M_0} \log(e M_0 / \Delta_0) + \log\log n)$ 轮内就初始多数派意见达成共识。此外，我们证明在相同偏差区间下，对于每个固定的 $h$（即使是为初始配置最优选取的 $h$），DéjàVu 渐近地从不慢于每轮收集一个样本的 $h$-majority 协议；还存在一些初始配置，使 DéjàVu 对所有 $h$ 都渐近更快。意见计数本身并不决定动力学：每次采纳依赖于在种群变化过程中多轮填充的隐藏记忆，而记忆较旧（因而较满）的智能体倾向于更早重置，因此主要由它们持有的优势可能丢失。我们所知的此类动力学中少数严格收敛结果仅涉及两种意见。我们推导了给定意见与重置历史的记忆的精确分布，并追踪多数派意见的优势如何随记忆年龄分布，对最近重置的智能体赋予更大权重，因为它们短期内再次重置的可能性更低。
translation.brief: 该论文解决分布式种群中多数派共识的收敛速度分析问题，核心方法是提出仅依赖重复检测、无需计数器或种群规模知识的 DéjàVu 协议，并给出其收敛轮数的严格证明及与 h-majority 协议的渐近比较。

papers.title: Kant-Q: A Q-Learning Algorithm for Kantian Equilibrium in Symmetric Markov Games
papers.abstract: AI agents increasingly interact with one another, and many of these interactions are mixed-motive games, which have posed a persistent challenge for learning algorithms. Most multi-agent reinforcement learning (MARL) algorithms are designed to reach Nash equilibria, yet in many such games these equilibria are Pareto-inefficient. We instead study Kantian equilibria, an economic solution concept in which each agent plays the action it would want all agents to adopt. In symmetric games, this corresponds to an optimal common policy. We propose Kant-Q, a Q-learning algorithm in which each agent learns action profiles where all agents play the same action. Each update is then a sample from a single-agent MDP, so Kant-Q inherits the convergence guarantees of standard Q-learning. We show that every symmetric Markov game has a pure Kantian equilibrium. We also prove that all agents' Q-tables converge to the same limit, whose greedy policy is such an equilibrium, and that greedy play converges whenever the optimal common action is unique at every state. We further show that in a subclass of symmetric monotone games, the Kantian equilibrium is Pareto-efficient among pure strategy profiles and strictly individually rational. Empirically, on the iterated Prisoner's Dilemma and the GovSim fishery with up to 200 agents, Kant-Q learns the Kantian equilibrium, while the baselines underperform. Since copies of the same AI system naturally face one another in symmetric games, these results suggest universalization as a design principle for cooperative AI-AI interaction.

translation.title: Kant-Q：对称马尔可夫博弈中康德均衡的 Q 学习算法
translation.abstract: AI 智能体之间的交互日益增多，其中许多是混合动机博弈，这对学习算法构成了持续挑战。大多数多智能体强化学习（MARL）算法旨在达到纳什均衡，但在许多此类博弈中，这些均衡是帕累托低效的。我们转而研究康德均衡——一种经济学解概念，其中每个智能体采取它希望所有智能体都采取的动作。在对称博弈中，这对应于最优的共同策略。我们提出 Kant-Q，一种 Q 学习算法，其中每个智能体学习所有智能体采取相同动作的动作组合。每次更新相当于单智能体 MDP 的一次采样，因此 Kant-Q 继承了标准 Q 学习的收敛保证。我们证明每个对称马尔可夫博弈都存在纯策略康德均衡，并证明所有智能体的 Q 表收敛到同一极限，其贪心策略即为这样的均衡，且当每个状态的最优共同动作唯一时贪心策略收敛。我们进一步证明，在对称单调博弈的一个子类中，康德均衡在纯策略组合中是帕累托有效的且严格个体理性。实验上，在重复囚徒困境和最多 200 个智能体的 GovSim 渔业博弈中，Kant-Q 学到了康德均衡，而基线方法表现不佳。由于同一 AI 系统的副本在对称博弈中自然会相互面对，这些结果提示普遍化可作为合作式 AI-AI 交互的设计原则。
translation.brief: 该论文解决多智能体强化学习中纳什均衡帕累托低效的问题，核心方法是提出 Kant-Q 算法，通过让每个智能体学习所有智能体采取相同动作的策略来收敛到康德均衡。

papers.title: EPPC-CARE: Staged Hierarchical Annotation of Communication Behaviors in Secure Patient-Provider Messages
papers.abstract: Objectives: Patient portal messages provide invaluable information about communication dynamics between patients and healthcare providers, but extracting it manually is labor-intensive. We developed and evaluated EPPC-CARE, an automated framework for identifying communication behaviors together with the supporting text for each classification. Materials and Methods: From 867 messages, we obtained 5,516 reference standard annotations. Each annotation is a triplet of communication-related text (span), a broader communication category (Code), and a specific subcategory (Sub-code). We evaluated EPPC-CARE's identified triplets across six open-weight large language models (LLMs) against supervised fine-tuning and communication-based models such as EPPC-OASIS. We also compared EPPC-CARE with human expert annotations on 100 messages. Results: EPPC-CARE improved performance over EPPC-OASIS across all six models. EPPC-CARE's Triplet F1 improved by 2.90 percentage points on average, with a best score of 64.4%. On the human expert evaluation subset, EPPC-CARE and the human expert showed comparable agreement with the reference standard, with differences favoring EPPC-CARE. Discussion: These findings suggest that identifying triplet components (span, code, subcode) sequentially can improve performance across model families while preserving the supporting text behind each identification. EPPC-CARE links the communication code and subcode with the source text (span), supporting human verification of automated annotations in clinical informatics. EPPC-CARE may therefore make larger-scale studies of patient-provider communication more feasible and provide a foundation for human-in-the-loop annotation workflows. Conclusion: EPPC-CARE offers a more reliable and reviewable approach for automated characterization of communication behaviors in secure patient-provider messaging.

translation.title: EPPC-CARE：患者-医疗服务提供者安全消息中沟通行为的分阶段层次化标注
translation.abstract: 目的：患者门户消息提供了关于患者与医疗服务提供者之间沟通动态的宝贵信息，但人工提取非常费力。我们开发并评估了 EPPC-CARE，一个用于识别沟通行为及其支持文本的自动化框架。材料与方法：从 867 条消息中获得 5,516 条参考标准标注。每条标注是一个三元组：沟通相关文本（span）、更宽泛的沟通类别（Code）和具体子类别（Sub-code）。我们在六个开放权重大型语言模型（LLM）上评估了 EPPC-CARE 识别的三元组，并与监督微调及基于沟通的模型（如 EPPC-OASIS）进行比较。我们还在 100 条消息上将 EPPC-CARE 与人类专家标注进行了对比。结果：EPPC-CARE 在所有六个模型上均优于 EPPC-OASIS，Triplet F1 平均提升 2.90 个百分点，最佳得分为 64.4%。在人类专家评估子集上，EPPC-CARE 与人类专家相对参考标准的一致性相当，且差异偏向 EPPC-CARE。讨论：这些发现表明，按顺序识别三元组组件（span、code、subcode）可以在保留每项识别背后支持文本的同时，提升各模型家族的性能。EPPC-CARE 将沟通 code 和 subcode 与源文本（span）关联，支持临床信息学中自动标注的人工验证。因此，EPPC-CARE 可使更大规模的患者-提供者沟通研究更可行，并为人在回路的标注工作流提供基础。结论：EPPC-CARE 为安全患者-提供者消息中沟通行为的自动化刻画提供了更可靠、可审查的方法。
translation.brief: 该论文解决患者门户消息中沟通行为人工标注费力的问题，核心方法是提出 EPPC-CARE 框架，通过分阶段层次化地识别 span-code-subcode 三元组实现自动化且可人工验证的标注。

papers.title: Reference-Model-Guided Distributed MPC for UAV Swarm Formation Flying Under Switching Directed Graphs
papers.abstract: Distributed formation control of unmanned aerial vehicle (UAV) swarms in complex environments faces several challenges, including switching inter-agent connectivity, limited communication, external disturbances, and collision avoidance. To address these challenges, we propose a reference-model-guided distributed model predictive control (MPC) framework for UAV swarm formation. Each UAV uses relative-position information from its neighbors as input to a local reference model, whose output serves as the formation guidance for the onboard MPC controller. Meanwhile, a Kalman filter is utilized to predict neighboring UAV motions, enabling the construction of inter-UAV collision-avoidance constraints solely from instantaneous relative-state information. By decoupling MPC optimization from distributed coordination, this control architecture preserves the look-ahead planning and constraint-handling capabilities of MPC while enhancing the swarm's adaptability to switching directed graphs. Moreover, eliminating the exchange of neighbors' predicted trajectories reduces communication bandwidth demands, offering strong scalability for large-scale UAV swarms. To improve robustness and safety, disturbance-observer-based feedforward compensation is employed, while the bounded residual disturbance is explicitly considered in the control barrier function (CBF)-based obstacle-avoidance constraints. Finally, the proposed framework is validated through both simulations and real-world flight experiments. Specifically, the flight verification is conducted on a fully distributed multi-UAV platform without external global localization.

translation.title: 切换有向图下参考模型引导的无人机集群编队分布式MPC
translation.abstract: 无人机集群在复杂环境下的分布式编队控制面临诸多挑战，包括智能体间连接关系的切换、通信受限、外部扰动以及避碰问题。为应对这些挑战，我们提出了一种参考模型引导的无人机集群编队分布式模型预测控制（MPC）框架。每架无人机将来自邻居的相对位置信息作为本地参考模型的输入，其输出作为机载MPC控制器的编队引导。同时，利用Kalman滤波器预测邻居无人机的运动，从而仅凭瞬时相对状态信息即可构建无人机间避碰约束。通过将MPC优化与分布式协调解耦，该控制架构在保留MPC前瞻规划与约束处理能力的同时，增强了集群对切换有向图的适应性。此外，取消邻居预测轨迹的交换降低了通信带宽需求，为大规模无人机集群提供了良好的可扩展性。为提升鲁棒性与安全性，采用基于扰动观测器的前馈补偿，并在基于控制障碍函数（CBF）的避障约束中显式考虑有界残余扰动。最后，通过仿真与真实飞行实验验证了所提框架。具体而言，飞行验证在一个完全分布式、无外部全局定位的多无人机平台上完成。
translation.brief: 针对切换连接、通信受限、扰动与避碰下的无人机集群编队控制问题，提出参考模型引导的分布式MPC框架，结合Kalman滤波预测与CBF避障约束实现解耦控制。

papers.title: ADClaw: A Programmable Visual Agent for Industrial Anomaly Detection and Understanding
papers.abstract: Industrial anomaly detection (IAD), the task of identifying and localizing deviations from normal product conditions, is essential to automated quality inspection in manufacturing. Many vision-language models for IAD rely on large domain-specific datasets for fine-tuning and make predictions in a single pass, leaving no opportunity to re-examine ambiguous regions. Although tool-using agents can revisit these regions, predefined tool interfaces limit how they can combine intermediate results in a follow-up check. When such checks are insufficient, models may miss subtle defects or misidentify the defect type. To address this limitation, we introduce ADClaw, an inspection agent that uses executable code to test anomaly hypotheses without task-specific fine-tuning. For each hypothesis, a Structured Normality Prior identifies the applicable rules and retrieves normal visual references for the inspection target. Guided by this prior, the agent writes and executes code in a persistent Inspection Workbench to combine masks, anomaly maps, and measurements from earlier steps into a new test of the suspected defect. After each check, Hypothesis-Guided Evidence Reasoning assesses whether the evidence supports the suspected defect and its location, using gaps or inconsistencies in that evidence to guide the next code action. ADClaw achieves competitive results in detection and localization across 2D and 3D industrial anomaly detection benchmarks and in anomaly understanding on MMAD.

translation.title: ADClaw：面向工业异常检测与理解的可编程视觉智能体
translation.abstract: 工业异常检测（IAD）旨在识别并定位产品偏离正常状态的情况，对制造业自动化质量检测至关重要。许多面向IAD的视觉-语言模型依赖大规模领域专用数据集进行微调，且仅通过单次前向推理给出预测，没有机会重新审视模糊区域。尽管使用工具的智能体可以复查这些区域，但预定义的工具接口限制了它们在后续检查中组合中间结果的方式。当此类检查不充分时，模型可能漏检细微缺陷或误判缺陷类型。为解决这一局限，我们提出ADClaw，一种无需任务特定微调、通过执行可执行代码来检验异常假设的检测智能体。对于每个假设，结构化正常性先验（Structured Normality Prior）识别适用的规则并检索检测目标的正常视觉参考。在该先验引导下，智能体在一个持久的检测工作台（Inspection Workbench）中编写并执行代码，将先前步骤得到的掩码、异常图和测量结果组合成对疑似缺陷的新检验。每次检查后，假设引导的证据推理（Hypothesis-Guided Evidence Reasoning）评估证据是否支持疑似缺陷及其位置，并利用证据中的缺口或不一致之处指导下一步代码动作。ADClaw在2D和3D工业异常检测基准的检测与定位任务以及MMAD的异常理解任务上取得了有竞争力的结果。
translation.brief: 针对视觉-语言模型在工业异常检测中无法复查模糊区域的问题，提出无需微调、通过编写执行代码检验异常假设的智能体ADClaw。

papers.title: VisualMontage: Manipulating the Beliefs of Vision-Language Agents with Authentic Image Sequences
papers.abstract: As agents based on vision-language models (VLMs) increasingly interpret social-media content, errors in their analysis may lend credibility to rumors and amplify their spread. In this paper, we study the problem of visual cognitive collusion, in which coordinated posts combine authentic images and locally faithful captions to induce VLM agents to infer and accept attacker-chosen target claims through their own reasoning. To enable systematic evaluation of this cognitive threat, we introduce a new benchmark comprising 544 target cases and 33.2K candidate images across eight application domains. We further propose VisualMontage, a multi-agent framework for simulating such attacks through narrative planning, image selection and ordering, and caption assignment under iterative review. We evaluate this threat through extensive experiments across 12 vision-language models, examining modality effects, production-team components, and downstream defenses. Using identical attack feeds across models without victim-specific optimization, we demonstrate cross-model transferability, achieving mean attack success rates of 61.93% for proprietary models and 68.71% for open-weight models. Moreover, 92.65% of generated feeds pass independent model-based validity auditing. Even after downstream review, residual attack success rates range from 35.3% to 76.7% across the evaluated configurations.
