Our additional controlled comparisons further reveal that captions can improve model-rated posting naturalness while reducing attack success. Together, these findings reveal a novel cognitive threat in social-media interpretation and motivate safeguards that assess how authentic posts jointly shape agents' reasoning and conclusions.

translation.title: VisualMontage：利用真实图像序列操纵视觉-语言智能体的信念
translation.abstract: 随着基于视觉-语言模型（VLM）的智能体越来越多地解读社交媒体内容，其分析中的错误可能为谣言赋予可信度并放大其传播。本文研究视觉认知合谋问题，即协同发布的帖子通过真实图像与局部忠实的说明文字，诱导VLM智能体通过自身推理得出并接受攻击者选定的目标论断。为系统评估这一认知威胁，我们构建了一个包含8个应用领域、544个目标案例和33.2K候选图像的新基准。我们进一步提出VisualMontage，一个通过叙事规划、图像选择与排序以及迭代审查下的说明文字分配来模拟此类攻击的多智能体框架。我们在12个视觉-语言模型上通过大量实验评估该威胁，考察模态效应、制作团队组件以及下游防御。在不对受害模型做特定优化的情况下，使用相同的攻击内容跨模型测试，我们证明了跨模型可迁移性：专有模型的平均攻击成功率为61.93%，开源权重模型为68.71%。此外，92.65%的生成内容通过了独立的基于模型的有效性审计。即使经过下游审查，各评估配置下的残余攻击成功率仍在35.3%至76.7%之间。我们额外的受控比较进一步表明，说明文字可以提升模型评定的帖子自然度，同时降低攻击成功率。这些发现揭示了社交媒体解读中的一种新型认知威胁，并促使人们建立评估真实帖子如何共同影响智能体推理与结论的防护机制。
translation.brief: 针对真实图像与说明文字协同诱导VLM智能体接受攻击者目标论断的视觉认知合谋威胁，提出多智能体攻击框架VisualMontage及相应基准进行系统评估。

papers.title: Do We Really Need an LLM for Weight-Space Programming? A Deterministic Forward-Only Paradigm and Its Capability Boundaries
papers.abstract: Recent work on Weight-Space Programming uses LLMs to edit neural weights with forward passes only, conflating LLM scripting with the underlying algebra of forward-only editing. We show that for core structured editing regimes, an LLM optimizer is unnecessary, and introduce Forward Weight-Space Programming (FWSP): a deterministic pipeline combining probing, localization, stratified operators (O1-O4), automatic blind routing (83.3% vs. 33.3% for a 27B LLM with the same tool library), and paired verification with zero additional per-token computation. For reasoning LLMs, we propose Protected FisherGate, a closed-form covariance-whitened readout edit orthogonal to normal-reasoning states: on DeepSeek-R1-0528-8B, a single frozen math-calibrated patch achieves 84.2% HumanEval pass@1 (1K budget; 75.4 +/- 9.4% across 3/5 Stage-4-passing subsets), beating 512-token-reserved budget forcing by +14.6 pp (-23.4% tokens) while transferring across HF-to-vLLM backends on full GSM8K and MATH-500. Across five modalities and thirteen models (50K to 27B dense and FP8 MoE), we further prove and verify two operator boundaries, subspace entanglement and frozen representation span, where FWSP-localized LoRA bridges forward-only and gradient adaptation.

translation.title: 权重空间编程真的需要LLM吗？一种确定性仅前向范式及其能力边界
translation.abstract: 近期关于权重空间编程（Weight-Space Programming）的工作使用LLM仅通过前向传播来编辑神经权重，将LLM脚本编写与仅前向编辑的底层代数混为一谈。我们证明，对于核心的结构化编辑场景，LLM优化器并非必需，并提出仅前向权重空间编程（Forward Weight-Space Programming, FWSP）：一个结合探测、定位、分层算子（O1-O4）、自动盲路由（在使用相同工具库时达83.3%，而27B LLM为33.3%）以及成对验证的确定性流水线，且无额外的逐token计算。对于推理型LLM，我们提出Protected FisherGate，一种与正常推理状态正交的闭式协方差白化读出编辑：在DeepSeek-R1-0528-8B上，单个冻结的数学校准补丁在1K预算下达到84.2%的HumanEval pass@1（在3/5个通过Stage-4的子集上为75.4 ± 9.4%），比预留512 token的预算强制方法高出14.6个百分点（token减少23.4%），并在完整GSM8K和MATH-500上跨HF到vLLM后端迁移。跨越五种模态和十三个模型（50K到27B的稠密模型及FP8 MoE），我们进一步证明并验证了两个算子边界——子空间纠缠与冻结表示张成空间，其中FWSP定位的LoRA桥接了仅前向适配与梯度适配。
translation.brief: 针对权重空间编程中LLM优化器是否必要的问题，提出无需LLM的确定性仅前向编辑范式FWSP，并刻画其能力边界。

papers.title: PipeAxes: Decoupling Compute and Communication Granularities for Pipeline-Parallel LLM Serving
papers.abstract: Pipeline parallelism can serve long-context language models on PCIe servers and across heterogeneous GPU clusters. Existing engines split prefill into token chunks to limit decode stalls. The chunk size also sets the GPU batch width and the size of activation transfers between stages. Small chunks reload model weights more often. Large chunks can keep the GPU and the link busy long enough to delay interactive requests. PipeAxes runs wide prefill batches a few layers at a time so decodes can run between slices. A fused Triton Hadamard-INT4 codec compresses activations, which travel in independently sized row groups over parallel TCP sockets. The scheduler uses latency slack to choose batch width, slice depth, and row-group size. We evaluated PipeAxes in 97 replays covering 5,016 requests on A800, RTX 4090, and RTX 3090 GPUs. All 74 requests met their latency targets during a tenfold bandwidth swing. In a four-stage mixture-of-experts pipeline, PipeAxes served requests within their latency targets at 23.3x the rate of calibrated Revisit-PP and 4.44x the rate of Fixed-4096 with Express. In a mixed 64K-context workload, p95 time to first token for short requests fell from 129.8 s with native vLLM to 512 ms. With INT4 transport, MMLU accuracy rose by 0.06 percentage points and GSM8K accuracy fell by 0.46 percentage points relative to BF16.

translation.title: PipeAxes：面向流水线并行LLM服务的计算与通信粒度解耦
translation.abstract: 流水线并行可以在PCIe服务器和异构GPU集群上服务长上下文语言模型。现有引擎将预填充切分为token块以限制解码停顿。块大小同时决定了GPU批宽度和阶段间激活传输的大小。小块会更频繁地重新加载模型权重；大块则可能让GPU和链路长时间忙碌，从而延迟交互式请求。PipeAxes每次以几层为单位运行宽预填充批次，使解码可以在切片之间运行。一个融合的Triton Hadamard-INT4编解码器压缩激活，激活以独立大小的行组通过并行TCP套接字传输。调度器利用延迟余量来选择批宽度、切片深度和行组大小。我们在A800、RTX 4090和RTX 3090 GPU上进行了97次重放、覆盖5,016个请求的评估。在十倍带宽波动期间，全部74个请求均满足其延迟目标。在一个四阶段混合专家流水线中，PipeAxes以校准Revisit-PP的23.3倍和带Express的Fixed-4096的4.44倍的速率在延迟目标内服务请求。在混合64K上下文负载中，短请求的p95首token时间从原生vLLM的129.8秒降至512毫秒。采用INT4传输时，相对于BF16，MMLU准确率上升0.06个百分点，GSM8K准确率下降0.46个百分点。
translation.brief: 针对流水线并行LLM服务中预填充块大小同时约束计算与通信粒度的问题，提出PipeAxes，通过分层切片、INT4激活压缩与延迟余量调度实现二者解耦。

papers.title: Evaluating More with Less: Black-Box Test Selection for AI Agents
papers.abstract: Agentic software systems are increasingly used in development, where changes to the model, prompt, scaffold, tools, or execution environment require repeated testing. Test case selection (TCS) can reduce testing costs while providing estimates of agent performance or exposing failures early. Although TCS has been studied for deep neural networks and LLM code models, prior work does not directly address agentic systems and often requires model information unavailable for proprietary agents. We present the first empirical study of black-box TCS for agentic software systems. We treat each benchmark task as a test case and adapt black-box regression-testing techniques using selection criteria based on task descriptions, metadata, code fragments, and embeddings. We also propose strategies that estimate task difficulty using heuristic features or independent LLM-as-judge assessments. Our strategies select tasks without executing the target agent or using past results. We evaluate fourteen selection strategies, including random sampling, plus a historical-data baseline, across ten AI agent benchmarks with 12 to 101 agents per benchmark. We assess Success Rate estimation and early failure detection. No single strategy dominates both objectives. Adapted black-box regression-testing strategies are most effective for Success Rate estimation, with Category Partition obtaining the lowest median error on five benchmarks at the 20% task budget. LLM-as-judge selection is more effective for early failure detection. For GPT 5.2 Codex on SWE-bench Verified, Category Partition selects 100 instead of 500 tasks, reducing execution cost from \$225 to \$47, with a Success Rate estimation error of 0.8 percentage points. At the same budget, LLM-as-judge selection detects nearly twice as many failures as random sampling: 53.0% of selected tasks reveal failures, compared with 27.4% for random sampling.

translation.title: 以更少评估更多：面向 AI Agent 的黑盒测试用例选择
translation.abstract: Agentic 软件系统在开发中的应用日益广泛，模型、提示词、脚手架、工具或执行环境的变更都需要反复测试。测试用例选择（TCS）可以在降低测试成本的同时估计 agent 性能或尽早暴露失败。尽管 TCS 已在深度神经网络和 LLM 代码模型上得到研究，但已有工作并未直接针对 agentic 系统，且往往需要专有 agent 无法获得的模型信息。我们提出了首个针对 agentic 软件系统的黑盒 TCS 实证研究。我们将每个基准任务视为一个测试用例，并改造黑盒回归测试技术，使用基于任务描述、元数据、代码片段和嵌入的选择准则。我们还提出了利用启发式特征或独立的 LLM-as-judge 评估来估计任务难度的策略。这些策略无需执行目标 agent 或使用历史结果即可选择任务。我们在十个 AI agent 基准上评估了十四种选择策略（包括随机采样）以及一个历史数据基线，每个基准包含 12 到 101 个 agent。我们评估了 Success Rate 估计和早期失败检测。没有任何单一策略在两个目标上都占优。改造后的黑盒回归测试策略对 Success Rate 估计最有效，其中 Category Partition 在 20% 任务预算下于五个基准上取得最低的中位数误差。LLM-as-judge 选择在早期失败检测上更有效。对于 SWE-bench Verified 上的 GPT 5.2 Codex，Category Partition 选择 100 而非 500 个任务，将执行成本从 \$225 降至 \$47，Success Rate 估计误差仅为 0.8 个百分点。在相同预算下，LLM-as-judge 选择检测到的失败几乎是随机采样的两倍：所选任务中 53.0% 暴露失败，而随机采样仅为 27.4%。
translation.brief: 针对 agentic 系统测试成本高的问题，提出无需模型内部信息的黑盒测试用例选择策略，基于回归测试技术和 LLM-as-judge 难度估计来选择任务。

papers.title: A Differential Computing Accelerator for LLM Inference Leveraging Bit-Slice Transition Sparsity
papers.abstract: Large language models (LLMs) have become foundational to modern artificial intelligence. Driven by scaling laws, their rapid growth poses increasing computational and memory challenges for deployment. To accelerate the general matrix multiplication (GEMM) operations that dominate LLM computation, bit-slice architectures decompose quantized operands along the bit dimension, exposing slice-level sparsity and redundancy. However, existing bit-slice designs primarily exploit sparsity in high-order slices, while dense low-order slices still offer substantial untapped reuse opportunities. We observe that bit-slice vectors (BSVs) are highly clustered in Hamming space, with many BSVs lying only a few bit flips away from a small set of representative patterns. Based on this observation, we propose ISTS, an algorithm-hardware co-designed accelerator that leverages representative BSV patterns as shared Steiner points to reuse partial sums across slices, substantially reducing computation. Specifically, the partial sum of each target BSV can be reconstructed from that of its assigned Steiner point using only a few additions or subtractions. On the algorithmic side, we propose Steiner Absorption Table Construction (SATC), which selects a compact set of Steiner points to absorb BSVs with only a few bidirectional bit flips, while FlipPrune selectively prunes flips to further expand the reusable BSV population. On the hardware side, we design a lightweight accelerator that supports Steiner reuse for static linear layer weights and runtime-generated attention K/V tensors. Comprehensive evaluations show that ISTS achieves average speedups of $3.09\times$, $2.41\times$, $2.18\times$, $1.27\times$, and $1.41\times$ over the state-of-the-art accelerators ANT, BBS, LUT Tensor Core, Transitive Array, and MCBP-BRCR, respectively.

translation.title: 利用位切片转移稀疏性的 LLM 推理差分计算加速器
translation.abstract: 大语言模型（LLM）已成为现代人工智能的基础。在 scaling laws 的驱动下，其快速增长给部署带来越来越大的计算和内存挑战。为加速主导 LLM 计算的通用矩阵乘法（GEMM）操作，位切片架构沿位维度分解量化操作数，暴露切片级别的稀疏性和冗余。然而，现有位切片设计主要利用高阶切片的稀疏性，而稠密的低阶切片仍蕴含大量未开发的复用机会。我们观察到位切片向量（BSV）在 Hamming 空间中高度聚集，许多 BSV 距离一小组代表性模式仅有几次位翻转。基于这一观察，我们提出 ISTS，一个算法-硬件协同设计的加速器，它利用代表性 BSV 模式作为共享 Steiner 点来跨切片复用部分和，从而大幅减少计算。具体而言，每个目标 BSV 的部分和可以仅通过少量加减法从其所属 Steiner 点的部分和重构。在算法方面，我们提出 Steiner 吸收表构建（SATC），选择一组紧凑的 Steiner 点来吸收仅需少量双向位翻转的 BSV，同时 FlipPrune 选择性地剪除翻转以进一步扩大可复用 BSV 的规模。在硬件方面，我们设计了一个轻量级加速器，支持对静态线性层权重和运行时生成的 attention K/V 张量进行 Steiner 复用。全面评估表明，ISTS 相对于最先进的加速器 ANT、BBS、LUT Tensor Core、Transitive Array 和 MCBP-BRCR 分别取得 3.09 倍、2.41 倍、2.18 倍、1.27 倍和 1.41 倍的平均加速。
translation.brief: 针对 LLM 推理中 GEMM 计算开销大的问题，提出 ISTS 加速器，利用位切片向量在 Hamming 空间的聚集性，以 Steiner 点复用部分和来减少计算。

papers.title: ZeroHero: Training Small Language Agents from Scratch
papers.abstract: Large pretrained language models provide capable policies for interactive tasks, but how much model capacity is necessary for a specialized language agent? We introduce ZeroHero, a framework for training small language agents (SLAs) from scratch. In each environment, a large language model acts as the expert, and we collect its successful trajectories. We pretrain each SLA, which has fewer than 50 million parameters, to predict the expert's responses given the interaction history. We then post-train the agent on its own interactions using proximal policy optimization (PPO). During post-training, reasoning alignment supplements environment rewards with expert supervision on the language the agent generates alongside its actions. We evaluate the agents in three multistep environments where acting requires both understanding and generating language. In Crafter, agents interpret textual observations and generate reasoning before acting. In WebShop, they translate shopping instructions into search queries. In Alfworld-Dialogue, they ask clarifying questions and use the answers to guide household actions. The agents approach expert performance on WebShop and surpass their respective demonstration experts on Crafter training rollouts and held-out Alfworld-Dialogue tasks. An interactive demo is available at this https URL.

translation.title: ZeroHero：从零训练小型语言 Agent
translation.abstract: 大型预训练语言模型为交互式任务提供了强大的策略，但一个专门化的语言 agent 究竟需要多少模型容量？我们提出 ZeroHero，一个从零训练小型语言 agent（SLA）的框架。在每个环境中，一个大语言模型充当专家，我们收集其成功轨迹。我们预训练每个参数量少于 5000 万的 SLA，使其在给定交互历史的条件下预测专家的响应。然后使用近端策略优化（PPO）在 agent 自身的交互上进行后训练。在后训练期间，推理对齐在环境奖励之外，对 agent 在执行动作时生成的语言施加专家监督。我们在三个多步环境中评估这些 agent，这些环境中的行动既需要理解也需要生成语言。在 Crafter 中，agent 解读文本观察并在行动前生成推理。在 WebShop 中，它们将购物指令转化为搜索查询。在 Alfworld-Dialogue 中，它们提出澄清性问题并利用答案指导家务动作。这些 agent 在 WebShop 上接近专家性能，并在 Crafter 训练 rollout 和留出的 Alfworld-Dialogue 任务上超越各自的示范专家。交互式演示可在该 https URL 获取。
translation.brief: 研究小型语言 agent 需要多少模型容量的问题，提出 ZeroHero 框架，通过 LLM 专家轨迹预训练加 PPO 后训练从零训练参数量不足 5000 万的语言 agent。

papers.title: REE: A Scientific Research Entrance Exam for AI Agents
papers.abstract: Autonomous research agents are emerging as a promising approach to scientific problem-solving across disciplines, owing to their growing ability to improve a solution through repeated experiments. Evaluating this ability requires benchmarks that pose open-ended research problems and measure improvements over established scientific methods. We introduce REE (Research Entrance Exam), a benchmark that tests AI agents on scientific research. It consists of 100 open-ended research problems spanning five broad scientific areas and 23 domains. To ensure high quality, every problem is drawn from active research in its field and individually reviewed by domain experts. Each problem is posed as a task of iterative improvement: an agent has up to 12 hours to improve a working starter solution, and REE scores the result on a common scale against an established expert solution evaluated under comparable conditions. By this measure, two of the four frontier agents we evaluate, Claude Opus 5.5 and GPT-6.1 Sol, outperform the expert solutions on 86% and 81% of problems, across all five scientific areas. Their runs also show how they do so: both agents surpass the expert solutions within the first two hours on average, and their best solutions mostly tailor or combine established methods of the field. REE thus provides a unified framework for evaluating autonomous scientific research, capturing both improvements over established methods and the research processes behind them.

translation.title: REE：面向 AI Agent 的科研入学考试
translation.abstract: 自主科研 agent 正在成为跨学科科学问题求解的一种有前景的方法，这得益于其通过反复实验改进解决方案的能力不断增强。评估这种能力需要能够提出开放式研究问题并衡量相对既有科学方法改进程度的基准。我们提出 REE（Research Entrance Exam），一个测试 AI agent 科研能力的基准。它包含 100 个开放式研究问题，覆盖五个宽泛的科学领域和 23 个学科。为确保高质量，每个问题均取自其领域的活跃研究，并由领域专家逐一审阅。每个问题被设定为迭代改进任务：agent 有最多 12 小时来改进一个可运行的初始方案，REE 在统一尺度上将其结果与在可比条件下评估的既有专家方案进行对比打分。按此标准，我们评估的四个前沿 agent 中，Claude Opus 5.5 和 GPT-6.1 Sol 分别在 86% 和 81% 的问题上超越专家方案，且覆盖全部五个科学领域。它们的运行过程也展示了如何做到这一点：两个 agent 平均在前两小时内即超越专家方案，其最佳方案大多是对该领域既有方法的定制或组合。因此，REE 为评估自主科学研究提供了一个统一框架，既捕捉对既有方法的改进，也捕捉其背后的研究过程。
translation.brief: 针对缺乏评估 AI agent 科研能力的基准的问题，提出 REE，包含 100 个经专家审阅的开放式研究问题，以迭代改进任务衡量 agent 相对专家方案的提升。

papers.title: Do We Still Need Reinforcement Learning When We Can Read the World Model?
papers.abstract: Reinforcement learning has achieved remarkable success in sequential decision-making, but learning effective policies often requires substantial interaction experience. Model-based reinforcement learning alleviates this dependence by leveraging world models, which are typically used to support planning or policy optimization. In this paper, we investigate an alternative paradigm in which autonomous LLM-based coding agents directly synthesize control policies by reasoning over readable world models. By examining environment source code, these agents translate environmental knowledge into executable decision rules and iteratively refine their policies using online feedback or offline data, without task-specific RL training. Experiments across diverse decision-making benchmarks show that synthesized policies match or outperform conventional RL methods while requiring substantially less experience. Further analyses reveal interpretable decision rules and how they evolve through feedback-driven refinement. Comparisons with policies generated without source code access and experiments under challenging conditions further demonstrate the benefits of readable world models. These findings suggest that direct policy synthesis can reduce reliance on trial and error, challenging the necessity of task-specific RL training.

translation.title: 当我们能读懂世界模型时，还需要强化学习吗？
translation.abstract: 强化学习在序贯决策中取得了显著成功，但学习有效策略往往需要大量的交互经验。基于模型的强化学习通过利用世界模型来缓解这种依赖，而世界模型通常用于支持规划或策略优化。本文研究另一种范式：自主的基于 LLM 的编码 agent 通过对可读的世界模型进行推理来直接合成控制策略。通过检查环境源代码，这些 agent 将环境知识转化为可执行的决策规则，并利用在线反馈或离线数据迭代改进其策略，而无需任务特定的 RL 训练。在多个决策基准上的实验表明，合成的策略能够匹配甚至超越传统 RL 方法，同时所需经验大幅减少。进一步分析揭示了可解释的决策规则及其如何通过反馈驱动的改进而演化。与无源代码访问时生成策略的对比以及在挑战性条件下的实验进一步证明了可读世界模型的优势。这些发现表明，直接策略合成可以减少对试错的依赖，对任务特定 RL 训练的必要性提出了挑战。
translation.brief: 探索能否用 LLM 编码 agent 直接阅读环境源代码（可读世界模型）合成控制策略，从而替代任务特定的强化学习训练。

papers.title: Learning to Be Truncated: Preparing LLM Checkpoints for SVD Compression
papers.abstract: Compression based on singular value decomposition (SVD) often requires subsequent fine-tuning or weight correction to mitigate performance degradation. Budget-specific optimization must be repeated for different compression ratios. We introduce LLift, which prepares a pretrained model for SVD compression across ratios without further fine-tuning. LLift fine-tunes a low-rank approximation at a single ratio using the original model as a teacher. We merge the learned updates into the original weights while preserving the complementary components excluded from the training forward pass. We apply SVD to the prepared model's target matrices and reuse the decompositions at different truncation ranks. On LLaMA-7B, we demonstrate accuracy gains across three compression ratios using a single prepared model. The gains extend across model families, model sizes, and SVD compression operators. We analyze gradients and an early training update to provide local evidence that updates learned at one ratio can benefit compression at other ratios. These results show that LLift can improve compression across deployment budgets without fine-tuning each compressed model separately.

translation.title: 学会被截断：为 SVD 压缩准备 LLM 检查点
translation.abstract: 基于奇异值分解（SVD）的压缩通常需要后续微调或权重校正来缓解性能下降，且针对不同压缩比率的预算特定优化必须重复进行。我们提出 LLift，它可以在无需进一步微调的情况下，为跨多种比率的 SVD 压缩准备好预训练模型。LLift 以原始模型为教师，在单一比率下微调低秩近似。我们将学到的更新合并到原始权重中，同时保留训练前向传播中被排除的互补组件。我们对准备好的模型的目标矩阵应用 SVD，并在不同截断秩下复用这些分解。在 LLaMA-7B 上，我们展示了使用单个准备好的模型在三个压缩比率下的准确率提升。这些提升扩展到不同模型家族、模型规模和 SVD 压缩算子。我们通过分析梯度和早期训练更新，提供了在一个比率下学到的更新可以使其他比率的压缩受益的局部证据。这些结果表明，LLift 可以在无需对每个压缩模型单独微调的情况下，改善跨部署预算的压缩效果。
translation.brief: 解决 SVD 压缩需按压缩比率重复微调的问题，提出 LLift 在单一比率下以原模型为教师微调低秩近似并合并更新，使准备好的模型可在多个截断秩下复用。

papers.title: An Embedded Ergonomic Posture Monitoring and AI-Assisted Home Learning System on a Raspberry Pi 3B Edge Platform
papers.abstract: During independent home study sessions, students frequently sustain improper sitting postures, accumulate excessive sedentary hours, and experience productivity loss from off-task digital distractions. Furthermore, learners often lack real-time pedagogical scaffolding for demanding self-study curricula. To mitigate these ergonomic and instructional challenges, this paper presents an affordable, privacy-preserving cyber-physical embedded system for domestic study spaces. Engineered on a Raspberry Pi 3 Model B (1 GB RAM) paired with a UVC optical camera and a USB condenser microphone, the system executes on-device computer vision utilizing MediaPipe Pose and OpenCV to monitor upper-body alignment, sagittal head inclination, and coronal shoulder asymmetry in real time without persisting raw video streams. A deterministic finite state machine (FSM) quantifies active study durations, enforces health-compliant rest periods, and detects illicit smartphone usage. Simultaneously, an integrated multimodal AI tutoring agent parses voice and text queries via an encrypted API gateway, synthesizing Socratic conceptual hints rather than direct solutions. A lightweight parental web dashboard delivers encrypted session analytics and scheduling configurations. Empirical benchmarks on the physical prototype confirm an end-to-end inference latency of 244-250 ms at a 352x288 resolution (4.0-4.1 FPS), a trunk-angle estimation error of 4.39 degrees MAE over 5,760 synthetic ground-truth poses, a resident set size of 320 MB, a peak SoC temperature of 58.0 degrees Celsius under sustained load, and a 1.58 s total latency for the offline TTS feedback path, proving high practicality for resource-constrained edge deployment.

translation.title: 基于 Raspberry Pi 3B 边缘平台的嵌入式人体工学坐姿监测与 AI 辅助家庭学习系统
translation.abstract: 在独立家庭学习期间，学生经常保持不良坐姿、累积过长的久坐时间，并因数字干扰而降低学习效率。此外，学习者在高难度自学课程中往往缺乏实时教学支架。为缓解这些人体工学和教学挑战，本文提出一个面向家庭学习空间的经济实惠、保护隐私的信息物理嵌入式系统。该系统基于 Raspberry Pi 3 Model B（1 GB RAM），搭配 UVC 光学摄像头和 USB 电容麦克风，利用 MediaPipe Pose 和 OpenCV 在设备端执行计算机视觉，实时监测上半身姿态、矢状面头部倾斜和冠状面肩部不对称，且不持久保存原始视频流。一个确定性有限状态机（FSM）量化有效学习时长、强制执行符合健康的休息时段并检测违规使用智能手机。同时，一个集成的多模态 AI 辅导代理通过加密 API 网关解析语音和文本查询，综合生成苏格拉底式概念提示而非直接答案。一个轻量级家长网页仪表盘提供加密的会话分析和调度配置。在物理原型上的实证基准测试确认：在 352x288 分辨率下端到端推理延迟为 244-250 ms（4.0-4.1 FPS），在 5,760 个合成真值姿态上躯干角度估计误差为 4.39 度 MAE，常驻内存为 320 MB，持续负载下 SoC 峰值温度为 58.0 摄氏度，离线 TTS 反馈路径总延迟为 1.58 s，证明了其在资源受限边缘部署中的高实用性。
translation.brief: 解决学生居家学习坐姿不良、久坐和缺乏辅导的问题，在 Raspberry Pi 3B 上用 MediaPipe/OpenCV 视觉监测、FSM 管理学习节奏并集成多模态 AI 苏格拉底式辅导代理。

papers.title: PoVi: Agentic Poetry-to-Video Generation with Knowledge Grounding and Figurative Understanding
papers.abstract: Poetry-to-video generation requires more than translating text into visual scenes. Poetic language is highly compressed, often depends on historical and cultural knowledge, and frequently conveys meaning through metaphor, imagery, and other non-literal expressions. We introduce PoVi, a benchmark and agentic framework for grounded poetry-to-video generation, evaluating semantic grounding, discourse coherence, and audiovisual realization. PoVi reconstructs poem semantics into an evidence-bounded representation and progressively transforms them into narration, interpretation, character assets, and shot-level visual plans, followed by narration-aligned video generation. Across three planning backbones and four video generators, PoVi consistently improves over single-call generation, with the largest gains on implicit background knowledge and metaphorical relations. PoVi provides a testbed for studying knowledge-grounded, long-horizon multimodal generation beyond direct text-to-video synthesis.

translation.title: PoVi：具备知识接地与修辞理解的智能体式诗歌到视频生成
translation.abstract: 诗歌到视频生成不仅仅是将文本翻译为视觉场景。诗歌语言高度凝练，往往依赖历史和文化知识，并经常通过隐喻、意象和其他非字面表达传递意义。我们提出 PoVi，一个面向接地诗歌到视频生成的基准和智能体框架，评估语义接地、语篇连贯性和视听实现。PoVi 将诗歌语义重构为有证据边界的表示，并逐步将其转化为旁白、解读、角色资产和镜头级视觉规划，随后进行与旁白对齐的视频生成。在三个规划骨干和四个视频生成器上，PoVi 持续优于单次调用生成，在隐含背景知识和隐喻关系上提升最大。PoVi 为研究超越直接文本到视频合成的知识接地、长程多模态生成提供了试验平台。
translation.brief: 解决诗歌因高度凝练、隐喻和文化知识导致的文本到视频生成语义失真问题，提出 PoVi 智能体框架将诗歌语义逐步分解为旁白、解读与镜头规划后再生成视频。

papers.title: Maco-RL: Scaling Agent Capabilities with Mixed-Task Reinforcement Learning
papers.abstract: Mixed-task reinforcement learning (MixRL) directly trains a unified policy across domains to continually expand agent capabilities without training separate specialists or requiring an extra distillation stage. Despite its appeal, scaling MixRL poses significant challenges in achieving stable and efficient mixed-task learning, effectively allocating rollout compute, and supporting continual domain expansion. To address these challenges, we propose Maco-RL, an approach that effectively scales MixRL. Specifically, Maco-RL employs a quota-based scheduler for asynchronous rollouts across multiple task domains, thereby stabilizing training by balancing gradient contributions and mitigating off-policy effects. Along an orthogonal axis, Maco-RL further introduces Tri-Buffer Sampling (TBS) to allocate compute among samples with varying levels of mastery, promoting sustained frontier exploration while preserving acquired capabilities. Experiments on five benchmarks show Maco-RL raises Qwen3.5-27B's overall score from 43.6 to 54.2 and then to 60.1 with continual expansion, reaching the frontier held by Qwen3.8-27B, which is further pushed outward by +5.7. Maco-RL also outperforms single-task RL with less compute for policy updates. These results support MixRL as a practical and compute-efficient post-training approach with substantial potential to strengthen general agent capabilities.

translation.title: Maco-RL：用混合任务强化学习扩展智能体能力
translation.abstract: 混合任务强化学习（MixRL）直接跨领域训练统一策略，无需训练单独的专家模型或额外的蒸馏阶段即可持续扩展智能体能力。尽管颇具吸引力，扩展 MixRL 在实现稳定高效的混合任务学习、有效分配 rollout 计算以及支持持续领域扩展方面面临重大挑战。为应对这些挑战，我们提出 Maco-RL，一种有效扩展 MixRL 的方法。具体而言，Maco-RL 采用基于配额的调度器在多个任务领域间进行异步 rollout，通过平衡梯度贡献和缓解 off-policy 效应来稳定训练。在正交方向上，Maco-RL 进一步引入 Tri-Buffer Sampling（TBS）在不同掌握程度的样本间分配计算，在保持已获能力的同时促进持续的前沿探索。在五个基准上的实验表明，Maco-RL 将 Qwen3.5-27B 的总分从 43.6 提升到 54.2，并在持续扩展后达到 60.1，达到 Qwen3.8-27B 所保持的前沿水平，并将其进一步外推 +5.7。Maco-RL 还以更少的策略更新计算量超越单任务 RL。这些结果支持 MixRL 作为一种实用且计算高效的后训练方法，在增强通用智能体能力方面具有巨大潜力。
translation.brief: 解决混合任务强化学习在稳定性、rollout 计算分配和持续领域扩展上的难题，提出 Maco-RL，采用配额式异步调度器和 Tri-Buffer Sampling 按掌握程度分配计算来训练统一策略。

papers.title: Decision and Support Mechanisms under Platform Information Overload: A Generative-Agent Experiment on College Application
papers.abstract: People now make major personal decisions surrounded by far more online information than they can read, yet research says little about why information overload affects some people more than others. We study this question in Chinese college applications, a high-stakes decision made amid heavy online content where each list can be scored objectively once admission cutoffs are released. We simulated 90 applicants using language-model agents with family backgrounds from a national household survey. Each applicant wrote a list of eight programs alone and revised it four times: after parent and teacher advice, after reading a feed of twenty real online items, after a mentor gave advice based on the applicant's rank, and after a second mentor offered only emotional support. After each step, we scored the list and asked how anxious the applicant felt. When applicants decided alone, admission rates were similar across socioeconomic status (SES) groups. The gap appeared once family background entered through parents and teachers: low-SES parents asked for low tuition and schools near home, leaving fewer reachable programs, so admission was 100% for high-SES vs. 77% for low-SES applicants. The platform feed gave everyone the same amount of information but did not narrow this gap; applicants maintained their decisions while reporting higher anxiety. Personalized advice cut the gap to 3 points by raising low-SES admission from 80% to 97%, but led students to higher tuition and less preferred majors. Emotional support did not further lower anxiety, but helped applicants go back and use helpful items they had ignored. These simulation results suggest that when information is abundant, more of it neither improves decisions nor reduces inequality. Personalized information does both, while moving inequality from the outcome to its cost.

translation.title: 平台信息过载下的决策与支持机制：一项关于高考志愿填报的生成式智能体实验
translation.abstract: 如今人们在做重大个人决策时被远超其阅读能力的在线信息所包围，但研究很少说明为什么信息过载对某些人的影响大于其他人。我们在中国的大学志愿填报中研究这一问题——这是一个在大量在线内容中做出的高风险决策，且一旦录取分数线公布，每份志愿列表都可以被客观评分。我们使用语言模型智能体模拟了 90 名申请人，其家庭背景来自一项全国住户调查。每位申请人独立写出一份包含八个项目的志愿列表，并修订四次：在父母和老师建议之后、在阅读二十条真实在线信息流之后、在导师基于申请人排名给出建议之后、以及在第二位导师仅提供情感支持之后。每一步之后，我们对列表评分并询问申请人的焦虑程度。当申请人独立决策时，各社会经济地位（SES）群体的录取率相近。差距在家庭背景通过父母和老师介入后出现：低 SES 父母要求低学费和离家近的学校，减少了可及的项目，因此高 SES 申请人的录取率为 100%，而低 SES 为 77%。平台信息流给每个人相同数量的信息，但没有缩小这一差距；申请人在报告更高焦虑的同时维持原有决策。个性化建议将差距缩小到 3 个百分点，将低 SES 录取率从 80% 提高到 97%，但导致学生选择更高学费和更不偏好的专业。情感支持并未进一步降低焦虑，但帮助申请人回头利用他们曾忽略的有用信息。这些模拟结果表明，当信息充足时，更多的信息既不能改善决策也不能减少不平等。个性化信息两者兼得，但将不平等从结果转移到了其代价上。
translation.brief: 研究信息过载为何对不同人群影响不同，用基于语言模型智能体模拟高考志愿填报的多轮决策实验，比较独立决策、家庭建议、信息流、个性化建议与情感支持对录取结果和不平等的影响。

papers.title: What Is a Theory Worth to an LLM Solver? Measuring, Inducing, and Merging Theories in Context
papers.abstract: Mathematicians solve problems faster when they know the right theory. We ask how much a stated theory is worth to a large language model (LLM) solver, and whether a model can write that theory itself. In a length-matched protocol, adding the right theory to the context of Qwen3-14B raises pass@1 on pattern waiting-time problems from 0.37 to 0.83 and cuts the median tokens of correct solutions from 10.2k to 6.3k, while worked examples of the same length do not help. The gain shrinks as the solver and its token budget grow (+0.46, +0.26, +0.07), and at a long budget it comes almost entirely from finishing within budget: solutions that finish are correct 98--100\% of the time in every condition. To separate induction from recall, we plant unpublished theorems in custom probability families and measure how much of the oracle theory's gain an induced theory recovers. A strong open model, required to explore the training problems with code before writing, recovers 60\% of the gain on one planted family, 48\% on a second, and almost none on a third, where it finds the right form but not the condition that makes the form computable. No single induced note is complete, but a strong model that merges several notes recovers 61\% of the gain on the classic family, above the best single note (47\%). Theories are worth the reasoning they save, and models can find their pieces before they can assemble them.

translation.title: 理论对LLM求解器价值几何？在上下文中测量、归纳与合并理论
translation.abstract: 数学家掌握正确理论时解题更快。我们探究一条明确陈述的理论对大语言模型（LLM）求解器有多大价值，以及模型能否自己写出该理论。在长度匹配的协议下，向Qwen3-14B的上下文中加入正确理论，使模式等待时间问题的pass@1从0.37提升到0.83，并将正确解的中位token数从10.2k降至6.3k，而同等长度的示例解答并无帮助。随着求解器及其token预算的增长，增益递减（+0.46、+0.26、+0.07），且在长预算下增益几乎完全来自在预算内完成：在所有条件下，能完成的解98–100%是正确的。为区分归纳与记忆，我们在自定义概率族中植入未发表定理，测量归纳理论能恢复多少oracle理论的增益。一个强开源模型在写作前被要求用代码探索训练问题，在一个植入族上恢复了60%的增益，第二个族上恢复48%，第三个族上几乎为零——它找到了正确的形式，却没找到使该形式可计算的条件。没有任何单条归纳笔记是完整的，但一个强模型合并多条笔记后在经典族上恢复了61%的增益，高于最佳单条笔记（47%）。理论的价值在于节省的推理，模型能先找到理论的碎片，之后才能将它们组装起来。
translation.brief: 研究显式理论对LLM解题能力的增益及模型能否自行归纳理论，通过植入未知定理的实验测量归纳与合并多条笔记所能恢复的增益。

papers.title: Collect for Coverage, Replay with Evidence: Adaptive and Efficient On-Policy Distillation for Long-Horizon Agents
papers.abstract: Fully online on-policy distillation (OPD) is costly for long-horizon agents because each update depends on fresh environment rollouts. Prefix replay offers an efficient alternative by sampling current-student responses from stored histories, reducing idle time for long-tail rollouts and allowing each collected trajectory to support multiple updates. However, our analysis of the complete prefix replay pipeline identifies two limitations in long-horizon settings. In trajectory collection, teacher-only trajectories miss student-induced histories, while broader history coverage can reduce teacher reliability. In trajectory reuse, fixed position-based schedules cannot identify critical decisions that may occur at any trajectory depth. We introduce CARE-OPD (Collect for coverAge, Replay with Evidence) to address both limitations. Student-seeded teacher completions and response-level confidence gating expand history coverage while filtering unreliable updates. Hindsight replay allocation then uses downstream execution evidence to select consequential turns. Across long-horizon tasks Software Engineering and Deep Research, CARE-OPD outperforms online OPD and prior prefix replay baselines. On SWE-bench Verified, it raises task success to 59.5% while reducing end-to-end training time by 45% and environment actions by 44% relative to asynchronous online OPD.

translation.title: 为覆盖而收集，带证据回放：面向长程智能体的自适应高效在策略蒸馏
translation.abstract: 完全在线的在策略蒸馏（OPD）对长程智能体代价高昂，因为每次更新都依赖新鲜的环境rollout。前缀回放通过从存储历史中采样当前学生模型的响应提供了一种高效替代方案，减少了长尾rollout的空闲时间，并使每条收集的轨迹可支持多次更新。然而，我们对完整前缀回放管线的分析发现其在长程设置下的两个局限：在轨迹收集上，仅教师轨迹会遗漏学生引发的历史，而更广的历史覆盖会降低教师可靠性；在轨迹复用上，固定的基于位置的调度无法识别可能出现在轨迹任意深度的关键决策。我们提出CARE-OPD（Collect for coverAge, Replay with Evidence）来解决这两个局限。学生种子教师补全和响应级置信度门控在扩展历史覆盖的同时过滤不可靠更新；随后事后回放分配利用下游执行证据来选择关键回合。在软件工程和深度研究两个长程任务上，CARE-OPD优于在线OPD和先前的前缀回放基线。在SWE-bench Verified上，相比异步在线OPD，它将任务成功率提升至59.5%，同时将端到端训练时间减少45%、环境动作减少44%。
translation.brief: 针对长程智能体在策略蒸馏中轨迹覆盖不足与关键决策难以定位的问题，提出CARE-OPD，通过学生种子教师补全、置信度门控和基于下游证据的事后回放分配来提升效率与效果。

papers.title: One Model, Many Modes: Evolving System Prompt Ensembles for Creative Generation
papers.abstract: Preference-aligned LLMs can exhibit mode collapse, concentrating their output distributions around a narrow set of high-reward responses. This limits creative generation, which requires quality, novelty, and diversity. Existing test-time methods often emphasize diversity, giving less attention to whether individual responses are both high-quality and novel. This distinction matters in practical use, where users may seek a single compelling, original response. We formalize creative generation as a multi-objective distributional optimization problem and introduce SEPO, a training-free framework for System Prompt Ensemble Optimization. The framework combines prompt evolution with greedy max-min selection to identify behaviorally distinct system prompts under a quality constraint, then uniformly samples one prompt per response at inference time. Across four creative generation tasks with increasing quality requirements and three open-weight models, SEPO ranks first in 8 of 12 settings on the harmonic mean of quality, diversity, and novelty, while no baseline leads in more than two. On average, it raises LLM-judged diversity from 1.92 to 3.43 and novelty from 1.00 to 3.34 over base sampling (1-5 scale), with quality decreasing from 3.72 to 3.30. We further show that expanding the optimized ensemble increases separation among prompt-conditioned response distributions. These results support system prompt ensemble optimization as a promising approach to improving LLM creativity at inference time.

translation.title: 一个模型，多种模式：面向创意生成的系统提示词集成演化
translation.abstract: 偏好对齐的LLM可能出现模式坍缩，将输出分布集中在少数高奖励响应附近。这限制了需要质量、新颖性和多样性的创意生成。现有测试时方法往往偏重多样性，较少关注单个响应是否兼具高质量和新颖性。这一区分在实际使用中很重要，因为用户可能只想要一个引人注目的原创响应。我们将创意生成形式化为多目标分布优化问题，并提出SEPO——一个免训练的系统提示词集成优化框架。该框架将提示词演化与贪心max-min选择相结合，在质量约束下找出行为上各异的系统提示词，然后在推理时为每个响应均匀采样一个提示词。在四个质量要求递增的创意生成任务和三个开源权重模型上，SEPO在12个设置中的8个里以质量、多样性和新颖性的调和平均排名第一，而没有任何基线在超过两个设置中领先。平均而言，相比基础采样，它将LLM评判的多样性从1.92提升到3.43，新颖性从1.00提升到3.34（1–5分制），质量从3.72略降至3.30。我们进一步表明，扩大优化后的集成会增大不同提示词条件下响应分布之间的分离度。这些结果支持系统提示词集成优化作为在推理时提升LLM创造力的有前景方法。
translation.brief: 针对偏好对齐LLM的模式坍缩限制创意生成的问题，提出免训练的SEPO框架，通过提示词演化与贪心max-min选择构建系统提示词集成以兼顾质量、多样性与新颖性。

papers.title: TASK Memory: Beyond Text-Only Memory with Activation Steering and Knowledge Editing against Memory Hallucination
papers.abstract: LLM agents increasingly rely on external memory, yet they still hallucinate about what they remember. Often the correct memory is retrieved and placed in the prompt, but the answer contradicts it or the memory is applied to the wrong question. We call these use-time memory hallucinations. Across five open models, we find that they arise from the conflict between parametric knowledge and external memory and take three forms: memory-ignoring, where the model returns to a stale fact in its weights (up to 46% of queries); memory-misapplying, where it attributes the memory to unrelated entities (up to 24%, and 49% when retrieval is combined with weight editing); and version confusion, where 53% of answers about revised facts assert the superseded value when both versions remain stored. We propose TASK memory, which goes beyond text-only memory by combining a Text note with Activation Steering and Knowledge editing that share one in-model address. The text holds the content. A removable knowledge edit supplies the address through its subject key and supports multi-hop composition. A pair of steering vectors decides, query by query, whether the model adopts the memory or keeps its own answer; the vectors store no content and control how the text memory is used. On frozen models under a pre-registered, test-once protocol, TASK reduces memory-ignoring hallucinations to at most 1.5% in all ten model-dataset cells and cuts neighbour misuse from 39.2% to 7.5% (+10.8 pp composite on CounterFact). It improves a 300-memory library over BM25 RAG by 16.4 pp, an advantage that holds at 3,000 memories, resolves fact revisions without fact IDs, and adds 7.5 pp of multi-hop accuracy on MQuAKE. 21 of 23 cross-model comparisons (8B-27B, four families) are significant, and TASK beats three recent context-steering methods in 9 of 10 model-dataset cells.

translation.title: TASK Memory：超越纯文本记忆，用激活引导与知识编辑对抗记忆幻觉
translation.abstract: LLM智能体日益依赖外部记忆，但仍会对所记忆的内容产生幻觉。往往正确的记忆已被检索并放入提示中，但答案与之矛盾，或记忆被用在了错误的问题上。我们称之为使用时记忆幻觉。在五个开源模型上，我们发现它们源于参数知识与外部记忆的冲突，并呈现三种形式：记忆忽视——模型退回到权重中的过时事实（最多占46%的查询）；记忆误用——模型将记忆归于无关实体（最多24%，当检索与权重编辑结合时达49%）；版本混淆——当两个版本都存储时，53%关于已修订事实的回答断言被取代的旧值。我们提出TASK memory，通过共享同一模型内地址的文本笔记、激活引导和知识编辑，超越纯文本记忆。文本承载内容；一个可移除的知识编辑通过其主体键提供地址并支持多跳组合；一对引导向量逐查询决定模型是采纳记忆还是保留自己的答案，这些向量不存储内容，只控制文本记忆的使用方式。在预注册、单次测试的协议下对冻结模型，TASK在全部十个模型-数据集组合中将记忆忽视幻觉降至最多1.5%，并将邻居误用从39.2%降至7.5%（CounterFact上综合提升10.8个百分点）。相比BM25 RAG，它在300条记忆库上提升16.4个百分点，且该优势在3000条记忆时依然保持；无需事实ID即可解决事实修订问题，并在MQuAKE上增加7.5个百分点的多跳准确率。23个跨模型比较（8B–27B，四个模型族）中有21个显著，且TASK在10个模型-数据集组合中的9个上击败三种近期的上下文引导方法。
translation.brief: 针对LLM智能体使用外部记忆时的记忆幻觉问题，提出TASK memory，将文本笔记与激活引导向量及知识编辑结合，通过共享的模型内地址控制记忆的正确使用。

papers.title: Make the Adversary Spend More: Stateful Deception as a Cost-Exchange Primitive for AI-Era Cyber Defense
papers.abstract: Large language models (LLMs) are transforming the economics of intrusion by reducing the attacker's cost to scan and adapt, while tempting defenders into unbounded compute. We argue that cyber deception should be judged by the cost exchange it imposes, not by realism or detection, and that the primitive making that exchange favorable is adversary-specific persistent state. Rather than a honeypot that resets or merges sessions, each recognized adversary re-enters the world it believes it has compromised, kept coherent with its own past actions and isolated from every other adversary, while the language model acts only as a constrained renderer of explicit state, never as its store. We formalize the trade-off as a Deception Exchange Rate (DER), relating mission-weighted adversary effort burned to defender resources spent, and instantiate it in an SSH honeypot pairing Cowrie with a local LLM. In this paper, we focus on the defender-side evaluation of that exchange, while specifying, but not yet measuring, per-adversary state and the adversary side of the DER. Across five open-weight models, deterministic-layer and prompt optimizations cut per-session defender cost by around 63% against a naive all-LLM decoy.

translation.title: 让攻击者付出更多代价：作为AI时代网络防御成本交换原语的有状态欺骗
translation.abstract: 大语言模型（LLM）正在改变入侵的经济学，降低了攻击者扫描和适应的成本，同时诱使防御者陷入无限制的计算消耗。我们主张，网络欺骗应以它施加的成本交换来评判，而非以逼真度或检测能力，使这种交换有利的原语是针对特定攻击者的持久状态。不同于会重置或合并会话的蜜罐，每个被识别的攻击者重新进入它自认为已攻破的世界，该世界与其自身过去的行动保持一致，并与其他所有攻击者隔离，而语言模型仅作为显式状态的受限渲染器，绝不作为其存储。我们将这种权衡形式化为欺骗交换率（DER），将按任务加权的攻击者消耗与防御者资源支出关联起来，并在一个将Cowrie与本地LLM配对的SSH蜜罐中实例化。本文聚焦于该交换的防御方评估，同时规定但尚未测量针对每个攻击者的状态和DER的攻击方。在五个开源权重模型上，确定性层和提示词优化使每会话防御成本相比朴素的全LLM诱饵降低约63%。
translation.brief: 针对LLM降低攻击成本带来的防御困境，提出以攻击者特定的持久状态为核心的有状态欺骗原语，并以欺骗交换率（DER）形式化攻防成本权衡，在SSH蜜罐中实现约63%的防御成本削减。

papers.title: DFly2: Turbocharging Long-Context Speculative Decoding by Sharing the Target's Sparsity
papers.abstract: To avoid the quadratic cost of dense attention over long contexts, models such as DeepSeek-V4 and Hy4 have turned natively sparse, and speculative decoding, which matters most where decoding is slowest, increasingly runs on them. Their drafters, however, still keep a context cache of their own, over the whole prompt or a sliding window. Beyond memory, such a cache costs prefill time, prefix-cache hits and decode concurrency. Drafters that read the target's cache avoid one of their own, but settle only which cache, not which positions, and still read everything or a recent window. Neither rule is made for the query at hand, and computing a selection per query in the drafter would cost more as the context grows. Yet a natively sparse target already picks positions for each query, over a cache it keeps anyway. Both of the drafter's choices are therefore already made, and paid for, by the target: its cache and its selection. We measure how far one selection carries: made a step early, it still covers close to nine tenths of what each later token selects on DS-V4.1-Flash. We present DFly2, a block-parallel drafter that shares the target's sparsity. Each draft layer reads the KV its paired target layer cached (KV sharing), at the positions that layer's indexer selected, a fixed number anywhere in the context (Index sharing). DFly2 thus runs no scoring pass and keeps no cache of its own. On DS-V4.1-Flash, GLM-5.3-Flash and Hy4~flash, whose sparse attention and architecture differ, it accepts more tokens per step than DFlash and DSpark trained on the same recipe, over general, long-context and agentic benchmarks. Its margin over the stronger baseline widens from 3.9%-10.5% on general workloads to 10.0%-31.5% on long-context and agentic ones. At high concurrency on DS-V4.1-Flash, at matched per-user decode speed, its throughput is 62% and 81% higher on two 64K sets.

translation.title: DFly2：通过共享目标模型稀疏性加速长上下文投机解码
translation.abstract: 为避免长上下文上稠密注意力的二次方开销，DeepSeek-V4 和 Hy4 等模型已原生采用稀疏注意力，而投机解码在解码最慢的场景下最为关键，因此越来越多地运行在这类模型上。然而这些模型的 draft 模型仍维护自己的上下文缓存，要么覆盖整个 prompt，要么采用滑动窗口。除了内存开销外，这样的缓存还消耗 prefill 时间、影响 prefix-cache 命中率和解码并发度。读取目标模型缓存的 draft 模型可以省去自己的缓存，但只解决了用哪个缓存的问题，没有解决读哪些位置的问题，仍然读取全部内容或最近的窗口。这两种规则都不是为当前 query 量身定制的，而在 draft 模型中为每个 query 计算选择会随上下文增长而开销增大。然而，原生稀疏的目标模型已经为每个 query 在其本就维护的缓存上选好了位置。因此 draft 模型的两个选择——缓存和位置选择——都已由目标模型做出并支付了成本。我们测量了这种选择能延续多远：在 DS-V4.1-Flash 上，提前一步做出的选择仍能覆盖后续每个 token 所选位置的近九成。我们提出 DFly2，一个共享目标模型稀疏性的块并行 draft 模型。每个 draft 层读取其配对目标层缓存的 KV（KV sharing），位置由该层的 indexer 选出，数量固定且可位于上下文任意位置（Index sharing）。因此 DFly2 无需运行打分过程，也不维护自己的缓存。在稀疏注意力和架构各不相同的 DS-V4.1-Flash、GLM-5.3-Flash 和 Hy4~flash 上，与用相同配方训练的 DFlash 和 DSpark 相比，它在通用、长上下文和 agentic 基准上每步接受更多 token。相对更强基线的优势从通用负载上的 3.9%-10.5% 扩大到长上下文和 agentic 负载上的 10.0%-31.5%。在 DS-V4.1-Flash 高并发下，在匹配的单用户解码速度下，其在两个 64K 数据集上的吞吐量分别高出 62% 和 81%。
translation.brief: 解决长上下文原生稀疏模型上 draft 模型缓存与位置选择开销大的问题，核心方法是让 draft 模型直接共享目标模型的 KV 缓存及其 indexer 的位置选择。

papers.title: When Every Rollout Fails: Splicing Learner-Conditioned Options into Long-Horizon Agent RL
papers.abstract: Group-based reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards often yields all-fail groups on long-horizon agent tasks: every sampled trajectory receives zero reward, leaving group-relative methods without a reward-based policy gradient. A common remedy supplies complete solutions from a stronger model, but full trajectories are expensive and expose the learner to long off-policy histories. We introduce SPLICE, which constructs local training targets from failed current-policy trajectories online. For each all-fail group, a proposal model selects a splice point in a current-policy trajectory and generates several bounded options from that point. We estimate each option's value using repeated current-policy continuations, convert positive estimates into a return-weighted local target, and fit the current policy on the options. We evaluate SPLICE across two policy families on two long-horizon agent tasks, Software Engineering with SWE-bench Verified and Deep Research with BrowseComp-Plus. SPLICE outperforms GRPO and full-trajectory guidance baselines in all four settings, improving over GRPO by 2.8--9.8 percentage points. On initially failed SWE tasks, it raises GRPO's graduation rate by 10.8 percentage points. Further experiments show that SPLICE improves performance while reducing costly proposal-model computation.

translation.title: 当所有 rollout 都失败时：将学习者条件化的 options 拼接进长程 Agent RL
translation.abstract: 基于可验证奖励的分组强化学习在长程 agent 任务上常产生全失败组：每条采样轨迹的奖励均为零，使组相对方法失去基于奖励的策略梯度。一种常见补救措施是从更强的模型提供完整解法，但完整轨迹代价高昂，且使学习者暴露于漫长的 off-policy 历史中。我们提出 SPLICE，在线地从失败的当前策略轨迹中构造局部训练目标。对每个全失败组，一个 proposal 模型在当前策略轨迹中选择一个拼接点，并从该点生成若干有界的 options。我们用当前策略的多次重复续写估计每个 option 的价值，将正估计转换为按回报加权的局部目标，并在这些 options 上拟合当前策略。我们在两个策略家族、两个长程 agent 任务上评估 SPLICE：基于 SWE-bench Verified 的软件工程和基于 BrowseComp-Plus 的 Deep Research。SPLICE 在全部四个设置中优于 GRPO 和完整轨迹引导基线，比 GRPO 提升 2.8-9.8 个百分点。在初始失败的 SWE 任务上，它将 GRPO 的毕业率提高 10.8 个百分点。进一步实验表明 SPLICE 在提升性能的同时减少了昂贵的 proposal 模型计算。
translation.brief: 解决长程 agent RL 中全失败组无奖励梯度的问题，核心方法是在线从失败轨迹中拼接 proposal 模型生成的局部 options 并用当前策略续写估计其价值作为训练目标。

papers.title: SceneDesigner3D: Agentic Evolutionary Search for Principled Rearrangement of 3D Indoor Scenes
papers.abstract: Scene rearrangement is an essential task for 3D content creation applications, requiring generation of diverse, aesthetic and functional scene rearrangements. We present SceneDesigner3D, an agentic evolutionary search method for 3D indoor scene rearrangement that systematically explores the design space of 3D scenes and generates multiple solutions according to common interior design principles. Given an input scene and a text prompt, SceneDesigner3D represents the rearrangement as an editable program and evolves a population of candidate layouts. Starting from distinct design ideas, a VLM agent mutates the programs by refining promising candidates, exploring new rearrangement strategies or redesigning from scratch, while verifying the layouts for physical validity. Proposals are scored by a VLM judge for adherence to the input prompt and satisfaction of design principles such as balance, zoning and emphasis, as well as numerically computed principles such as circulation and clutter. An archive of top-performing, structurally varied candidates further increases diversity of rearrangements. Experiments on the SAGE-10k and SceneSmith datasets show that SceneDesigner3D improves prompt adherence and computed design principle scores over baselines by up to 5.1% and 15.2%, respectively. Code will be made publicly available.

translation.title: SceneDesigner3D：面向有原则的 3D 室内场景重排的 Agentic 进化搜索
translation.abstract: 场景重排是 3D 内容创作应用中的一项重要任务，需要生成多样、美观且实用的场景重排方案。我们提出 SceneDesigner3D，一种用于 3D 室内场景重排的 agentic 进化搜索方法，它系统地探索 3D 场景的设计空间，并依据常见的室内设计原则生成多个解决方案。给定输入场景和文本 prompt，SceneDesigner3D 将重排表示为可编辑的程序，并进化一个候选布局种群。从不同的设计想法出发，VLM agent 通过改进有前景的候选、探索新的重排策略或从头重新设计来变异程序，同时验证布局的物理有效性。提案由 VLM judge 依据对输入 prompt 的遵循度以及平衡、分区、强调等设计原则的满足度进行评分，同时也评估动线和杂乱度等可数值计算的原则。一个保存表现最佳且结构多样候选的档案库进一步增加了重排的多样性。在 SAGE-10k 和 SceneSmith 数据集上的实验表明，SceneDesigner3D 在 prompt 遵循度和可计算设计原则得分上分别比基线提升最高 5.1% 和 15.2%。代码将公开发布。
translation.brief: 解决 3D 室内场景重排中生成多样且符合设计原则方案的问题，核心方法是将重排表示为可编辑程序并用 VLM agent 驱动的进化搜索进行变异与评分。

papers.title: PersonaFactory: Stylistic User Prompt Augmentation with Synthetic Persona Bank
papers.abstract: Large language models increasingly replace real people in the AI development pipeline, as they are used to generate training dialogues at scale and to drive alignment and evaluation. However, out-of-the-box models produce monolingual and stylistically flat texts as synthetic user prompts, failing to replicate the real user-AI communication mechanics. We present PersonaFactory, an end-to-end pipeline that generates detailed user personas and uses them to augment existing user prompts from their point of view, producing a bank of over 740000 structured synthetic personas detailing their background and communication behaviors, and a corpus of roughly 1.24 million persona-styled synthetic conversations spanning 85 languages. We evaluate the effect of personal features on style adoption and intent preservation, using an LLM-judge and heuristic metrics to assess augmentation fidelity together with the downstream impact on assistant persona control through training data. Results show that our structured, attribute-based style representation enables per-axis control and better intent preservation at comparable style fidelity than free-text persona descriptions used in existing methods. A human expert evaluation found the augmented conversations plausible, with favorable ratings for intent preservation, style naturalness, and multilingual authenticity. Finally, PersonaFactory conversations achieve comparable performance to original training data on capability benchmarks, are preferred on real user prompts at equal reply length, and adapt their reply style more closely to users without explicit steering.

translation.title: PersonaFactory：基于合成 Persona 库的风格化用户 prompt 增强
translation.abstract: 大语言模型越来越多地在 AI 开发流程中替代真人，被用于大规模生成训练对话以及驱动对齐和评估。然而，开箱即用的模型生成的合成用户 prompt 是单语且风格平淡的文本，无法复现真实的用户-AI 交流机制。我们提出 PersonaFactory，一个端到端流水线，它生成详细的用户 persona 并从其视角增强现有用户 prompt，产出一个包含超过 74 万个结构化合成 persona 的库（详述其背景和交流行为），以及一个涵盖 85 种语言、约 124 万段 persona 风格化合成对话的语料库。我们评估个人特征对风格采纳和意图保留的影响，使用 LLM-judge 和启发式指标评估增强保真度，以及通过训练数据对助手 persona 控制的下游影响。结果表明，与现有方法使用的自由文本 persona 描述相比，我们基于属性的结构化风格表示在相当的风格保真度下实现了逐轴控制和更好的意图保留。人类专家评估认为增强后的对话可信，在意图保留、风格自然度和多语言真实性上获得好评。最后，PersonaFactory 对话在能力基准上达到与原始训练数据相当的性能，在相同回复长度下于真实用户 prompt 上更受偏好，并且无需显式引导就能使回复风格更贴近用户。
translation.brief: 解决合成用户 prompt 风格单一、缺乏真实用户多样性的问题，核心方法是构建大规模结构化合成 persona 库并据此对用户 prompt 进行风格化增强。

papers.title: Solve Vision with Code: Coding Agents Are Stronger Visual Reasoners Than Video Models
papers.abstract: Video generation models are increasingly evaluated as visual reasoners: given a first frame and a natural-language prompt, can the model produce the video in which the specified task is carried out? The paradigm is considered advantageous because the reasoning is native to the visual medium, unfolding directly in the frames rather than through language or code. Whether this native route is in fact the more reliable path to visual reasoning has not been tested against a symbolic alternative under the same conditions. We therefore pose the same tasks, with identical inputs, output specification and evaluator, to both media: rather than denoising pixels, a coding agent writes a program that renders the answer video, which an unmodified rule-based evaluator scores. On VBVR-Pro-Bench (Xu et al., 2026), a 500-instance suite spanning five cognitive categories with symbolic ground truth, the agent receives the same first frame and prompt as the video model, with no access to ground truth, metadata or generation models, and one attempt per instance. Three closed-model agents (Codex with gpt-6-astra, Claude Code with Fable 5.1 and Gemini CLI with Gemini 3.1 Pro) score 0.923, 0.894 and 0.893, each more than 0.22 above the strongest video model. Among 23 runnable open-weight models, the best, GLM-5, reaches 0.572, above all video models except the RL-trained one. Together, we show that for tasks whose solutions can be computed from a first frame and a prompt, program synthesis is currently a substantially more reliable route to visual reasoning than video generation. We further distinguish depictive programs, which navigate the image to recover a transferable scheme, from propositional programs, which operate on hard-coded values, revealing how visual reasoning unfolds in agent-written programs and what it implies for its nature of reasoning in general.

translation.title: 用代码解决视觉问题：编码 Agent 是比视频模型更强的视觉推理器
translation.abstract: 视频生成模型越来越多地被作为视觉推理器来评估：给定第一帧和自然语言 prompt，模型能否生成执行指定任务的视频？该范式被认为具有优势，因为推理是视觉媒介原生的，直接在帧中展开，而非通过语言或代码。然而这种原生路径是否确实是更可靠的视觉推理途径，尚未在相同条件下与符号化替代方案进行过对比。因此，我们以相同的输入、输出规范和评估器，向两种媒介提出相同的任务：编码 agent 不是对像素去噪，而是编写一个程序来渲染答案视频，再由未经修改的基于规则的评估器打分。在 VBVR-Pro-Bench（Xu et al., 2026）——一个包含 500 个实例、覆盖五个认知类别且具有符号化 ground truth 的测试套件——上，agent 与视频模型接收相同的第一帧和 prompt，无法访问 ground truth、元数据或生成模型，每个实例只有一次尝试。三个闭源模型 agent（Codex 搭配 gpt-6-astra、Claude Code 搭配 Fable 5.1 和 Gemini CLI 搭配 Gemini 3.1 Pro）分别得分 0.923、0.894 和 0.893，每个都比最强的视频模型高出 0.22 以上。在 23 个可运行的开源权重模型中，最好的 GLM-5 达到 0.572，超过除经 RL 训练的那个之外的所有视频模型。综上，我们表明对于可从第一帧和 prompt 计算出解的任务，程序合成目前是比视频生成可靠得多的视觉推理途径。我们进一步区分了描绘性程序（在图像中导航以恢复可迁移的方案）和命题性程序（操作硬编码的值），揭示了视觉推理在 agent 编写的程序中如何展开，以及这对推理本质的普遍启示。
translation.brief: 解决视频生成模型是否是可靠视觉推理途径的问题，核心方法是在相同任务与评估条件下对比编码 agent 的程序合成与视频生成模型的表现。

papers.title: Deep Reinforcement Learning for Multi-UAV Data Harvesting Under Variable Team Sizes and Agent Loss
papers.abstract: Collecting data from wireless sensors can be challenging when limited communication infrastructure prevents them from offloading their measurements. In such settings, unmanned aerial vehicles (UAVs) can exploit their mobility to harvest data locally, while coordinated UAV teams can provide efficient and redundant coverage of remote areas. Multi-agent reinforcement learning (MARL) enables such teams to learn decentralized coordination policies. However, training separate policies for different team and sensor populations is costly, and fixed-population policies may be vulnerable to agent failures. This work proposes F-MADDPG, a flexible variant of Multi-Agent Deep Deterministic Policy Gradient (MADDPG) that supports data harvesting with varying numbers of wireless sensors and UAVs. The framework also accommodates unexpected catastrophic failures that permanently remove agents during a mission. We compare F-MADDPG with a MADDPG baseline that uses multilayer perceptrons (MLPs) and evaluate training strategies based on team-size sampling and exposure to agent terminations. The results show that F-MADDPG learns across the evaluated population sizes, completes missions faster than the baseline on average, benefits from inverse-cardinality team-size sampling compared with uniform sampling, remains effective after permanent agent losses, and gains no consistent benefit from exposure to failures during training.

translation.title: 面向可变团队规模与智能体丢失的多无人机数据收集深度强化学习
translation.abstract: 当通信基础设施受限导致无线传感器无法上传测量数据时，无人机（UAV）可利用其机动性就地收集数据，而协同的无人机团队可对偏远地区提供高效且冗余的覆盖。多智能体强化学习（MARL）使这类团队能够学习去中心化的协调策略。然而，为不同的团队和传感器规模分别训练策略代价高昂，且固定规模的策略在智能体失效时可能十分脆弱。本工作提出F-MADDPG，一种多智能体深度确定性策略梯度（MADDPG）的灵活变体，支持无线传感器和无人机数量可变的数据收集。该框架还能应对任务期间永久移除智能体的意外灾难性故障。我们将F-MADDPG与使用多层感知机（MLP）的MADDPG基线进行比较，并评估基于团队规模采样和智能体终止暴露的训练策略。结果表明，F-MADDPG能在所评估的各规模下学习，平均比基线更快完成任务，相比均匀采样受益于逆基数团队规模采样，在智能体永久丢失后仍保持有效，且训练中暴露于故障并未带来一致收益。
translation.brief: 针对无人机数量与传感器规模可变且智能体可能永久失效的数据收集问题，提出支持可变团队规模的F-MADDPG灵活MARL算法并结合团队规模采样策略进行训练。

papers.title: VulnSafe: Measuring Vulnerability-Aware Relational Safety in Large Language Models
papers.abstract: Emotionally supportive interactions require large language models not only to avoid overtly harmful content, but also to recognize vulnerability-related risk, regulate their relational stance, preserve user agency, and provide context-appropriate support. Existing safety benchmarks often measure isolated violations, leaving unclear what underlying response competence their scores represent. We introduce VulnSafe, a Chinese capability assessment centered on Vulnerability-Aware Response Competence (VARC). VARC organizes relational safety into five complementary constructs: Risk Perception, Safety Preservation, Autonomy Protection, Supportive Response, and Boundary Management. Following an evidence-centered design, 41 scenarios elicit construct-relevant behavior through 2,050 balanced prompts and scenario-specific scoring rubrics. The assessment further separates proactive should-do behavior from prohibitive should-not behavior. Across eight representative LLMs, results show distinct competence profiles and larger disparities than prohibitive requirements. VulnSafe therefore makes relational safety interpretable as a multidimensional model capability rather than as refusal compliance alone.

translation.title: VulnSafe：度量大型语言模型中脆弱性感知的关系安全
translation.abstract: 情感支持型交互要求大型语言模型不仅避免明显有害内容，还要识别与脆弱性相关的风险、调节其关系立场、保护用户自主性并提供符合情境的支持。现有安全基准往往只度量孤立的违规行为，其分数所代表的底层响应能力并不清晰。我们提出VulnSafe，一个以脆弱性感知响应能力（VARC）为核心的中文能力评估。VARC将关系安全组织为五个互补构念：风险感知、安全维护、自主性保护、支持性响应和边界管理。遵循以证据为中心的设计，41个场景通过2,050个平衡的提示词和场景专属评分细则引出与构念相关的行为。该评估进一步区分了主动的应做行为与禁止性的不应做行为。在八个代表性LLM上的结果显示出明显不同的能力画像，且在应做要求上的差距大于禁止性要求。因此，VulnSafe使关系安全成为可解释的多维模型能力，而不仅仅是拒绝合规。
translation.brief: 针对现有安全基准无法刻画LLM关系安全底层能力的问题，构建了基于五维VARC构念的中文能力评估基准VulnSafe。

papers.title: The Linguistic Knowledge Benchmark: Do Language Models Know the Foundations of Early-Grade Literacy?
papers.abstract: Many languages of instruction in low- and middle-income countries (LMICs) are poorly represented in the data used to train language models. Before these models can support early-grade literacy in such languages, we need to know whether they hold the linguistic knowledge of each language that literacy teaching relies on. To test this, we present the Linguistic Knowledge Benchmark and the reproducible, largely automated pipeline that turns curriculum documents, teacher guides and pupil books into a vetted question set organised on a fixed grid of nine linguistic domains and seven grade levels. The pipeline combines LLM-driven source survey, feature consolidation, item generation and quality control with an item-selection step inspired by item response theory and a final expert review. We instantiate it for Kiswahili (Kenya; 135 items) and English (United Kingdom; 137 items) and evaluate 121 and 119 models respectively. Frontier models exceed 90% accuracy in both languages, but accuracy falls steeply for smaller and cheaper models, and more so in Kiswahili. The two best models under 10 billion parameters reach 91.7% and 73.0% in English but only 51.9% and 40.7% in Kiswahili, and the mean accuracy of models deployable on mobile and tablet hardware is 47% in English against 24% in Kiswahili. The models most practical for low-resource classrooms are therefore the least capable in the languages they would serve. We release a 20-item sample per language, all pipeline prompts, open-source code, and a public leaderboard. This is the first rung of a three-level evaluation ladder for measuring and generating decodable text to support foundational literacy.

translation.title: 语言知识基准：语言模型是否掌握早期年级识字教学的基础知识？
translation.abstract: 中低收入国家（LMIC）的许多教学语言在用于训练语言模型的数据中代表性不足。在这些模型能够支持此类语言的早期年级识字教学之前，我们需要知道它们是否掌握识字教学所依赖的各语言的语言学知识。为此，我们提出语言知识基准以及一个可复现、高度自动化的流水线，将课程文件、教师指南和学生用书转化为按九个语言学领域和七个年级水平的固定网格组织的、经过审核的题集。该流水线结合了LLM驱动的源材料调研、特征整合、题目生成与质量控制，并辅以受项目反应理论启发的选题步骤和最终专家评审。我们为Kiswahili（肯尼亚；135题）和英语（英国；137题）实例化该流水线，分别评估了121和119个模型。前沿模型在两种语言中均超过90%的准确率，但较小、较便宜模型的准确率急剧下降，在Kiswahili上尤为明显。两个最佳的百亿参数以下模型在英语中分别达到91.7%和73.0%，但在Kiswahili中仅为51.9%和40.7%；可部署于手机和平板硬件的模型平均准确率在英语中为47%，在Kiswahili中仅为24%。因此，最适合低资源课堂的模型恰恰在其应服务的语言上能力最弱。我们发布了每种语言20题的样本、全部流水线提示词、开源代码和公开排行榜。这是用于度量并生成可解码文本以支持基础识字教育的三级评估阶梯的第一级。
translation.brief: 针对语言模型是否掌握低资源教学语言的识字教学基础知识缺乏评估手段的问题，构建了自动化流水线生成语言学知识题集并大规模评测各规模模型。

papers.title: Routeability Before Routing: Routeability Audit Protocol (RAP) and RouteabilityBench for Audited LLM Model Selection
papers.abstract: LLM routing aims to choose, for each prompt, which model in a portfolio is most likely to answer correctly. This only makes sense when the benchmark contains enough prompt-specific variation for different models to be best on different inputs. On coarse-scored LLM benchmarks, however, many models often tie for the best score, and the single best model may already leave little room for improvement. We therefore propose a routeability-first audit, instantiated as RAP and RouteabilityBench, a runnable claim-verification package. The audit is retrospective: it runs once the benchmark-portfolio score matrix exists and before router comparisons are interpreted as general evidence, rather than certifying a portfolio that has not yet been evaluated. Across four benchmarks and 66 LLMs, generic routing enhancements such as larger embedding sets, dimensionality reduction, selective abstention, clustering, and stronger regressors do not consistently outperform the single best model. The clearest positive evidence is concentrated in portfolio-dependent Omni-MATH settings, while GPQA, MMLU-Pro, and IFEval show different ways in which routing can remain hard or predictor-sensitive. Our practical recommendation is that routing gains should be reported together with routeability diagnostics, tied-best analysis, portfolio construction details, and family-corrected statistical tests.

translation.title: 先审计可路由性再路由：用于经审计LLM模型选择的路由性审计协议（RAP）与RouteabilityBench
translation.abstract: LLM路由旨在为每个提示词选择组合中最有可能正确作答的模型。这只有在基准包含足够的提示词级差异、使不同模型在不同输入上各有所长时才有意义。然而在粗粒度评分的LLM基准上，许多模型常常并列最高分，且单一最佳模型可能已几乎没有提升空间。因此我们提出以可路由性为先的审计，实例化为RAP和RouteabilityBench，一个可运行的声明验证包。该审计是回溯性的：它在基准-模型组合得分矩阵生成之后、在将路由器比较解读为一般性证据之前运行，而非为尚未评估的组合颁发认证。在四个基准和66个LLM上，诸如更大嵌入集、降维、选择性弃答、聚类和更强回归器等通用路由增强并未持续优于单一最佳模型。最明确的正面证据集中在依赖组合的Omni-MATH设置中，而GPQA、MMLU-Pro和IFEval则展示了路由保持困难或对预测器敏感的不同方式。我们的实践建议是：报告路由收益时应同时附上可路由性诊断、并列最佳分析、组合构建细节以及经家族校正的统计检验。
translation.brief: 针对LLM路由研究缺乏对基准是否真正存在路由空间的审计问题，提出回溯式的可路由性审计协议RAP与RouteabilityBench以规范路由收益的评估与报告。

papers.title: Provably Efficient Offline Discounted Reinforcement Learning under Recursive Entropic Risk
papers.abstract: We study risk-sensitive reinforcement learning in finite discounted infinite-horizon Markov Decision Processes with recursive entropic risk measures (ERM), parameterized by $\beta\neq 0$. We consider both risk-averse ($\beta>0$) and risk-seeking ($\beta<0$) settings. We consider the offline RL setting, where the agent is provided with a fixed dataset and wishes to learn a near-optimal policy using this dataset. We introduce a model-based algorithm, called ERM Value Iteration Lower Confidence Bound (ERM-VI-LCB) and derive a PAC-type bound on its sample complexity. We also establish a corresponding lower bound, demonstrating that exponential dependence on $|\beta|/(1-\gamma)$ asserted by the upper bound is unavoidable in the worst case. The presented bounds provide the first rigorous sample complexity guarantees for offline RL under recursive ERM across both risk-averse and risk-seeking regimes.

translation.title: 递归熵风险下可证明高效的离线折扣强化学习
translation.abstract: 我们研究在有限折扣无限时域马尔可夫决策过程（MDP）中以递归熵风险度量（ERM）为风险准则、参数为$\beta\neq 0$的风险敏感强化学习。我们同时考虑风险厌恶（$\beta>0$）和风险寻求（$\beta<0$）两种设定。我们考虑离线RL设定，即智能体获得一个固定数据集，并希望利用该数据集学习近最优策略。我们提出一种基于模型的算法，称为ERM值迭代下置信界（ERM-VI-LCB），并推导出其样本复杂度的PAC型界。我们还建立了相应的下界，证明上界所断言的关于$|\beta|/(1-\gamma)$的指数依赖在最坏情况下不可避免。所给出的界为递归ERM下离线RL在风险厌恶和风险寻求两种情形提供了首个严格的样本复杂度保证。
translation.brief: 针对递归熵风险下离线强化学习缺乏样本复杂度理论保证的问题，提出ERM-VI-LCB算法并给出匹配的PAC型上下界。

papers.title: Put the World Back: Timestamps Matter in Time Series Reasoning
papers.abstract: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly applied to time series reasoning. However, current evaluations often give models events in chronological order and already matched to the time series. This makes it unclear whether models use timestamps to connect events with observations or simply take shortcuts. To expose this ambiguity, we reformulate time series reasoning from a world-to-series projection perspective, viewing timestamps as explicit indices that connect numerical observations and external events to shared world states. We identify three structures that timestamps can make explicit: temporal causal structure, time semantics, and event-series alignment. Building on this perspective, we develop a diagnostic protocol that distinguishes timestamp-grounded reasoning from correlational shortcuts, a distinction that accuracy-based benchmarks cannot make. Controlled interventions on 310 questions from two tasks show that high accuracy can persist when timestamps are replaced by relative offsets or removed, while breaking event-series alignment induces systematic failures. When context is pre-aligned, models barely need timestamps. When order is missing, they use dates to recall world knowledge. Without dates, they rely on correlational shortcuts and rarely notice incorrect timestamps. These findings show that high accuracy on pre-aligned, ordered inputs does not establish that a model uses timestamps to synchronize observations with the world. We release our code, model outputs, and trajectory labels at this https URL.

translation.title: 把世界放回来：时间戳在时间序列推理中的重要性
translation.abstract: 大语言模型（LLM）越来越多地被应用于时间序列推理。然而，当前的评估通常按时间顺序向模型提供事件，且事件已与时间序列预先对齐。这使得我们无法判断模型究竟是利用时间戳将事件与观测联系起来，还是仅仅走了捷径。为揭示这一模糊性，我们从“世界到序列投影”的视角重新表述时间序列推理，将时间戳视为显式索引，把数值观测和外部事件连接到共享的世界状态。我们识别出时间戳可以显式化的三种结构：时间因果结构、时间语义以及事件-序列对齐。基于这一视角，我们开发了一套诊断协议，用以区分基于时间戳的推理与相关性捷径——这一区分是基于准确率的基准无法做到的。对来自两个任务的310个问题的受控干预实验表明：当时间戳被替换为相对偏移或被移除时，高准确率仍可保持；而破坏事件-序列对齐则会引发系统性失败。当上下文预先对齐时，模型几乎不需要时间戳；当顺序缺失时，模型利用日期来回忆世界知识；而没有日期时，模型依赖相关性捷径，且很少注意到错误的时间戳。这些发现表明，在预先对齐、有序输入上的高准确率并不能证明模型利用时间戳将观测与世界同步。我们在该网址发布了代码、模型输出和轨迹标签。
translation.brief: 针对现有评估无法判断LLM是否真正利用时间戳连接事件与时间序列的问题，提出从世界到序列投影的视角和诊断协议，通过受控干预区分基于时间戳的推理与相关性捷径。

papers.title: Real2SimLab: A Unified Platform for Real-to-Simulation Transfer
papers.abstract: Real-to-simulation transfer, which builds simulations from real-world observations, has long been studied in research and industry. Recently, coding agents have become capable of generating simulation programs from video recordings, and several benchmarks have been proposed to evaluate them. However, each individual benchmark defines its own inputs, deliverables, and scoring pipeline. This leads to $N \times M$ integrations when evaluating $N$ methods on $M$ benchmarks. To this end, we present Real2SimLab, a unified platform for real-to-simulation transfer. It evaluates a method by running its written program and scoring the output simulation with the original scorer of each benchmark. Moreover, Real2SimLab provides a pipeline to create training data and reward annotations for real-to-simulation methods. Our pipeline carefully avoids data contamination by filtering out the video recordings that exist in benchmarks. For each video recording, a program is first produced, and then our pipeline computes its reward with the same code that Real2SimLab uses for evaluation. So far, it supports 47 coding agents and 5 non-agent methods on 6 benchmarks. Both the platform and Awesome-Real2Sim, our research map of nearly 300 real-to-simulation papers, are open source, and we invite the Real2SimHub community to build them together.

translation.title: Real2SimLab：面向真实到仿真迁移的统一平台
translation.abstract: 真实到仿真迁移，即从真实世界观测构建仿真，长期以来在学术界和工业界被广泛研究。近来，编码智能体已能根据视频录像生成仿真程序，并出现了若干评估它们的基准。然而，每个基准都定义了自己的输入、交付物和评分流程，导致在M个基准上评估N个方法时需要N×M次集成。为此，我们提出Real2SimLab，一个面向真实到仿真迁移的统一平台。它通过运行方法所编写的程序，并使用各基准原有的评分器对输出仿真进行评分来评估方法。此外，Real2SimLab还提供了一条流水线，用于为真实到仿真方法创建训练数据和奖励标注。该流水线通过过滤掉基准中已有的视频录像，谨慎地避免数据污染。对于每段视频录像，先生成程序，再用与Real2SimLab评估相同的代码计算其奖励。目前，该平台支持6个基准上的47个编码智能体和5个非智能体方法。平台以及我们整理的涵盖近300篇真实到仿真论文的研究图谱Awesome-Real2Sim均已开源，我们邀请Real2SimHub社区共同建设。
translation.brief: 针对各真实到仿真基准各自定义输入与评分流程导致N×M集成负担的问题，提出统一平台Real2SimLab，用各基准原生评分器统一评估方法并提供防污染的训练数据与奖励标注流水线。

papers.title: DRBench Pro: A Knowledge-Centric Benchmark for Professional Deep Research Agents
papers.abstract: Deep research agents gather information from multiple sources and synthesize it into reports on complex, open-ended questions. Existing benchmarks assess report quality along several dimensions, but lack a dedicated knowledge-centric evaluation of which research directions a report covers and how deeply it explores them. We introduce DRBench Pro, a benchmark that makes structured knowledge coverage the primary evaluation target. Our automated pipeline builds local knowledge trees from Wikipedia and uses sampled subgraphs to generate research queries and evidence-grounded rubrics. Each rubric corresponds to a relation in the tree, preserving the structure of the knowledge being evaluated. Agents receive only the research query. This structure allows us to measure breadth across major research directions and depth along related knowledge chains, with their geometric mean giving overall coverage. The benchmark includes 144 cases across 24 domains and 44,102 rubrics. Evaluating 16 deep research agents reveals different strengths in breadth and depth, with the best-performing agent reaching 57.04% overall coverage. Rubric judgments agree closely with human annotations, and agent rankings remain stable across the tested metric configurations.

translation.title: DRBench Pro：面向专业深度研究智能体的以知识为中心的基准
translation.abstract: 深度研究智能体从多个来源收集信息，并将其综合成针对复杂、开放式问题的报告。现有基准从多个维度评估报告质量，但缺乏以知识为中心的专门评估，即报告涵盖了哪些研究方向以及探索得有多深入。我们提出DRBench Pro，一个将结构化知识覆盖度作为首要评估目标的基准。我们的自动化流水线从Wikipedia构建本地知识树，并利用采样的子图生成研究查询和基于证据的评分细则（rubric）。每条评分细则对应知识树中的一条关系，从而保留被评估知识的结构。智能体只收到研究查询。这一结构使我们能够衡量跨主要研究方向的广度以及沿相关知识链的深度，二者的几何平均数给出总体覆盖率。该基准包含24个领域的144个案例和44,102条评分细则。对16个深度研究智能体的评估揭示了它们在广度和深度上的不同优势，表现最佳的智能体达到57.04%的总体覆盖率。评分细则的判定与人工标注高度一致，且智能体排名在所测试的指标配置下保持稳定。
translation.brief: 针对现有基准缺乏对研究报告知识覆盖广度与深度的专门评估的问题，提出DRBench Pro，通过从Wikipedia构建知识树自动生成查询与证据支撑的评分细则来衡量知识覆盖度。

papers.title: A Survey of Security, Privacy, and Ethics of Large Language Models in Telecom
papers.abstract: Large Language Models (LLMs) are increasingly integrated into telecommunications for customer service, network analytics, and operational support. While offering efficiency and innovation, their deployment raises critical privacy, security, and ethical challenges due to the uniquely sensitive and longitudinal nature of telecom data. This paper presents a survey of LLM risks and safeguards in telecom context. Our survey introduces a telecom-specific taxonomy linking privacy, security, and ethics with use cases and outlines open research challenges such as longitudinal data privacy, cross-border compliance, and scalable guardrails.

translation.title: 电信领域大语言模型的安全、隐私与伦理综述
translation.abstract: 大语言模型（LLM）正日益被集成到电信领域的客户服务、网络分析和运营支持中。在带来效率与创新的同时，由于电信数据独特的敏感性和长期性，其部署引发了严峻的隐私、安全和伦理挑战。本文对电信场景下LLM的风险与防护措施进行了综述。我们的综述提出了一个电信专用分类法，将隐私、安全与伦理同具体用例相关联，并概述了长期数据隐私、跨境合规和可扩展防护栏等开放研究挑战。
translation.brief: 针对电信场景中LLM部署带来的隐私、安全与伦理风险缺乏系统梳理的问题，提出电信专用分类法并概述开放研究挑战。

papers.title: Shape-Aware Three-Way Merge for RDF Knowledge Graphs: The schema defines the conflict: an implementation and evaluation
papers.abstract: Merging RDF serializations creates ordering conflicts and misses semantic ones. We describe and evaluate a three-way merge in which the schema defines a conflict: set algebra combines canonical triples, and a slot is contended only where a SHACL shape bounds its cardinality and both sides' changes cannot stand within that bound. Unbounded predicates union; contended slots go to a person. The same shapes graph validates the result. We do not claim the first three-way merge for RDF. Our contribution is an implementation in a production multi-agent store and an evaluation against a reimplementation of Quit Store's Context Merge overlap rule, which it extends rather than replaces, and six other strategies. Across five synthetic seeds, the shape-aware operator raised 33 conflicts, all true positives as judged by the same shapes that define them, with no triples lost or fabricated and no SHACL violations admitted. The context-overlap baseline, counted per slot, detected the same 33 conflicts but asked 845 questions. A replay built from recorded production incidents covers 105 human alias repairs (93 after excluding 12 chained pairs) and 939 duplicate-value incidents. It reproduces a triple-level limit: different names for one entity remain invisible (0 of 93 alias repairs detected, matching 0 of 21 synthetic cases). In a study of evolving shape contracts, merging shape declarations first handles the tested cardinality changes, while datatype evolution exposes a detector blind spot caught by post-merge validation. An oracle that reads no shapes agrees with the shipped operator on the facts and history of all 23 reachable single-slot cases. Under wrong shapes, a missing bound loses data silently and a spurious one only adds questions. The supported claim is fewer human decisions with nothing silently lost, for cardinality conflicts in one deployment, not general merge correctness.

translation.title: 面向RDF知识图谱的形状感知三方合并：模式定义冲突——一个实现与评估
translation.abstract: 合并RDF序列化会产生顺序冲突并遗漏语义冲突。我们描述并评估了一种以模式定义冲突的三方合并方法：用集合代数合并规范化三元组，仅当SHACL形状约束了某个槽的基数且双方修改无法同时满足该约束时，该槽才被视为有争议。无界谓词取并集；有争议的槽交由人来裁决。同一shapes图用于验证合并结果。我们并不声称是首个针对RDF的三方合并。我们的贡献是在一个生产级多智能体存储中的实现，以及针对Quit Store的Context Merge重叠规则（我们对其扩展而非替代）的重新实现和其他六种策略的评估。在五个合成种子上，形状感知算子提出了33个冲突，按定义它们的相同形状判断全部为真阳性，没有三元组丢失或伪造，也没有引入SHACL违规。按槽计数的上下文重叠基线检测到了相同的33个冲突，但提出了845个问题。基于生产事故记录构建的重放涵盖105次人工别名修复（排除12对链式后为93次）和939起重复值事故。它复现了一个三元组层面的局限：同一实体的不同名称仍然不可见（93次别名修复中检测到0次，21个合成案例中匹配0次）。在一项关于演化形状契约的研究中，先合并形状声明可以处理所测试的基数变化，而数据类型演化则暴露了一个检测盲点，需靠合并后验证来捕获。一个不读取任何形状的预言机在所有23个可达的单槽案例的事实与历史上与所交付的算子一致。在形状错误的情况下，缺失的约束会静默丢失数据，而多余的约束只会增加问题。所支持的论断是：在单一部署中针对基数冲突，减少人工决策且不静默丢失任何内容，而非一般性的合并正确性。
translation.brief: 针对RDF三方合并中顺序冲突误报和语义冲突遗漏的问题，提出由SHACL形状定义冲突的合并方法，仅对基数受限且双方修改不可共存的槽请求人工裁决。

papers.title: How Much Do Coding Agents Over-Edit, and Why? An Empirical Study of Unneeded Edits in Repository-Level Agent Patches
papers.abstract: Agent patches are larger than developers', which is widely read as over-editing. But patch size does not say whether the extra edits are needed, what they are, or where they come from. We introduce Delta Residue Attribution (DRA), which replays agent trajectories, traces every block (unit) of the final patch to the step that wrote it, reverts each unit, and reruns the task tests to decide whether the unit is needed. We apply DRA to 7,660 resolved GitHub Copilot CLI trajectories from 18 frontier models on SWE-bench Verified (6,728) and DeepSWE (932), and grade developer patches using the same method. Agent patches do change more lines than developers'; on SWE-bench Verified the majority of extra edits add tests (61%) and documentation (13%) while on DeepSWE, most extra edits are code (58%). On both benchmarks, agents' code is on average at least as necessary as developers' (mean $NP_{code}$ 0.887 vs. 0.864 on SWE-bench Verified, where 11 of 18 models leave less unneeded code than developers, and 0.797 vs. 0.785 on DeepSWE). On average, 11% of an agent patch's code units on SWE-bench Verified are still unneeded, and 89% of those change behavior. Debug steps write almost none of the unneeded code. Code necessity differs substantially by model; it is unrelated to resolve rate on SWE-bench Verified and negatively correlated with it on DeepSWE (Spearman -0.59, p = 0.01). On SWE-bench Verified, pruning with DRA using only the tests the agent can see (its own tests and the repository's) removes the majority of unneeded code but also some needed code (67% recall, 46% precision), and 89% of pruned patches still resolve the task; asking the agent to audit its own diff is more precise but less effective (36% recall, 66% precision). We recommend that benchmarks report code necessity next to resolve rate and that over-editing be addressed through model training and harness-level pruning.

translation.title: 编码智能体过度编辑有多严重，为什么？——仓库级智能体补丁中不必要编辑的实证研究
translation.abstract: 智能体补丁比开发者的更大，这通常被解读为过度编辑。但补丁大小并不能说明多余的编辑是否必要、是什么以及从何而来。我们提出 Delta Residue Attribution（DRA），它重放智能体轨迹，将最终补丁的每个代码块（单元）追溯到写入它的步骤，回退每个单元并重新运行任务测试，以判断该单元是否必要。我们将 DRA 应用于 18 个前沿模型在 SWE-bench Verified（6,728 条）和 DeepSWE（932 条）上的 7,660 条已解决的 GitHub Copilot CLI 轨迹，并用相同方法对开发者补丁进行评分。智能体补丁确实比开发者改动更多行；在 SWE-bench Verified 上，多余的编辑大多数是新增测试（61%）和文档（13%），而在 DeepSWE 上，多余的编辑大多是代码（58%）。在两个基准上，智能体代码平均至少与开发者代码同样必要（SWE-bench Verified 上平均 NP_code 为 0.887 对 0.864，其中 18 个模型中有 11 个留下的不必要代码比开发者少；DeepSWE 上为 0.797 对 0.785）。平均而言，SWE-bench Verified 上智能体补丁中 11% 的代码单元仍是不必要的，其中 89% 会改变行为。调试步骤几乎不产生不必要代码。代码必要性因模型差异显著；在 SWE-bench Verified 上与解决率无关，在 DeepSWE 上与解决率负相关（Spearman -0.59，p = 0.01）。在 SWE-bench Verified 上，仅使用智能体可见的测试（其自建测试和仓库测试）进行 DRA 剪枝可去除大部分不必要代码，但也会去除一些必要代码（召回率 67%，精确率 46%），且 89% 的剪枝后补丁仍能解决任务；让智能体审计自己的 diff 更精确但效果较差（召回率 36%，精确率 66%）。我们建议基准在解决率之外同时报告代码必要性，并通过模型训练和 harness 层面的剪枝来解决过度编辑问题。
translation.brief: 针对智能体补丁中不必要编辑难以判定的问题，提出 DRA 方法，通过重放轨迹、逐单元回退并重跑测试来判定每个编辑单元的必要性。

papers.title: Agentic LongLive: Asynchronous Agentic Memory for Long Video Generation
papers.abstract: Real-time autoregressive video generators stream minutes of video and accept new prompts on the fly, but struggle to keep people, objects, and places consistent over a long interactive story. Agent systems provide such memory for offline multi-shot generation, yet they read the whole script in advance, plan each shot before generating it, and regenerate failed shots, which a live stream does not allow. We present Agentic LongLive, an asynchronous agentic memory for long video generation. A memory agent on separate GPUs reads only the prompts revealed so far, never the generated video, and keeps a text state and evolving images for every person, object, and scene. From this entity memory it composes a global image and a per-shot memory image, which an auxiliary GPU prefills into the generator's attention sink before the next shot starts, and writes entity cards for the prompts that name them, so the video never waits for memory and video errors are not written back. A small language model, trained with reinforcement learning and an image reward calibrated using downstream video outcomes, decides what to remember before the next prompt is known. On LongStory-Online, a new benchmark of 25 stories (857 shots) revealed one shot at a time, Agentic LongLive improves persistent-state accuracy of LongLive-2.0, its base generator, by 26.3 points, protagonist identity by 44.9, and revisited-place consistency by 40.4, at about 1% extra generation time on H100. The full system streams faster than real time on one 8xB200 node with the generator in BF16 (34.3 FPS), keeps image quality stable over 14-minute stories, and improves identity on two MiniMax-H3 generators, one of which, LongLive-H3, also runs in real time with it. To our knowledge, it is the first real-time video generator with text and image memory kept by an LLM agent.

translation.title: Agentic LongLive：面向长视频生成的异步智能体记忆
translation.abstract: 实时自回归视频生成器可以流式生成数分钟视频并即时接受新提示，但难以在长交互故事中保持人物、物体和场景的一致性。智能体系统可为离线多镜头生成提供此类记忆，但它们会预先读取整个剧本、在生成前规划每个镜头并重新生成失败镜头，这些在实时流中都不允许。我们提出 Agentic LongLive，一种面向长视频生成的异步智能体记忆。运行在独立 GPU 上的记忆智能体只读取目前已揭示的提示，从不读取已生成的视频，并为每个人物、物体和场景维护文本状态和不断更新的图像。基于该实体记忆，它合成一张全局图像和每张镜头的记忆图像，由辅助 GPU 在下一镜头开始前预填充到生成器的 attention sink 中，并为提及它们的提示写入实体卡片，因此视频无需等待记忆，视频错误也不会被写回。一个小型语言模型通过强化学习训练，并使用基于下游视频结果校准的图像奖励，在下一个提示未知之前决定记住什么。在 LongStory-Online（一个包含 25 个故事、857 个镜头、逐镜头揭示的新基准）上，Agentic LongLive 将其基础生成器 LongLive-2.0 的持久状态准确率提升 26.3 分，主角身份一致性提升 44.9，重访场景一致性提升 40.4，在 H100 上仅增加约 1% 的生成时间。完整系统在单个 8xB200 节点上以 BF16 运行生成器时流式速度超过实时（34.3 FPS），在 14 分钟故事中保持图像质量稳定，并在两个 MiniMax-H3 生成器上提升身份一致性，其中 LongLive-H3 与之配合也能实时运行。据我们所知，这是首个由 LLM 智能体维护文本和图像记忆的实时视频生成器。
translation.brief: 针对实时长视频生成中人物、物体和场景一致性问题，提出异步智能体记忆系统，由独立 GPU 上的记忆智能体维护实体记忆并预填充到生成器注意力中。

papers.title: $μ$-Bench: Benchmarking Multi-User Task Completion in Shared Interaction Voice Agents
papers.abstract: Voice agents in shared spaces must satisfy interdependent multi-user requests while upholding per-user authority, privacy, and task constraints. Existing evaluations offer limited coverage when participants react throughout a session. We introduce $\mu$-Bench, a benchmark for joint task completion in closed-loop, full-duplex multi-user voice interaction. Simulated participants act from isolated profiles of goals, knowledge, and permissions, adapting to the agent's speech and tool outcomes. Across 20 domains, 100 scenarios vary group size, acoustics, and follow-up demands to form 800 cases (408 tool-augmented, 392 tool-free). Joint Task Success (JTS) requires all user goals, privacy boundaries, and terminal states to hold jointly, while Pure JTS further disallows unauthorized tool calls; Attribution, Threading, and Coordination (ATC) diagnostics localize failures. Across 13 voice agents, proprietary systems peak at 62.24\% tool-free and 65.44\% tool-augmented success, while open-weight models remain below 20\%.
