ATC diagnostics show that open-weight models lag primarily in multi-turn attribution and threading, and controlled contrasts reveal that larger groups consistently degrade joint task success across capable systems. By coupling reactive multi-user simulation with verifiable session-level outcomes, $\mu$-Bench provides a rigorous testbed for shared voice agents.

translation.title: μ-Bench：共享交互语音智能体中多用户任务完成的基准测试
translation.abstract: 共享空间中的语音智能体必须满足相互依赖的多用户请求，同时维护每个用户的权限、隐私和任务约束。当参与者在整个会话中持续反应时，现有评估的覆盖能力有限。我们提出 μ-Bench，一个用于闭环、全双工多用户语音交互中联合任务完成的基准。模拟参与者基于各自隔离的目标、知识和权限档案行动，并根据智能体的语音和工具结果进行调整。该基准覆盖 20 个领域、100 个场景，变化群体规模、声学环境和后续需求，共构成 800 个案例（408 个带工具、392 个无工具）。联合任务成功（JTS）要求所有用户目标、隐私边界和终止状态同时成立，而 Pure JTS 进一步禁止未授权的工具调用；归因、线程与协调（ATC）诊断用于定位失败。在 13 个语音智能体上，专有系统在无工具和带工具场景下分别最高达到 62.24% 和 65.44% 的成功率，而开源权重模型低于 20%。ATC 诊断显示开源权重模型主要在多轮归因和线程方面落后，受控对比表明更大的群体规模会持续降低各能力较强系统的联合任务成功率。通过将响应式多用户模拟与可验证的会话级结果相结合，μ-Bench 为共享语音智能体提供了一个严格的测试平台。
translation.brief: 针对共享空间语音智能体多用户任务完成缺乏评估的问题，构建 μ-Bench 基准，通过响应式多用户模拟和会话级可验证指标评估智能体表现。

papers.title: Diverse Alternative Reasoning Traces for Hard Math Problems
papers.abstract: Post-training large language models (LLMs) for mathematical reasoning often relies on accepted traces whose final answers pass a verifier. For hard math problems, however, such traces can be rare under independent Monte Carlo (MC) sampling. To address this, we propose Diverse Alternative Reasoning Traces (DART), a trace-mining method that starts from a rejected trace, decomposes it into reasoning steps, and ranks them by position-weighted uncertainty. It then generates deliberately distinct alternative candidates for highly ranked steps using reference-answer guidance and a meta-thought before completing the resulting traces. On greedy-unsolved DeepMath-103K problems, DART recovers 37% more problems than MC sampling at a matched number of generated traces. Its estimated generation cost per recovered problem is nearly identical, while its cost per accepted trace is 30% lower. Post-training Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct on traces mined by DART achieves the highest point estimate in five of six evaluations across MATH-500 and AIME benchmarks. These results demonstrate that revisiting rejected traces with DART can expand problem coverage and provide effective post-training data.

translation.title: 面向困难数学问题的多样化替代推理轨迹
translation.abstract: 大语言模型（LLM）的数学推理后训练通常依赖最终答案通过验证器的已接受轨迹。然而对于困难的数学问题，在独立蒙特卡洛（MC）采样下这类轨迹可能非常稀少。为此，我们提出 Diverse Alternative Reasoning Traces（DART），一种轨迹挖掘方法：从一个被拒绝的轨迹出发，将其分解为推理步骤，并按位置加权不确定性排序，然后借助参考答案引导和元思考（meta-thought）为高排名步骤生成刻意不同的替代候选，再补全由此产生的轨迹。在贪心解码无法解决的 DeepMath-103K 问题上，在生成轨迹数量相同的情况下，DART 比 MC 采样多恢复 37% 的问题。其每个恢复问题的估计生成成本几乎相同，而每条已接受轨迹的成本降低 30%。使用 DART 挖掘的轨迹对 Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct 进行后训练，在 MATH-500 和 AIME 基准的六项评估中有五项获得最高点估计。这些结果表明，用 DART 重新审视被拒绝的轨迹可以扩大问题覆盖范围并提供有效的后训练数据。
translation.brief: 针对困难数学问题中通过验证的推理轨迹稀少的问题，提出 DART 方法，从被拒绝轨迹中分解步骤并生成多样化的替代推理候选以扩充后训练数据。

papers.title: Attack Policy Selection can Mislead Monitor Evaluators
papers.abstract: AI monitors, classifiers that flag dangerous behaviour by AI agents, are often evaluated against transcripts generated by attack policies acting as proxies for dangerous behaviour in deployment. We evaluate an ex-production OpenAI monitor as a case study and find that measured false negative rate is highly sensitive to both the method used to generate attack policies and the level of optimisation applied within that method. This rate ranged from 0.5\% to 20.8\% across optimisation levels of a single method (reinforcement learning), and from 6.4\% to 23.0\% across methods at their best observed optimisation level (optimised prompting vs.\ transcript editing). Every attack policy was developed against proxy monitors only: all reported results show attacks transferring to the held-out GPT-5.4 target monitor. Our results suggest that monitor evasion evaluations can easily mislead: an evaluation using only basic attack methods may give false confidence that a monitor is strong. The sensitivity to attack-policy choice raises a problem: interpreting any particular result as evidence about deployment performance requires justification. The transcripts produced by attack policies are proxies for the dangerous behaviour a monitor must flag in deployment. These proxies can introduce visible artefacts, such as reasoning about a ``side task'' absent from the instructions shown to the monitor, that affect monitor judgements. Given the sensitivity above, the choice of proxy can change an evaluation's conclusion. Reading these results as evidence about deployment therefore requires a separate legitimacy argument for why the proxies are informative, including any justification of conservativeness. Making convincing arguments remains an open problem.

translation.title: 攻击策略选择可能误导监控器评估
translation.abstract: AI 监控器是标记 AI 智能体危险行为的分类器，通常通过与攻击策略生成的对话记录进行对比来评估，这些攻击策略充当部署中危险行为的代理。我们以一个曾投入生产的 OpenAI 监控器为案例进行评估，发现测得的假阴性率对生成攻击策略的方法以及该方法内部的优化程度都高度敏感。在单一方法（强化学习）的不同优化级别下，该比率在 0.5% 到 20.8% 之间变化；在各自最佳优化级别下跨方法（优化提示 vs. 对话记录编辑）则在 6.4% 到 23.0% 之间变化。每个攻击策略都仅针对代理监控器开发：所有报告结果均显示攻击可迁移到留出的 GPT-5.4 目标监控器。我们的结果表明，监控器规避评估很容易产生误导：仅使用基础攻击方法的评估可能给人监控器很强的错误信心。对攻击策略选择的敏感性带来一个问题：将任何特定结果解读为关于部署性能的证据都需要论证。攻击策略生成的对话记录是监控器在部署中必须标记的危险行为的代理，这些代理可能引入明显的痕迹，例如对监控器未见指令中不存在的“side task”进行推理，从而影响监控器判断。鉴于上述敏感性，代理的选择可能改变评估的结论。因此，将这些结果解读为关于部署的证据，需要对代理为何具有信息量进行单独的正当性论证，包括对保守性的任何辩护。如何做出令人信服的论证仍是一个开放问题。
translation.brief: 针对 AI 监控器评估中攻击策略选择影响结果可信度的问题，通过案例研究揭示假阴性率对攻击方法和优化程度高度敏感，并论证评估结论需要代理正当性论证。

papers.title: Tracking Any Point with Agentic Visual Reasoning
papers.abstract: A general-purpose Vision-Language Model (VLM) has surpassed expert vision models in many domains such as object detection and video recognition. However, point correspondence is known to be challenging for VLMs since it goes beyond object-level recognition: it requires pixel-level localization of the same physical surface point across observations, even when appearance changes or the point disappears and later reappears. In this paper, we introduce AgenTAP, a VLM-based agent that directly predicts point coordinates and visibility and actively reasons over videos. Starting from its own estimate, the agent autonomously chooses what to inspect and uses the resulting evidence to verify point identity and refine its predictions. With GPT-6 Astra, it surpasses expert vision models in both point localization and visibility prediction, without correspondence-specific fine-tuning. We further use AgenTAP to re-identify physical points after disappearance and reconnect fragmented tracks, constructing EgoTAP-4D, a dataset of 3D point trajectories in long real-world egocentric videos. On sampled reappearing points, its predictions approach human agreement, and adding EgoTAP-4D to D4RT training improves average 3D tracking performance.

translation.title: 基于智能体视觉推理的任意点跟踪
translation.abstract: 通用视觉语言模型（VLM）在目标检测和视频识别等许多领域已超越专家视觉模型。然而，点对应关系对VLM来说众所周知是困难的，因为它超越了对象级识别：它需要在观测之间对同一物理表面点进行像素级定位，即使外观发生变化或该点消失后又重新出现。本文提出AgenTAP，一个基于VLM的智能体，可直接预测点坐标和可见性，并对视频进行主动推理。智能体从自身估计出发，自主选择要检查的内容，并利用所得证据验证点的身份并细化预测。借助GPT-6 Astra，它在点定位和可见性预测上均超越专家视觉模型，且无需针对对应关系的微调。我们进一步使用AgenTAP在点消失后重新识别物理点并重新连接碎片化轨迹，构建了EgoTAP-4D，一个来自长真实世界自我中心视频的3D点轨迹数据集。在采样的重现点上，其预测接近人类一致性，且将EgoTAP-4D加入D4RT训练可提升平均3D跟踪性能。
translation.brief: 针对VLM难以进行像素级点对应跟踪的问题，提出基于VLM的智能体AgenTAP，通过主动视觉推理直接预测点坐标与可见性，并构建EgoTAP-4D数据集。
